༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs/ /rgya gar skad du/sarba bu

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI095_gsang 'dus chos byung legs bshad ngo mtshar bang mdzod/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ sarba buddha sya ru pa badzra dha ra buddha dhwa dza ye na mā mi/ bod skad du/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pa zas gtsang sras po yi/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma 'phags mchog klu sgrub sogs/ /'phags yul mdzes par byed pa'i skyes chen dang / /'gos lo la sogs skad gnyis smra rnams rgyal/ /kun dga'i chu gter yid 'ong 'khyil pa'i dbus/ /zab don snying po'i me tog 'bum ldan dang / /bsod nams mi zad chu bo rab brtan pa'i/ /phan bde'i 'bras bzang rtse mor son de'ang rgyal/ /rnam dkar grags pa'i rgyal mtshan ches mtho dang / /'gro kun dga' ba'i 'bras bu yongs stsol ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i bla chen gang / /'phags mchog la sogs rje btsun thams cad rgyal/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras dang / /rdo rje 'chang chen ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zol/ /rgyal ba mus pa chen por snying nas 'dud/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams/ /'phags pa'i yul dang bod 'dir byung ba'i tshul/ /legs bshad ngo mtshar rin chen bang mdzod 'di/ /lhag bsam dag pas bshad la dga' bas nyon/ /ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas nyan par bdams te/ 'dir bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye gsang gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don 'di'i sa bcad don chen po so so'i snying po rnams bsdus pa'i legs bshad nyung ngu zhig brtsams na blo dman rnams la mkho bar snang yang /

'dir don tshan so so ma 'dres par yongs rdzogs bris pa'i dgos pa ni/ rje bla ma gong ma de dag gi gsung rgyun ngo mtshar can rnams kyi tshig zur tshun yang ma nyams par/ rjes 'jug rnam dpyod can rnams kyis mthong ba'i tshe dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa chen po 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i phyir yi ge'i dka' tshegs ma bskyungs par bris pa yin pas blo gsal dpyod ldan rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzad 'tshal lo/ /'on kyang las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ don tshan 'di dag gi snying po 'dus pa'i legs bshad nyung ngu zhig logs su 'chad par bdag spro 'o/ tshan bdun gyi sgo nas ston te/ rje btsun bla ma mchog gi gsung rgyun las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ paṇa chen gung ru'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ mkhas pa kun blo'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ nyi zla seṅge'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ rjes 'jug mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po rje btsun bla ma mchog gi gsung rgyun las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ bdag gi bla ma khams gsum gyi 'dren pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo/ sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ mdo rgyud kun gyi glegs bam gcig pu ba/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid/ gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na g.yo ba de nyid kyis/ rje nyid dgung gi lo bdun bcu don drug bzhes shing / kho bo cag rang lo nyer gcig lon pa'i sbrul lo nag pa zla ba la gling dga' bde ba can gyi yang dben bsam gtan phug gi gnas mchog de nyid du bdag sogs dad ldan gyi slob ma 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams gsung ba'i tshe/

sngon du 'gro ba spyi'i rnam gzhag rnams 'chad pa'i skabs su/ rje btsun gong ma rnams dang gnyis su med pa'i rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ dpon slob rnams kyi gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung zhes 'di'i bla ma/ rje btsun dam pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje/ de nyid kyi sku mthong ba tsam dang / tshul khrims kyi dri bsung tshor ma thag chos ra der blo lhing phebs shing rtog pa rags pa rnams rang 'gags su khrig 'gro zhing zhal gyi dkyil 'khor kho na la lta ba las yid gzhan du mi 'phro ba dang / thugs lhag bsam rnam par dag cing ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i rgyun la chos gsung ba'i dus kyang skabs skabs su yug re 'byams 'gro ba dang / bsnyun gsung las/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las de bzhin du 'byung bas 'di bzhin du bsgoms na srid pa hrul por 'jig pa la tshegs med ces nyams ldan gyi tshig 'ga' gsungs pa'i tshe de ma thag chos dang bla ma nges shes khyad par can dbang med du skye ba dang skye bo phal pa zhig yin yang zhal mthong zhing gsung thos pa tsam gyis sems rnal du phebs shing mi lus thengs gcig tsam thob pa 'di don dang ldan pa byas so snyam pa'i dga' spro khyad par can bskyed pa dang / bdag rang gi bsam pa la yang bla ma sangs rgyas mi gzugs can 'di 'dra ba'i drung du/ rgyud sde'i nges gsang sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med 'di lta bu thos shing nyams su len pa'i skal ba 'di 'dra a re dga' snyam pa'i dad pa dang spro ba rang shugs kyis skye ba dang bcas/ rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa bka' drin can de nyid bdag cag slob ma rnams kyi dbus der sku mdzes shing zil che la bag gro ba de drang por bsrangs nas zhal dkyil zla ba rgyas pa'i spyan gnyis utpal lta bu'i slob bu'i tshogs la dal bur gzigs shing / dpal gyi mgul nas rnam 'phrul gyi ljags bskyangs te/

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa nyid la sku tshe hril por sbyangs pa ltar lugs 'di'i rgyas bshad/ don bsdus/ dka' gnad kyi bshad pa sogs gang mdzad kyang de kho na la sbyangs pa ltar dpyod ldan kun gyi rna bar snyan cing snying la 'bab pa'i gsung gis ha cang dal ba dang / brel ba'i skyon spangs pa'i dag gsal snyan pa'i sgo nas nyin rang po chos kyi grwar zhugs kyang skyo sun cung zad kyang mi bskyed pa'i ngang nas 'di ltar gsungs te/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan snyam pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang gnas khang srung ba'i 'khor lor bsgom pa/ rang nyid kyang dpal gsang ba 'dus par bsgom pa/ slob dpon zla grogs rnams kyang der bsgom zhing / dus ston pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos gsungs pa'i dus de nyid yin snyam pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag gi rgyud las/ brtul zhugs mthar thug sangs rgyas thod/ /las tshogs mthar thug gshin rje gshed/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /zhes rgyud sde gzhan nas che bstod mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'chad par byed pa lags/ 'di la 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bshad srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod kyang / slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs 'grel bar byed/ de la yang rgyud 'chad pa'i dbang du byas pa dang / man ngag 'chad pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis las dang po rgyud 'chad pa la/ 'chad byed kyi 'grel pa sgron gsal ni rtsa bar gyur pa yin la/ de las gzhan 'grel pa 'phags lugs bzhi tsam yod pa ni de'i yan lag tu gyur pa yin no/ /gnyis pa man ngag 'chad par byed pa la/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis bkral ba'i man ngag gi chos skor byung tshul spyir bstan pa dang /

de ltar byung ba'i man ngag zab mo dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdog pa'i bla ma gong ma yan chad du byung tshul bla ma'i rnam thar lta bu'i zhar la cung zad tsam bstan pa ma gtogs/ zur du phyogs 'byams yi ger bkod pa med la/ de'i rjes su brlan rtsad tsa nyi ma lcam gyis mdzad pa'i sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad byung tshul bris pa rnams/ khong gsang 'dus la sbyangs pa che ba legs po yin mod kyang re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag de'i rjes su bu ston pas rgyud 'grel gyi byung tshul/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo nyid kyi spyi rnam la gzhi byas/ der 'dus pa'i byung tshul rgyas par bshad na'ang rgya ches pa dang / dbang rgyud dang / bshad rgyud kyi rim pa sna tshogs yang ni snang / legs cha'ang mang mod na'ang 'dir de'ang btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa rnams rgyud sde dang 'grel ba'i man ngag zab mo gang 'chad kyang de dag gi gzhung tshad mar gyur pa rnams la brten nas byung tshul mdzad pa ltar/ 'dir yang de dang mthun par/ spyir sde snod rnams byung tshul gsum du dbye ba/ bye brag gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i rnam par gzhag pa/ de las kyang 'dus pa'i byung tshul/ dang po ni/ spyod bsdus su/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i gzugs kyis dman pa nyan thos kyi theg pa bden pa bzhi la sogs pa'i lam bstan 'bras bu la bkod/ de nas gdul bya nga rgyal can rnams gzung ba'i phyir ston pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i gzugs de nyid kyis sa dang phar phyin gyi lam bstan/ 'bras bu la bkod/ de nas 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyis zab mo sngags kyi theg pa gsungs/ gdul bya rnams 'bras bu mchog la bkod ces pa la sogs pa 'byung bas theg pa gsum du byed/ de bzhin du shanti pa'i theg gsum rnam gzhag slob dpon dran pa'i ye shes grags kyi bde gshegs kyi bka' mtha' dag bsdus te bshad pa zhes pa'i bstan bcos dang /

ṭi pi ta ka ma la'i tshul gsum sgron me rnams las kyang / dman pa nyan thos kyi theg pa/ rgya che ba sa dang phar phyin gyi theg pa/ zab mo sngags kyi theg pa/ zhes theg pa gsum du chos kun bsdu bar mdzad do/ /sngags kyi theg pa phar phyin theg pa'i khongs su 'du mod kyang shin tu zab pa'i theg pa yin pas 'phags skor ba'i lugs kyis 'di bzhin du gsungs pa yin no/ /bye brag tu sngags kyi theg pa bshad pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa gang gi don du gsungs na/ skye bo 'dod chags can don du/ /zhes gsungs pas 'dod chags can gyi don du gsungs/ bla med kho na de'i don du yin gyi rgyud sde 'og ma rnams ma yin nam snyam na/ 'dir bshad pa'i 'dod chags can gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa kho na la bya ba min gyi/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang / /rgod dang blta ba dag gi yang / /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyi/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sbyang bya 'dod chags can la rigs mang po yod pas/ de dag sbyong byed du rgyud sde rnams gsungs pa yin te/ de'i bya rgyud lta bu re re la'ang dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang / de'i tshul gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'o na rgyud sde de dag bsdu na dur grangs nges snyam na/ 'di'i tshul la/ slob dpon a bhya ka ras rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod de/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad ni/ /ston pas rgyud sde gnyis su bsdus/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon kun snying gsum du 'dod de/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /zhes so/ /rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig dang rje btsun sa skya pa la sogs pa bod phal cher ba kyai rdor rgyud gsum nas 'byung ba'i shes byed kyi lung drangs nas rgyud sde bzhir 'dod de/ rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyi/ /zhes so/ /shanti pa sogs rgya gar ba phal cher rgyud sde lngar 'dod de/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla ma la pha ma gnyis su dbye bas lnga'o/

/rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba rnams rgyud sde drug tu 'dod de/ sngar gyi lnga'i steng du ma'i ma rnal 'byor gsang mtha' zhes so/ /jo bo rjes mdzad par grags pa'i lam sgron rang 'grel du/ sngar gyi steng du rtog pa'i rgyud ces bsnan pas bdun du 'dod do/ /rtog pa'i rgyud ni padma gar gyi dbang phyug go zhes so/ /lam sgron 'di las dbu sems kyi sems bskyed phyogs gcig tu byed par bshad/ bka' gdam pa la la tshad mar byed/ la la 'di tshad mar mi byed do/ /bus 'di'i lung drangs pa mang po yang yod/ jo bos mdzad par grags pa'i zhes/ btags chos su'ang res 'ga' bzhed cing dgag pa mdzad pa'ang mang po yod do/ /slob dpon yab sras 'di pa'i lugs kyi rgyud sde lngar 'dod de/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyud sde ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / gnyis ka'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / bya ba'i rgyud dang / rtog pa'i rgyud dang rnam grangs lnga'o zhes grangs nges gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag re re'i tshad rnam par gzhag pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la ni stong phrag bcu gnyis so/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud la ni stong phrag drug go /spyod pa'i rgyud la ni stong phrag brgyad do/ /bya ba'i rgyud la stong phrag bzhi'o/ /rtog pa'i rgyud la ni stong phrag bzhi'o/ /zhes de nyid las gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i rgyud sde'i grangs de dag rgyud sde re re'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ shlau ka'i dbang du byas pa ni ma yin te/ don zhags kyi rtog pa cho ga zhib mo la yang shlau ka stong phrag brgyad yod do zhes rje btsun rtse mos gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la stong phrag bcu gnyis zhes pa'ang rnal 'byor pha'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na ma rgyud la bye ba phrag drug yod par bshad pa'i phyir te/

sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud kyi grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni drug tu nges/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud sde de dag gi mtshan gzhi ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud ni de nyid 'dus pa sogs la rnal 'byor rgyud du byas pa dang / 'dus pa sogs rnal 'byor bla med la byas pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma yin te/ sgron gsal las/ dpal ldan 'dus pa rnal 'byor rgyud la mtha' drug gis ni rnam phye ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lugs gnyis kas kyang rnal 'byor gyi sgra don mi 'dor te/ de'i don/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ rnal 'byor gyi skad dod la yo ga zhes bya la/ sgra'i bstan bcos las yo rtsir sbyor ba la'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ gnyis mnyam par sbyar ba zhig yin la/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs par lha'i rnal 'byor dang / stong pa nyid ro gcig tu sbyar ba bshad pas rnal 'byor rgyud yin la/ 'dus pa bas 'od gsal stong pa nyid dang / lha sku sgyu ma lta bu zung 'jug tu sbyar bas na rnal 'byor zhes bshad de/ zab cing rgya che bshad gang la/ /rnam par mi rtog dang po ste/ /gnyis pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /sgyu ma lta bu/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /sgyu ma lta bu de ci zhe na/ chos kun rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhes/ /sangs rgyas pa kun smra mod kyi/ /bdag byin rlabs las phyir gyur pas/ /rmi lam sgyu 'drar rtogs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud 'di pas de nyid 'dus pa sogs la bzhed pa yin te/ slob dpon klu byang gis/ rdo rje slob dpon la gsol pa/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa gnyis ka'i rgyud las ni/ lha thams cad zhal gcig pa lta bur gsungs na/ 'dir ci'i phyir zhal gsum pa lta bur bsgrags zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bu ston pas 'di'i gnyis ka'i rgyud spyod rgyud la mdzad pas/

rtsa rgyud du/ dngos grub kun gyi 'bras 'dod phyir/ /sngags shes pas ni sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshim pa dang mgu bar bya ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya ste/ gnyis ka'i rgyud las bshad pa'i cho gas so/ /zhes gsungs nas gnyis ka'i rgyud rnam snang mngon byang la byas/ 'dus pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnam snang mngon byang nas bshad pa'i cho ga gyong se ba gcig gis mdzad de/ grub mtha' 'chugs pa yin no zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris rnams las gsungs/ dge ldan pa'i lugs la yang / 'dir bshad pa'i gnyis ka'i rgyud spyod rgyud la 'chad de/ rang gis byas pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa'i 'grel par de kho na nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa dang / gnyis ka'i rgyud rnam snang mngon byang las kyang / zhes sogs kyis 'bru gnon byas nas dogs spong yang / de kho na nyid 'dus pa las gtso bo zhal bzhi par bshad kyang / 'dir 'khor gyis dbang du byas pa'o zhes zer ba shin tu mi 'thad de/ 'di gnyis ka'i rgyud rnam snang mngon byang du 'dod na/ der lha thams cad zhal gcig par ma gsungs te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang / zhal gsum phyag drug pa la sogs pa zhal mang phyag mang bshad pas/ lha thams cad kyi tshig gsungs pa don med par thal ba'i skyon yod do/ /de nyid 'dus pa las gtso bo zhal bzhi par bshad kyang / zhes sogs kyi dogs spong mi dgos te/ rgyud sde'i dngos bstan gtso bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ gcig las ma bshad pas/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyi rjes su 'brangs pa rnams kyis grub chen kun snying la 'di skad ces khyod kyis rdor dbyings kyi gtso bo zhal bzhi par byas pas mi 'thad de/ de nyid 'dus par zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes rgol ba la/ kun snying na re/ bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang rtsa ba'i rgyud ngan song sbyong rgyud las zhal bzhi pa las zhes bshad do zhes bsgrubs pas de'i lugs yin gyi/

rgyud kyi dngos bstan rang zhal gcig pa yin pas/ klu byang gis de'i dbang du mdzad do zhes sogs rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun bris pa rnams las 'di ltar 'byung zhes mtha' sel gyi dgag sgrub mang du gsungs shing / de la 'phros nas spyir grub mtha' 'di la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung ste/ mtshan nyid theg pa'i grub mtha' bzhi la/ lta ba'i gnad la nang gses kyi dbye ba mi 'dra ba so sor yang 'di dang 'di 'dod ces zhib tu gsungs pa dang / khyad par bod gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dbu ma'i lta ba gcig pu la yang mkhas grub so so'i 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung ste/ skyes mchog dam pa 'di dang 'di'i gsung rab las 'di dang 'di ltar du 'byung zhes/ mkhas pa so so'i bzhed srol rnams rgyas par gsungs te/ mthar mdo sngags kyi don la 'khrul pa zad pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa 'di ltar yin zhes lag par 'chang du yod pa lta bu'i sngar mkhas pa rnams kyi blo ngor ma shar ba'i legs bshad kyi tshogs du ma zhig stsal mod kyang / de dag gi rgyas bshad rnams ni 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /des na bu dge sogs gnyis ka'i rgyud spyod rgyud la 'dod cing slob ma rnams la grags mod kyang / slob dpon yab sras 'di pa gsang 'dus sogs deng sang bla med du grags pa la rnal 'byor dang / de nyid 'dus pa sogs/ yo gar grags pa la gnyis ka'i rgyud kyi tha snyad mdzad do/ /spyod rgyud ni rnam snang mngon byang sogs so/ /rtog pa'i rgyud ni bya rgyud las logs su gyur pa med la/ 'on kyang rje btsun rtse mos/ spyir bya rgyud yin pa la/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa gtso bor ston pa la bya rgyud dang / las tshogs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud la rtog pa zhes mdzad de lags so/ /de la bya rgyud ni/ dpung bzang dang legs grub sogs so/ /rgyud sde de dag gi ming ji lta bu yin snyam na/

ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ ka kha zhes nas/ sha ṣa sa de rnams kyi ming gi mtha' can no zhes gsungs pas/ mtha' can zhes pa ni mtshon pa ste thog ma can dang / dbus can yang thob pa yin no/ /sarba buddha sa ma bhyo ga zhes pa sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba ga'i mtha' can/ badzra ma la zhes pa rdo rje phreng ba/ la'i mtha' can lta bu'o/ /ye shes rdo rje kun las btus su/ gsal byed so gsum las ma gsungs shing / sgron gsal du so bzhi bshad pa dang po'i ka dang mtha' ma'i ṣa bsdebs pa kṣa zhes pa bsnan/ de'i mtha' can yang yod de/ pañtsa rakṣa zhes pa bsrung ba lnga'i rgyud lta bu'o/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di ni 'gos rdog pa rnams kyis tha ma'i sa dang / dbus nas a dang / dang po'i dza rnams kyi mtshan dang ldan pa/ sa ma dza/ 'dus pa zhes pa gsal byed so bzhi'i mtha' can gyi rgyud sde stong phrag so bzhi'i rgyal po lta bu yin no zhes bshad la/ snyan grags bzang pos ni/ rgyud phyi mar 'di'i mtshan/ /de yi rtsa ba yi ge gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ yin/ de gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yin la/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud yin pas gsang ba 'dus pa zhes gsungs pa'ang de bzhin du bshad du rung ba tsam yin mod kyang / 'dir/ de yi rtsa ba yi ge gsum/ /zhes pa 'gos kyis sa ma dza la bshad pas de nyid tshad mar bzung / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ de ltar rgyud sde'i ming gsungs nas rgyud sde de dag gi nges pa yang gsungs te/ gang du bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la zhugs nas mtha' drug gi bshad pas rab tu phye ba ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la zhugs so zhes gsungs te/ don ni rgyud sde gang du rdzogs rim bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin ston zhing / rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la zhes pa la bshad pa mang yang 'dir chos 'byung gi dbus su gzhal yas khang gi nang du rang nyid lha'i skur gsal ba bskyed pa'i rim pa dang /

'chad pa'i mtha' drug ni dgongs pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa'i bshad pa/ sgra ji bzhin pa dang / ji bzhin ma yin pa'i bshad pa drang don dang / nges don gyi bshad pa ste drug go /rtsa rgyud 'di dang brtag gnyis lta bu drug char gyis bshad dgos pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyang yod/ drang nges lta bu gnyis kyi bshad pas chog pa'i rgyud kyang yod de/ gong gi mtshan nyid de dag mtha' dag med kyang / kha re yod pa'i rgyud ni rnal 'byor rgyud do/ /yang de nyid las/ rig ma dang lha mo dkyil 'khor la bkod pa dang / de nyid bcus bsgrub par bya ba ni gnyis ka'i rgyud la bzhugs so zhes gsungs pas/ rig ma dkyil 'khor la 'god pa ni/ kun rig lta bu la dngos su yod pa dang / rdor dbyings la/ mu stegs rgol ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs su zhes gsungs pa ltar yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan bkod pa yod pa dang / lha mo bkod pa sgeg sogs bzhi'am/ me tog ma sogs bzhi bsnan pas brgyad dkyil 'khor pa'i phyi rol tu bkod pa'i bshad pa yod pa'o/ /de nyid bcu ni/ ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dang / /'dug stangs stangs stabs bzlas brjod dang / /sbyin sreg mchod pa las sbyor dang / /slar log pa yi rnam pa ni/ /phyi yi de nyid bcur bshad do/ /zhes bshad pa ltar de nyid bcu thams cad tshang bar yod pa dang / gnyis ka'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i bzhi tsam lnga tsam yod pa yang gnyis ka'i rgyud do/ /de la ting nge 'dzin ni gsum ste/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog ste 'di dag rgyud las bshad pa bzhin nyams su len pa dang / dkyil 'khor ni rgyud sde 'di pa'i lugs kyi phyi'i rdul tshon dang ras bris la sogs pa dang / nang gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa gnyis su bshad do/ /phyag rgya ni/ las dang / chos dang / dam tshig dang / phyag chen bzhi cho ga rgyas rung bsdus rung yod dgos te/ phyag rgya bzhi yi rgyas gdab dgos/

/zhes bshad pa'o/ kha cig tu bzhi ka sngags kyis byed pa dang / kha cig tu bzhi ka lag pa'i phyag rgyas byed pa sogs mdor na rgyas bsdus gang yod kyang tshang ngo / /stangs stabs ni/ sa chog la sogs pa'i dus su g.yas brkyangs la sogs pa'i stangs ka byed pa sogs so/ /'dug stangs ni/ rnal 'byor sgom pa'i tshe lus kyi spyod lam skyil krung la sogs pa'o/ /las sbyar ni/ oṃ badzra dha tu/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis sems can rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab dang phyogs gcig byas kyang rung ngo / /sbyin sreg ni/ gnyis ka'i rgyud nyid las bshad pa'i sbyin sreg go /mchod pa ni/ dpal mchog dang po lta bu mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod pa dang / kun rig lta bu mchod pa nyer lnga pas mchod pa lta bu yin no/ /bzlas brjod ni/ yid bzlas dang / ngag bzlas zhes pa nyams su len tshul tha dad du yod de/ yid bzlas ni/ sna rtser phra mo'i rnal 'byor la sems gtad de sngags bzla ba lta bu yin la/ ngag bzlas ni/ ngag tu oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ zhes pa lta bu sgra lhang gi brjod pa'o/ /slar log pa'i cho ga'i rnam pa ni/ mjug tu rdul tshon chu bor dor ba la sogs pa rjes kyi cho ga yod pa'o/ /yang de nyid las bya ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i bzlas pa dang / las kyi cho ga rgya chen po bsgrub pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ bya rgyud nas bshad pa'i bsrung ba'i sngags dang / rigs gsum spyi'i sngags sogs bzla ba dang / de nas bshad pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i tshul ston pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud yin no/ /yang de nyid las/ 'jigs shing gtsang sbra byed pa dang / bdag nyid lha'i bsnyen pa dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba dam pa med pa ni/

bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la 'jigs shing gtsang sbra che ba bsnyung gnas la sogs pa byed pa dang / bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa rgyud kyi dngos bstan la med pa ste/ 'dir bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa zhes dmigs kyis bsal bas/ spyod rgyud yan la bdag bskyed yod par grub bo/ /ye shes sems dpa' bde ba dam pa med pa ste/ ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug med pa rnams ni bya ba'i rgyud do/ /bde ba dam pa zhes pa'i don la gnyis ka'i rgyud kyi srol 'dzin pa'i slob dpon rnams na re/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa spyod rgyud man las khyad par 'phags te/ ye shes dgug gzhug byas pa las byung ba'i bde ba yod pa'i phyir/ bde ba yod de/ 'jig rten pa pho mo'i dbang po nyi tshe ba gnyis sprad pa la'ang 'dzag bde 'byung na/ nged ye shes pa'i dbang po dang dam tshig pa'i dbang po so sor 'dres pa la bde ba ci'i phyir mi 'byung / so sor 'dres pa'i go rgyu ni/ ye shes pa'i mig gi dbang po dang / dam tshig pa'i mig gi dbang po dbyer med du 'dres/ gzhan rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /des na 'jig rten pa'i 'dzag bde las khyad par 'phags pas na dam pa'o zhes gsungs/ yang de nyid las/ sngags dang sman la sogs pa dang / bye ma dag gis las kyi cho ga rgya chen po bsgrub pa ni rtog pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so zhes pa rtog pa'i rgyud bya rgyud kyi nang tshan yin pas mtshan nyid bya ba 'dra yang / bya rgyud ni 'dir gzugs sku rjes su dran pa dang / chos sku rjes su dran pa la sogs pa lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms te tshe 'di nyid la bden pa mthong ba yan chad kyi rtogs pa bskyed nus pa'i cho ga rgyud kyi dngos bstan la yod pa la bya la/ rtog pa ni/ sngar ltar rjes dran gnyis bsgoms nas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub nor bsgrub pa la sogs dngos su ston pa'i rtog pa ste/

nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa dang / gar mkhan mchog gi rtog pa dang / gnod gnas kyi rtog pa dang / tshogs bdag gi rtog pa sogs nor bsgrub dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sogs yin no/ /slob dpon yab sras kyis rgyud sde'i dbye ba 'di bzhin byas pa la/ kha cig na re/ kyai rdor nas/ rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba ji ltar spong zhes zer na/ bshad par bya ste/ 'dir slob dpon gyis gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi'i mtha' can gyi rgyud sde stong phrag so bzhi'i rnam dbye shes par bya ba'i phyir rgyud sde lngar gsungs mod kyang / don la bzhir bsdu ba slob dpon gyi dgongs pa yin te/ rim lnga las/ sgyu lus byin gyis brlab pa'i dbang bskur skabs su dkyil 'khor chung chung gcig bshad/ der slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid bshad pa las/ chu la sogs pa'i dbang dgu thob pa/ rgyud sde bzhi'i don la mkhas pa zhes bshad/ chag lo'i mchan du/ bshad rgyud bzhi'i don la mkhas pa zhes bshad kyang / 'dir 'gos kyis rgyud sde bzhi bya ba sogs bzhi la bshad pa nyid legs te/ gsang 'dus rgyud sde stong phrag so bzhi'i gtso bo'am/ rtsa ba yin par 'dod pas na/ /'khor tu gyur pa'i rgyud sde de rnams shes dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir rgyud sde lnga bshad pa'i skabs su rtog pa'i rgyud la stong phrag bzhi'o zhes bshad pas rtog pa'i rgyud logs su ma bgrangs par bya rgyud kyi khongs su bsdus na/ gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi'i mtha' can gyi rgyud sde stong phrag so bzhi 'grig par mi 'gyur bas de rtogs par bya ba'i phyir yin la/ bzhir bsdu ba na/ rtog pa bya rgyud du bsdu'o/ /gzhan yang slob dpon yab sras kyi dgongs pa rgyud sde bzhir bsdu bar nges te klu byang gi nyi shu par/ bya ba'i rgyud ni ma gtogs par/ /spyod dang gnyis ka'i rnal 'byor rgyud/

/grub pa'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas kyi/ /tshul lugs las byung yang dag bshad/ /ces bya rgyud dang / spyod rgyud dang / rnal 'byor rgyud la gnyis ka'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i zhes pa bcad nas rnal 'byor rgyud dang gnyis gsungs kyi/ rtog pa'i rgyud ma gsungs pas/ ma rgyud pa'i rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa dang khog mthun no/ /de la bya rgyud ni rgyud sde gang nas gsang sngags kyi cho ga bshad cing / bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ma bshad pa de ni dpung bzang sogs phyed dang nyis brgya lhag tsam zhig yod do/ /bya rgyud 'di'i bdag bskyed yod med kyi tshul la/ sngon rgya gar gyi slob dpon phal che ba dang / bod kyi rje btsun sa skya pa rnams dang / 'gos kyi rjes 'brangs rnams dang / mar pa dpon slob rnams te/ mdor na bu ston ma byon bar du bdag bskyed med pa'i tshul 'di byung ba yin la/ phyis bu ston pas rgyud sde spyi rnam du/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las bdag bskyed med par gsungs shing / bod kyi bla ma rnams kyang de ltar du bzhed mod/ rgya gar gyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / rgya mtsho dang / phyed dang nyis brgya pa rnams las bdag bskyed bshad pa rnams bya rgyud la thob pa yin nam/ rgyud sde gong ma rnams kyis rgyas bkab pa yin nam brtag go zhes the tshom tsam mdzad cing / phyis don zhags kyi bshad par bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod pa 'di yin te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi lung de dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal mi byed pa la dgongs zhes gsungs so/ /chos rje ri bo dge ldan pas bya rgyud la bdag bskyed dgos te/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs kyi lung dang / 'di bltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyi rgyud yin la/ mdun du sangs rgyas kyi sku spyan ras gzigs lta bu bris/

de'i g.yon du gos dkar mo lta bu zur gyis blta ba bskyed pas bltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyi sgrub thabs su mi 'gyur te/ lha pha rol po de dag bsgoms pas rang rgyud la bde ba ster bar mi nus pa'i phyir/ des na rang nyid lha'i skur bsgom dgos pa 'dis grub pa yin zer/ khong rang tsho rigs pa 'di 'jigs rung du byed do/ /bu ston pas bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod de/ don la'ang thob cing sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa'i phyir zer ba mi 'thad de/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las bdag bskyed med par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i lung dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal med pa la dgongs zer na/ 'o na bya rgyud la dus thams cad du nga rgyal med pa'ang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bya rgyud la dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal byed par bshad pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'joms kyi 'grel pa las bzod par gsol lo/ /bsngo ba bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badzra atma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdag nyid las kyi rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bu dge gnyis kas kyang sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa'i phyir zer nas/ sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang dang / phyag rdor dbang bskur nas drangs pa'i lung rnams 'god par byed do/ /dge ldan pas sngags rim gyi thog mar rgyud sde gsum dang drug tu 'dod pa la dgag pa byas nas/ rang lugs la bzhir khas blangs pa yin la/ 'di'i skabs su bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod de/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang dang / phyag rdor dbang bskur las bshad pa'i phyir du song / de byas tsa na bya spyod gnyis rgyud sde'i sde tshan gcig tu khas blangs/ gzhan yang bya spyod la ngo bo'i sgo nas khyad med ces khas blangs tshar/ de ltar na rgyud sde bzhir grangs ma nges par 'gyur ro/ /yang de gnyis ngo bo gcig na zab khyad kyang med cing /

spyod rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi yang mi rnyed do/ /khong pa'i lugs kyi ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi 'bru non ni/ bdag bskyed med pa'i bya rgyud kha cig la dgongs lo/ /gzhan yang bya rgyud bltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyi sgrub thabs yin la/ bltas pa'i bde ba rang rgyud la bskyed pa la/ rang lta ba po lha de dang der bsgom dgos kyi/ mdun du bskyed pas rang rgyud la bde ba bskyed mi nus pa'i phyir zhes pa 'di bdag bskyed yod pa'i rigs pa drag shos yin/ 'o na skyes bu bud med la 'dod chags can zhig gis bud med la bltas pa'i bde ba rang rgyud la bskyed par 'dod na/ rang bud med du bsgom dgos par 'gyur ro/ /rang rgyud la bud med la bltas pa'i bde ba bskyed pa la/ rang lta ba po bud med du bsgom dgos na ha cang thal lo/ /kho na re/ nged kyis rnam byang la byed la/ khyod kyis de kun nas nyon mongs kyi phyogs yin lan du mi rung ngo zer te/ lce ma chad tsam gyi lan du zad do/ /zhes ngor pa'i zin bris 'ga' zhig tu bris 'dug pa sngon rje rdo rje 'chang dang / chos rje ri bo dge ldan pa dngos kyi gsung gleng mang po byung tshod gda' bas de skabs kyi gsung sgros 'dra gsungs pa zin bris pa rnams kyis sgra ji bzhin pa bkod par 'dug gsungs/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ rnal 'byor chen po pas mdun du lha bskyed pa des sgrub pa po'i rgyud la bde ba lam du byed dam mi byed/ byed na/ gnyis kyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i bde ba lam du byed dgos tsa na rang mdun gyi lha der bsgom dgos par 'gyur te/ bltas pa'i bde ba lam du byed pa la rang lha der bskyed dgos pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la yang mtshungs so/ /mi byed na rnal 'byor chen po'i sgrub pa pos de ltar mdun bskyed bsgom pa don med par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta bu'i grub mtha' bcas tsa na/

rnal 'byor chen po'i sgrub thabs kyi mdun bskyed la skur pa btab/ bya spyod la sgro btags pas khyed rgya nag mkhan po dang 'dra'o zhes kyang rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris 'ga' zhig las 'byung ngo gsung / yang khong tsho na re/ thang sku la lha bris pa de dag rang nyid 'di ltar bsgom dgos pa yin no/ /zhes mtshon sla ba'i phyir yin gyi/ mdun du de ltar bsgom pa min zer/ 'o na 'dul ba lung las/ ston pa'i skyes rabs bri'o zhes gsungs pa'i don ston pa'i sngon gyi mdzad pa mthong bas gzhan dad par bya ba'i phyir yin la/ khyed ltar na rang rgyal po thams cad sgrol du bsgom dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa bri bar gsungs pa/ der skye bo gzhan byung ba'i dus sku gnyer gyis 'di yi dwags dang 'di dmyal ba zhes smos pas des ngan 'gro la 'jigs nas chos la 'jug par 'gyur bas de re re bris pa'i dgos pa yin mod kyi/ de ltar na/ rang yi dwags su bsgom dgos par thal/ rang rgyud la ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa bskyed pa la rang der bsgom dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de mi dgos na/ rang rgyud la bltas pa'i bde ba bskyed pa la rang lhar bsgom dgos pa nyams so/ /des na lha phan tshun blta ba'i zur mig la sogs pas blta ba la dmigs pas rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gyur ro/ /de bas na/ dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi 'grel pa dang / lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyi gur 'grel dang / ind+ra bhu ti'i bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang / tha ga na rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i 'dus pa'i 'grel pa rnams las bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med par gsal bar bshad cing / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa sogs rgyud kyi don yang de ltar du snang la/ bya rgyud rang nas bdag bskyed zur tsam gcig kyang ma bshad pa dang / bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma sa skya pa dang /

'gos rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams dang / yang rgya gar ba'i bya rgyud kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta byang chub mchog rnams kyis kyang bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med par bshad pas/ rgyud sde gang du sngags kyi cho ga bshad cing bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ma bstan pa de bya ba'i rgyud yin la/ de'i chos kyi rnam grangs bod na phyed dang nyis brgya tsam zhig yod par bshad cing / spyod rgyud ni/ rgyud sde gang du bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa bshad cing / ye shes dgug gzhug ma bshad pa/ de'i rnam grangs bod na rnam snang mngon byang / phyag rdor dbang bskur sogs dgu tsam yod do zhes 'byung / chos rje dge ldan pas/ spyod rgyud la ye shes pa dgug gzhug yod de/ phyag rdor dbang bskur las 'gro yang rung / 'greng yang rung / bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i lung 'di 'dren par mdzad do/ /spyod rgyud la ye shes pa dgug gzhug rgya gar ba thams cad dang / bod kyi bon po yan chad kyi bla ma thams cad mi bzhed/ 'on kyang 'di khong rang gi gsung rab la dbang che chen po bco brgyad yod pa'i gcig yin no/ /zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris rnams las bshad do/ /de la spyod rgyud la ye shes dgug gzhug byed pa mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i spyod rgyud kyi bstan bcos su 'di tsam zhig las ma bshad pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas gsang ba tshad mar byed na des khyab/ mi byed na sngar bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod de/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa'i phyir zhes pa dang 'gal/ spyir yo ga dang bla med du rnal 'byor pha rgyud pa rnams kyi lugs la ye shes pa bcug cho ga zin pa dang gshegs gsol byed pa yin la/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud pa rnams gshegs gsol mi byed par rang la thim pa byed pas dus thams cad du rang ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa tha mi dad pa'i nga rgyal byed pas/

khong pas kyang ma rgyud la de ltar du bshad do/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dam/ 'phags pa yab sras ltar gnyis ka'i rgyud ni/ rgyud sde gang du bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'i steng du ye shes dgug gzhug yod pa'o/ /de'i rnam grangs ni de kho na nyid 'dus pa/ dpal mchog rtse mo/ sbyong rgyud la sogs pa nyer gcig tsam yod par bshad la/ rnal 'byor bla med dam rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ces pa sbyar na/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ni/ rgyud sde gang du sbyang gzhi sems can gyi skye shi bar do gsum sbyong ba'i sbyong byed bskyed rim yod pa'o/ /bshad pa'i rim pa'i rnam gzhag 'di rnams ni sman zhabs kyis rgyas par gsungs so/ /de la dbye na/ ma rgyud dang / pha rgyud gnyis so/ /de yang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ /ces so/ /pha rgyud la rigs drug ste/ he ru ka'i rigs kyai rdor bde mchog sogs so/ /mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyang de nyid dang gcig go /rnam snang gi rigs la rdo rje gdan bzhi/ mi g.yo ba bla med/ 'od dpag med kyi rigs padma dra ba'i rgyud ces pa rdo rje 'chang gi dus su de'i dbang bka' yod tshod du 'dug gsung / rin 'byung gi rigs rdo rje bdud rtsi/ don grub kyi rigs mgon po mngon 'byung dang / sgrol ma/ rnal 'byor chen por bshad pa rnams so/ /drug ka cha mnyam pa sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ pha rgyud la bu ston pas rigs lngar 'byed pa mi 'thad pa sogs dgag sgrub mang du mdzad kyang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris la rtogs par 'dod na gzhan du shes so/ /bus rnam snang sgyu dra rnam snang gi rigs su bzhag kyang / spyir rnam snang sgyu dra/ kun snying / rab zhi bshes gnyen/ smṛrti dzñā na kirti la sogs pas yo gar bkral/ rgyud 'di rnal 'byor chen po yin pa mtha' gcig tu ma nges mod/

'on kyang de tsam yin pa'ang srid/ gang ltar rang lugs la rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la gnyis/ ma rgyud logs su 'chad la/ pha rgyud la rgya gar ba rnams dang / bod snga rabs pa rnams sde gsum du 'byed de/ de skad du rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ skye bo 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i rgyud/ zhe sdang can 'dul ba/ gti mug can 'dul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dus pa/ phyag rdor/ zla gsang thig le sogs so/ /'dus pa 'og tu 'chad la phyag rdor gyi skor la rgyud ci yin 'di yin med pa zhe gcig tsam yod par gsungs te/ de'i phyir rje btsun gyis/ dpal ldan sa gsum gdug pa kun 'dul ba/ /khyod la log par rtog pas sa gsum khengs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum 'dul zhes bya ba/ gzungs dang rgyud gnyis ka'i mtshan 'byar ba/ sngags bho bho ni yod pa de nyid dag po yin zhing 'di nas 'khor chen ston/ 'di la dmar gyi ṭīkka dang dbang chog sogs gzhung tshang ma yod cing / rje rdo rje 'chang gi skabs su de'i dbang dang lung sogs cha tshang yod par 'dug de dag gi dkyil 'khor lha bcu gsum ma yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam par bzhugs pas/ 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i rgyud du bzhag zla gsang thig le la da lta lung ma gtogs dbang dang 'grel pa ni med la/ sngon byung bar gsal te/ bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dkar chag tu zla gsang thig le'i 'grel pa ye shes rdo rjes bris pa/ zhes bshad pas so/ /'di kha cig gis ma rgyud du bzhag pa yod kyang / 'di nyid las/ dpa' bo zla gsang thig le ni/ /zhes bshad pas pha rgyud yin no/ /gnyis pa ni gshin rje'i gshed skor rnams ni/ de yang dmar nag gnyis su 'dus/ dmar po la le'u bcu dgu pa/ le'u dang po nas lha lnga ston/ brgyad pa nas bcu gsum ma ston/

de yang birwa pa'i lha lnga ma dang / dpal 'dzin gyi bcu gsum ma gnyis yin la de dag bod la dpyal lo/ chag lo/ da na shī las g.yag sde la gsungs pa dang lugs gsum/ de'i gong 'gos dang / sa skya pa gong ma rnams la ni med do/ /deng sang de gnyis kyi dbang dang rgyud kyi lung bzhugs/ dgra nag mkhas po gcig shes na rgyud de 'chad sla bar 'dug ces rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung gsungs/ 'di la rgya 'grel med par bshad/ glo bo lo tsā ba chag lo'i slob ma yin pas de'i rjes 'brang du gtogs so/ /phyis le'u nyer gnyis pa bu ston pas bsgyur te dbang dang lung rgyun ni med pa 'dra gsungs/ 'di blo bzang snying po'i lha lnga ma dang shin tu mthun pas 'di la brten nas brtsams par bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed do/ /nag po'i skor la/ rtsa rgyud dgra nag de'i 'khrul 'khor gsal bar ston pa gdong drug drag las bye brag tu ston pa 'jigs byed/ dgra nag la dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa/ shanti pa/ gzhon nu zla ba/ nag po pa rnams kyi 'grel pa yod par bshad la/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs bcu gsum ma yin la/ rgyal po int+ra bhu ti la sangs rgyas kyis dbang bskur mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus de yang bcu gsum ma yin no/ /de'i lha rnams kyi rtsa phyag gnyis yum la 'khyud pa yin la/ 'di rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ma gtogs phyag lhag ma rnams 'dra zhing / phyag mtshan yang 'dra bas/ de dang 'di gnyis 'jam dpal zhi ba dang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yin no/ /zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bshad gsungs so/ /dgra nag la dpal 'dzin sogs kyi gzhung phran yod cing / bod du bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo la 'gyur/ bla ma gong ma rnams thugs rtsis che zhing / da lta yang de'i bstan pa'i rgyun yod la/ khyad par zhang lugs pa rnams 'di la 'chad nyan sgrub pa byed cing / de la khong rnams rgyud 'di la bshad gsar re byed pa dang /

de'i sngon du bsnyen pa lo skya sngo bcu gnyis song bya ba/ lo ngo drug tsam re byed pa'i srol bzang po yod pas dgra nag zhang la thug ces zer/ snyos kha rag pa zhes dang po zer la/ 'dam gyi kha thod na khong tsho'i dgon chen po yang yod tshod du 'dug gsungs/ deng sang skyo lugs su grags pa'i skyo ba rnams kyang / zhang pa lta bu'i rgyas po ni med la/ 'di yi bshad pa hrug pa re dang dbang rgyun 'byung zhing / rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams kyang thugs dam 'di la mdzad do zhes grags shing / gdong drug la rgya 'grel med par bshad la/ gzhung phran la/ klu sgrub kyi slob ma de min pa'i klu byang bya ba gcig gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / de wa a ka ra tsant+ras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis yod cing / de wa a ka ra tsant+ra 'di gdong drug gi bdag po yin par bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed la/ bod kyi rwa lo'i 'grel pa yod la/ gzhung gi ngo bo la rwa los 'grel pa rgyas par byas na go mod/ 'on kyang 'grel pa 'khrugs se ba gcig mdzad/ man ngag rnams la zur du gzhung phran zhe brgyad tsam mdzad nas bzhag go /de'i dbang bka' dang lung gi rgyun yang 'byung ngo / /rtog bdun la/ gzhon nu zla ba/ mi bskyod pa rnams kyi 'grel pa yod la/ gzhan yang la lar mdzad byang med pa dang / la lar grub pa'i rdo rjes byas zer ba dang / bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas byas/ da na shrīs byas zer ba ming mi 'dra yang / 'grel pa de bzhi tshig la zhus dag thub pa lta bu yin no zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun las 'byung gsungs/ gzhung phran la/ la li ta badzras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs bzhi bcu la nye ba zhig yod la/ spyir 'jigs byed 'di la rje btsun sa skya pa/ rwa pa/ skyo pa sogs bod na'ang lugs srol shin tu mang ba yin no/ /bar chad bzlog pa la shin tu bsngags pas rgya gar na'ang shin tu dar ro/ /chos rang gi khungs la bltas na shin tu sbas pa gcig 'ong thad 'dug kyang /

rgya bod gnyis char na grags che'o zhes dang / des na da lta bod na gshin rje'i gshed nag po skor gsum gyi bstan pa yang tshang bar bzhugs pa des rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung ngo gsungs/ 'di phyogs kyi gzhung gzhan ma dag pa rnams ni gzhan du gsal la/ rtog gsum ni/ skyo pa'i bla ma gong ma mkhas po zhig gis byas pa yin te/ a mo gha badzra chung ba skyo pa'i bla ma yin pas/ khong gi 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ 'khrul 'khor ston pa drag po'i las bdun/ zhi ba'i las bdun/ drag las phyogs gcig pa bya ba rnams dang mthun pas so/ /rwa pa dang mi mthun te/ de yang rwa pa la myur ba'i las bdun bya ba rgyud rgya gzhung nas ma bshad kyang / khong gi 'di man ngag las tshogs la shin tu myur/ snying po dang rtsa sngags spel/ nye snying dang rtsa sngags/ snying po dang nye snying spel ba sogs yod de shin tu dkon pas/ chos skor 'di rnams mdo khams sogs na e yod/ 'di phyogs na med pa 'dra zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gis kyang gsungs bar grags so/ /rgya ston rwa pa'i slob ma yin kyang / skyo pa'i rtog gsum la ṭīkka byas yod la/ rtog gsum 'di skyo lugs la mkho zhing / gzhan dang mi mthun tshod du 'dug gsungs/ gti mug can 'dul ba rnam snang sgyu dra la/ kun snying / rab zhi bshes gnyen/ smṛrti rnams kyis yo gar bkral ba'i 'grel pa byas/ dus 'khor gyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi dbang bcu gcig pa'i nang du 'di'i dbang bskur byed pa dang / slob dpon a bhyas rnal 'byor bla med du bshad pas 'di pha rgyud du bzhag go /da lta de'i dbang bka' med cing / rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku tshe'i stod tsam gyi gong na bla ma 'dra rnam snang sgyu dra'i dbang byed pa yod de/ sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i dbang ni min no zhes rdo rje 'chang gsungs par grags so/ /'dod chags can 'dul ba/

'dus pa la/ rtsa bshad gnyis/ 'di'i rtsa rgyud la 'bum phrag gsum pa snyigs dus kyi gdul bya tshe thung ba rnams la mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs zhes slob dpon shanti pa'i 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog tu bshad do/ /de yang tha mal pa tshe thung ba la mi snang ba yin gyis/ grub thob rnams la thos bsam byed pa'i skal ba yod do/ /le'u bco brgyad pa 'di bzlas te gsungs pa yin la/ 'phags pa yab sras kyis le'u bcu bdun pa yan la rtsa rgyud du byed cing / rgyud phyi ma khyad par du 'phags pa yin mod/ 'on kyang sgron gsal du le'u bcu bdun pa yan gyi 'grel pa las/ slob dpon zla grags kyis ma mdzad la/ ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams le'u bco brgyad pa la 'chad nyan mdzad cing / sman zhabs kyis rgyud phyi ma la 'grel pa zur du yang mdzad la/ rgyud 'di bod du lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur cing le'u bco brgyad pa'i gsham du 'gyur byang yang smos/ de'i don gyis 'phags lugs pa 'chad nyan byed pa'i bod rnams kyis le'u bcu bdun pa yan bris rtogs pa'i rgyal po rdzogs bya ba las 'gyur byang med pa mang po 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /des na rgyud phyi ma 'phags lugs la mi dgos la ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i grub mtha' yan lag bzhi dang / sbyor ba yan lag drug sogs rgyud phyi ma nas 'don dgos pas gal shin tu che'o/ /bshad rgyud la bzhir 'dod pa dang / brgyad du 'dod pa gnyis las/ bu ston pas rdo rje phreng ba sogs bzhi dang / rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa/ gnyis med rnam rgyal dang brgyad du rim lnga'i khrid yig tu bshad do/ /dang po bzhi rtsod med kyi bshad rgyud yin la/ rgyud phyi ma dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams bshad rgyud du byed kyi/ 'phags pa yab sras mi bzhed do/ /lha'i dbang pos zhus pa'ang mdo yin pa'ang srid/

rgyud yin pa'ang srid bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /'di bshad rgyud yin pa la sgrub byed/ sgron gsal du/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i skabs su lung drangs pa'i phyir kho na las med/ de tsam gyis bshad rgyud du 'gyur na ha cang thal lo/ /gnyis med rnam rgyal la po ti chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa bya ba gcig dang po nas yod/ 'di la bar skabs kyi dge bshes rnams na re/ gnyis med rnam rgyal du grags pa 'di chu shul du rgya pho ba lung pas brtsams pa yin/ ji ltar brtsams lugs kyang / khong la 'dus pa mar lugs kyi man ngag mang po yod pas/ de tsho ston byed kyi rgyud cig dgos pa 'dug snyam nas brtsams/ 'di nas 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi nang du dkyil 'khor so gnyis byas pa/ dbus kyi mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa'i lha snam la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha so gnyis rdzogs pa de bzhin du/ shar phyogs mi g.yo ba'i gnas su mi bskyod pa phud nas/ gtso bo mi g.yo bas byas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po gcig yod de de ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' min zhing / 'on kyang bla ma blo chen na re/ khong rang tsho gang zer ba gyis/ nga rang 'di'i dbang bskur byed zer nas dbang bskur mang po byed pa yin no zhes kyang grags so/ /bu ston pas 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud du khas blangs pa ni khong ras bsgyur pa'i gnyis med rnam rgyal de yin no/ /dang po'i gnyis med rnam rgyal de rgyud rnam dag yin na pha rgyud du bzhag tu rung mod/ 'on kyang 'di la 'phags pa rin po ches rgyud kyi lung mang po drangs yod pas bka' min zhes kyang mi rung la/ rang gi ngo bo bod gcig gis bsgrigs pas bkar yang mi rung zhes the tshom can brtag pa'i yul du mdzad pa nyid legs so/ /bu ston pas gnyis med rnam rgyal 'di yo ga ba gcig gis yo gar bkral na'ang 'grel thub par snang la/

bla med yin na'ang rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhig bshad pas/ gti mug can 'dul ba rnam snang sgyu dra'i khongs su rigs kyis/ 'dus pa'i don med do/ /sngar gyi gnyis med rnam rgyal de'i mtshan la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa rnam par rgyal ba thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba bya ba zhes mtshan du grags/ 'di tshad mar 'dod pa dag gis thun gsang las zhes lung yang drangs so/ /klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim par/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba las bya ba 'byung ste de ni rgyud 'di ma yin no/ /bus gnyis med rnam rgyal de la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba bya ba med la/ 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud du 'dod na ming phyi ma de yang 'byor dgos tshod du 'dug go /bus bsgyur pa 'di ka dri ma med pa ni yin la/ 'gyur yang legs/ de bod du bsgyur pas bka' drin che/ 'di la 'grel pa dang gzhung phran sogs med pas rgyud sde gang gi khongs su gtogs pa bzhag dka'o/ /des na 'phags lugs la/ bshad rgyud bzhi yin te/ 'di la'ang thun mong ma yin pa dang / thun mong ba gnyis/ dang po la rtsa rgyud kyi tshig gi cha ston pa ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa yin zhing / 'di'i rtsa rgyud la mtha' drug tshul bzhi rgyan bdun sogs tshig gi cha gsal bar ston/ 'di lta bu'i bshad rgyud cig med na rtsa rgyud kyi tshig gi bshad pa bying can 'di mi 'thon/ rgyud 'di la shrardha'i rgyan bdun gyi brjed byang bya ba'i don 'grel ma gtogs gzhan med do/ /don gyi cha gsal bar ston pa dgongs pa lung ston yin/ 'dis rtsa rgyud kyi sgyu ma dang 'od gsal zung 'jug rnams sbas pa'i dgongs don gsal bar 'chad pas thun mong ma yin pa ste/ 'di lta bu'i bshad rgyud klu sgrub la mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa yin gyi/ ye shes zhabs dang shanti pa sogs 'grel byed gzhan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud 'di pa med pas bshad pa'i bying ma 'thon pa yin zhing /

'di la 'grel pa tshang ba ni med/ shrardhas gzhung khel bu cung zad gcig la byas yod par bshad cing / rdog tshul khrims bzang po bya bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa bod la yod/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus ni/ 'dis ngag dben gyi skabs su phan 'dogs/ gzhan sambu ṭi la sogs pa bla med/ rlung gi bshad pa yod tshad la phan 'dogs pas bshad rgyud do/ /'di la slob dpon ye shes snying po'i 'grel pa/ smṛrti'i 'grel pa dang gnyis yod de/ snga ma bzang zhing 'gyur legs gsungs/ rdo rje phreng bas/ 'di'i gleng gzhi'i sbas don gsal bar ston pas bshad rgyud du 'jog cing / gleng gzhi'i mthar thug gi bshad pa yang dgongs pa lung ston gyis bshad dgos so/ /'di nas spyi bo pu li ra ma la ya sogs yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bshad pa bde mchog dang mthun par bshad/ bde mchog rgyud du lus dkyil gyi cho ga sbas par yod pa 'di'i nang du gsal ba yin te/ dper na mi zhig nor chen po yod pa rang gi nang du mi 'jog par gzhan gyi khyim du sbed pa bzhin yin gsungs shing / des na slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gnang ba byin nas/ rdo rje phreng ba la rtsom stan byas nas lus dkyil gyi cho ga brtsams pa yin no/ /des na 'di bde mchog dang thun mong yin pas na thun mong gi bshad rgyud do/ /des na bshad rgyud bzhi yin no/ /ye shes zhabs lugs pas rgyud phyi ma bshad rgyud du 'dod pas/ de'i rjes 'brangs 'grel byed mang pos kyang phyogs gcig tu 'grel pa byas shing / khong tsho'i grub mtha' ston pa la gal che'o/ /'phags lugs pas lung yar drangs pa ni yod la/ 'bru non mar la byas pa'i 'bru ṭig ni med cing / 'grel pa sgron gsal du yang rgyud phyi ma la 'grel pa med pas/ lung re tsam mdzad pa sngon gyi bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la byung ba yin tshod du gda' gsungs/

rdog arya de was 'di la don tshan bcu gsum du byas pa'i sa bcad gcig byas so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs pa rnams rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud 'di bshad rgyud du zhal gyis bzhes/ de yang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud kyi lha grangs mi gsal ba gsal bar byed/ bzlas pa dang rdzogs rim sna rtse gsum gyi rdzogs rim yang gsal bar byed cing / spyir bod na bla med rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa dang / yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud sa paṇa gyis bsgyur pa gnyis las/ 'di bla med de yin no/ /'di la rgya 'grel med par bshad cing / spyir rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag byed pa la/ pha rgyud 'chad na pha rgyud dang mthun par bshad/ ma rgyud 'chad na ma rgyud dang mthun par 'chad pa ni rnam par dag pa yin zhing / de dag ni rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rnal 'byor pha dang ma'i rgyud spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa mdor bsdus te bshad pa yin gsungs/ gsum pa 'dus pa'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ 'dir gsal byed sum cu so bzhi'i mtha' can gyi rgyud sde stong phrag so bzhi'i nang nas rtsa ba dang mchog tu gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i man ngag zab mo 'chad par byed pa las/ de la thog mar bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam par thar pa dang rgyud kyi byung tshul bshad par bya ba la/ spyir ston pas 'dus pa'i rgyud gsung tshul/ de nyid rgya gar du byung tshul/ de dag bod du ji ltar dar tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon kun snying gis ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du gsungs so zhes nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa las bshad cing / yang slob dpon la kha 'phangs pa'i 'grel pa bo dong gis byas pa po ti drug tsam byas pa yod do gsungs/ yang rdo rje phreng ba la 'grel pa slob dpon a lang ka ka la sha zhes pa rgyan gyi rol pas mdzad par gsang sngags mtha' dag dga' ldan du gsungs par bshad pa yod na'ang /

'dir rje btsun sa skya pa rnams spyir gsang sngags la ston pa 'di 'das te ma gsungs pa dang / gsungs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'di bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon du sangs rgyas nas theg pa gsum gyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ kyai rdor gyi rgyud 'bum phrag lnga dang / 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa sogs rtsa rgyud chen po rnams gsungs mod/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir ston pa 'dis sems can tshe thung zhing longs spyod dman pas rgyud de la thos bsam byed pa la song nas/ bsgom pa'i ro mi myong bar 'gyur bar gzigs nas de mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ de dag 'das te ma gsungs pa yin la/ de dag dang don 'dra zhing tshig nyung ba'i bsdus rgyud 'di lta bu ni 'das te gsungs pa yin no/ /de yang dang por rgyud sde 'di rnams rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs u rgyan na bzhugs pa'i rgyal po int+ra bhu ti zhes bya bas nam mkha' la ston pa'i nyan thos rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba mthong nas ci yin dris pas/ ston pa'i nyan thos yin zer bas ston pa la dad pa skyes te mnyan yod na bzhugs pa mngon sum du mthong ngo / /de nas sang bdag gi 'dir gdugs tshod la gshegs su gsol zhes zhus pas rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ der chos zhus pas/ rab tu byung zhig gsungs/ mi nus pas/ 'dod yon la spyod bzhin du sangs rgyas thob pa'i lam zhu byas pas/ 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur bas/ de nyid kyi tshe grub pa brnyes so/ /'di ni dbang kho nas grol ba yin no/ /de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i bya rog yan chad kyis kyang gtor zan zos pas grub pa brnyes so/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje chos la rgyud sde rnams gtad do/ /rdo rje chos ni gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin yin pas rgyud sde 'dzin pa la gzhan las khyad par ches 'phags pa'i phyir ro/

/der rgyal pos rgyud rnams gser la baiḍūryas bris te de dag bzhugs pa'i khang bu byas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas thams cad grub pa brnyes/ yul khams de rim gyis stongs te mtshor gyur te/ de la klu mang po gnas par gyur te/ der yang phyag na rdo rje byon nas klu rnams la gsang sngags bstan/ rim pas mtsho 'gram du grong yang chags/ de nas mtsho yang skam par gyur to/ /der sngar gyi rgyal po'i dpe khang byung ba la he ru ka rang byung gi gandho la zhes ming btags so/ /de'i dpe rnams phyag na rdo rjes klu rnams la gtad/ dbang bskur/ lam bstan pas klu las gyur pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma mang bar byung ngo / /he ru ka rang byung gi gandho la deng sang yang bar snang la yod cing / skal ldan 'ga' res mthong ba yang yin no/ /spyir u rgyan ni sa cha ser mdangs can zhig yod par gsungs la/ de ni o ḍi ya na zhes pa'i gnas de yin no/ /sgra drang por bsgyur na 'phur 'gro zhes bya'o/ /de yang yul de'i mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'phur nas 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /sgra zur chag pa las u rgyan zhes bya la de ni rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs na yod do/ /rdo rje gdan ni sa skya'i lho drang thad na yod ces grags kyang / skyid grong gi lho drang thad na yod do zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung gsungs/ 'o na 'phags pa'i yul du nam gyi tshe gdan drangs snyam na/ u rgyan na klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma mang du yod pa de'i tshe na/ 'phags pa'i yul na rgyal po bi su kalpa legs pa'i tog ces bya ba theg chen gyi sde snod la mkhas pa zhig yod de/ des bsam pas/ theg chen gyi sde snod 'di dag las nyon mongs spong dgos zhes phal cher gsungs na'ang / sems can byang chub ste/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o zhes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spyod kyang bya ba dang /

'od srung gis zhus pa las/ ji ltar grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud/ /de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams bskyed la phan/ /zhes nyon mongs nyid lam du gsungs shing / 'di'i don ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' yod nges te bdag gis rnyed na snyam du bsam pas/ u rgyan gyi yul du song zhig dang rnyed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan byung / des der phyin pas klu las gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gcig gis dbang bskur/ lam bstan/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud byin to/ /spyir u rgyan du la las dbang dang lam thob kyang / rgyud ma lon pa dang / la las rgyud lon kyang dbang dang lam ma thob pa yod kyang / rgyal po 'dis thams cad dus gcig la lon pa yin no/ /de ltar rgyal po dbang thob lam bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes nas rgyud khyer te 'phags yul du byon to/ /de'i tshe 'phags yul na bram ze zhig la bu bzhi yod pa'i gcig bcom ldan 'das kyi sras sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i drung du rab tu byung bsnyen par rdzogs te mtshan yang sgra gcan 'dzin bzang por mtshan btags so/ /des bri ka ma la shi la'i mkhan po mdzad cing bzhugs tsa na/ rgyal po bi dzu kalpa la u rgyan nas lon pa'i chos yod zer ba thos nas zhus te/ 'dus pa sogs mang po gnang bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes so/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug des mda' 'phen pa'i spyod pa mdzad pas sa ra ha zhes grags so/ /gzhan yang sha wa ri dbang phyug la sa ra ha chung ba zhes brda chad byed pa yod de/ khong pa'ang mda' 'phen zhing spyod pa mdzad pa yin pa 'dug go gsungs/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po grub pa brnyes pa'i sa ra ha des/ do ha mdzod kyi glu mdzad do/ /spyir do ha la rgyal po do ha/ dmangs do ha/ btsun mo do ha zhes grags pa du ma yod kyang / slob dpon gyis mdzad pa ni ding sang dmangs do har grags pa/

sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /zhes pa yod pa de yin la/ gzhan gnyis bal po'i paṇḍi ta 'dras byas pa yin par bshad do/ /sa ra ha des klu sgrub la gdams so/ /de la klu sgrub ni lho phyogs be ta'i yul du bram ze phun sum tshogs pa zhig la bu med pa la/ lha la gsol ba btab pas bu byung / de bram ze mtshan mkhan la bstan pas bzang ste zhag bdun na 'chi zer/ ci phan byas pas/ bram ze brgya dang / dge slong brgya la chos ston drangs na rim pa bzhin zla ba bdun dang lo bdun 'tsho zer/ de ltar byas nas lo bdun la nye bar bslebs/ pha ma bu'i ro mthong ba mi bzhed nas g.yog dang bcas te yul gzhan du spyugs/ des rim gyis na lend+ra na sa ra ha bzhugs pa'i sgo drung du bslebs/ der tshigs su bcad pa bton pas/ nang du bos rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ rab byung nus na thabs yod gsungs/ gzod 'byung bar khas blangs/ der sbyong rgyud kyi 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang bskur dang lam bstan nas bsgrub tu bcug pas tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes/ dgung lo brgyad pa la de nyid kyi drung du rab tu byung / de nas rim gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ lam bstan/ mtshan dge slong dpal ldan zhes btags so/ /der dge 'dun gyi zhal ta ba la bskos/ mu ge lo bcu gnyis byung pa la/ slob dpon gyis slob dpon bha lin ta'i drung du gser 'gyur gyi rtsi bslabs/ dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog byas/ mu ge sangs pa dang / dge 'dun rnams na re/ mu ge byung pa yin pa 'dug pa la/ khyed kyis ji ltar 'tsho ba btsal zhes dris/ rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ dge 'dun log 'tsho la sbyar bas zer nas gnas nas dbyung la/ mchod rten bye ba dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs shig byas phud do/ /dge 'dun log 'tsho la sbyar ba min yang / de ltar phyung na mchod rten dang bstan bcos rtsom pa'i phyir yin nam snyam mo gsungs/

de nas chos gsung gin bzhugs tsa na/ byis pa dri zhim pa gnyis chos nyan du byung / klu'i rgyal po 'jog po'i bu yin zer/ slob dpon la klu'i yul du 'byon dgos zer ba la/ 'bum bskur ba dang / mchod rten gyi 'dam ster na 'gro gsungs nas byon/ 'bum gyi mjug dum pa gcig ma gtogs pa rnams dang / 'dam bskur/ 'bum gyi 'gyur re skan las/ de man gyi gzhung da lta rdzogs so'i bar yod pa nyi khri nas kha bskangs pa yin no/ /zhes sngon gyi zin bris 'ga' las 'byung zhing / de nas mi yul du byon/ seng ldeng gi nags su byon pas/ ma he 'tsho ba'i byis pa gcig na re/ bud med gcig nas/ slob dpon klu sgrub bya ba sgo na yod nang du shog gsungs so zer/ phyin pas sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ 'di slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyi lugs kyi sgrol ma lha lnga ma me tog phreng 'dzin du grags pa de yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis lha lnga'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ slob dpon 'dis gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad do/ /de nas sgra mi snyan du 'byon pa'i lam kar byis pa mang po'i lag yig gzigs/ gcig rgyal por 'gyur bar lung bstan/ tshur phebs dus des rgyal po thob 'dug go /des slob dpon gyi sbyin bdag byas der yun ring du bzhugs/ yang dpal gyi ri la byon/ rgyal po de la bu gcig yod pa la/ bu de la ras gcig yod pa ma la 'di nya ra gyis rgyal po thob dus dgos zer ro/ /ma na re/ rgyal sa mi 'thob ste/ khyod kyi pha slob dpon klu sgrub dang srog gcig pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub yod pas so zer bas/ bu ngu ba la/ ma na re thabs yod de/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' yin pas khyod rang dbu slong du song zer/ phyin pas gnang / de nas dbu de lung pa gzhan zhig tu bskyur to/ /byams pa'i bstan pa la de gnyis 'grig yong zer/

kha cig na re/ da lta yang dbu dang sku lus gnyis je nye je nyer 'gro yi 'dug ces grags so/ /dbu dang sku lus ni rdo dkar po'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs so/ /de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' des/ dbu ma rtsa shes la sogs pa'i rigs tshogs rnams dang / gtam bya rin po che'i phreng ba la sogs pa gtam tshogs rnams dang / chos dbyings bstod pa la sogs pa bstod tshogs rnams mdzad/ mdo kun las btus/ bslab pa kun las btus pa chen po zhes pa slob dpon gyis mdzad par grags pa'i gzhung khyad 'phags shig gnang yang / bka' gdams pa 'gas ra sgreng gi mdo sde nas btus pa yin nam brtag go /sngags phyogs la byang chub sems 'grel zhes pa tshigs bcad ma 'di slob dpon gyis mdzad pa yin la/ lhug pa zhig yong ba ti shrī grags 'od nas bzung ste bstan 'gyur zla la zur du byas kyang / sgron gsal gyis byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa zur du phyung ba yin no/ /gzhan yang mdo byas/ mdo bsres/ rim lnga rnams mdzad/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa'i cho ga nyi shu pa 'di/ 'gos rdog pa rnams kyi slob dpon kyis mdzad par bzhed cing de nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' yang yod pa la/ sa skya pa rnams dbang bka' rnying pa zhes pa'i tha snyad byed/ bu ston ma byon gong du the tshom can du su yang mi zer/ bu ston pas cho ga nyi shu pa slob dpon gyis mdzad pa ma yin te/ sgrub thabs mdor byas dang mi 'dra ba'i phyir dang / klu'i byang chub dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zhes gsungs so/ /sgrub thabs mdor byas dang mi mthun pa chen po rang med cing / klu byang dang mi mthun pa'i phyir byas pa la/ red mda' ba na re/ slob dpon gyi mi 'thad de/ slob ma dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zer ba mi 'thad de zer ro/ /klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa de/ slob dpon gyi mdzad nges shes pa min zer ba 'di nus pa chen po yin te/

slob dpon gyis mdzad nges yin na/ klu byang gis de dang mi mthun pa mdzad mi rigs pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen bstan pa'i gtad rabs dgu pa yin zhing / klu sgrub kyi dngos slob kyang yin pa la klu sgrub kyi gzhung yod na de'i lung 'dren rigs pa la ma drangs par/ klu byang gi dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba nas lung drangs pa/ dbab pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis dbab pa'i snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma la dbab par byed de/ grub pa'i dbang phyug klu'i blo'i cho ga las so/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang a bhye la sogs pa rgya gar ba mang pos kyang klu byang gi dkyil chog nas lung mang po drangs pa'i phyir ro/ /rje 'gos rngog pa sogs gong ma rnams la klu sgrub kyi dkyil chog de'i steng nas dbang bka' yod pas ma mdzad zer ba yang dka'/ 'gyur nyes pa yin nam snyam ste/ slob dpon gyi rtsom rnams hril le ba zhig yong na/ 'di nyog ge ba zhig kyang 'dug bu ston gyi rig pa de dang gzhung kho rang gi tshig 'gros la bltas na min nam snyam ste brtag go /zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun bris pa las 'byung ngo gsungs/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang klu byang gi dkyil chog gnyis mtshams sbyor tsam ma gtogs tshig tshun chad shin tu mthun/ de gnyis la brten pa'i dbang bka' kha che paṇa chen gyis chos rje sa paṇa la gnang / 'di la sa skya pa rnams dbang bka' gsar pa zhes gsungs/ deng sang bu lugs su grags pa de yin no/ /des na bstan bcos mang du brtsams pa'i slob dpon klu sgrub de/ lang kar gshegs pa dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma rnams nas lung bstan pa yin no/ /de la slob ma'i mchog ni/ slob dpon arya de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu byang rnams ni dngos slob yin pa la rtsod pa med cing / zla grags dngos slob yin min 'og tu dpyad do/

/arya de wa ni sngon ston pa bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bya rog cig gis ston pa'i dbu la bya thal btang / de ston pas ma 'ongs pa na mu stegs shig tu gyur te bstan pa la gnod par byed pa lung bstan/ der btsun chung zhig gis de ngas 'dul bar gyur cig par smon lam btab bo/ /de nas dus ring zhig na rgyal po zhig gi ldum ra na padma mang po yod pa nyin bye zhing / mtshan zum par 'gyur ba yin pa la padma chen po zhig nyin mo yang kha zum/ de'i rgyu mtshan rgyal po la bsnyad pas srungs shig sras skye'o zhes gsungs/ de nas zhag 'ga' nas kha phye bas/ slob dpon klu sgrub gang na yod zer ba'i khye'u mtshan ldan zhig byung ngo / /de rgyal po'i bur khas blangs/ de nas bu des ring zhig na slob dpon can du byon rab tu byung / bsnyen par rdzogs nas gsang 'dus la sogs pa'i dbang zhus/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa zhus nas dpal gyi ri la bzhugs so/ /de dus mu stegs shig la bu gcig skyes/ mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs byas kyang phas ma nyan mu stegs la bcug go /des dbang phyug bsgrubs pas grub ste dngos grub byin no/ /des rgya gar shar phyogs dang lho phyogs na yod pa'i sangs rgyas pa kun pham par byas so/ /der ma na re/ rgya gar shar dang lho na sangs rgyas pa rta'i rna ba tsam yin dbus na lend+ra na sangs rgyas pa rta'i lus ltar ches che ba dag yod kyis der song la/ rgyal na nga rgyal byed pa yin mod byas pa dang / yul dbus su song nas bud med gcig dang 'phrad/ na ga lend+ra ga na yod byas pas/ blun po na lend+ra zer ba yin zer/ rten 'brel ma legs snyam mo/ /der de na yod pa'i paṇḍi ta rnams la rang re rnams rtsod/ nga rgyal na khyed kun nga'i bstan pa la 'jug dgos/ khyed rgyal na nga chu bo gaṅgā la lceb zer/ der kho dang rtsod nus pa'i paṇḍi ta ma byung nas gros byas/ dpal gyi ri la slob dpon yab sras bzhugs/

rang re rnams chos skyong la gsol ba btab nas/ der zhu ba btang ba drag zer nas gsol ba btab gtor ma byas te de'i steng du phrin yig bzhag pa bya rog gis khyer te dpal gyi ri la song ngo / /bod rnams chos skyong bya rog ma bya ba de la zer ba yin zer ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis phrin yig gzigs nga rtsod pa la yul dbus su 'gro gsungs pa la/ 'phags pa lha na re/ slob dpon 'byon mi 'tshal/ nga yis 'gro yis zhus pas/ khyod kyis mi thub gsungs/ thub zhus pas/ blta yis gsungs nas/ slob dpon gyis mu stegs kyi grub mtha' bzung arya de bas nang pa'i grub mtha' bzung nas brtsad pas lha lan gsum rgyal/ mu stegs ngan pa de khyer ces slob dpon la lh+wam brgyab/ phyis 'gyod pa las/ de dus na nga mu stegs kyi 'du shes yin nyes pa med gsungs/ der lhas yul dbus su byon/ lam khar spyan slong pa la ya gcig byin no/ /der chu len gyi tshul du byas nang du byon/ khos snga gong nas phyi nas rtsod pa 'ong par go nas sgo la nyal zhing / nang du dge 'dun re re nas mgo la dbyug pa brgyab nas bgrang la/ der slob dpon nang du tshud gral gsham der bsdad pas/ mgo zlum gang nas 'ongs zer/ ske nas 'ongs byas/ de nas bzung ste brtsad nas pham par byas nas bstan pa la btsud pa ni rta dbyangs yin no/ /sngon gyi lung bstan yang de gnyis yin no/ /slob dpon des spyod bsdus sgron me dang / bzhi brgya pa la sogs pa mdzad/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa mdzad zer ba ni rdog arya de wa yin no/ /spyir bod na sgron chung / sgron 'bring / sgron chen/ stod 'bum/ smad 'bum bya ba bzhi yod pa'i snga ma rdog nyi ma seṅges/ gnyis pa brlan nyi ma lcam gyis/ gsum pa rdog arya de was byas pa dang 'khrul bar zad do/ /'phags pa lha ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma nas lung bstan to/

/slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen ni klu sgrub kyi dngos kyi slob ma/ rim lnga'i rim pa gnyis pa mdzad mkhan slob dpon chen po de yin/ rim pa gnyis pa mdzad pa'i tshul la/ kha che legs smra'i rim lnga'i 'grel par/ sras kyi thu bo yin pas dgyes dgyes mdzad nas shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad byang bcug pa yin te zer ro/ /kha cig shākya bshes gnyen slob dpon gyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin zer mod kyang / 'dir 'gos kyis rim pa gnyis pa slob dpon gyi rtsom 'phro shākya bshes gnyen gyis brtsams pa yin gsungs pa de gtso bor bzung ngo / /gang ltar yang rim lnga la rgya 'grel byas tshad kyis khong gi 'di la yang 'grel pa byas pas/ dngos slob chen po zhig yin par nges so/ /'dir rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gis spyir yo ga ba shākya bshes gnyen bya ba zhig byung yang / de 'di min te/ yo ga ba shākya bshes gnyen des/ legs ldan 'byed kyi lung mang po drangs nas bshad pa de nyid kyis shes so/ /yang spyod bsdus sgron me'i 'grel pa byed mkhan gyi shākya bshes gnyen zhig byung zhing / de'ang paṇḍi ta gtsang hrig pa zhig yin par 'dug la/ 'grel pa yang dga' mo thon yod cing / 'on kyang spyod bsdus kyi 'grel pa 'gos rdog gi gtso bzang ngo zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris su byas pa rnams las 'byung ngo gsungs/ slob dpon de dang yang sngar gyi shākya bshes gnyen mi gcig cing / ye shes zhabs lugs pa la yang shākya bshes gnyen zhig yod pa de yang 'di dang dus mi mtshungs so/ /slob dpon klu byang ni/ sngar slob dpon li kha ra shing 'phel na gsar 'gyur mdzad dus/ der bram ze rgas 'khogs gnyis kyang yod/ de la sbyin pa byin pas mgu ste/ rgan pos slob dpon gyi nye gnas byas/ de nas shi 'phos ma he 'tsho ba'i bu zhig tu skyes/ ma he 'tsho ba'i bus bag chags dran te/

klu sgrub kyi sgo drung du byon grub pa nga skyo sgom ston cig zer/ ma he sgoms byas pas bsgoms/ ji zhig na slob dpon can byung / da nga'i rwa 'di ma bde dmigs pa spos zer/ mdun du mi dkar po thal mo sbyar ba gcig sgoms gsungs/ bsgoms pas de dngos su byung / dngos grub ci dgos zer bas/ khyod rang de ru sdod/ ngas grub pa la dri'o byas/ dris pas/ khyod rang nga'i snying la zhugs gyis shig gsungs/ de skad byas pas/ zhugs pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyi drung du rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan klu'i byang chub ces kyang bya/ klu'i blo dang / klu'i bshes gnyen zhes kyang zer ro/ /der slob dpon gyis 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug lam bstan pas grub pa brnyes so/ /klu byang gis 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdzad cing / sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdzad zer yang bod du ma 'gyur/ bskyed rim ston pa rnam gzhag rim pa/ rdzogs rim ston pa las mtha' rnam 'byed de/ 'di 'gos rdog pa la med par bshad/ chag gis bsgyur/ rim lnga'i don bsdus kyi 'grel pa khongs su bsdu ba 'di pa tshab kyis bsgyur cing 'di yang 'gos rdog pa la med pa 'dra zhes gsungs/ gzhan klu byang gi rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa nor bu'i phreng ba/ 'grel chen 'grel pa don gsal bya ba gsum tsam la klu byang gis mdzad zer ba yod kyang / 'di ni paṇḍi ta phra la ring grong 'jug byas pa yin zer ba zom rong chos bzang khong gis byas pa yin nam/ khong gi rjes su rong du de lta bu'i bstan bcos mang po brtsams nas kha 'phang byed mkhan mang po byung ba de rnams kyis byas par nges kyi klu byang gis mdzad pa min zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs so/ /legs ldan 'byed dang sangs rgyas bskyangs rnams kyang slob dpon gyi dngos slob yin mod kyi gsang 'dus pa la ma grags so/ /slob dpon zla ba grags pa ni/

spyir de dus na lend+ra na mu stegs dang rtsod pa byed nus pa kun gyis phyi ru chos 'chad mi nus pa kun nang du chos 'chad pa las/ slob dpon 'di phyi ru chos 'chad/ de'i tshe rgya gar lho phyogs nas slob dpon tsaṇḍa go mi byon/ slob dpon zla grags kyi chos grwar 'dud pa ma byas par bsdad de/ slob dpon zla grags kyis chos ci shes dris pas/ sgra dang sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa dang / mtshan brjod shes so zhes dris lan btab pas/ paṇḍi ta chen po yin par go nas/ phyir bkyed de bsu ba byas te shing rta gnyis la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku zhig dang / khong gnyis re re bkod/ khong gis 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa byas pas 'jam dbyangs zhal phyir gzigs zhes zer/ 'jam dbyangs de la da lta rgya gar na 'jam dbyangs mjing yon du grags so/ /der slob dpon gnyis brtsad pas zla grags kyis lan thogs med du 'debs nus la/ tsaṇḍas thogs bcas su nus pa che'o/ /nangs gcig tsaṇḍa go mi la spyan ras gzigs kyis chos dngos su ston pa zla bas rgyab nas gzigs/ mdun du byon pas spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku yod pa de la thim song bas/ zla bas nga la zhal ston na ston/ mi ston na nga 'chi byas pas/ rmi lam du khyod 'jam dbyangs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas ngas zhal ston mi dgos/ tsaṇḍa go mi la ngas ma bstan na gzhan med gsungs/ der slob dpon gyis 'phags pa nye ring ma mdzad par zhal ston cig gsungs pas/ spyan ras gzigs dngos su gzigs/ gzhan yang slob dpon 'di ri mo'i ba las 'o ma 'jo ba dang / rdo'i ka ba la phyag bsnun na thogs pa med pa la sogs pa'i yon tan mnga'o/ /'dis mtshan nyid kyi phyogs la mngon pa mdzod dang grub mtha' rkang gcig pa'i phung po lnga brtag pa'i rab byed bya ba dang / dbu ma'i phyogs la tshig gsal/ 'jug pa/ bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa rnams mdzad/ sngags phyogs la 'grel chen sgron me gsal ba mdzad/

zla grags kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas shig 'byung ba 'ga' zhig 'di bod ma yin zer na'ang / gro kha la bris pa'i rgya dpe snang bas bod ma ma yin zhing / 'on kyang zla grags zhes pa'i mtshan mnga' ba'i paṇḍi ta khyugs tsam zhig gis byas 'dug go /zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gsung bar zin bris rnams las bshad gsungs/ yang mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba rtsa 'grel gnyis zla grags la kha 'phangs pa'i 'dus pa'i bstan bcos shig yod pa rdog pa'i bla ma gcig gis byas shing / kha ma 'phangs na bstan bcos dga' mo zhig 'dug ste/ kha 'phangs pas gdul bya 'gags so/ /zhes kyang sngon gyi zin bris 'ga' las bshad 'dug go gsungs/ zla ba grags pa 'di/ 'gos rdog pa rnams dang / bka' gdams pa rnams dang / bu ston pas slob dpon gyi dngos slob yin par bzhed cing / sa skya pa rnams min par bzhed de/ de yang bka' gdams pa rnams jo bo rjes/ klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhes zer ba la/ sa paṇa gyis zla grags klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa bskong ba'i slob ma yin gyi dngos slob min te/ de'i don gyis/ klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin/ zhes gsungs/ bus skye med mdzod las/ slob ma'i tha ma zla grags la/ /chos kyi tha ma skye med bstan/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir zhes gsungs nas dngos slob tu 'dod bzhin du skye med mdzod klu sgrub kyis ma mdzad/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta zhig gis byas pa yin zhes khong pa rang gi chos 'byung du bris tshar nas/ de'i lung drangs pa ni cung zad mi bde ba 'dra ste brtag par bya'o gsungs/ chos rje dge ldan pas/ dngos slob yin te/ zla grags tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i phyir zhes zer te/ tshe'i rig 'dzin skyes nas brnyes kyi/ ma skyes gong du ga la brnyes/ /zhes rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsungs zhes zin bris 'ga' las 'byung gsungs/

'on kyang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis phyis zhal bstan pa ni srid/ dus kyi dbang du byas na slob dpon gyi dngos slob tu mi 'grig go /des na sa skya pa'i dbang bka' gsar ma'i brgyud pa la klu sgrub/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu byang / zla grags bya ba 'byung la/ byang sems kyi sdom brgyud la klu sgrub/ arya de wa/ klu'i bshes gnyen/ zla grags bya ba yod pas/ slob dpon zla ba dang klu'i bar na slob dpon gnyis gsum yod dgos na'ang / klu byang tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pas gcig gis chog pa srid tsam yin gsungs/ gzhan yang dngos slob yin na tshig gsal las/ bde ba can du rgyal ba'i sras po klu sgrub gshegs par gyur pa des mdzad pa'i/ /gzhung mang dang ni slob ma'i tshogs de dag kyang dus mang zhig na nyams par gyur/ /de nyid nyi ma nub pas deng sang gzhung lugs gsal po de ni gang na'ang med/ /ces smre sngags 'don pa 'di ci zhig yin/ yang / gcig nas gcig tu brgyud las 'ongs dang bdag gi rnam phye las rnyed gang / /zhes gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa gang zhig yin/ de na zla grags klu sgrub kyi dngos slob yin na/ de'i dus na slob dpon gyi slob ma'i tshogs kyang ma nyams la/ gzhung lugs gsal po yang yod dgos pa las/ de dag nyams pa dang med par gsungs pas so/ /kha cig dngos slob yin te/ sgron gsal las/ slob dpon klu sgrub las rnyed do/ /zhes gzhung 'don no/ /sgron gsal las ni slob dpon klu sgrub man ngag las rnyed/ ces gsungs pas man ngag ces pa'i tshig ma rku zhig des na lung brdzun byas nas zla grags dngos slob tu bsgrub pa la dgos pa ci yod/ des na brgyud yig rnams las klu sgrub dang zla grags kyi bar na klu byang yin na tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pas gcig de min na gnyis cis kyang yod la/ klu sgrub ston pa gshegs nas lo bzhi brgya nas byon/ thogs med dgu brgya nas byon/

de'i rjes su dbyig gnyen byon/ de'i slob ma phyogs glang yin la/ phyogs glang zla grags kyi sngon du byon zin pa yin te/ zla grags kyis/ gnas brtan chos skyong / dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang zhes phyogs snga ma la bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel par byas so/ /des na zla grags kyis klu sgrub kyi zhabs dus kyi dbang du byas na ma zin pa yin la/ phyis zhal bstan nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni ma bkag go /zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab dang / gsung rgyun phal cher las 'byung zhing / 'on kyang gong du drangs pa'i 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi lung de la/ klu sgrub man ngag las rnyed ces pa'i man ngag ces pa'i tshig de med pa'i sgron gsal yang mang du snang bas lung brdzun yin par yang ma nges pas dpyad par bya ba'i gnas yin no gsungs/ de lta bu'i zla grags kyis slob pa'i rdo rje la/ des slob dpon nag po pa la/ 'di la bus bde mchog pa'i nag po pa yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ dus mi mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gsungs la/ des na 'gos kyis nag po pa che 'bring gsum du byas nas 'di chen po zhes bshad kyang / 'di nag po spyod chung bya ba yin par bshad do/ /des sa 'dres pa la/ de la slob ma bzhi'am lnga yod de/ mngon shes can te/ birya bha dra/ btsun mo can/ shanti pa/ dpal sbas te bzhi dang / lngar byed na/ mar me mdzad bzang po zhes bya ba/ ye shes zhabs lugs pa de'ang min/ jo bo rje'ang min pa gcig yin par gong ma'i yig cha rnams su bshad gsungs/ mngon shes can gyi slob ma nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ khong gi mtshan dngos shrī bha dra bya ba yin no/ /'dis gsang 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog dkyil chog cig yod pa 'di ni phal cher ma rgyud pa'i cho ga gzhir bzhag pa gcig yod la/ gzhan yang 'dus pa'i gtor chog mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ rim lnga rnams kyi 'grel pa mdzad/ mdo bsre la 'di las gzhan pa'i 'grel pa med cing /

nag po pa 'di dang kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi'i nag po dam tshig rdo rje gnyis gcig go /kha cig tu rgya skad smos nas kṛṣṇa sa ma ya badzra zhes byas shing / 'gos kyi stong thun du shrī bha drar bsgyur nas bzang po dpal zhes brjod do/ /sa skya pa'i dbang bka' gsar pa'i brgyud pa la/ zla grags/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa sogs brgyud nas 'byung ngo / /'o na bod du ji ltar du 'gyur snyam na/ sngon chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi ring la gsang sngags rnying ma mang po 'gyur/ de'i dus su'ang 'di 'gyur te/ rnying ma ba rnams/ sku'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi zla gsang thig le/ thugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi rdo rje bdud rtsi/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud karma ma ya/ kha skong sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ glang chen rwa 'bog la sogs pa yan lag gi rgyud bcu gnyis te/ tan tra sde bco brgyad ces tha snyad mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i rtsa rgyud drug ni dri ma med pa'i rgyud sde yin la/ 'dus pa la rdo rje bzhad pa'i 'grel pa mda' tshad bco brgyad tsam zhig snang / des rgyud 'chad thub pa dka'/ don bsdus kyis 'grel pa lta bu bzang po gcig 'dug ces rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung gsungs shing / yang za hor gyi slob dpon bi shu mu khas 'grel pa le'u bcu bdun pa la dum bu gnyis su byas/ de nyid la le'u bco brgyad pa'ang byas pa gcig 'dug rgya gar ma min zhing mchan dkyus su shor ba lta bu lhad che bar 'dug gsungs/ zhes sngon gyi zin bris 'ga' las bshad do/ /yang slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa yang yod cing / rnying ma nas brgyud pa'i lung bka' ni med do/ /karma ma la'i dpe deng sang med cing / rgyud dri ma med pa yin te/ sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus 'grel du/ ji skad du las kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/
