zhes bshad do/ /rgyud de sngon bod du 'gyur ba yin par 'dug go zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung gsungs/ rgyud de rnams dar ba'i tshe rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsnubs so/ /de nas rnying ma ba rnams sbyor sgrol chos su smra ba de na mar byung zhing / de nas chos rgyal chen po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs/ paṇḍi ta shrardha sogs mang du gdan drangs/ rgyud sde mang po bod du bsgyur/ khyad par gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ sgron gsal/ mdo byas/ mdo bsres/ rim lnga/ spyod bsdus rnams bsgyur/ lo tsā ba'i thugs dam ye shes zhabs lugs la mdzad/ de'i bstan pa shin tu dar bar byung / lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' yod la/ 'phags lugs la gtso bor 'chad nyan ma mdzad cing / de'i sku tshe'i sked tsam la 'brog mi lo tsā ba byon/ ma rgyud kyi bstan pa ches gsal bar byas/ des rgyud 'grel mang po bsgyur/ de'i slob ma 'gos yin te 'brog mi'i drung du 'gos kyis sgra dang / gzhung phran tshegs mang po bslabs nas khyed la ma rgyud kyi gdam ngag zab la mang bar gda' bas bdag la gnang bar zhu byas pas/ gser khyer la shog gsungs/ yul du phyin/ zhing rnams btsongs pas gser mang po byung / gser 'bul dgos mnyam po rgya gar la 'gro snyam phyin/ 'gro khar 'brog mi'i drung nas 'big par ta'i dpe gcig brkus pas/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po na re/ 'gos ngan pa nga'i bla ma'i dpe brkus pas nga kha mi lab zer zhes kha cig 'chad la/ de lta bu'i 'gos lo tsā ba de yul rta nag pa yin/ ming sring gnyis 'dus pa'i bu yin pas khug pa/ rta nag phu'i lhas shig tu btsar phyin pas lhas btsas/ blon po 'gos kyi rus brgyud yin pas 'gos zhes bya/ de nas khong cher skyes pa'i tshe/ zur 'ug pa lung du rnying ma slob tu btang pas/ rnying ma ba rnams khong la sdang bar byung nas/

ngas rgya gar du phyin la chos shig bslabs nas/ khyod la gcig bya'i zer nas gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer dang 'grogs nas rgya gar du phyin/ de dus na mkhas pa sgo drug ni grongs nas mi 'dug 'dus pa slob dgongs nas su drag dris pas/ sa 'dres pa'i slob ma rnams drag zer/ shanti pa dang / dpal sbas ni grongs tshar/ mngon shes can dang / btsun mo can la 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams zhus/ bod du byon/ de tsa na mdo khams nas kham pa mar stan seng rgyal bya ba nor chen po yod pa zhig gtsang 'jad kyi lung pa stong par yod pas der bsdad tsa na/ 'gos dang mjal chos zhus/ slar yang nor mang po phul nas de nas yang 'gos kyis rgya gar du byon/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje la 'dus pa mthar phyin par bslabs/ de ltar 'dus pa bslabs pa'i bla ma gsum gyi gsung bgros rnams rang rang sar bris/ rim lnga'i khrid lan gsum zhus pas khrid yig kyang shog ril gsum byas/ gzhan yang paṇḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can la'ang chos zhus shing / 'di ga ya dha ra dang gcig ste/ 'gos 'gyur gcig tu/ paṇḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhes bshad/ lo chen rin bzang gi dbang snga ma'ang zhus/ paṇḍi ta tsaṇḍa ha ri la yang chos zhus/ paṇḍi ta 'di'i grub mtha' rnam gzhag ston pa'i bstan bcos rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa mdzad/ ljon shing du 'di'i lung yang drangs yod cing / khong rang bya spyod la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin par 'dug gsungs/ de la sogs pa paṇḍi ta bdun cu/ rnal 'byor ma gnyis te bla ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis la gtugs/ lo chen rin bzang gi 'gyur yod pa rnams la 'gyur bcos ma mdzad/ sgron gsal la g.yar khral cung zad bgyis zer ba'i sgron gsal g.yar khral ma bya ba la/ la la rtsis che bar byed cing / bod du byon nas rgyud kyi tshig 'grel mchan chen 'di bstan bcos bzang po yin/ don 'grel stong thun chen mo la sogs pa khong thugs bsam bzang po rang gcig yin par 'dug pas man ngag yi ger bkod pa 'di bka' drin shin tu che gsungs/

khong la 'dus pa'i slob ma rgyud kyi ka ba tshugs pa bzhi/ man ngag gi gdungs ma theg pa brgyad la sogs pa shin tu mang bar byung / khyad par du mar ston seng rgyal la 'dus pa'i chos ma lus par gnang / de tsam na khams nas rdog chen po bya ba 'jad du byon/ mar ston seng rgyal dang mjal/ 'di khong gi zhang po yin pas 'dus pa 'phags skor ma lus pa gnang / mtshan dngos rdog ye shes seṅge / khong gis 'gos kyi stong thun gyi mngon shes can gyi lugs zur du phyung ba'i ṭīkka byas shing / de la stong 'bring zhes zer/ des bla ma'i chos gsungs tshad zin/ zin tshad yi ger bkod/ de'i sras rdog nyi ma seṅges stong thun shog bu bcu tsam byas pa yod la 'di la stong chung zhes zer/ sngar gyi 'gos nyid kyis mdzad pa de la stong chen zhes grags/ rdog nyi ma seṅge des gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa sgron chung / 'dus pa 'phags lugs gzhung phran de dus na 'gyur ba rnams la sa bcad/ ṭīkka rnams mdzad/ khong dzambha la grub pas longs spyod che/ pha rgyud la mkhas ma rgyud mahā ma ya gcig shes la/ der chos mkhas shing longs spyod che bas slob ma mang du 'dus/ rdog shākya thub pa zhes kyang grags/ zur du sras gcig byung ba mis ma tshor ba byas mdo smad du bskyal to/ /des shang gi brlan rtsad tshe nyi ma lcam zhes bya ba sngags pa skya bo lcang lo can la 'dus pa'i chos skor rdzogs par zhus/ brlan gyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa rdog gi de khongs su bcug gsung bgros bsnan te cung zad rgyas par byas pa sgron 'bring zhes bya/ de'i dpe yang shin tu mod cing / ṭīkka de'i mgo na stong thun lta bu byas pa rnying ma'i brda chad re kha khyer yod cing / de tsam ma gtogs gzhan ṭīkka legs po yin par bshad/ bus kyang khong rang gi ṭīkka ma brtsams gong du khong gi de'i steng nas 'chad pa yin par 'dug gsungs/ de nas rdog nyi ma seṅge grongs/

gdan sar su bkod byas pas/ gcig na re/ mdo khams na bla ma'i sras po yod zer/ gdan drangs pas/ nga'i pha chos gang yin zer/ 'dus pa yin byas pas/ su mkhas zer/ gye re lha khang pa mkhas byas pas/ der byon gsung gleng byas pas/ nged ye shes zhabs lugs pa yin/ khyod kyi pha chos 'phags lugs yin pas brlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam can byon zer/ phyin pas 'dus pa rdzogs par gnang / khong gis slar yang gsung bgros zur du bsnan pa'i 'grel pa sgron chen bya ba mdzad/ mtshan dngos rdog arya de wa zhes grags/ sa skyar 'chad nyan la byon sa paṇa gyi slob ma yang yin la/ sa thag ring pas lam btegs la bya ru gzhung sa paṇa gyis gnang bas/ des na sa paṇa gyi slob ma zhang bya ru ba bya ba de yin no/ /de gong du 'gos rdog rnams bshad pa kho na ma gtogs sgrub mchod byed pa'i srol med cing / khong gis sa skya pa phyag len bde ba'i dmigs shugs khyer nas 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod btsugs/ dkyil chog mchod phreng sogs bstan bcos mang po mdzad de/ 'gos rdog bla ma gong ma rnams sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa rgyun du byed pas bskyed rim bsgom pa zhar la 'ong zhing / rim lnga'i khrid rgyun du bsgom pa ma gtogs dkyil chog brtsams pa yang med la/ mang po tshogs nas sgrub mchod kyang mi mdzad pa yin zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bshad gsungs/ de'i dus su khong gi slob ma rnams kyis gsung bgros phyogs gcig tu bris pa stod 'bum bya ba po ti gcig dang / smad 'bum bya ba po ti gcig ste gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa chen po lta bu yang brtsams so/ /de lta bu'i 'gos 'di ni rten dge bsnyen skya bo'i tshul du yod/ des mar ston seng rgyal la/ des khong gi zhang po rdog ye shes seṅge la/ khong gis 'grel pa gzhung phran dang bcas pa'i bstan bcos mang bar mdzad kyang deng sang dar rgyu med cing / sa skya'i sgo srung na de'i dpe 'dug go zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris 'ga' na 'dug gsungs/

rdog ye shes seṅge des khong rang gi sras po rdog nyi ma seṅge la gnang / khong gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams legs shing shin tu dar rgyas che ba yang byung / des brlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam la bshad/ des stag pa rin chen grags la/ des mi nyag rdo rje grags la bshad/ des gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od la bshad/ des kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la/ des 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho la/ des bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la gnang zhing / khong pas sgron gsal gyi ṭīkka mtha' drug rab gsal/ sgrub thabs dngos grub char 'bebs/ bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/ gtor chog 'dod don char 'bebs/ dkyil chog ye shes char 'bebs/ sbyin sreg 'phrin las char 'bebs rnam snang mngon byang dang bstun pa/ chos 'byung gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ rim lnga'i khrid yig yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che za ma tog rnams mdzad de 'dus pa'i bstan pa bzung ngo / /bu'i khrid yig 'di'i rtsom tshul ni/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis mar 'gos gnyis ka'i gdam ngag gsan nas/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la gnang / des bla ma'i gsung bgros shog bu bdun tsam gcig mdzad pa shin tu dar bar yod pa la/ bus zhus nas bla ma'i yig chung dkyil du yod par byas pa'i gsung bgros bris pa yin la 'di'i ngo bo dben gsum yan 'gos lugs su snang zhing / sgyu ma'i skabs su mnyam gzhag sgyu ma la sbyor drug gi dmigs pa zhig kyang bris te/ kun mkhyen chos sku ba sbyor drug pa yin pas bsnan pa yin gsungs/ gzhan sgyu ma gsum btud sogs nag khrid bsres pa yin zhing / zung 'jug la bsdus se ba zhig mdzad snang ngo / /de lta bu'i bu ston des khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ des chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan la/ de'i drung du rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos tshar gsum gsan ces rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris rnams las 'byung zhing /

de rnams ni rgyud kyi bshad bka'i brgyud pa yin la/ dbang brgyud la rnying pa dang gsar pa gnyis/ bka' babs bdun ldan sogs su yod pa las/ 'di dag la nang sel gyi dbye ba mang du yod pa rnams ni 'og tu 'chad la/ rim lnga'i khrid kyi brgyud pa yang 'og tu 'chad do gsungs/ man ngag gi shog ril gsum sogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje kun dga' bzang pos ye shes rgyal mtshan pa la zhus/ des dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bo dong pa dge slong nam mkha' dpal bya ba gcig la zhus par 'dug de man tsam las de yan gsal bar zin bris ga na yang mi 'dug pas/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis gsal bar mi gsungs yod pa 'dra gsungs/ de lta bu'i rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa'i chos kyi rje kun dga' bzang po de nyid kyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs rgya mtsho/ sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho/ dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho/ mchod phreng mchod sprin rgya mtsho/ gtor chog 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho/ sbyin sreg 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtsho/ bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho/ khrid yig zung 'jug gsal ba rnams mdzad cing / phyogs 'di'i dbang / rgyud/ man ngag gzhung phran dang bcas pa la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad nas 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab ste/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad pa yin te/ de dag gis tshul rgyas par ni chos rje srad pa kun blo sogs kyi gsung rab rnams las gsal bar 'byung bas de dag tu blta bar bya'o gsungs so/ /de dag gi 'dus pa 'phags lugs 'gos las brgyud pa'i brgyud tshul mdor bsdus te bshad zin to/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa mar lugs su grags pa 'di la/ rim lnga dmar khrid bya ba dang / nā ro chos drug dang bsres pa'i rim lnga nag khrid bya ba gnyis kyi khrid bka' deng sang ma chad tsam yod cing / mar pa rang gis mdzad pa'i rim lnga gdan rdzogs bya ba de man ngag khyad par 'phags pa zhig yin par bshad la/

gser sding pas nā ro chos drug dang rim lnga bsres pa'i nag khrid bya ba brtsams pas/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyi gsan yig tu yang / nā ro chos drug dang rim lnga bsres pa'i nag khrid du grags pa'i lung thob ces 'byung bar rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris pa rnams kyis bris snang ngo / /yang chag lugs zhes bya ba lo tsā ba des bal po ra wen tra la 'dus pa'i dbang zhus/ khong dbang chog bod kyi 'gos rdog gi lugs byed/ brgyud pa bal po la ded/ ra wen tra dang 'di pa'i dbang chog ye mi gcig kyang / khong de bzhin du mdzad par grags la/ chag lo'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyis sa skyar 'chad nyan yun ring du byas shing / de'i don gyis bla brang shar na chag los mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi sa bcad dang / ṭīkka shin tu mang ba yod par grags shing / rje rdo rje 'chang bzhugs dus chag lo nas brgyud pa'i brgyud pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i dbang bka' thang po ches pa rnams la yod pa nas/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal ba dang / chos rje rong bo gnyis kyis kyang gsang 'dus thang po che pa la zhus pa yin no/ /zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun las 'byung gsungs/ jo bo rje'i lugs kyi rim lnga'i khrid cig sngon gyi dus su bshad cing byung / bar skabs su dar mod kyang deng sang chad nas med pa 'dra'o/ /des na brgyud pa bzang zhing dar rgyas che ba'i gsang 'dus 'phags lugs 'gos kyis bod du gdan drangs pa 'di dus ding sang gi bar du dbang / rgyud/ 'grel pa/ man ngag gzhung phran dang bcas pa rnams shin tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa yin no/ /de ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu'i snying po bsdu na/ smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi khrid/ de'i rgyab rten rgyud dang / rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan rnams kyi bshad pa dang lung rnams su 'dus pa las/ de la thog mar smin byed dbang gi brgyud pa la/

sa skya pa'i dbang bka' rnying pa'i brgyud pa dang / gsar pa'i brgyud pa gnyis/ gzhan yang brgyud pa'i bka' babs bdun ldan rnams su yod pa las/ dang po sa lugs kyi dbang bka' rnying pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ int+ra bhu ti/ klu las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ arya de wa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ grub chen klu'i byang chub/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ phyi ma bzhi char la slob pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa/ sa 'dres pa chen po/ des paṇa chen birya mngon shes can/ bha dra/ de la a btsun mo can/ ka ra tsant+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ de gsum gyis 'gos lo tsā ba/ dbus pa dge ser/ bla ma gnam kha'ub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ gnam kha'ub pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnyan chen grags pa blo gros/ spyan snga rin po che dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ de'i drung du bdag gi bla ma dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa de nyid kyis gsan gsungs/ yang rje spyan snga bas chos rje dkon mchog rin chen la yang gsan pas/ des rje 'jam dbyangs la gsan nam snyam ste brtag go /yang brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub la gnang / des snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen la gnang /

des thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can la gnang / de las kyang rje nyid kyis gsan gsungs shing / bdag gis ni lugs 'di'i smin byed kyi dbang sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can las thos la/ sa skya pa'i dbang bka' gsar pa'i brgyud pa la ring brgyud dang nye brgyud gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ arya de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bikṣa ta de ba/ kha che shākya shrī bha dra/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'u dar she se mo ra pa rin chen dpal/ bla ma ra gnyis pa rin chen rgyal/ sru lung pa kun smon/ bla ma grags chen pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā/ gnyan chen grags pa blo gros/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ de'i drung du rje mus pa chen po nyid kyis gsan gsungs so/ /sa skya pa'i dbang bka' gsar ma'i nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ ma tang gi sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī bikṣa ta de ba/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'od zer shākya man gong dang 'dra la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa bka' babs bdun ldan gyi thog mar rdog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ int+ra bhu ti/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ rgyal po bi su rgya gar lho phyogs o sde'i sha kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ nā gardzu rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i dge slong dpal ldan/ pa/ de la slob ma'i mchog arya de wa dang / shākya bshes gnyen dang /

klu'i byang chub dang / zla ba grags pa dang bzhis zhus/ des slob pa'i rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa ba/ sa 'dres pa/ des mar me dī paṃ ka ra/ mdzad paṇa/ dang / de wa paṇa dkar/ a ka ra btsun mo can/ tsant+ra/ dang / bidya paṇa/ bha mngon shes can/ dra gsum las/ gsum pos 'gos khug sngags pa co reg can/ pa lhas btsas la gsungs/ gzhan yang za hor gyi mkhas pa btsun mo can/ bal yul rdzong gi nā ga ko ṭi/ bi kra ma la shi la'i thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis par grags pa dī paṃ ka ra/ rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po chen po nag po pa/ kaṅko la'i mkhas pa chen po rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can/ rgyal po'i khab kyi mkhas pa chen po dza hu zhes bya ba zhi ba bzang po/ kha che khri brtan gyi mkhas pa chen po tsant+ra ha ri la sogs paṇḍi ta bdun cu/ mkha' 'gro bla ma gnyis dang bcas pa la lo tsā ba chen po 'gos kyis gsan/ des 'jad pa po rong gi mang ra ba seṅge rgyal mtshan la/ des 'jad brag ltag gi rdog ye shes seṅge / btsun pa/ des dbon po rdog mu ni rab tu byung ba'i mtshan nyi ma seṅge btsun pa/ des bres chu bar gyi rlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam/ co reg de gnyis la mu ne'i sras arya de ba/ de la zhar chos pa skyi mkhar 'jug gres kha dben tsha'i rtag pa rin chen grags pa/ de la bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chos 'od kyis rgyud 'grel gyi bshad bka' thob/ yang rdog chen po dang rlan rtsad tsha gnyis la/ snyi mo'i phug ka ba 'bum skyabs/ rong lha steng gi gtsang ston smra seng / nyang stod srib chung gi lce mdo seng / yang brag ltag pa chen po la cha gar mon mo brag gi mi nyag rdo rje co reg grags/ de la lce mdo sde co reg seṅge / de la bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa dge sding pa chos mi bskyod rdo rje/ 'od/ yang rlan rtsad tsha la/ thang spe ba grub thob gser sding pa/ bla ma chos 'od/

bla ma 'phags 'od/ yang na thams cad mkhyen pa lce blo ldan seṅge / bla ma 'phags pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu rdo rje sems dpa'/ ston/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ pha ri 'gag chen/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnyan chen grags pa blo gros/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ de la bdag gi bla ma byang chub kyi sems rdo rje buddha'i mtshan can nyid kyis gsan gsungs so/ /yang rje dkon mchog rgya mtshos chos rje dkon mchog rin chen la yang gsan cing / des rje 'jam dbyangs la gsan nam snyam mo/ /mar lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sgro 'dogs nang nas chod pa grub thob nyams brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / int+ra bhu ti/ ḍā ki bde ba'i zhabs/ ḍombhi he ru ka rdo rje dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ kambha la pa/ nag po spyod pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ sngags pa lcang lo can/ 'tshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kirti/ mgar ston shes rab rgya mtsho/ drang so khro bo la rtsar ang khug pa rin chen seṅge / rong pa shes rab seṅge / ston mo lung pa ye shes 'bar/ bla ma chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston khyung po/ chos rje shar pa/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ buddha ratna/ sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra'o/ /yang na/ rdo rje 'chang / byang sems blo gros rin chen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mtshan gsang ba ma taṃ gi pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ 'tshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kirti/ mkhan po bya khang pa bsod rin/ mkhan po thur mal tshul khrims skyabs/ mkhan po thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ grub thob gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od man 'dra'o/ /mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/

int+ra bhu ti/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ de'i thugs sras bzhi/ nye sras gsum ste bdun ni/ 'jam dpal zhal mthong shākya mi tra/ sgrol ma zhal gzigs na ga bo dhi/ sa brgyad non pa arya de wa/ spyan ras gzigs zhal mthong ma taṅgi pa/ nye ba gsum ni/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ slob dpon dpa' bo dang gsum mo/ /yang ma taṅgi pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa'o/ /yang klu sgrub kyis ma taṅgi pa/ zla grags/ rig pa'i khu byug a wa dhu ti pa/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ nag po zhabs/ dri med blo gros/ dpal ye shes snying pos mar pa la gdams te/ mar pa la 'phags skor gyi rgyud 'grel pa dang / rgyud rkyang / bshad rgyud lnga gzhung phran dang bcas pa dang / ye shes zhabs lugs sogs dang bcas pa la/ rgya gar na 'grel pa nyer gsum/ jo bos nyer lnga tsam gsan gsungs skad/ bod na bdun zer yang mang du snang / mar pa la/ dza ya na/ tha ga na/ snyim tog gsum yod/ spyir rgya gar du lan gsum/ bal por lan bzhi ste bdun/ shar nub/ lho byang / kha che/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta dang / ku sa li grags tshad la bla ma brgya rtsa/ brgyud pa 'dzin nges lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum/ 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i bla ma bdun gyi nang nas nub tu la kṣe tra'i gtsug lag khang na gnas pa dpal ye shes snying po las 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud gdams pa'i bka' babs/ khyad par du mar pa'i bu bzhi'i nang nas 'tshur dbang la nā ro pa'i dbang dang rgyud rkyang gdams par bcas pa gdams/ de'i rjes gad pa kirti/ de la mi nyag thur la pa/ dbus pa 'gar dge grub thob zhang zhung pa/ des thugs sras gsum la/ gang bar gser kha'i rin chen gling pa tshul khrims mdzes/ bla ma rgya rnal 'byor 'pho ba lung pa/ dge slong chos grags dpal bzang / bla ma shaka gzhon/ bla ma blo ldan/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bu ston sogs man gong dang 'dra'o/

/jo bo'i lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang bdag int+ra bhu ti che/ /nā ga dzo gi bram ze sa ra ha/ /nā gardzu na zla ba grags pa dang / /ku sa li gnyis jo bo a ti sha /rong pa 'gar dge lha rje stod pa dang / /shes rab rgyal po shes rab gtsug tor dang / /lha rje chen po thang stod chos kyi 'od/ /bla chen klog skya bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal ldan grags pa dpal/ /'dus pa'i dbang dang gzhung phran lung thob byas/ /phyis ni bla ma bsgom ye'i zhabs drung du/ /bde dge gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel phran bcas thob/ /khong la 'phags pas rgyud 'grel phran bcas gsan/ /de la bu ston man gong dang 'dra'o/ /chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub/ sras kyi thu bo shākya bshes gnyen/ arya de wa/ 'phags pa rta dbyangs/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza landha ri pa/ dpe med dpal/ gambhi ra ma ti pa/ niska laṅka pa de ba/ ra went+ra pa de ba/ chag lo tsā ba/ 'u yug kung ra ba bla ma dpal/ yang klu'i byang chub kyis/ ḍombhi ba/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ma ti garbha/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ra went+ra pa/ chag lo tsā ba/ yang zla grags kyis rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par grags pa'i lha/ rnyog med lha/ ra went+ra pa/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ 'u yug dpal la/ bla ma grags chen pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston man chad gong dang 'dra'o/ /sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ mgon po klu sgrub/ arya de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bi khye ta de wa/ kha che shākya shrī bha dra/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'u dar she se mo ra pa rin chen dpal/

bla ma ra gnyis pa rgyal rin/ sre lung nags phug pa kun smon/ bla ma grags chen pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston man gong dang 'dra'o/ /jo bo lugs kyi dbang gi mjug na/ dpyal a mo ghas sbyar ba'i bum dbang cho ga'i dbang bka' 'di dkyil chog dpyal ba'i dpe steng nas byas pa yin gyi dbang bka' jo bo'i bar ma chad pa yin no zhes 'byung la/ dpyal lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo dang 'dra'o zhes zer ba bu ston rin po che'i gsan yig la snang yang / dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos kha che paṇa chen la zhus par snang bas/ yan chad sa lugs dang 'dra la/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ rje btsun sga lo/ bla ma dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma don ri grags chen/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston lo tsā ba/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams man 'dra'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i rim pa smos pa 'di rnams chos kyi khungs tsam shes par bya ba'i phyir yin gyi/ brgyud pa'i gtso bo ni/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i chings dang / lag len gyi rim pa rnams ni 'gos dang / sa lugs gtso che ba yin no gsungs shing / rje mus chen nyid kyis bla med kyi dbang gis gzhan don mdzad pa'i thog ma yang 'di yin te/ de yang rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na gling dga' bde ba can du gsang 'dus kyi chos skor don gnyer gyi bu slob mang po 'dus pa'i tshe/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gsung gis da lam gyi gsang 'dus don gnyer 'dir 'dus rnams la/ chos rje shang pas dbang bskur gyis/ de nas nged kyis khrid sogs ston pa yin no zhes gsungs pa bka' bzhin bsgrub par mdzad pa'i sta gon gyi nub mo rje nyid kyi mnal lam du dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung na zan ril brtag pa zhig mdzad kyi 'dug pa na/ ril bu gcig phyir thon pa la me 'bar nas je mtho je mthor song ste/ mthar nam mkha'i dbyings su thim pa'i mtshan ltas shin tu gsal ba byung gsungs/

'di ni rje btsun bla ma nyid kyi 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pas gdul bya rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 'dren nus pa'i mtshan ma yang dag pa yin par nges so/ /de ltar kho bo cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'dis ni bgrang ba las 'das pa'i slob ma rnams la dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba dang / zab mo'i khrid ston pa sogs kyi sgo nas pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad cing / lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor dang / gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod rnams kyang ji srid mtshan ma brnyes kyi bar du thugs nyams su bzhes pa la brten/ zhing skyong tsa turmu kha 'di nyid rje nyid kyi bran bzhin du bka' nyan cing 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mang du snang yang / 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris la/ rtogs par 'dod na kho bos byas pa'i rje nyid kyi rnam thar nyid la blta bar gyis shig de ltar gong du bshad pa'i brgyud pa de dag las 'ongs pa'i dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma rnams la 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i zab mo'i khrid ston pa'i skabs su babs par gyur pa yin zhing / 'di la yang rje 'gos nas brgyud pa dang / mar pa nas brgyud pa gnyis yod pa las/ 'gos lugs kyi dbang du byas nas/ dang por spyod bsdus ltar/ sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa/ de nas smin byed kyi dbang rnams legs par thob par byas te/ sngon 'gro song nas/ dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor lus dben pa la slob pa/ de dag la lob pa'i dbang gis/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga lo chen 'gyur gzhung ltar rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sems la dmigs pa bdag byin gyis brlabs pa/ mngon par byang chub pa/ zung du 'jug pa dang lngar mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar 'phags pas bskyed rim rags pa/

lus dben phra ba ste/ rags pa'i khongs su phra ba 'du bar bya'o/ /sems dben gyi spros bral stong pa nyid du bstan pa la/ de ltar dge sdig la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag mi rigs sam zhes rgol ba byung na bzlog pa'i phyir/ sems la thog med nas bag chags brtan pa'i dbang gis kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad do zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ klu'i byang chub kyis mtha' rnam par dbye ba mdzad chag chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ cing / sems de nyid gsal ba'i phyir du arya de was sems kyi sgrib sbyong mdzad/ dzñā na a ka ra dang / nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal po'i 'gyur/ kun rdzob bden sgyu lus khongs bsdu/ pa sgyu lus kyi skabs su/ khyed kyi sgyu ma lta bu de phar phyin theg pa na grags pa'i sgyu ma lta bu de yin nam/ de las lhag pa gzhan yod ces chos nyid ngo sprod ston pa'i skabs su/ lus stong nyid tsam gyi ngo bo nas khyad par med kyang / rtogs byed kyi thabs la khyad par che bas/ de'i kha skong arya de bas/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa mdzad 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ 'od gsal chos can bde ba chen po'i kha skong / arya de was mngon par byang chub pa'i rim lo chen/ pa mdzad/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bde chen gyis drangs pa'i stong nyid spros bral ston pa'i skabs su/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis byang chub sems 'grel mdzad/ rim pa lnga po re re la yang rim pa lnga lnga tshang bar yod do zhes ston cing shes pa'i phyir/ klu'i byang chub kyis rim pa lnga khongs bsdu mdzad/ de rnams kyis rim pa lnga rgyas par bstan pa'i don bsgoms pas/ rtogs pa skyes na de dag ngo sprod pa dang / lam rim can du dkri ba'i tshul arya de was spyod bsdus sgron me mdzad/ rim lnga sbyor ba yan lag drug tu sbyar ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i sbyor ba drug pa/ sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/

rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa 'di man ngag gsang ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'di rim lnga sbyor drug dang gnad gcig tu bstan/ mngon shes can/ nag po pa/ btsun mo can rnams la 'gos kyis gsan pa'i shog ril gsum/ de'i 'grel pa 'gos kyis mdzad pa/ rdog gis mdzad pa'i khrid yig kyang rdog arya de bas mdzad pa'i dbang gong ma gsum gyi dmigs pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i khrid yig kun mkhyen chen po'i kha skong dang bcas pa/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud la 'gos kyis btab pa'i mchan chen sogs mdor na rje 'gos lo tsā ba'i lugs gtsang mar gyur pa'i rim lnga'i khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje chos/ klu las gyur pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ grub chen klu'i byang chub/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ slob dpon slob pa'i rdo rje/ paṇḍi ta nag po pa/ rgyal sras sa 'dres pa chen po/ paṇḍi ta bi ya bha dra/ de wa a ka ra tsant+ra/ rje 'gos lo tsā ba/ mar ston seṅge rgyal mtshan/ rngog ye shes seṅge / rlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam/ rdog arya de wa/ mkhan po 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shri/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge / yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ kong ston dbang phyug grub pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ de'i drung du bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa rje btsun bka' drin can mus chen buddha'i mtshan can nyid kyis gsan gsungs shing /

yang rim lnga mar lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / byang sems blo gros rin chen/ klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā/ dbang gi rdo rje/ rje gad pa/ bya khang pa bsod rin/ mi nyag thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ rgya mkhar thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ grub thob gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge / kong po paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ de'i drung du rje nyid kyis gsan gsungs/ des na rje mus chen nyid la rim lnga'i brgyud lugs gnyis ka bzhugs kyang / rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams 'gos lugs la gtso bor mdzad pa nyid la dgongs nas rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig zung 'jug gsal ba dang / rje sems dpa' chen po'i gsung la chos rje mang mkhar ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su btab pa'i rim lnga'i khrid yig rnams kyi steng nas/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i zab khrid smin rgyas su stsal te/ de'i rgyab rten du rgya bod kyi gzhung rnams kyi bshad pa dang lung gi tshogs rnams kyang shin tu zhib par gnang ste/ rje btsun gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis bdag blo'i bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur te rab dga'i sa thob pa lta bu'i dga' bde'i dpal la rang gzhan kun 'god par mdzad pa'i bka' drin gzhal du med pa stsal pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis rje btsun bla ma mchog gi gsung rgyun las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ khyab bdag byang chub sems kyi rdo rje nyid/ /gzhan ngor bshes gnyen mchog gi tshul bzung nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa'i/ /gang gi bka' drin dran pas snying nas 'dud/

/dbyibs mdzes brjid chags gzi 'od 'bar ba'i sku/ /padma ra ga'i lhun po phyis pa ltar/ /su yis mthong yang dwang ba'i dpal bskyed pa'i/ /yid 'phrog bla ma'i sku de lhag par dran/ /zab rgyas chos tshul sgo brgya 'byed pa'i tshe/ /zil che rab snyan rna ba'i bdud rtsi mchog /mgon de'i gsung de da lta mngon sum du/ /thos pa'i skal ba yod na e ma mtshar/ /chags sdang rmongs pa'i dri ma kun spangs shing / /ting 'dzin zab mo'i rgyun la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i chu gter che/ /bla ma'i thugs kyi yon tan dran zhing dad/ /gang sku tshul khrims dri bsung 'phro ba can/ /de gsung dam chos chos char 'bebs mkhas pa/ /khyod thugs ting 'dzin du mar mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /gsang gsum 'dus pa'i mgon der phyag bgyi 'o/ /gang gi drin las dpal ldan 'dus pa yi/ /dam chos byung tshul mdo tsam bshad pa 'di/ /rang nyid gsung rab don la goms phyir dang / /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir bshad mod kyi/ /'on kyang snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs rags/ /ji ltar byas kyang gzhan sems 'dzin dka' zhing / /phal cher rang nyid bsam pa ma rdzogs pa'i/ /nyes med gzhan la gzhi med sgro btags kyis/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis skur pa 'debs byed pa'i/ /tsher phung dbus su gcer bur gnas pa ltar/ /ci byas skyon du 'dzin zhing 'jug pa yi/ /skyes ngan rnams kyis smad par ma gyur cig/ ༈ //yongs 'dzin yongs kyi skyabs gnas bla ma yi/ /gsang gsum gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams/ /dad ldan dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /legs gsung legs bshad zin bris 'di ngo mtshar/ /tshul 'dis 'dus pa'i 'phrin las rab rgyas shing / /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar gyur pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /spyi don gnyis don tshan 'di rnams mkhas pa gong ma de dag gi gsung rab so so nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/

sgra ji bzhin du glegs bam 'dir bkod pa'i dgos pa ni/ gong du mchan bur bris zin pa de nyid dang / gzhan yang ding sang dus bskal gyi dbang gis blo gsal rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing gong ma'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can rnams la mthong rgya dang rtog dpyod 'dod pa'i skal bzang las 'phro can brgya zhig na re re tsam snang zhing / cung zad srid kyang 'dir bkod pa'i mkhas pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab mtha' dag ni/ ding sang gi skye bo dpe tshogs can sus kyang lag tu 'dzoms pa ni shin tu dka' bar mthong nas/ rgyu mtshan des na skyes bu blo gsal dang rnam dpyod rab tu gsal ba'i las 'phro can gsung rab rgya chen po mthong 'dod can rnams la gcig tu phan pa'i bsam pa kho na'i dbang byas te/ gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho las/ /ngo mtshar legs bshad rin chen rnams/ /gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam 'di/ /blo gsal rnams kyi dga' ston yin/ /'di la slob par 'dod rnams kyis/ /rang rang blo gros dang sbyar te/ /'dir bshad don tshan gcig bzung nas/ /gzhan rnams bklags pas bde blag rtogs/ /zhes kyi bar rtogs par gyis la/ blo chung log lta can rnams kyis ma go ba'i gtam ma smra zhig pa gung ru shes rab bzang po'i gsung rab nas 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ paṇa chen de nyid kyis rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung la zin bris mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim ི rnam bshad rmongs pa'i mun sel lam/ yid kyi mun sel zhes kyang bya zhing / log rtog gi mun pa sel bar byed pa padmo'i gnyen zhes kyang bya ba de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir bshad par bya ba'i chos ni dgra nag dang / gshed dmar gyi rgyud du/ rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyud sde gzhan nas kyang bsngags pa chen po mdzad cing / sgron gsal du bshad pa ltar dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge re re'i mtha' can gyi mtshan dang ldan pa'i rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig gsungs pa'i nang nas ches zab cing de thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i/

yi ge sa mā dza gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhes rgya bod na nyi zla ltar grags pa de yin no/ /'o na gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i don gang yin snyam na/ sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ /'dus pa tshogs par bya ba nyid/ /ces gsang 'dus kyi rgyud las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /'di bshad pa la don bzhi ste/ lam 'di phyogs gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba'i tshul gyis rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag bstan pa/ 'dus pa rgya bod du srol ji ltar byung tshul/ 'phags lugs kyi bshad srol 'di'i rten pa'i rgyud ngos bzung ba/ rgyud de la brten pa'i 'phags lugs kyi lam gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyod bsdus kyi le'u dgu par gsungs pa ltar/ bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan nas byon te 'dod chags bral ba'i gzugs su mngon par sprul te/ chags bral dman pa la mos pa rnams la theg dman gyi chos 'khor de bskor/ rgya chen po la mngon par zhen pa rnams la theg chen pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos 'khor de bskor/ yang 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gzugs su sprul nas zab mo la lhag par mngon par zhen pa rnams la theg chen gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor de bskor ba la de'i nang nas gsang ba 'dus pa 'di ni sngags kyi theg par gtogs so/ /'o na mdo sngags gnyis la khyad par ci yod snyam na/ slob dpon kri pi ta ka ma las tshul gsum sgron mer rgyud kyi lung drangs par/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar mdo sngags gnyis mthar thug 'thob bya'i 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / lta ba'i yul stong nyid dang spyod pa phar phyin bcu dang / sa bcu lam lnga thabs snying rje dang sems bskyed sogs gcig na yang lta ba de rtogs pa'i thabs la rmongs ma rmongs dang /

mchog thun mong sgrub pa la thabs mang nyung dang / lam dka' ba yod med dang / dbang po rno rtul gyi khyad par bzhi yod pa yin no/ /de yang mdo sngags gnyis ka mthar thug gi 'bras bu don gcig ste/ sam pu ṭi las/ gang phyir chos ni du mas ni/ /chu bo'i rgyun ni rgya mtsho ltar/ /bar pa nyid ni gcig pu nyid/ /mang po dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / sgyu 'phrul dra bar/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /mdo sngags gnyis lta ba stong nyid tsam rtogs pa la khyad par med de/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ gal te dbu ma las lhag pa'i/ /lta ba gzhan zhig yod na ni/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' bral du gtan la phab nas bsgom tshul mdo sde rnams nas bshad pa ltar rgyud sde rnams la yang rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang mdo sngags gnyis lta ba de rtogs pa'i thabs la rmongs ma rmongs yod de/ phar phyin theg par dpe dang gtan tshigs sogs kyi sgo nas lta ba rtogs par 'dod la/ sngags la de'i steng du yang bla ma la mos gus kyi byin rlabs dang / ye shes phab pa la brten nas lta ba rtogs pa'i nyams myong rgyud la skye ba'i thabs yod cing / bla med ltar na dbang gong ma gsum skur ba'i tshe dpe'i ye shes dang / don gyi ye shes skyes pa'i tshul gyis lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs lhag po yod cing / rnam rtog gis g.yo med du stong nyid la sems yun ring du 'jog nus pa yang yin no/ /yang mdo sngags gnyis la mchog thun mong bsgrub pa'i thabs mang nyung yang yod de/ mchog bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas na/ phar phyin tu rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pas 'bras bu sku gsum bsgrub tshul sogs rgyas par gsungs kyi/ sngags la de'i steng du yang mtshan bcas kyi lha'i rnal 'byor rgya chen po dang /

mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas mchog bsgrub pa yod cing / bla med ltar na bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i sgo nas mchog bsgrub pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /thun mong bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas na phar phyin theg par sngon gyi sbyin 'bras dang tshong khe phogs sogs la brten nas longs spyod 'byung bar byed cing thos bsam gyis blo sbyangs pas shes rab 'phel ba la sogs pa yod la/ sngags la de'i steng du yang nor bsgrub zab mo'i thabs nyams su blangs pas rang gzhan gyi tshe 'di'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung ba dang / 'jam dbyangs sogs shes rab blo 'phel gyi man ngag zab mo nyams su blangs pas shes rab myur du skye ba'i thabs yod cing / gzhan yang zhi sogs kyi las tshogs rab 'byams yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang mdo sngags gnyis dka' ba yod med kyi khyad par yang yod de/ phar phyin theg par bsam gtan dang shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba khyad par can yod kyang / sngags la de'i steng du'ang sbyang bya 'dod khams kyi 'dod chags rigs bzhi'i gnyen por 'dod chags de dang rigs 'dra ba'i bde ba rigs bzhi sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi la yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang mdo sngags gnyis la dbang po rno rtul yang yod de/ phar phyin gyi gdul bya de myur na yang bskal chen grangs med gsum dang so gsum 'gor la/ sngags kyi gdul bya de myur na tshe gcig la sangs rgya ba'am/ bla med ltar na rab tshe gcig lus gcig la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du byed/ 'bring bar do'am/ dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrungs na/ tha ma'ang skye ba bdun nam bcu drug la grol bar gsungs so/ /yang mdo sngags gnyis so so'i gang zag la'ang dbang po rno rtul mang po 'byung yang / bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gsog dgos pa dang / mi dgos pa gnyis po la yang dbang po rno rtul mang ba yin no/ /yang na thabs mang dka' ba med pa sogs kyi don phar phyin tu nyon mongs sogs spong tshul bshad kyang /

nyon mongs la brten nas lam du byed tshul ma bshad pas thabs nyung la/ sngags su nyon mongs pa 'dod chags lam du bsgyur tshul sogs gsungs pas thabs mang la/ yang phar phyin tu mgo dang rkang lag sogs gtong dgos pas dngos po yang dka'/ lam bde bas ma brgyan pas na lam yang dka'/ bskal pa grangs med sogs 'gor bas dus kyang dka' na/ sngags la ni lam bskyed rdzogs tsam gyis 'grub pas na dngos po yang sla/ sngags rgyud sde bzhi las lam bde ba rigs bzhis brgyan pas na lam yang sla/ sngar bshad pa ltar sngags kyis myur na tshe gcig dang / 'bring bar do'am/ tha ma skye ba bdun dang bcu drug tshun la 'grub par rgyud rgya gzhung tshad ldan rnams las bshad pa ltar yin pas na dus kyang sla ba yin no/ /yang phar phyin pa'i gdul bya de sngar blo gzhan du ma sbyangs pas na dbang po yang brtul zhing / sngags kyi gdul bya de phar phyin theg par blo sbyangs pa gcig 'jug pas na dbang po rno ba sogs kyi khyad par yod do zhes bde mchog gi skabs su gsungs so/ /'di rnams kyi skyon spong dang bcas pa rgyud sde spyi rnam sogs su shes so/ /sngags la yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ phyi nang gi rgyud sde gnyis su byas pa dang / slob dpon a bhya'i dgongs pa phyogs gcig la rdor phreng du rgyud sde bzhi pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi cho ga gnyis su bsdus nas rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud dang / ma'i rgyud sde gnyis su mdzad pa dang / slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje sogs yo ga ba rnams bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de gsum du byas pa dang / rdo rje gur du/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor sbyin/ /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar kyai rdor rgyud gsum gyi skabs su/ rje btsun birwa pa yab sras kyi rjes su 'brangs nas sa skya'i rje btsun yab sras kyis rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad pa rgya chen po mdzad pa dang /

yang slob dpon a bhyas bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum gyi steng du/ bla med la pha bla med dang / ma bla med de rgyud sde lngar byas pa dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig par/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes pa la brten nas grub chen nā ro pa dpon slob kyis bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum gyi steng du rnal 'byor gsang mtha' la/ pha bla na med pa dang / ma bla na med pa dang / ma'i yang ma gsang mtha' ste rgyud sde drug tu bzhed pa sogs yod na'ang / 'dir 'phags pa yab sras kyis 'dus pa'i rgyud ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ gnyis ka'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dang lngar mdzad pa'i nang nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'di rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du gtogs so/ /de ltar 'phags pa yab sras rnams kyis rgyud sde lngar byas kyang / rnam gzhag rim pa sogs su bde mchog gi lung drangs par shes rab kyi mdo las zhes gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la yang pha rgyud/ ma rgyud gnyis su bzhed par mngon la/ rim lnga'i sgyu lus kyi skabs su/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid la rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas pa zhes gsungs so/ /bsdu na rgyud sde bzhir 'dus par yang bzhed de/ rtog pa'i rgyud ni don bya rgyud yin yang thun mong gi las tshogs ston pa rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud lta bu la zer bas so/ /'o na rgyud sde de rnams gang la ngos 'dzin snyam na/ de la rtogs pa'i rgyud ni snga ma bzhin yin la/ gnyis pa bya ba'i rgyud ni/ rgyud sde gong ma'i cho ga ma sbyar bar bya rgyud rang rkang ba'i dbang du byas nas bdag nyid lhar mi bskyed/ mdun du lha rje dpon lta bu la dngos grub len pa'o/

/de ston pa'i gzhung ni gsang ba spyi rgyud/ legs grub kyi rgyud/ dpung bzang gi rgyud/ bsam gtan phyi ma sogs yin te/ rgyas par bya rgyud spyi rnam du shes so/ /rgyud sde gong mas rgyas bkab nas bya rgyud kyi lha la bdag bskyed sbyar ba yang yod de/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / rgya mtsho sogs kyi lha phal mo che bya spyod kyi lha yin pa la rgyud sde gong ma ltar bdag bskyed ye shes pa 'jug pa sogs slob dpon mang pos mdzad snang bas so/ /grub chen kun snying gis/ snying po phyag rgya sngags rig pas/ /dum bu las bshad rang bya 'am/ /bsgrub pa 'di ni thams cad du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni bya rgyud kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor dang / sngags kyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rnam dbye la mkhas pas bya rgyud so so'i cho ga ltar bya ba'am/ yang na yo ga ltar gyi cho gas nyams su blang rung bar gsungs pas/ bya rgyud la rgyud sde gong ma'i cho ga sbyar ba'i bshad pa byung ba yin no/ /bya rgyud rang rkang la bdag lhar bskyed pa med de/ bya rgyud kyi gzhung rnams nas bdag bskyed ma bshad pas/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud du/ bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med cing ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba dam pa dang bral ba ni bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs so/ /zhes 'byung ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas grub chen dpal 'dzin sogs tshad ldan mang pos bya rgyud la bdag bskyed mi bzhed pas so/ /de la dgongs nas chos rje sa paṇa gyi dris lan kha cig dang / sdom gsum rab dbye'i rang mchan du/ bya rgyud la rtog pa'i dbang du byas pa dang / sgrub thabs kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis yod do zhes gsungs pa ni gnad kyi don no/ /phyis kyi bla ma bu ston dag bya rgyud la bdag bskyed 'dod tshul sogs gyi dgag sgrub sogs ni bya rgyud spyi rnam du shes so/

/gsum pa spyod rgyud ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka lhar bskyed de/ lha grogs po lta bu la dngos grub len yang ye shes pa bcug pa med pas te/ bdag lhar bskyed pa ni bya rgyud las khyad par 'phags chos yin yang / bya rgyud la bdag bskyed na khyad par du 'phags chos gzhan ma byung pas/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /zhes sogs rgyud sde gong ma gong ma zab par bshad pa sogs dang 'gal lo/ /spyod rgyud kyi gzhung ni rnam snang mngon byang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud sogs la zer te/ rgyas par spyod rgyud spyi rnam du shes so/ /bzhi pa gnyis ka'i rgyud ni/ de'i steng du ye shes pa bcug phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab nas dngos grub len par gsungs kyang / dbang bzhi dang / rim pa gnyis dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa sogs med pas te/ ye shes pa bcug pa 'di bya spyod las khyad par 'phags chos yin kyang / bya spyod rang rkang la ye shes pa bcug par 'dod pa la ni rgyud sde gong 'og gi rnam dbye med par zad do/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud kyi gzhung ni rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa dum bu bzhi/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i yang phyi ma bshad rgyud la dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba/ gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa/ dum bu thams cad kyi bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo ste 'dis rigs lnga ka'i byed pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa ston pas na/ rim lnga sogs su 'di'i lung drangs par/ rgya che rol pa'i mdo las zhes gsungs pa de sher phyogs kyi rgya che rol pa dang nor bar mi bya'o/ /cha mthun gyi rgyud ni/ dpal mchog gi skor/ yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ ngan song sbyong rgyud sogs la zer ro/ /'dir bla ma phyi ma mang pos spyod rgyud la gnyis ka'i rgyud du 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/

slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba sogs kyis spyod rgyud la gnyis ka'i rgyud du byas pa yod kyang / 'phags lugs kyi skabs 'dir de ltar byed pa ni grub chen gyi gzhung dang dngos su 'gal lo/ /ji ltar 'gal na/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud du/ 'jig rten dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa dang mtha' drug gi spyod pa ston pa ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la bzhugs so/ /rig pa'i lha mo dkyil 'khor la bkod de de la 'phrin las bskul ba de kho na nyid bcu ston pa ni gnyis ka'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /las kyi bya ba phyag rgya chen po ston la phyag rgya la dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid ston pa sgrub par byed pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so zhes dang / grub chen klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu par/ bya rgyud cho ga ma gtogs pa/ /spyod dang gnyis ka rnal 'byor gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas ni/ /zhes sogs kyis gnyis ka'i rgyud spyod rgyud la ma bshad par/ spyod rgyud kyi gong gi rgyud sde phyis de nyid bcus khyad par du byas pa de la bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sgron gsal le'u bcu drug pa las/ sbyin sreg ces pa ni/ sbyin sreg gi mchod sbyin 'bul ba ste gnyis ka'i rgyud las byung ba zhes bya ba ni lhag ma'o zhes pa'i don du bsams nas/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang gi sbyin sreg gsang 'dus la sbyar ba yang nor te/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po rab 'jigs rdo rjes/ slob dpon bya dang spyod pa'i ma/ /gsal ba'i sbyor ba bris pa ni/ /de 'dir gsang 'dus sbyin sreg tu/ /rdo rje can gyis ma gsungs so/ /zhes sogs kyis spyod rgyud kyi sbyin sreg gsang 'dus la sbyar ba bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /yang sgron gsal gyi gzhung mang por sbyin sreg gi mchod sbyin 'bul ba ste/ gnyis ka'i rgyud las 'byung ba zhes gsungs pa ltar na phyi nang gi sbyin sreg gnyis ka rgyud las byung ba ltar bya zhes brjod na'ang bde ste/

gzhung de'i 'og tu bshang gci zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni nang gi sbyin sreg gsungs pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa dang 'grig go /des na 'dir de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa la gnyis ka'i rgyud zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ phyi'i spyod pa bya rgyud dang mthun/ nang gi sgom pa spyod rgyud dang mthun pas so/ /lnga pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la dbang bzhi dang / lam rim pa gnyis dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten nas dngos grub len pa gcig yin no/ /sdom gsum rab dbyer/ dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bskyed rdzogs rgyud sde 'og ma la med pa'i bla med kyi khyad chos yin pa/ rgyud don la mkhas pa thams cad bzhed pa mthun yang / lha bsgom tshad bskyed rim dang / stong nyid sogs dmigs med bsgom tshad rdzogs rim du smra ba ni rgyud sde'i don ma shes pa'i skyon yin no/ /rnal 'byor chen po la yang pha rgyud dang / ma rgyud gnyis yod la/ mkhas pa bu ston pa dang rjes 'brang dag na re/ pha rgyud la rigs drug gam bdun yod pa'i mi bskyod pa'i rigs la'ang gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu mi bskyod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ phyag rdor 'khor chen lta bu mi bskyod pa'i sems dpa'i rigs/ gshin rje gshed kyi skor ni mi bskyod pa'i khro bo'i rigs te rigs gsum mo/ /gnyis pa rnam snang gi rigs ni rnam snang sgyu dra'o/ /'od dpag med kyi rigs ni/ thugs rje chen po bde chen ral gcig go /rigs drug cha mnyam du ston pa ni zla gsang thig le'o/ /rin 'byung gi rigs dang / don grub dang / rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i pha rgyud ni bod du ma 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /de la bya rgyud rigs drug dang ma rgyud sgo drug tu byas pa yod kyang / pha rgyud la rigs drug tu byed pa mi 'thad de/ de ltar du mkhas pa snga ma sus kyang ma mdzad cing /

de ltar du byed pa'i lung rigs med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang 'dus 'jam rdor de sems dpa'i rigs su 'dod na/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gcig la de pa'i rigs dang sems dpa'i rigs gnyis su byed pa 'gal zhing / 'jam rdor de pa'i rigs su 'dod na/ phyag rdor 'khor chen yang de pa'i rigs su 'gyur te/ 'jam dbyangs dang phyag rdor gnyis don la de pa yin yang / sems dpa'i tshul bzung ba mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rigs bdag sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa yin par yang mtshungs pas so/ /gzhan yang bde chen ral gcig 'di don la rnying mar 'dug cing 'di'i kha 'dzin byed pa'i khro phu bas ni/ ma rgyud du 'dod pas na pha rgyud du mi 'thad do/ /yang rin 'byung dang don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi pha rgyud kyi rnam gzhag kyang mi 'thad de/ rgyud de gnyis ni bod du ma 'gyur bar ma zad/ 'phags yul sogs su'ang yod par bsgrub mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na zla gsang thig le'i rgyud du/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis rgyud sde gsum du mdzad pa kho na 'thad de/ de'ang 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa gsang ba 'dus pa/ zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa gshin rje gshed skor/ gti mug can 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa rnam snang sgyu dra'i rgyud sde gsum mo/ /dang po la'ang / 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ bshad rgyud la ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ rdo rje phreng ba/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud phyi ma ste rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bdun tsam yod do/ /lha'i dbang pos zhus pa dang / gnyis med rnam rgyal rnams kyang 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud du 'dod pa yod kyang / lha'i dbang pos zhus pa ni bod du ma 'gyur zhing mdo rgyud gang yin mi gsal la/

gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud chung de ni rnam snang sgyu dra'i bshad rgyud lta bur snang ngo / /gshin rje gshed skor la dmar nag gnyis kyi/ dang po la gshed dmar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis ka ston pa'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa dang / lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor kho na ston pa'i gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa ste gnyis so/ /nag po'i rgyud la rtsa rgyud dgra nag le'u bco brgyad pa'o/ /de'i bshad rgyud la drag las gtso bor ston pa 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa'i rgyud dang / 'khrul 'khor gsal bar ston pa sdom pa gsum pa'am gdong drug gi rgyud de rgyud sde gnyis so/ /yang rtog bdun gyi bshad rgyud du 'dod pa'i rtog gsum dang / gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa dang / gshin rje gshed 'khor lo'i rtog pa gcig ma dang / gshin rje brag dmar gyi rtog pa dang / las mkhan te'u lo pa'i rtog pa ste lnga tsam snang yang / rtog gsum ni skyo pa tshang gi bla ma zhig gis byas shing / gzhan rnams kyang bod dag gis 'jigs byed kyi bshad rgyud du sgro btags pa'o/ /kha cig na re/ rtog gsum bshad rgyud min zer ba mi 'thad de/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i rtog bdun gyi 'grel par/ phyi rol dbyangs dang gsal byed kyis bskor ba dang gshin rje'i lte bar bzhag pa la sogs pa ni 'di'i bshad rgyud rtog gsum las shes par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhes bris snang ngo / /de ni brdzun tshig yin te/ mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa'i le'u gnyis par lhag ma phyi rol dbyangs dang gsal byed kyis bskor ba dang gshin rje'i lte bar bzhag pa la sogs pa ni 'di dang cha mthun pa'i rgyud las shes par bya'o zhes sngar smras so zhes pa'i tshig gcig byung la/ tshig de'i bsnyeg sa ni sngar le'u dang por dbang bskur ba thob pa zhes bya ba ni gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud ces bya ba/

rgyud 'di dang rjes su mthun pa'i rgyud de las/ 'dir dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang / gtor ma dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi bya ba dang / bstod pa la sogs pa drang bar bya ste/ zhes smos pa de la bsnyegs pa yin gyis/ 'grel pa de'i stod smad gang du'ang rtog gsum zhes pa mi 'byung bas brdzun kho nas grub mtha' 'khyongs su re ba'i blun po mgo bskor ma byed cig yang ma rgyud la rigs drug tu yod de/ he ru ka'i rigs/ brtag pa'i rigs/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs/ padma gar dbang gi rigs/ rta mchog gi rigs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi rgyud do/ /dang po la'ang kyai rdor rgyud gsum/ rdo rje a ra li/ rigs kyi a ra li/ snyog pa med pa'i a ra li ste a ra li skor gsum/ phyag rgya chen po thig le/ ye shes thig le/ ye shes snying po/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid/ gsal ba grub pa nges bstan thig le ste thig le skor lnga/ phyi ma 'di bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud le'u nga gcig pa/ bshad rgyud la he ru ka mngon 'byung / phag mo mngon 'byung / sdom 'byung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ mngon brjod bla ma sogs dang / mahā ma ya/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo rnams su yod cing / dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ he ru ka ni dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu nyid ces 'byung bas dus 'khor ma rgyud du'ang gsal ba yin no/ /brtag pa'i rigs ni mi g.yo ba bla med/ rdo rje gdan gzhi/ de'i bshad rgyud/ maṇḍa aṃ pa/ gsang ba thams cad pa rnams so/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud do/ /padma gar dbang gi rigs ni rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa'i rgyud dang / ku ru kulle'i rtog pa'o/ /rta mchog gi rigs ni sgrol ma bla med kyi rgyud do/

/rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs ni ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud do/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor lta bu rigs thams cad pa'i rgyud de zur pa gcig tu byed pa mi 'thad do/ /de lta bu'i rigs bsdus pa ni bde mchog 'khor lo bsgyur drug la yod kyang / rdo rje gur dang 'di rnams he ru ka'i rigs su 'dus pas so/ /'o na pha rgyud ma rgyud la khyad par ci yod snyam na/ bla ma dag skyes pa 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa dang / phos zhus pa de pha rgyud/ bud med 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa dang / mos zhus pa de ma rgyud/ yang dur khrod yod med dang rdzogs rim la rlung ston pa dang / 'od gsal dang zung 'jug ston pa de pha rgyud dang / rtsa thig ston pa dang dga' ba bzhi ston pa de ma rgyud yin zhes sogs mang po bris pa ni phyogs re mtshon nus kyang / khyad par 'byed par byed pa'i gtso bo de ma yin no/ /yang ma rgyud las pha rgyud khyad par du 'phags te/ ma rgyud pa'i gdul bya ni dbang po brtul po dbang dus kyi nyams myong gi rgyun de nyid goms par byed pa tsam yin la/ pha rgyud pa'i gdul bya de lam zab pa dang rgya che ba la mos shing / ma rgyud pa'i lam gyi drag shos gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ pha rgyud pa'i ngag dben rdor bzlas kyi skabs su tshang zhing / phyag rgya la brten pa dbang gsum pa'i lam dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes 'dren par byed pa ni pha rgyud pa'i sems dben las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa dang chags lam du mtshungs pas sems dben gyi skabs su dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes tshang zhing / de'i steng du'ang sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug sogs pha rgyud la lhag por yod pa'i phyir ro zhes rje 'gos kyis gsungs/ 'di mar pa'i dgongs par yang mngon te/ mar pa'i rim lnga bsdus gsal las/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor rlung gis ste/ /bde chen byang chub sems kyis so/

/zhes gsungs so/ /de la ma rgyud kyi bdag po dag na re/ bskyed rdzogs kyi lam sna dang po dbang dus nas 'dzin dgos pas ma rgyud kyi gdul bya des dbang dus kyi nyams rgyun skyong bar byed pa bden yang / ma rgyud las pha rgyud khyad par du 'phags gsungs ba mi 'thad de/ sgyu ma'i sku dang 'od gsal dang zung 'jug ni ma rgyud la'ang yod cing / pha rgyud pas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba la/ ma rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor nas gsungs pa'i spyod pa gsum byed tshul gyi lam rnams snon dgos par spyod bsdus le'u tha ma gsum du gsungs pas so/ /yang pha rgyud kyi ngag dben dang / ma rgyud gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis mi mtshungs te/ ma rgyud du rlung bum pa can gyi gdams ngag khyad par can yod la/ pha rgyud la de med pa'i phyir/ yang sems dben las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa'i nyams len des ma rgyud pa'i dbang gsum pa'i lam phyag rgya la brten nas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes bskyed pa de 'dra ba gcig 'dren par mi nus te/ ma rgyud du nyams len de'i sngon du rlung sems la dbang thob par byed pa'i man ngag gtum mo'i rlung sbyor sogs yod kyang pha rgyud pa la man ngag de dag med pas so/ /dper na pha rgyud pas 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa 'dren pa'i don du phyag rgya bsten pa dang / sems dben gyi rtog pa 'dren pa'i don du phyag rgya bsten pa gnyis kyang chags lam du mtshungs na'ang man ngag khyad par sgyu lus sngon du song ma song gi khyad par gyis 'od gsal gyi rtog pa 'dren nus mi nus kyi khyad par yod pa bzhin no/ /de ltar min na bskyed rim gyi skabs su yang chags lam gyi gdam ngag yod pas des kyang sems dben dang 'od gsal gyi rtog pa 'dren nus par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na pha rgyud dang ma rgyud kyi khyad par ni/ grub chen nag po pas/ bskyed dang rdzogs 'byung dbye ba yis/

/rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /bskyed pa rnal 'byor pha zhes bya/ /rdzogs pa rnal 'byor ma zhes grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bskyed rim rgyas pa dngos su ston cing rdzogs rim shugs la ston pa de pha rgyud/ rdzogs rim rgyas pa dngos su ston cing bskyed rim shugs la ston pa de ma rgyud du 'jog go /de ltar 'thad pa yang yin te/ pha rgyud kyi gtso bo gsang 'dus la bskyed rim rgyas par bstan kyang / rdzogs rim gtum mo dang dga' bzhi'i ye shes dang / rtsa thig la gnad du bsnun tshul rgyas par ma gsungs la/ ma rgyud bde dges sogs su rdzogs rim de rnams rgyas par dngos su gsungs pas so/ /pha rgyud las ma rgyud shin tu zab cing rgya che ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin yang / rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi zab don mi shes pa'i man ngag dang mi ldan pa kha cig rang nyid kyis shes par rlom pa'i gsang 'dus kyi che ba dbyung bar bsams nas rgyud thams cad dang / chos thams cad la rang rang gi che ba dbyung ba'i kha zin re yong ba spyi lugs yin pas 'di'i bsngags pa brjod pa yang tshul de yin no snyam du mi 'dzin par 'dus pa shin tu zab par shes dgos tshul bris pa ni khron pa'i nang gi rus sbal gyis phyi'i rgya mtsho gzhal ba ltar yin pas rgyud sde zab mo thams cad la skur pa btab pa yin no/ /'o na thabs shes gnyis med kyi rgyud zab mo zhig zur na med dam snyam na/ de ltar med de/ kun rdzob tu gdul bya drang don du pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis gsungs kyang / rgyud kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa nges don du ni bla med thams cad thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud yin te/ rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga pa'i lung rdo rje snying 'grel du drangs par/ gang du thabs ni kun spyod cing / /shes rab gnas par gyur pa ni/ /kun rdzob rnal 'byor pha rgyud du/ /gang yin de ni nga yis bshad/ /gang du shes rab kun spyod cing /

/thabs ni gnas par gyur pa ni/ /kun rdzob rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /gang yin de ni nga yis bshad/ /kyai rdor gyi ni phyogs gcig min/ /don gyi 'dus pa la sogs pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dur khrod 'grel pa ye shes le'ur yang / rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces pas te/ kun rdzob kyi gang du rnal 'byor ma rnams yang dag par rgyu zhing thabs mi g.yo ba de ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /gang du thabs yang dag par rgyu zhing shes rab mi g.yo ba de ni thabs kyi rgyud do/ /rang gi ngo bo ni thams cad shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid/ gzhan rnams rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'di nyid de zhes gsungs shing / nges don du na/ kyai rdor dang / gsang 'dus dang / dur khrod rnams thabs shes gnyis med kyi rgyud yin tshul lung dang bcas pa bris pa'i phyir ro/ /don dam nges don du bla med kyi rgyud thams cad thabs shes gnyis med yin zhes pa'i don yang drang don du gdul bya'i ngor thabs shes gnyis med gtso che chung so sor gsungs kyang / nges pa'i don du rgyud kyi dgongs pa mthar thug bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu gnas so zhes pa'i don yin te/ dper na bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya'i ngor chos sna tshogs gsungs pa rnams kyang nges pa'i don du na/ de bzhin nyid la gzhol zhing 'bab ces pa dang mtshungs so/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi la dbang chog gi khyad par yod de/ bya rgyud la chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tsam zhig yod/ spyod rgyud la rdo rje dril bu ming dbang ste rigs pa'i dbang tsam zhig yod/ yo ga la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang bcas pa yod la/ bla med la dbang rdzogs par yod/ des na rgyud sde bzhi la sngags sdom thob pa'i dbang chog la khyad par yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sngags sdom la'ang khyad par yod cing / bsrung bya la'ang khyad par yod de/

bya rgyud du kho rang gi sgos kyi rtsa ltung bcu gsum/ spyod rgyud la rtsa ltung bzhi/ yo ga la rtsa ltung brgyad dam bcu gcig bla med la rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sogs bshad pas so/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag rgyas par ni rje btsun rtse mo'i rgyud sde spyi rnam dang / rje 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo sogs su shes so/ /gnyis pa 'dus pa la rgya bod du lam srol ji ltar byung tshul la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rgya gar du byung tshul yang bdun tsam yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyis 'dus pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud lnga la brten pa'i lam srol 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba ni lam srol chen po gcig yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'jam dbyangs la dngos su zhus pa'i bshad srol te/ de'ang 'dus pa rtsa rgyud dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma ste rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum po de la brten nas bskyed rim bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le ste ma rgyud dang mthun par bkral cing / de yang slob dpon nyid kyis sgrub thabs kun bzang / 'jam dpal zhal lung / grol ba'i thig le rnams mdzad cing / de'i dngos slob mar me mdzad bzang pos dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa mdzad de/ srol 'di ni rgya gar du nyi zla ltar grags shing grub chen dman zhabs/ grub chen tha ga pa/ dpal 'bras rdo rje/ rtse lung pa sogs brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma 'phags lugs pa las kyang ches bzang ba mang du byung zhing / gzhung phran yang mang po byung ngo / /gsum pa ni slob dpon shanti pas/ rtsa rgyud dang phyi ma sbrel ba'i 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog mdzad/ slob dpon 'di 'phags lugs pa'i slob dpon rgyal sras sa 'dres pa dang / ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i slob dpon dman zhabs gnyis kyi slob mar 'dug kyang /

lta ba sems tsam du bkral cing lha yang nyer lnga byas par snang bas 'phags lugs dang ye shes zhabs lugs gang yang min par 'dug go /bzhi pa ni slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa gleng gzhi ma rgyud dang mthun par bshad pa'i srol zhig byung ngo / /lnga pa ni smrirtis bla ma bzang po'i zhabs zhes pa zhig gi rjes su 'brangs nas rgyud kyi 'grel pa rang 'gyur du byas pa zhig yod do/ /drug pa ni shanti pa sogs mkhas pa sgo drug gi rjes tsam du byang shambha la nas dus kyi 'khor lo dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis 'phags yul du 'gyur ba'i nang nas gsang ba 'dus pa/ rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor bzhugs so/ /de'ang dus 'khor sngon la'ang byung ba phyis de'i chos skad gsang 'dus sogs la sbyar ba lta bu ni ma yin te/ shambha la'i rigs ldan rnams kyi lugs la bla med thams cad dus 'khor ltar 'chad rgyu yin pas so/ /bdun pa ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan cing sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub chen kun snying gis gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang / rnam snang sgyu dra rtsa bshad du bsdebs nas yo ga rnal 'byor dbyings ltar bsnun bsreg bcing gsum gyi srung 'khor dang / phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs sogs byed pa ste/ de'ang rdor dbyings ltar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun lon pa'i tshe rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa gsungs pas/ de'i rjes su gsungs pa'i rgyud thams cad de'i bshad rgyud lta bur 'dod pas/ slob dpon 'dis rgyud ma rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / pha rgyud gsang 'dus dang / sgyu dra rnams yo gar bshad de sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa yang mdzad do/ /gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa che ba kun snying gis byas zer ba de ni zom rong gis byas pa'o/ /'o na gsang 'dus sogs yo gar bshad pa mi 'thad dam snyam na/

skyon med de/ yo ga la 'phags yul ba'i slob dpon rnams kyi 'grel tshul dang / kun snying sogs za hor gyi yul gyi slob dpon rnams kyi 'grel tshul dang gnyis 'byung ba las/ 'phags yul ba'i slob dpon rnams kyis rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa byas nas rdor dbyings sogs rgyud sde gsum par byas te de'i gong du bskyed rdzogs zab mos khyad par du byas pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde rnams yod pa'i lugs yin la/ kun snying sogs za hor ba'i slob dpon rnams kyis rgyud sde gsum du byas nas/ spyod rgyud kyi gong na rgyud sde gang byung thams cad yo gar 'dus pas de'i gong du bla med zer ba'i rgyud sde gzhan med pa'i lugs so/ /dper na bla med la'ang 'phags yul ba'i slob dpon rnams kyi 'grel tshul la dus 'khor de bla med gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i chos skad zur pa gcig yin par 'dod la/ byang shambha la'i rigs ldan rnams kyis bla med thams cad dus 'khor ltar bshad rgyu yin gsungs nas/ bde dges gsang sogs dus 'khor ltar bkral ba'i sems 'grel skor gsum byung ba lta bu'o/ /'o na rgyud sde 'og mar/ bha gar ling ga bzhag nas ni/ /de la sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgom/ /zhes sogs rig ma dang snyoms 'jug byed par bshad pa rnams ji ltar 'chad snyam na/ de'i don bla med ltar snyoms 'jug la mi zer bar/ lha dam tshig pa'i bha ga la lha ye shes pa'i ling ga bzhag pas te/ des mtshon nas dam tshig pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad la lha ye shes pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad 'jug pa ston par 'chad do/ /yang rig ma lo bcu drug dang nyi shu lon pa ston pa sogs kyang mchod pa bcu drug dang mchod pa nyi shu ston par 'chad do/ /gzhan yang slob dpon a bhyas phreng bar gsang 'dus 'phags 'jam gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bris kyang / 'phags 'jam gyi zur bka'i nyams len dang mi mthun no/

/de yang zla grags gnyis pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs su/ dkyil 'khor pa'i lha la yang kha cig bcu gsum par 'dod do/ /kha cig bcu dgu mar 'dod do zhes 'byung ba ltar rgya gar ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs kyang mi mthun te/ 'phags lugs la so gnyis yin yang / shanti pa dang sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs dang 'grel pa rin phreng dang / kun snying gis mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha nyer lnga mdzad/ ye shes zhabs kyis bcu dgur mdzad/ smrirtis kyang mi bskyod par bcu dgu mar mdzad/ int+ra bho dhis bcu gsum du mdzad/ dus 'khor du'ang gsang 'dus rigs drug la lha dgu ma/ bcu gsum ma/ bcu dgu ma/ nyer lnga ma/ so gnyis ma/ so bzhi ma dang drug bshad de/ dus 'khor 'grel pa dri med 'od kyi dbang ler/ gsang 'dus lha dgu ma dang / bcu gsum ma dang / bcu dgu ma dang / nyer lnga ma dang / so gnyis ma dang / so bzhi ma rnams bshad nas/ de ltar 'dus pa drug gi dbye ba tha dad do zhes gsungs so/ /ye shes le'ur lha lnga ma dang / so drug ma sogs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa ni dus 'khor rang nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbye bsdu yin no/ /gnyis pa bod du srol byung tshul ni/ bstan pa snga dar la gsang 'dus 'gyur kyang rnying ma'i lhad zhugs so/ /bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar lo chen rin bzang gis paṇḍi ta shrardha la gsang 'dus zhus nas bsgyur cing dar bar mdzad kyang de nas brgyud pa'i gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dbang bka' sogs chad do/ /yang lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad du jo bo rje bod du byon nas rong pa 'gar dge ba rab gsal la 'dus pa 'phags lugs gnang zhing / mnga' ris kyi rgyal po lha byang chub 'od la gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dkyil 'khor la spyan ras gzigs dbus su go 'pho ba'i gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs gnang ba yang da lta ma chad par bzhugs so/ /de yang shanti pas gsang 'dus kyi 'grel par/

gal te rgyal gzhan dbus mar bzhag /de yi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ye shes zhabs lugs pas 'jam dbyangs dbus su bzhag nas/ 'jam dbyangs kyi rigs bdag mi bskyod pa de yar btegs pas dkyil 'khor de yang mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jog pa dang mthun par jo bo'i lugs la spyan ras gzigs dbus su bzhag dbus kyi mi bskyod pa nub kyi 'od dpag med kyi gnas su bskyal/ 'od dpag med spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs bdag tu yar btegs pas dkyil 'khor de'ang spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs bdag 'od dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/ /'o na 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag pa de 'khor gyi lhas gtso bo'i sa bzung bas gtso 'khor go log tu mi 'gyur ram snyam na/ mi 'gyur te/ gal te rgyal gzhan dbus mar bzhag /ces pa ltar 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs gnyis gzhan nas byon te dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag dbus kyi gtso bo de rigs bdag tu btegs pa yin gyi gtso bo de 'khor gyi gnas su mi 'jog pa'i dbang du byas kyi sems dpa' de gnyis dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i 'khor min te/ bcu dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa' gzhan rnams 'khor yug tu bkod pa med pas 'phags lugs dang 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /de yang lha bcu dgu ni rigs lnga yum bzhi/ khro bo bzhi/ rdo rje ma drug ste bcu dgu'o/ /'phags lugs pas chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i sbyang gzhi chos dbyings de/ lha gzhan rnams kyi sbyang gzhi la khyab pas chos dbyings rdo rje ma yang thams cad kyi spyi khyab tu btang nas zur du mi bgrang yang / ye shes zhabs lugs pas de yang brtsis nas rdo rje ma drug tu byas so/ /ye shes zhabs la 'jam dbyangs kyis gnang ba yin yang / jo bos spyan ras gzigs dbus su byas pas de bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gam/

yi dam gyis gnang ba yin min mi gsal lo/ /yang 'brog mi lo tsā bas paṇḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can la 'dus pa'i chos skor zhus pa yang da lta chad do/ /yang 'gos khug pa lhas btsas rgya gar du byon nas spyir chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma bdun cu/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mi'i bu mo'i gzugs can gnyis la zhus/ khyad par du 'phags skor la mkhas pa'i bla ma btsun mo can/ mngon shes can/ rdo rje gdan gyi nag po dam tshig rdo rje sprin gyi shugs can rnams las 'dus pa mkhas par bslabs nas bod du byon te bla ma snga ma gsum gyi bzhed pa thams cad bkod pa'i stong thun chen mo/ rgyan bdun gyi stong thun shog dril gsum/ sgron gsal gyi mchan chen rnams mdzad do/ /khong gi slob ma rgyud kyi ka chen 'dzugs pa bzhi/ man ngag gi gdung chen 'degs pa brgyad/ las tshogs dang 'phrin las la mkhas pa lcam dang dral ma gshib pa tsam byung ste 'dus pa'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad do/ /'gos kyi slob ma rdog ye shes seṅges mdor byas kyi ṭīkka mdzad/ de'i sras nyi ma seṅges stong thun chen mo'i nang gi btsun mo can gyi lugs de gtso bor ston pa'i stong thun 'bring po dang / sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa mdzad do/ /de'i slob ma brlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam gyis sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa mdzad do/ /yang de dang sa paṇa gnyis ka'i slob ma nyi ma seṅge'i sras rdog arya de wa zhes kyang bya/ zhang bya ru ba zhes kyang bya ba des sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa dang stong thun chen mo'i nang gi nag po pa'i lugs de gtso bor bkod pa'i stong thun chung ba mdzad do/ /stong thun gsum po yas rim gyis che la sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa gsum po mas rim gyis che'o/ /yang bla ma mar pa rgya gar du byon nas nā ro pa la 'dus pa 'phags lugs zhus te/ de yang klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i bshad pa spyod bsdus sogs 'grel pa lugs dang /

rnal 'byor pa ku sa la'i man ngag sangs rgyas lag bcang gi gdam ngag dang gnyis yod pa las khong gi lugs de phyi ma 'di yin gsungs nas dbang gong ma gsum la sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dang / me tog phreng ba 'bul ba dang / ye shes phab pa re re byed cing rdzogs rim la yang rim lnga gdan rdzogs zhes pa'i lam gcig car ba bsre 'pho'i gdams ngag dang bcas pa ston pa'i srol gcig byung ste/ 'di'i brgyud 'dzin la rgya pho ba lung pa'i lugs dang / bla ma gser sding pa'i lugs dang gnyis las phyi ma la rgyud rim lnga nag khrid kyi shog ril sum cu tsam yod gsungs so/ /phyis bla ma dag mar lugs kyi rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi nyams len yang yin/ spyod bsdus sogs kyi don yang yin par byas pa'i khrid yig byas pa ni mi 'thad de/ mar lugs kyi gdan rdzogs yin na lam cig car ba yin la/ spyod bsdus sogs su lam snga ma la lobs nas phyi ma la slob par bshad pas srol de gnyis shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang sa lugs ni rje 'gos kyis dbus pa dge ser la gnang / des gnam kha'ub pa la gnang / des sa chen la gnang / yang 'gos kyis 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la gnang / des skyu ra a skyabs la/ des sa chen la/ des rje btsun sku mched la gnang ste/ 'phags pa rin po ches mi bskyod pa'i dkyil chog mdzad la/ sa paṇa gyi slob ma la ru ba bsod nams seṅge / 'od zer shākya/ 'phags pa'i slob ma spro lung kun smon/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal rnams kyis sgrub thabs re mdzad/ yang rje sa chen gyis lo chen dang gnyan nas brgyud pa'i gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi sgo nas rigs sras bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad pas rje btsun sku mched bzhi sogs 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud byon pa yin zhing / sa skya paṇḍi tas paṇa chen shākya shrī la zhus nas/ zung 'jug gsal ba bsgyur pa yin zhing / de'i sa bcad kyang mdzad nas/

zung 'jug gsal ba dang / klu byang gi dkyil chog gnyis sbyar ba'i dbang bzhi rdzogs kyi bka' khyad par can 'di de nas byung bas na 'di sa skya paṇḍi ta kho na'i drin yin no/ /yang chag los bal po ra ben tra la gsang 'dus kyi dbang zhus nas sgrub thabs kyang mdzad/ klu byang gi dbang chog gnyis bsgyur kyang dbang chog sogs phreng ba ltar bya'o/ /yang chag los rngog rje btsun me 'bar la'ang 'dus pa zhus par grags so/ /yang chag lo dang 'phags pa rin po che gnyis ka'i slob ma grags pa grub kyis kyang sgrub thabs mdzad do/ /yang dpyal ba'i lugs kyi gsang 'dus kyang yod la/ gnyos lo tsā ba dpon slob la 'jam rdor gyi bshad srol bzang po byung na'ang da lta chad do/ /yang pa tshab lo tsā bas shud pu lo tsā ba'i lugs kyi gsang 'dus bsgyur kyang da lta chad do/ /de ltar bod kyi mkhas grub snga ma rnams la 'dus pa'i chos skor byung tshul mdo tsam bris pa ni da lta'i skye bo rnams rang nyid kyis phyogs tsam mthong ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas khron pa'i sbal pas rgya mtsho las rang gi khron pa che bar bzung ba ltar mkhas grub snga ma rnams la skur pa 'debs par mthong nas bris pa'o/ /gsum pa 'phags pa yab sras kyi bshad srol 'di'i rten pa'i rgyud ngos bzung ba ni/ mkhas pa dag 'phags pa yab sras kyis rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud la ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/ dgongs pa lung ston/ rdo rje phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gnyis med rnam rgyal/ rgyud phyi ma/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa/ sgyu dra ste rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bcu gcig la brten par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ sngar smras pa ltar sgyu dra ni kun snying gis gsang 'dus yo gar bshad pa'i tshe bshad rgyud du sbyar ba yin yang / spyir sgyu dra gsang 'dus kyi rgyud min la/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa yang bod du ma 'gyur zhing mdo sngags gang yin mi gsal bas gsang 'dus su mi 'grub cing /

gnyis med rnam rgyal che ba de ni chu shul gyi rgya pho ba lung pas byas so/ /rgyud chung ba de ni rnam snang sgyu dra dang mthun no/ /rgyud phyi ma dang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud gnyis ni/ spyir gsang 'dus kyi rgyud yin yang / ye shes zhabs lugs la med mi rung gi rgyud yin gyi/ 'phags lugs kyi bshad srol 'di la med thabs med ma yin no/ /kha cig na re/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa de ka 'phags lugs la dgos pa'i gsang 'dus kyi rgyud yin te/ sgron gsal du gleng gzhi'i e waṃ ma ya'i skabs su lung du drangs so/ /zhes zer ro/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa'i e waṃ gyi lung des 'dus pa'i gleng gzhi la phan pa tsam zhig e waṃ ma ya yod pa'i mdo rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi la phan pas de rgyud thams cad kyi bshad rgyud du 'gyur zhing / 'dus pa'i skabs su lung drangs tshad bshad rgyud du mi 'gyur te/ 'phags pa yab sras kyis bzang spyod sogs mdo lung du ma zhig drangs pas so/ /kha cig rgyud phyi ma ni 'phags pa yab sras rnams kyis lan gcig min par drangs shing / sgron gsal du yang rdo rje bzhi bskyed la sogs pa'i bskyed rim gyi cha du ma zhig dang sbyor ba yan lag drug la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim gyi rnam gzhag ches mang po zhig rgyud phyi ma nyid drangs nas rtsa rgyud kyi don bshad pas/ 'phags lugs pas rgyud phyi ma gtso bor mi mdzad do/ /zhes smra ba ni ma brtags pa chen po'o/ /zhes pa bris snang ngo / /de ni khyed rang gi ma brtags pa chen po yin te/ spyod bsdus kyi le'u tha ma gsum du ma rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi gzhung mang po drangs nas gsang 'dus pa'i gdam ngag gi rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa byed tshul rgyas par gsungs pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa yang sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu zhes pa'i yum gyi lung de spyod bsdus su zung 'jug gi skabs su drangs pa dang /

rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes pa'i lung de lus dben gyi skabs su drangs pas/ khyed ltar na mdo de rnams dang ma rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sogs/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs 'dir gtso bor byed dgos par 'gyur zhing / spyod bsdus su zung 'jug gi skabs su drangs pa dang / rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes pa'i lung sgron gsal la mdo rgyud bsres pa zhes zer ba ltar mdo rgyud mang po'i lung drangs nas gsang 'dus kyi rgyud don bshad pa ma nges pa'i skyon yin no/ /rgyud phyi ma'i lung drangs nas rtsa rgyud kyi don bshad zer ba la yang nus pa med de/ rtsa rgyud 'chad pa'i skabs su rgyab rten du drangs pa'i lung thams cad rtsa rgyud kyi don bshad pa'i phyir du drangs pas so/ /yang sbyor ba yan lag drug la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim gyi rnam gzhag ches mang ba zhig rgyud phyi mar drangs pa'i cha nas rgyud de gtso bor byed na/ rgyud phyi mar gsungs pa'i rdzogs rim sbyor ba drug de ji lta bzhin du 'phags pa yab sras kyis zhal gyis bzhes par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang de dag gis ni lung du drangs pa tsam dang bshad rgyud du 'gro ba'i mtshams kyang gtan nas ma shes pa yin te/ bshad rgyud du 'gro ba la ni rtsa rgyud du sbas pa'i don gcig la ston pa nyid kyis sngar gyi don de 'chad byed du dmigs nas phyis gsungs pa'i rgyud de bshad rgyud du 'gro la/ de la yang mi gsal ba gsal bar bya ba dang / ma tshang ba kha skong bar byed pa sogs kyis bshad rgyud du 'gro tshul lnga tsam yod pa'i gnad ma shes pa'i bab chol du smra ba yin no/ /des na 'phags pa yab sras kyi bshad srol 'di la med kha med kyi rgyud ni rtsa bshad lnga yin te/ rgyud lnga po de dag gang rung gcig ma tshang na'ang 'chad thabs kyi man ngag mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i 'chad tshul sogs dang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len rnams tshang bar mi 'thon pa'i phyir ro/
