/de yang bshad rgyud phyi ma gnyis po de thun mong gi bshad rgyud yin te/ rdo rje phreng ba ni bde mchog sogs dang thun mong ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa ni sambu ṭi dang thun mong ba yin pas so/ /dang po gnyis po de thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud yin la/ de yang ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las don gyi cha de gtso bor ston/ dgongs pa lung ston gyis tshig gi cha de gtso bor ston pa yin no/ /bzhi pa de la brten pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa la bzhi ste/ 'phags skor gyi gzhung yod tshul/ de rnams kyi nang nas nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung rnams nyams len du bsgrig tshul/ nyams len gyi rnam gzhag spyir bshad pa/ bye brag tu bskyed rim bshad sa bcad 'di'i don rgyas par shes par 'dod na kun mkhyen gung rus mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi rnam bshad rmongs pa'i mun sel du blta bar gyis shig kho bos byas pa'i bstan bcos 'dir ni rnam bshad de nyid kyi dbu na bzhugs pa'i lugs 'di'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul nyid logs su bkol ba yin no/ pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa nyid kyis sgrub thabs mdor byas te rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa yan chad du bsdus pa yin no/ /zhes yid ches pa'i khungs dang sbyar zhing / mdor byas kyi kha skong 'ga' zhig kyang ston pa mdo bsres te/ bskyed rim gyi gzhung gnyis mdzad la/ yang rim lnga dang byang chub sems 'grel te rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gnyis mdzad do/ /byang chub sems 'grel tshig lhug pa de ni 'phags pas mdzad pa ma yin no/ /snga rabs pa rnams klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa de tshad mar byas te/ de'i steng nas phyag len du mdzad do/ /'on kyang 'gos rang gis ni stong thun chen mor 'phags lugs kyi dbang chog tshang mar bris pa ltar mdzad do/ /phyis klu byang gi dkyil chog gi bka' de byung nas sngar gyi de la bka' rnying zer ro/

/de la bla ma dag sngar gyi dkyil chog de klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ma yin te/ de klu byang gi dkyil chog dang mi mthun pas so zhes gsungs so/ /mkhas pa kha cig de ni slob ma'i gzhung dang ma mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis slob dpon gyi gzhung 'gog par mi rigs pas klu byang gi dkyil chog de klu sgrub kyi dkyil chog dang mi mthun pas the tshom can du byed dgos so zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang klu byang gi dkyil chog de tshad mar byed dgos te/ klu sgrub kyi dngos slob sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bzang pos zung 'jug gsal bar/ ye shes dbab tshul klu byang gi dkyil chog la kha 'phangs shing / phreng ba'i stod smad mang por lung drangs pa dang / kha che paṇa chen sogs kyis tshad mar byas pas so/ /dkyil chog snga ma de dang por 'phags pas chung se ba zhig mdzad pa la dus phyis mchan dkyus su shor ba'am/ 'phags pa'i gsung rgyun bla ma gzhan zhig gis bris pa la lhad cung zad cig zhugs pa yin par 'dug go /de lta na'ang de'i dbang chog de 'phags lugs kyi bka' yang dag yin te/ gzhung der thun mong gi dbang dgu sogs legs par byung ba dang / 'gos kyi stong thun du yang lung drangs pas so/ /'o na zung 'jug gsal bar/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i/ /dbang gi cho ga gsal bar bshad/ /ces 'byung ba de gang la zer snyam na/ de ni gzhung de'i sa bcad sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad par gsungs pa ltar klu sgrub kyi rim lngar/ phreng ba chu dang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs kyis dbang chog gsungs pa de la zer ba yin no/ /yang arya de was rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa spyod bsdus sgron me le'u bcu gcig yod pa dang / sems dben las 'phros pa sems kyi sgrib sbyong / sgyu lus las 'phros pa bdag byin gyis brlab pa/ 'od gsal la 'phros pa mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa ste gzhung bzhi mdzad par grags kyi/

phyi ma 'di rdog pa las byung ba'i the tshom can no/ /yang arya de was byas zer ba'i sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa ni rdog arya de bas byas la/ ya ra la wa sogs tshul bzhi bshad pa yang de'i nang gi gleng gzhi'i bshad pa de zur du phyung ba'o/ /yang ro bsreg gi cho ga arya de was byas zer ba yang bod ma'o/ /yang klu byang gi 'phags pa'i mdo byas kyi nyams len de sbyang gzhi dang sbyar ba dang / lhag mos 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang / lus dkyil dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs rnams su kha skong gi zin bris lta bur gyur pa rnam gzhag rim pa dang / dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi sems dben las 'phros pa las mtha' rnam 'byed dang / rim lnga khongs bsdud de gzhung bzhi mdzad par grags kyang phyi ma 'di the tshom can no/ /klu byang gis mdzad pa'i mdo byas kyi 'grel pa de kho na nyid grub pa zhes bya ba gcig yod par grags kyang bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /yang rim lnga'i 'grel pa nor bu'i phreng ba klu byang gis byas zer ba ni zom rong gis byas so/ /yang don gsal zhes pa dang / mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel klu byang gis byas zer ba yang bod ma'o/ /yang sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis ras bris kyi dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba mdzad do/ /slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis rim lnga'i sems dben gyi mjug tu/ srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol 'gyur/ /zhes pa yan rdzogs pa'i de man chad kyi 'phro de mdzad do/ /des na shākya bshes gnyen zhes pa 'phags pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su 'chad pa dang / 'phags pas mdzad pa la shākya bshes gnyen gyi mdzad byang sbyar ba yin zhes sogs 'chad pa ni mtha' ma chod pa'o/ /yang sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa bha bya kirtis byas zer ba dang / spyod bsdus kyi 'grel pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis byas zer ba yang 'phags pa'i dngos slob gnyis po de ma yin no/

/yang dpal ldan zla ba grags pas 'phags pa yab sras kyi dgongs pa bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams len rnams rgyud la mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi sogs rgyan bdun gyi bshad pa byas pas ston no zhes shes pa'i phyir du rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa'i 'grel pa sgron gsal mdzad cing / 'grel pa des yab sras kyi gzhung snga ma rnams la mi gsal ba'i sgrub dkyil gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba mang po zhig kyang bstan to/ /'o na rgyan bdun po de gang la zer snyam na/ gleng slang ba rnam pa lnga/ rigs pa bzhi/ mtha' drug spyi sbas mthar thug yig don gyi bshad pa ste tshul bzhi/ slob tshogs kyi bshad pa gnyis/ slob ma brtag pa/ bden pa gnyis dang bdun yin te/ sgron gsal dang stong thun chen mor shes so/ /'o na zla ba grags pa 'di klu sgrub kyi dngos slob min nam zhe na/ 'phags pas rgyal bu la dbu sbyin par btang rjes zhal mjal ba lta bu la ni 'gal ba med de/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes su zhal mjal ba dang / grub chen klu byang da dung yang lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas bzhugs pa la skyes bu skal ldan rnams da lta yang zhal mjal ba yin no/ /'phags pas dbu sbyin par ma btang gong du dpon slob tu byas nas 'chad nyan byas pa'i dngos slob ni min te/ zla grags 'di nā ro pa'i slob dpon tsaṇḍa go mi dang dus mtshungs du bshad pa dang / zla grags kyi dus na arya de wa'i slob ma gnas brtan chos skyong ste birwa pa yang byon zin par bshad pa dang / klu sgrub dang de'i dngos slob phal cher yang 'das zin par zla grags rang nyid kyis gsungs te/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i rang 'grel du/ gal te gnas brtan dbyig gnyen dang / phyogs kyi glang po dang / chos skyong la sogs pa bstan bcos mdzad pa po rnams byon zin par gyur pa de dag gis kyang / yi ge tsam mthong bas 'jigs te rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i don phyin ci ma log par ston pa 'di yongs su spangs sam zhe na/

de skad du smra'o/ /zhes pa dang / tshig gsal gyi mjug tu/ bde ba can du rgyal ba'i sras po klu sgrub gshegs par gyur pa des mdzad pa'i/ /gzhung rnams dang ni slob ma'i tshogs de dag kyang dus mang zhig na nyams par gyur/ /de nyid nyi ma nub pas deng sang gzhung lugs gsal po de ni da lta gang na'ang med/ /ces gsungs so/ /kha cig na re/ jo bos/ klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin/ /de las brgyud pa'i man ngag gi /zhes pa dang / legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma shes rab sgron me'i 'grel pa spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs su/ dbu ma'i 'grel pa mdzad pa po/ gnas brtan bhuddha dharma pa li ta dang / tsaṇḍa kirti sogs bgrangs pa'i mthar slob dpon legs ldan 'byed nyid la thug pa'i bar dag yod pa las/ zhes bshad pas dpal ldan zla grags kyang klu sgrub kyi dngos slob tu grub bo zhes gsungs so/ /de ni ma nges te/ lung snga ma'i don ni mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis gsungs pa ltar zla grags 'phags pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin skyong nus pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin pa la dgongs pa ste/ chos grags kyis phyogs glang gi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin lon pas bar du dbang phyug sde yod kyang phyogs glang chos grags zhes dngos kyi dpon slob lta bur brjod pa bzhin no/ /spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyi dngos slob tu 'dod srid kyang slob dpon de tshad mar rang gis kyang ma byas te/ de'i rtsa she'i 'grel pa 'ga' las/ 'jig med klu sgrub kyi rang 'grel du 'dod pa de khyed rang gis kyang tshad mar ma byas pas so/ /kha cig na re/ rje 'gos sogs kyis dngos slob tu 'dod zer ba ni brdzun yin zhing / paṇḍi ta ku ma ras dngos slob tu byas zhes pa dang / skyon gsal 'grel par/ skal ldan grags pas dngos slob tu byas zer ba yang skal ldan grags pa khyed rang gis kyang tshad mar ma byas shing / dngos slob tu 'dod pa'i rgya gar ba kha cig la yang nges pa med de/

shākya bshes gnyen de klu sgrub kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs su 'dod pa'i nor ba rgya gar ba la yang 'dug cing / zla grags kyi rgyus de zla grags rang nyid che ba'i phyir ro/ /des na gong du smos pa ltar klu sgrub dang klu byang sogs la dus phyis mjal ba'i slob ma yin par mi 'gal te/ grub chen klu byang da dung yang lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs par bshad pas so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs tsaṇḍa kirtis byas zer ba 'di sgron gsal mkhan pos mdzad pa min te/ gzhung de yab sras dang mi mthun pa'i lcags chu me rlung gi ra ba'i srung 'khor mdo bsres dang mi mthun pa'i lung sbyor du ma snang ba dang / ye shes tsam la snyoms 'jug pa/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /ces pa rnam snang sgyu dra'i khungs de bde mchog gi lung khungs su nor ba sogs snang bas so/ /yang gzhung der kha cig lha bcu dgur 'dod ces pa 'byung ba de ye shes zhabs lugs la zer na ni ye shes zhabs zhi ba 'tsho'i slob ma 'grel pa don gsal mkhan po slob dpon seṅge bzang po'i slob mar bshad pas sgron gsal mkhan po las ches phyi ba yin no/ /bla ma kha cig rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs 'di bod ma yin gsungs pa yang mi 'thad de/ gzhung 'di la rgya dpe dngos su snang zhing / gzhung de la la li ta badzra dang / ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta'i 'grel pa 'byung bas so/ /sa paṇa gyi gsan yig tu rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs shes rab 'byung gnas kyis byas pa zhes 'byung bas zla grags gnyis pa ste slob dpon gzhan zhig gis byas pa yin no/ /yang mdor byas la 'grel pa brgyad yod de/ a bhya ka ra'i rim lnga dang sbrel ba'i 'grel pa/ bha bya kirti'i 'grel pa/ thub pa dpal gyi 'grel pa/ brtson 'grus bzang po ste btsun mo can gyi 'grel pa/ bi bhu ta tsaṇḍa'i 'grel pa/ nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdo bsres dang gnyis ka la 'grel pa byas pa/

slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i 'grel pa/ kha che legs smra'i 'grel pa rnams so/ /yang klu byang gis byas pa'i mdo byas kyi 'grel pa de kho na nyid grub pa zhes bya ba zhig yod par snang ba bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /shanti pas byas zer ba'i 'grel pa rin chen phreng ni sgeg pa'i rdo rje ltar lha nyer lnga byas snang bas 'phags lugs min no/ /yang nag po dam tshig gi rdo rjes 'dus pa'i dkyil chog ma rgyud dang mthun pa gcig gtor chog rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog rnams mdzad do/ /yang mngon shes can gyi gtor chog rab 'jigs rdo rje'i sbyin sreg slob dpon sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi lam gyi rim pa rnams yod do/ /'di man chad gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos byung tshul rang du mi snang yang lugs 'di'i nyams len gyi rnam gzhag dang / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i gnad la shin tu phan pa zhig 'dug pas bris pa lags/ gnyis pa de rnams kyi nang nas nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung rnams nyams len du bsgrigs pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi dbang du byas na mdor byas dang / mdo bsres gnyis la rnam gzhag rim pa de zin bris kyi tshul du sbyar te/ de la le'u bzhi yod pa'i le'u tha ma don dam pa'i rnam par gzhag pa 'di lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i skabs su sbyar/ le'u gnyis pa dgod pa'i rnam par gzhag pa lus dkyil gyi skabs su sbyar/ le'u gsum pa phyung ba'i rnam par gzhag pa de dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs su sbyar/ le'u dang po sbyang gzhi'i rnam par gzhag pa de sgrub thabs dang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul du 'chad do/ /yang sgron gsal gyi skabs kyi bskyed rim la nye bar mkho ba lhag mos kyis mdzad pa sogs mang po kha bskang rgyu yod la/ sngon 'gro'i skabs su rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog nyams su blangs pas sgrub thabs tshang bar 'byung zhing /

dkyil chog gi dbang du byas na/ klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu pa dang / zung 'jug gsal ba gnyis kyi steng du sgron gsal gyi le'u brgyad par bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsgrub tshul gsungs pa dang / le'u bcu drug par nang dbang bskur tshul gsungs pa sogs sbyar bas dkyil chog des rdzogs par thon la/ rab 'jigs rdo rje'i sbyin sreg dang / mngon shes can gyi gtor chog rnams sbyar bas bskyed rim gyi cha rdzogs par 'byung ngo / /de yang dkyil chog la sgron gsal gyis kha bskang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sgron gsal du nang dbang bskur ba/ rnam snang chu dbang rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs su lus dkyil 'god pa/ sngags kyi rjes gnang byed tshul sogs gsungs pas so/ /bla ma phyi ma rje dag bshad rgyud rdor phreng du mi bskyod pa chu dbang du gsungs pa la brten nas gsang 'dus la mi bskyod pa chu dbang byas te/ rnam snang chu dbang mi byed pa ni rgyus med pa'i gtam yin te/ rdor phreng du dbang chog gsungs pa de mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis gsungs pa ltar/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang chog de ston pas te/ rgyud rdor phreng de bde mchog dang thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud du 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin zhing / rgyud der thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs kha ṭwaṃ ga thod pa/ tshangs skud sogs ster ba dang / lus dkyil du dbang bskur tshul rgyas par bshad pa de bde mchog ma gtogs gsang 'dus la ji ltar sbyar du rung soms shig de la rgyud der phur gdab sogs bshad pa de dril bu pa la sbyar du mi rung bas 'phags lugs kyi cho ga nyi shu pa de ston pa yin nam snyam na/ ma yin te/ dril bu pa la dgos pa'i dbang chog tsam tshur sbyor ba yin la/ rgyud der sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i cho ga nyi shu bshad pa/ 'phags lugs kyi cho ga nyi shu dang don mi gcig pas zhib tu dpyod cig des na 'dus pa 'phags lugs la rnam snang chu dbang byed dgos te/

klu sgrub kyi dngos slob sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyi chu dbang gi skabs su/ phreng ba'i dbang bskur byas pa yis/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor dbus bkug ste/ /rtag pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa yis/ /zhes pa dang / klu byang gi dkyil chog gi ming dbang gi skabs su/ slob ma rdo rje 'dzin dag tu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / /thabs cig tshigs bcad 'di brjod cing / /zhes mi bskyod pa ming dbang du bshad pas rnam snang chu dbang du grub la/ dus 'khor 'grel par yang 'dus pa ba'i rnam snang chu dbang byed pa'i 'dod pa bkod cig sgron gsal le'u bcu drug par/ sangs rgyas te rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms nas de bum pa'i nang du chud pa ni spyan la sogs pa bzung bar mkhas pa ste slob dpon gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /de ci 'gyur zhe na/ slob ma blo brtan pa sems rtse gcig rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad du gyur par bsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang rig pa'i dbang lnga la lus dkyil tshang bar 'god dgos te/ lung snga ma de'i 'phros su/ lus dang ngag sems rdo rje can/ /zhes pas slob ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor la sngags shes pas zhes pa lha bskyed pa'i sa bon shes pas dgod par bya'o/ /de ltar dgod par byas nas 'og nas bshad pa 'dis dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur ba ni dbang bskur ba thams cad de zhes 'byung bas so/ /yang nang dbang bskur ba yang byed dgos te/ lung snga ma de'i stod der/ yungs kar gyis ni brdeg par bya/ zhes pa'i 'bru non du rang gi phyag rgya dang lhan cig tu byas pa las byung ba'i yungs kar te/ byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le rnams kyis brtul zhugs can te/ slob dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bsgoms la slob ma la dbang bskur bya ba'i phyir brdeg par bya zhing bskur bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul zhing bdag nyid nye bar byon nas dbang bskur cing byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/

/zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rjes su sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa yang bya dgos te/ yang de nyid las/ sngags kyi zhes bya ba las sogs pa la dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin pa la/ bla mas khyed dngos grub gang 'dod ces dri bar bya'o/ /des gal te bdag ni 'di 'tshal lo/ /zhes smra na/ de'i tshe de la bya ba de bsgrub pa'i sngags sbyin par bya'o/ /ji ltar sbyin par bya zhe na/ sngags kyis bskul ba smra ba pos/ /zhes bya ba ste sngags kyis bskul ba smras pa yi zhes pa ste/ smras pa de la sngags kyis bskul ba smra ba'i slob ma'i tshig des slob dpon gyis de'i tshig la bsam pa shes par byas la sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa tshad mar byed na rnam snang chu dbang sogs byed dgos pa yin zhing / rnam snang chu dbang sogs byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi man ngag kyang snang ngo / /bskyed rim gyi gzhung rnams de ltar yin zhing / rdzogs rim la 'phags pa'i rim lnga'i sems dben gyi skabs su/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong dang las mtha' rnam 'byed rnams dang / sgyu lus kyi skabs su bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/ 'od gsal gyi skabs su byang chub sems 'grel dang / mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa rnams sbyar te bshad pas rdzogs rim de rdzogs par thon no/ /rim lnga khongs bsdu dang / rdo rje 'chang gi lam rim pa gnyis kyang rdzogs rim la nye bar mkho ba tsam yin te/ dang pos rim lnga'i rim pa re re la'ang rim pa lnga lnga tshang tshul gcig ston la gnyis pas 'phags lugs kyi rim lnga dang / rgyud phyi ma nas bshad pa'i sbyor drug de cha mthun sbyor tshul tsam zhig ston pas so/ /gsum pa nyams len gyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa ni/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ bskyed rim la rim pa gcig dben gsum la sems tsam la dmigs pa zhes pa'i rim pa gcig kun rdzob bden pa sgyu lus/

kun rdzob bden pa dag pa ste 'od gsal/ bden pa gnyis sbyor ba ste zung 'jug dang / rim pa lngar mdzad nas rgyud kyi don ma lus pa rim pa lnga po der 'dus par gsungs te/ sgron gsal du/ gsang sngags sku ni rab sgrub byed/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa dang po yin/ /sems la dmigs pa tsam zhig ni/ /rim pa gnyis pa zhes brjod do/ /kun rdzob bden pa bstan pa ni/ /yid 'ong rim pa gsum pa yin/ /kun rdzob bden pa dag pa ni/ /rim pa bzhi po zhes brjod do/ /bden gnyis sbyor ba gang yin pa'i/ /zung 'jug ces bya lnga pa ste/ /'di ni bsgrub pa'i yan lag mchog /rgyud kun gyi ni don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'phags pa nyid kyis lus dben dang bskyed rim sngon song gi rdzogs rim kho na la rim pa lngar mdzad do/ /'o na lus dben dang bskyed rim ji ltar sngon du song snyam na/ bskyed rim ni mdo byas ltar yin la/ lus dben yang mdo byas kyi rjes spyod kyi skabs su snang ba thams cad lhar bsgom par gsungs pa de nyid la man ngag gi bshad pa byas pas thon pa yin no/ /yang arya de was rim pa lnga'i grangs nges ma mdzad par/ lus dben sogs dngos su bris te/ spyod bsdus la le'u mang po byas nas gang zag rim gyis dkri tshul gsungs shing / rim lnga khongs bsdud du lus dben dang lam rim pa drug tsam du byas so/ /'o na 'phags pa yab sras kyi lam gyi rnam gzhag phan tshun 'gal lo snyam na/ tshig gi 'chad tshul ni mi mthun te/ bskyed rdzogs thams cad rim lngar 'dus pa'i bshad tshul dang / rdzogs rim 'ba' zhig la rim lngar byas pa sogs bshad tshul tha dad pas so/ /'on kyang don gyi dgongs pa ni mi 'gal te/ klu sgrub dang arya de was lam gyi rnam gzhag mang po gsungs pa rnams bsdu na zla grags ltar 'du zhing / yang zla grags kyis bskyed rdzogs thams cad rim lngar bsdus pa'i rdzogs rim de la yang klu sgrub ltar ngag dben sogs rim pa lngar dbyer yod de/

sgron gsal las/ sngags dang sems dang lus dang ni/ /rnam gzhag dang ni gzug pa dang / /rim pa lnga yi bsdus pa'i don/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang lam de rnams bsdu na bskyed rdzogs gnyis su yang 'dus so/ /de la spyir/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam gzhag la/ sems 'grel ba rnams 'bras bu la bskyed rdzogs mtshan nyid par bzhed do/ /kyai rdor rgyud gsum gyi skabs su birwa pas lam la bskyed rdzogs mtshan nyid par bzhag ste/ sa skya pa yab sras kyang 'di nyid la thugs rtsis su mdzad nas bshad pa rgyas par mdzad do/ /'dus pa'i skabs 'dir sbyang gzhi'i bskyed rdzogs skye 'chi gnyis la bskyed rdzogs mtshan nyid par bzhag ste/ dang po khu khrag sogs las lus rim kyis bskyed pa'i bskyed tshul de 'dra ba dang / mthar tshe yongs su rdzogs nas 'byung bzhi dang phung khams skye mched bsdu tshul rdzogs pa 'chi ba'i rim pa gnyis po de blos btags pa tsam min pa don steng du mtshan nyid par grub la/ lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis ni blos btags pa ste bcos nas bsgom dgos pas so/ /de ltar du'ang spyod bsdus su/ skye ba zhes bya kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /'chi ba'i ming yang don dam bden pa yin/ /rim gnyis 'di dag bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /brnyed pa gang de ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la kha cig na re/ sbyang gzhi skye 'chi gnyis po de bskyed rdzogs mtshan nyid pa yin na/ sems can thams cad la bskyed rdzogs rang chas su yod par 'gyur bas de rnams 'bad med du grol bar 'gyur zhing / rim pa gnyis po de bla ma'i man ngag la rag ma las par 'gyur bas/ rim gnyis 'di dag bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /brnyed pa gang de ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang 'gal lo zhes bris snang ngo / /'o na khyed rang gis kyang sbyang gzhi 'chad pa'i skabs su/ 'bras dus kyi sku gsum dang / lam dus kyi sku gsum dang /

gzhi dus kyi sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag byas/ sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum po de sku gsum du khas blangs pas/ sems can thams cad la sku gsum rang chas su yod par 'gyur bas de rnams 'bad med du grol bar 'gyur zhing / sku gsum lam du byed pa bla ma'i man ngag la mi ltos par 'gyur ro/ /gal te gzhi dus kyi sku gsum po de skye 'chi bar do gsum la bzhag nas/ de gsum sems can thams cad la rang chas su yod pa yin gyi/ 'bras dus kyi sku gsum ma yin pas skyon de rnams med do snyam na/ 'o na nged kyis kyang bskyed rdzogs gnyis po de sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi lam dang 'bras bu la 'jog tshul gsum yod pa'i nang nas 'dus pa'i skabs 'dir gtso bor sbyang gzhi la bskyed rdzogs su byas pa'i skye 'chi gnyis po de sems can thams cad la rang chas su yod par 'dod pa yin gyi/ lam la bskyed rdzogs su byas pa de sems can thams cad la rang grub tu yod par khas ma blangs pas sems can thams cad 'bad med du grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes skyon 'phen pa ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis po lam la 'jog pa'i shes 'dod yid la bzhag pa'i lugs phan tshun 'dres pa'i skyon brjod tsam yin pas lugs phan tshun bsres pa'i babs chol ma byed cig de ltar ma yin na bskyed rdzogs 'bras bu la 'jog pa'i shes 'dod yid la bzhag nas gzhan gyi bskyed rdzogs lam la 'jog pa la lam gyi dus na 'bras bu rang chas su yod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i skyon brjod na yang / khyed ltar na skyon du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /yang skye 'chi gnyis la bskyed rdzogs su 'jog na rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la yang bskyed rdzogs 'byung bas/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis po de bla med kyi khyad chos ma yin par 'gyur ro snyam na yang / bla med kyi khyad chos su 'gyur ba de lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi dbang du byas pa yin pas 'khrul par mi bya'o/

/gzhan yang sbyang gzhi la bskyed rim zer ba mi 'thad na/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi le'u gnyis par/ lha'i rnal 'byor sogs ma gsungs kyang / sbyang gzhi skye gnas bzhi'i bshad pa rgyas par mdzad pa'i mjug tu/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o zhes pa de yang mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /yang lam gyi bskyed rim de lha'i rnal 'byor tsam la mi bya ste/ de tsam zhig ni rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la'ang yod pas na rnam gzhag rim pa'i le'u dang por bshad pa ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong nus pa'i rnal 'byor khyad par can gcig la bya ste/ mdor byas las/ rnam rtog bag chags nyes pa yin/ /'gro ba gsum po rnam 'khor la/ /blo dang ldan pas legs bltas nas/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyis sbyang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de yang sbyang gzhi sbyong nus pa'i nyams len khyad par can du 'gro ba la lam 'di dang 'di ni sbyang gzhi 'di dang 'di'i sbyong byed yin no snyam du blos zhen pa tsam mam/ lam rang nyid kyi steng du sbyang gzhi sbyong nus su yod pa tsam gyis mi chog ste/ dang po ltar na lam bzang ngan la mi ltos par zhen pa tsam gyis chog par 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ltar na sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /des na lam de'i ngos nas kyang sbyang gzhi sbyong nus su ma nor bar yod dgos la/ nyams su len pa'i tshe na yang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa'i tshul gyis bsgom dgos te/ bla ma gong mas sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa gal che'o/ /zhes yang dang yang du gsungs pas zhib par bla ma'i zhal las rag go /gzhan yang lam bskyed rim de nyid 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i bdag 'dzin gnyis dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i tshul gyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bas rgyas btab nas bsgom dgos te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun las gzhan pa yi/

/srid pa'i bcing ba gzhan ci'ang yod ma yin/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal bar gyur pa'i sems/ /de ni mngon sum nyid du rtogs par 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi bdag nyid can/ /gang yin de ni kun rtog snang mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /zab mo stong pa dang gsal ba lha sku bsgom pa re re ba ma yin par zab gsal gnyis med du bsgom dgos par gsungs te/ zab mo kho na rtogs pas min/ /gsal ba dag kyang de bzhin no/ /de phyir thal byung zab mo yi/ /grol 'dod de la nga ma dad/ /de bas chos rnams gnyis med du/ /rtogs pas tshe 'dir 'bras thob nges/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom pa'i go rim ni gzhung gzhan du bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsgom pa sogs yod kyang / 'dir ni bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa yin te/ 'phags pas/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi gdang bu lta bur bstan/ /ces gsungs shing / yab sras rnams kyis lam rim can du 'khrid tshul rgyas par gsungs pas so/ /de yang 'di'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams len spyod bsdus dang / 'gos kyi shog dril gsum ṭīkka dang bcas pa las shes so/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis paṇa chen gung ru'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsungs/ /gsung bzhin paṇa chen mchog gis gsal bar mdzad/ /mdzad pa'i don rnams legs par bshad pa 'di/ /'di phyi'i don chen sgrub rnams blang bar rigs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa sdom brtson dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ sdom brtson dam pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las 'byung ba bzhin zin bris su mdzad pa/

blo'i padmo rgyas byed ces bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsal byed sum cu so bzhi'i mtha' can gyi rgyud sde stong phrag sum cu rtsa bzhi gsungs pa'i nang nas rgyal po lta bur gyur pa ni yi ge gsum ma yin la/ de yang sa mā dzaḥzhes te/ bod skad du 'dus pa'o/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'di nyid rgyud sde gang du gtogs she na/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes gdul bya dbang po brtul po dang 'bring po dang / mchog dang / mchog rab bzhi'i ngo bor rgyud sde rnam bzhi bka' stsal pa'i nang nas mchog rab la gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do/ /de la yang pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med kyi rgyud ces gsungs pa yang nges pa'i don du rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud yin na/ gnyis med kyi rgyud yin dgos te/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab rkyang pas min/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes dang / thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyi nyon/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /drang ba'i don du na/ skyes pa rnams ni rjes gzung phyir/ /rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud ces bshad/ /bud med rnams ni rjes gzung phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud thams cad kyang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'di ni pha'i rgyud do/ /bu dol gnyis na re/ dus 'khor gnyis med kyi rgyud yin zhes zer kyang / rnal 'byor ma rgyud yin te/ bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ he ru ka ni dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu nyid/ /ces he ru kar bshad pa dang /

dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor la/ bya ba'i rgyud rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba rigs gsum rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa rigs drug rnal 'byor rje rigs 'khor lo sdom pa chen po/ shes rab rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo zhes dus 'khor shes rab kyi rgyud du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis ma rgyud du bshad pa legs pa yin no/ /bu na re/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la rigs lnga rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs drug cha mnyam pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde bdun du byed pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud la yang rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang rigs drug cha mnyam pa'i rgyud de bdun du 'byed dgos pa yin te/ de gnyis gang zag gcig sangs rgya bar byed pa'i lam bzang ngan 'dra bas so/ /ma rgyud du rigs lnga la he ru ka brtag pa/ rdo rje nyi ma/ padma gar dbang rta'i rgyal po'i rigs kyi rgyud ces mtshan bsgyur nas gsungs pa ni/ lha sgrub thabs phyin ci log gi mu stegs pa rnams gzung ba'i ched yin la/ rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud du mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi rgyud ces rigs lnga rang gi ming gis gsungs pa ni/ lha bsgrub phyin ci ma log pa'i nang pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du gsungs pa yin no/ /de la mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi rgyud la/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi khro bo/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud do/ /dang po ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud bshad pa'i rgyud brgyad dang bcas pa rnams yin no/ /gnyis pa ni gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud do/ /gsum pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'khor lo chen po'i rgyud rtsa bshad rnams so/ /gnyis pa rnam snang gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ nam mkha'i snying po dang /

rin 'byung gi rigs su gtogs pa'i rgyud rnams te bod du 'gyur ba mi snang ngo / /'od dpag med kyi rigs ni/ bde chen ral gcig yin te 'di la dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis bshad pas rnal 'byor bla med yin zhing / bla ma rnams pha rgyud du bzhed pa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs su 'dug pas pha rgyud do/ /don grub kyi rigs ni/ kun tu bzang po dang / don grub kyi rigs su gtogs pa'i rgyud sde bod na mi snang ngo / /rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud ni/ rigs thams cad kyi gtso bo bsdus pa'i rgyud de/ de yang bod na mi snang ngo / /rigs drug cha mnyam pa'i rgyud ni/ zla gsang thig le'o/ /'di snga rabs pa kha cig ma rgyud du 'dod kyang / de nyid las/ dpa' bo zla gsang thig le ste/ /zhes thabs dpa' bo'i sgras gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ ma rgyud la rigs bdun gyi rgyud du 'byed pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud la rigs bdun du byed pa gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / bye brag tu mi bskyod pa'i rigs la mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa gsum du 'byed pa ni/ bya rgyud kyi rgyas bkab pa yin gyi/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud du de lta bu'i brda chad rgyud rgya gzhung 'grel pa tshad ldan gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs pas kyang gnod de/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su 'jog pa de/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor yod pas 'jog pa yin na/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la 'jam dbyangs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor yod pas/ 'dus pa'i rgyud byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud du khas len dgos par 'gyur ro/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs de rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas de bzhin gshegs pa yin no snyam na/ de ltar na 'jigs byed dang / phyag rdor 'khor chen yang rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas de bzhin gshegs pa yin pas/

gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud rnams kyang mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud du khas len dgos par 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud la/ 'khor lo chen po'i rtog pa dang / de'i bshad rgyud drag po gsum/ rnam 'joms ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis rgyud the tshom can du byas shing / khyed rang gis kyang de ltar du byas la/ de gnyis kyang phyag rdor 'khor chen byang chub sems dpa' yin pas/ de ltar du 'jog na sngar gyi skyon rnams gnas so/ /de ltar na phyag rdor 'khor chen dang / bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed rnams dang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rnams rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs par mtshungs pa dang / rnam pa'i sgo nas byang chub sems dpa' yin na yin mnyam dang / min na min mnyam du mtshungs pas/ de lta bu dbye ba mi 'thad do/ /rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba la yang rigs gsum yod pas rnam snang rkyang pa'i rigs kyi rgyud du 'jog pa la shes byed med do/ /bde chen ral gcig gi rgyud de yang dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sogs rnying ma'i man ngag dang tshul mtshungs pas the tshom gyi gzhir gyur pa yin no/ /rje btsun mai tri bas khro phu lo tsā ba la dngos su gnang ba ma yin nam snyam na/ khro lo la gnang ba de ni gtso mo bde chen ral gcig rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs de yin gyi/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gnang ba'i bshad pa med do/ /rin 'byung / don grub/ rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud rnams bod na 'gyur ba mi snang zer ba ni/ bde chen de lta bu sgyur rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na zla gsang thig le pha rgyud yin zhes pa don la gnas shing / rje btsun rin po ches kyang pha rgyud du bshad la/ de nyid las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/

/zhes gsungs pas/ sbyang bya 'dod chags rigs bzhi'i dbye bas rgyud sde bzhir 'jog pa dang / 'dir yang nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi dbye bas pha rgyud sde gsum du 'jog pa yin te/ 'dod chags can rjes su gzung bar bya ba'i phyir du gtso bor bstan pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor/ zhe sdang gis zhe sdang mi spong zhing zhe sdang can nyid bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam du sgyur bar byed pa gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor/ gti mug gis gti mug mi spong zhing gti mug bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam du sgyur bar byed pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i chos skor zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ bshad rgyud la 'phags pa yab sras ltar na thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud gnyis/ thun mong gi rgyud gnyis te bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus dang / dgongs pa lung ston gnyis te/ dang pos mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi la sogs pa'i don gyi cha dang / gnyis pas tshig gi cha ston te/ rtsa rgyud du/ rdo rje cher bklag ces pa'i tshig 'byung ba la/ dgongs pa lung ston du/ rdo rje ni stong pa nyid/ cher bklag pa ni lus dkyil gyi lha rnams 'od gsal du bcug pa la bshad pa dang / yang rtsa rgyud du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bsad na/ /dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ba la de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs ni lus dkyil gyi lha rnams yin la/ bsad pa ni de rnams 'od gsal du bcug pa la bshad pa sogs 'byung bas so/ /gnyis pa thun mong gi bshad rgyud la/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dkyil chog dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa khams sogs bshad pas bde mchog dang thun mong ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus ni/ sambu ṭi dang thun mong ba yin pas ma rgyud thun mong gi bshad rgyud do/ /ye shes zhabs lugs ltar na/

rgyud phyi ma dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud de gnyis so/ /de yang slob dpon des bshad rgyud gong ma bzhi po de ma gzigs pa yang min/ rgyud rnam dag tu khas mi len pa yang ma yin mod kyi/ khong rang gi bskyed rim bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi/ rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le dang / sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag de thon pa la bshad rgyud de gnyis kyis chog cing / de gnyis med na mi rung bas de'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /rin po che pas/ bshad rgyud bzhi'am brgyad kyis bkral pa/ zhes pa ltar na rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / gnyis med rnam rgyal gnyis bshad rgyud du 'dod kyang / dang po ni grub chen kun dga' snying pos bshad rgyud du byas pa'i tshe/ yo gar bkral pa yin zhing / bla med du bkral pa'i tshe bshad rgyud du 'dod mkhan su yang med do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis med rnam rgyal chen po thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba zhes par grags pa ni/ rgya pho ba lung pas mdzad par grags/ rin po che pas thar lo'i phyag dpe'i gseb nas rgya dpe shog 'khyar lnga tsam brnyed pa bsgyur pas/ gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud kyi dum bur 'dug ste/ 'di mgo mjug ma tshang bas 'di rang gis mi phan kyang / sngar gyi gnyis med rnam rgyal de brdzus ma yin par rtogs pa'i ched du bsgyur pa yin gsungs/ phyis ting bzang ldan 'debs mkhan gyi kun spangs chos grags kyis de'i rgya dpe brnyed nas rin po che pa la phul bas/ de la phyis 'gyur mdzad nas mang nyung brtag gnyis tsam pa zhig byung zhing / de gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud du byas nas rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung tshig rnams dang sbyar ba yod kyang / rgyud des ni rnam snang gtso bor byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig ston par snang ba sogs rtsa rgyud kyi don du mi 'thad pas bshad rgyud du mi 'thad kyi/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang rigs gcig pa yin no/

/gnyis pa gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor la/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag gnyis/ dang po ni/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu ma/ lha lnga dang / lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis ka ston pa gshong blo brtan dang grub thob u rgyan pa/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal rnams kyi 'gyur re yod pa dang / le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis ma/ lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rkyang pa ston pa lo tsā ba rnams kyi 'gyur ngan ngon zhig yod pa la/ phyis rin po che pas 'gyur bcos byas pas legs su song ba gcig dang gnyis yod do/ /nag po'i skor la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dgra nag le'u bcu bdun ma/ bshad pa'i rgyud gshin rje gdong drug gi rgyud dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa gnyis so/ /gshin rje'i 'khor lo'i rtog pa gcig ma/ las mkhan te'u lo'i rtog pa/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa/ gshin rje brag dmar gyi rtog pa sogs ni bod kyi sngags pa kha cig gis bzos pas rgyud rnam dag min no/ /rtog gsum yang / rgya gar gyi man ngag legs po yod pa zhig gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos yin/ rgyud yin zer ba kho rang gi nang na yang med do/ /rje 'gos lo tsā ba'i gsung gis/ pha rgyud dang / ma rgyud gnyis kyi nang nas/ dang po ni/ gang zag dbang po rnon po rin po che lta bu'i lam don du gnyer ba dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis kyi nang nas/ zab la rgya che ba sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la slob pa nas zung 'jug gi bar la slob nus pa'i gang zag gi ngor gsungs pa yin la/ ma rgyud ni dbang po brtul po de lta bu'i zab la rgya che ba la slob mi nus shing / dbang dus kyi ye shes tsam skyong bar byed pa'i ngor bstan pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /spyir 'phags yul du gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad srol byung ba la/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i lugs/ 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs lugs/

slob dpon shanti pa'i lugs/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs/ paṇḍi ta smṛrti'i lugs so/ /dang po ni/ rnam snang sgyu dra dang / rtsa rgyud du sbrel te yo gar bkral pa mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor ston pa/ mang nyung sdeb gcig byas pa lo chen gyis bsgyur pa yod de/ de ltar du bkral pa de yang rang bzo ma yin gyi/ rdo rje sems dpas za hor gyi rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la tan tra sde bco brgyad yo gar bkral ba'i man ngag gnang ba yin zhing / de nas brgyud pa'i lugs yin pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan gyi dgongs pa yo gar bkral pa mi 'grig pa med kyang / sbas pa'i don zab mo bshad rgyud rnams na yod pa klu las gyur pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas/ grub chen sa ra ha la dngos su bstan pa'i man ngag yin la/ de yang 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs kyi bskyed rim rnal 'byor gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / rdzogs rim rim pa lnga de nyid kyi sngon du smin byed kyi dbang la thun mong gi dbang dgu dang bcas pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan la mi thon cing / rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung tshig re re la yang bshad pa'i rgyud du dgongs pas bshad pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa sogs byas pa'i sgo nas thon pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis gsang 'dus kyi paṇḍi ta nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam la thug cing / bye brag tu 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo byas pa'i slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rjes dngos su gnang ba'i man ngag bskyed rim bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi/ rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le zhes pa 'khor lo bzhir thig le bzhi bsgoms nas dga' bzhi dang / lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa skyed par byed pa ma rgyud pa dang mthun pa dang / de'i sngon du smin byed kyi dbang yang ma rgyud dang mthun par bshad pa yin te/

slob dpon des kyang gsang 'dus pha rgyud du khas len mod kyi/ 'on kyang bkral tshul de ma rgyud dang mthun par snang ngo / /slob dpon de la mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa'i grwa pa bzhi/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad bka' 'dzin par nus nges shes pa'i grwa pa bco brgyad/ de rnams kyi nang du rtsa rgyud rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa la 'grel pa byed mkhan bcu gsum tsam byung ngo / /gzhan yang de dag gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi gzhung phran du ma yang yod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ slob dpon shanti pas byas pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog ces pa yod la/ lugs de nyid bod snga rabs pa dang bstan 'gyur bsdud mkhan rnams kyis ye shes zhabs kyi rjes su 'brang par 'dod kyang / de nas mi bskyod pa gtso bor byas pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor gcig ston pas/ de'i rjes su 'brang pa ma yin te/ ye shes zhabs lugs pas mi bskyod pa gtso bor byas pa'i tshe na yang / lha bcu dgu las khas mi len pa'i phyir dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor yang de dang yang mi mthun/ 'phags lugs kyi rjes su 'brang pa yang min zhing / bla med du bkral pa'i phyir grub chen kun snying gi rjes su 'brang pa yang ma yin no/ /sngags kyi shing rta'i srol rang dgar 'byed nus pa yang min pas/ bla ma snga ma kha cig gi rjes su 'brang par snang yang gang gi yin mi shes so/ /spyir slob dpon de 'phags yul ba'i rgyal sras sa 'dres pa chen po dang / ye shes zhabs lugs kyi slob dpon dman pa'i zhabs kyi grwa pa yin par snang ngo / /gang ltar yang 'grel pa de'i nang nas dbang chog bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor dang bcas pa tshang mar ston cing / chos 'di la ni rnam par rig pa tsam du blta bar bya ste/ zhes sogs kyi lta ba gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi de kho na nyid ston par snang ngo / /lnga pa ni/

slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes pa zhig gis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa gleng gzhi ma rgyud dang mthun par bshad pa gcig yod la/ slob dpon de yang mtshan brjod kyi 'grel byed 'jam dpal seng ldan gyi dkyil chog rtsom pa po yin na ni 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung nges shes pa gcig yin par 'dug pas/ 'jam dbyangs kyis gnang ba'i man ngag yin nam dpyad do/ /drug pa ni/ paṇḍi ta smṛrtis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa smṛrti nyid kyis rang 'gyur du byas pa/ bod skad 'ol le ba las mi shes pa'i stobs kyis 'gyur shin tu ngan pa zhig yod la/ de yang bla ma bzang po'i zhabs zhes pa zhig gis gnang ba'i man ngag yin gsungs/ de gnyis ka yang gong gi 'grel byed rnams gang gi yang rjes su 'brangs pa ma yin no/ /bi ma la mi tra dang / bi sha mu tra gnyis kyis byas zer ba'i 'grel pa dang / rab byung gi mtshan la kun dga' snying po zer ba zhig gis byas pa'i 'grel pa po ti drug tsam yod pa rnams ni rnying ma dang 'brel pa sogs su snang bas the tshom gyi gzhir gyur pa yin no/ /yang dus kyi 'khor lo rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa rigs drug bshad pa la/ lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ bcu gsum gyi/ bcu dgu'i/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'i/ sum cu so gnyis kyi/ lha so bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de la dang mtha' gnyis ni dus 'khor ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yin la/ lha bcu gsum ma ni rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po'i dngos bstan du bshad cing / grub chen int+ra bo tis ye shes grub par yang bshad/ lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ ye shes zhabs dang thun mong ba/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ grub chen kun snying gi lugs dang thun mong ba/ lha so gnyis ni/ 'phags lugs dang thun mong ba yin no/ /lha dgu ni rigs lnga yum bzhi'o/ /de'i steng du sgo ba bzhi bsnan pas bcu gsum/

de'i steng du rdo rje ma drug bsnan pas bcu dgu'o/ /de'i steng du byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang sa snying dor/ drug bsnan pas nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /de'i steng du khro bo gtsug tor can the bas khro bo lnga/ khro mo drag can ma bsnan pas drug gtso bo yab yum gnyis so sor bgrangs pas lha so gnyis so/ /de'i steng du gnod mdzes shin tu sngon po gnyis bsnan pas so bzhi'o/ /de dag kyang bsdus pa'i rgyud gzhan rnams kyi skabs su/ mi bskyod pa sngon po nas don grub ljang khu sogs su bshad pa ni nang gi sbyang gzhi khams kyi de kho na nyid mi shes pa'i byis pa so so skye bo rnams drang ba'i ched du bstan pa yin gyi/ nang du sbyang gzhi khams rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis phyi rol tu lha'i kha dog kyang de ltar du bzhag pa yin pas/ 'od dpag med dkar por bshad pa ni 'thad pa yin no/ /zhes pa ni dus 'khor ba'i lugs so/ /de rnams kyi nang nas 'phags pa yab sras kyis bkral tshul de nyid bod du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos paṇḍi ta dha shra ta la zhus te/ rtsa rgyud sgron gsal 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung phran rnams dang bcas pa bsgyur cing / sgron gsal gyi bshad bka'/ rim lnga'i khrid bka' dbang bka' dang bcas pa byung yang da lta chad nas med do/ /yang 'brog mis bla ma sprin gyi shugs can la zhus/ de'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'gyur dang / dbang bka' dang / rim lnga'i khrid bshad bka' dang bcas pa byung yang da lta chad nas med do/ /'brog mi'i sku tshe'i smad la/ rje 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis rgya gar du byon te/ paṇḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ mngon shes can/ btsun mo can te gtso bor gsang ba 'dus pa'i bla ma bzhi la 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams gsan/ spyir rgya gar na chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma bdun cu/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtugs te/

spyir bla med kyi chos mang po dang / bye brag tu gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ rgyud 'grel gyi bshad bka'/ dbang bka'/ rim lnga'i khrid bka' sogs 'phags lugs kyi chos skor rnams la mkhas par byas te bod du dar bar mdzad cing / lo chen gyis bsgyur pa'i gzhung phran rnams la 'gyur bcos 'ga' re mdzad/ des rdog nyi ma seṅge sogs la gnang / des brlan la/ des pre'u chung pa blo ldan seṅge / des 'phags 'od/ des rin po che pa sogs la gnang zhing / yang 'gos kyis slob ma dbus pa dge ser ba/ des gnam kha'ub pa/ de la rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos gsan pa ni gsang 'dus rnying mar grags pa'i brgyud lugs so/ /yang jo bo chen po rjes/ 'phags lugs kyi dbang bka'/ rim lnga'i khrid bka'/ rgyud 'grel gyi bshad bka' rnams rong pa 'gar dge ba rab gsal la gnang zhing / rim lnga'i khrid yig bod kyi dge bshes 'ga' res zin bris byas pa yang byung zhing / da lta dbang bka' sogs chad nas med do/ /yang skyes mchog mar pa lo tsās jo bo nā ro ta pa la 'phags pa'i dngos kyi slob ma grub chen ma tang ki pa nas/ bla ma ti lo pa la brgyud pa'i dbang bka'/ rgyud dang man ngag gi bshad pa/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi khrid bka' rnams gsan/ dbang bka' la dbang gong ma gsum yang sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i 'og tu thod pa chang gis bkang ba/ de'i 'og tu rdul tshon gyi chos 'byung gru gsum re re/ dbang gong ma gsum ka la yang ye shes dbab pa dkyil 'khor du me tog dor ba sogs byed pa yod do/ /mar pas byas kyang zer/ grub chen nā ro pas brtsams pa yin zhes pa'i rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi bstan bcos kyang yod do/ /mar pa'i slob brgyud rgya rnal 'byor pho ba lung pa dang / gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po gnyis las/ dang pos rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi ṭīkka byas shing man ngag rnams kyang legs par yod do/

/gnyis pa la rim lnga nag khrid du grags pa rim lnga dang nā ro chos drug bsres pa'i khrid yod do/ /yang chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis bal po ma na ka shrī dzña na la 'phags lugs kyi dbang bka' rdo rje phreng bas bdag byas pa gcig dang / sgron gsal gyi lung / rim lnga'i khrid bka' rnams zhus shing / thang po cher dar bar byas nas da lta yang yod do/ /yang dus phyis chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas kha che paṇa chen la gsang sngags kyi skor la dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus gnyis gsan cing / gsang 'dus la rgyud 'grel gyi bshad bka'/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa la zung 'jug gsal ba nas dbang gong ma gsum kha bskangs/ dkyil chog de gnyis kyi steng nas dbang bka' gsan/ zung 'jug gsal ba la lo paṇa gnyis kyis 'gyur yang mdzad/ chos rje dang / paṇa chen gnyis kyi dngos kyi slob ma 'od zer shākya gsang 'dus 'phags lugs pa'i sgos kyi 'chad nyan par bkod de/ lugs de nyid dar bar byas pa ni/ gsang 'dus gsar mar grags pa'o/ /gang dag klu byang gi dkyil chog steng nas dbang thob par khas len cing / chos rje sa paṇa brgyud par mi 'dod pa ni rang gis rang la 'tshab byas pa yin no/ /bu'i klu byang gi brgyud pa yang sa skya pa'i dge bshes don ri grags chen pa/ de la kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ de la bus gsan pa yin no/ /lugs de rnams kyi nang nas 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs de bod du dar ba'i lugs rnams kyi nang nas ches khyad par du 'phags pa rje 'gos kyi lugs/ de nyid 'dir gtan la dbab par bya ba'i chos so/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa// //skye ba skye ba du ma'i sngon rol tu/ /legs bsags legs spyad bye ba'i mthu ldan rnams/ /dus 'dir dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /rjes bzung rjes 'jug gus pas bstan par rigs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//

༈ //spyi don bzhi pa mkhas pa kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ mkhas pa de nyid kyis rje rdo rje 'chang la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams gsan pa'i dus su zin bris su mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams byung tshul zhib tu bshad pa'i rgyud kyi spyi rnam chen mo las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi tshogs khang du rje btsun kun dga' bzang po sgo nang du phebs tsam nas yig brgya gsungs te khrir bzhugs nyer gcig tsam kun gyis 'dren/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bsngos nas sku bsrangs te mgo 'dren 'di skad gsung pa yid spro bas bris/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / gnas khang srung 'khor gyi dbus su chud pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i gnas 'og min du bsam pa dang / chos ston pa'i bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje drug pa rdo rje 'chang shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / khyed rang rnams dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la thugs mnyam par bzhag nas chos nyan pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang / ston pa la nang du yang dag 'jog pa'i dus dang / snyoms par 'jog pa'i dus dang / chos 'chad pa'i dus rnams las/ gsung gi 'phrin las chos 'chad pa'i dus phun sum tshogs pa dang / rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di'i tshig gi phreng ba rnams dang / don rtogs par bya ba rnams ni chos phun sum tshogs pa ste phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

'dir rgyud sde rnams kyi nang nas ches zab pa dang rgya che bar gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rgyud sde gzhan nas/ dpal gshin rje dgra nag las brtul zhugs mthar thug sangs rgyas thod/ /las tshogs mthar thug gshin rje gshed/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /zhes che bstod mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'chad par byed pa legs/ 'di la bshad srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod kyang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi lugs bzhin 'grel bar byed/ de la 'di 'chad byed kyi 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba ni rtsa bar gyur pa yin la/ gzhan lam lugs kyi 'grel pa bzhi tsam yod pa ni de'i yan lag tu gyur pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i 'grel chen 'chad par byed pa la/ rgyud 'grel gyi byung tshul rnam par gzhag pa dang / de ltar byung ba'i rgyud 'grel dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni rdog pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams yan chad du byung tshul bla ma'i rnam thar gyi zhar la cung zad tsam bstan pa ma gtogs/ zur du phyogs 'byams yi ger bkod pa med la/ de dag gi rjes su bla ma brlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam gyis mdzad pa'i sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad du byung tshul bris pa rnams khong gsang 'dus la sbyangs pa che bas 'dus pa rang gi chos skad ngo bo shin tu bzang mod/ gzhan gsung rab spyi la sbyangs pa chung tsam yin pa 'dra bas thun mong gi brda chad spyi rigs dang / sngags rnying ma'i chos skad mang du bkod pa yod pas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag de'i rjes su bu ston rin po ches rgyud 'grel gyi byung tshul/ rje btsun rtse mo'i rgyud sde spyi rnam la gzhi byas/ der gsang 'dus kyi byung tshul shin tu rgyas par bkod pa zhig mdzad na yang / rgya ches pa dang / dbang brgyud dang / bshad brgyud kyi rim pa sna tshogs yang ni snang / legs cha yang shin tu mang mod/ skabs 'dir de yang btang snyoms su bzhag

'dir rje btsun sa skya pa rnams rgyud sde gang 'chad kyang / de dag gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gzhung tshad mar gyur pa rnams la brten nas byung tshul mdzad pa ltar/ 'dir yang de dag dang mthun par spyir sde snod rnams tshul gsum du dbye ba/ bye brag gsang sngags kyi theg pa rnam par gzhag pa/ de las kyang gsang ba 'dus pa'i byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyod bsdus sgron mer/ de la thog ma kho nar bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i gnas skabs su gling la sogs pa la gzigs nas dga' ldan nas babs sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas te 'dod chags dang bral ba'i gzugs su mngon par sprul nas dman pa la mos pa rnams la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par mdzad cing / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i spyod pa bstan pa dang / bdag tu lta ba'i nga rgyal chen po la mngon par zhen pa'i 'gro ba rnams la rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad la sogs pa bstan pa'i sgo nas bdag med pa rtogs par mdzad cing / sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa zab cing rgya chen po bstan pa dang / dka' thub dang 'dod pa'i yul spangs pas skrag cing zab mo la lhag par mos pa chos kyi de kho na nyid kyi snod du gyur pa rnams la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzugs su mngon par sprul par mdzad nas bden pa gnyis rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ 'dod chags kyi chos kyi spyod tshul lta bu la sogs pa bstan te sngags kyi sgo ston par mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes 'byung bas/ dam pa'i chos bstan pa'i tshul ni rnam pa gsum ste/ bden pa bzhi dang ldan pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa dang ldan pa dang / gsang sngags kyi khyad par gyi spyod pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin du slob dpon shanti pa'i theg gsum rnam gzhag slob dpon dran pa'i ye shes grags pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' mtha' dag bsdus te bshad pa/ slob dpon tri pi ta ka ma la'i tshul gsum sgron ma rnams las/

dman pa nyan thos kyi theg pa rgya che ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa/ zab mo sngags kyi theg pa zhes chos kun bsdu ba mdzad de/ theg pa che chung gnyis su byas nas sngags kyi theg pa phar phyin theg pa'i khongs su 'du mod kyi/ shin tu zab pa'i theg pa yin pas/ 'phags skor ba 'di pas lugs 'di bzhin du gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i rnam par gzhag pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa gang gi don du gsungs na/ skye bo 'dod chags can don du/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gdul bya 'dod chags can gyi don du gsungs/ bla med kho na de'i don du yin gyis/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams ma yin nam snyam na/ 'dir bshad pa'i 'dod chags gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa kho na la byas pa ma yin gyi/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang / /dgod dang blta ba dag gis kyang / /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /zhes gsungs pas sbyang bya 'dod chags rigs mang po yod pas/ de dag sbyong byed du rgyud sde rnams gsungs pa yin te/ de'i tshul gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'o na rgyud sde de dag grangs dur nges snyam na/ 'di'i tshul la slob dpon a bhya ka ra rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod de/ dkyil 'khor las bsog cho ga zer lha tshogs thams cad ni/ /ston pas rgyud sde gnyis su bsdus/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas rgyud sde gsum du bzhed de/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye ba/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces so/ /slob dpon kun dga' snying po yang rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye ba dang mthun par/ phyi dang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /zhes pa'i don/ phyi bya spyod gnyis/ gsang ba rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang gsum du bzhed 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi 'grel par/ sems can rtog pa mang ba rnams kyi don du bya ba'i rgyud gsungs so/ /gcig kho nar rnal 'byor gyis sgrub par 'dod pa rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams bshad do/

/gnyis ka'i spyod pa rgyud dang gsum mo zhes kha cig ste kun snying dang lugs gnyis su bsdud par gsal la 'chad ces so/ slob dpon birwa pa dang / ḍombhi he ru ka la sogs pa'i rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig dang / rje btsun sa skya pa la sogs pa rgyud sde bzhir 'dod de/ rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /zhes dang / dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /slob dpon bha wa pa dang / shanti pa la sogs pa rgya gar ba phal mo che bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor bla ma/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces lngar 'dod de/ rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyi/ /dgongs pa'i skad ni ma bsgrags pa/ /zhes pas bzhir ma gsungs pas lnga pa zhig shugs la bzhed/ bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba rnams drug tu bzhed/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum/ bla med la pha bla na med pa dang / ma bla na med pa dang / ma'i yang ma bla na med pa gsungs/ jo bo rje'i lam sgron rang 'grel du drug po de'i steng du rtog pa'i rgyud ces pa bsnan nas bdun du 'dod de/ rtog pa'i rgyud ni padma gar gyi dbang phyug go /zhes so/ /gzhung der dbu sems kyi sems bskyed phyogs gcig tu byed par bshad/ bka' gdams pa la la tshad mar byed/ la la mi byed/ bu ston rin po ches 'di las lung drangs pa yang mang bar yod la/ res 'ga' jo bos mdzad par grags pa'i zhes btags chos su yang bzhed cing dgag pa yang mdzad de/ slob dpon yab sras 'di pa'i lugs kyis rgyud sde lngar bzhed de/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ byang chub sems dpa' chen pos gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / gnyis ka'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / bya ba'i rgyud dang / rtog pa'i rgyud rnams kyi tshad ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi ming stong phrag bcu gnyis zhes bya ste/

rgyas par byas na grangs med do/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud stong phrag drug go /spyod pa'i rgyud stong phrag brgyad do/ /bya ba'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi'o/ /rtog pa'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi'o/ /de dag ni stong phrag sum cu rtsa bzhi ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ /rgyud sde'i grangs de dag kyang tshigs su bcad pa'i grangs su mi blta ste/ rgyud kyi ming tha dad pa'i grangs su blta'o/ /ji ltar zhe na/ bya ba'i rgyud la stong phrag bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa cho ga zhib mo mdo kho na la'ang stong phrag brgyad yod do/ /zhes rje btsun rtse mos gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis zhes pa yang / rnal 'byor pha'i dbang du byas nas 'dir de tsam zhig bshad pa yin gyi/ gzhan du sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi ni tshad/ /bye ba phrag ni drug tu nges/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grangs/ /zhes gsungs pas mtha' yas so/ /rgyud de dag gi mtshan gzhi gang yin snyam na/ rnal 'byor rgyud la de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du byas pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor bla med la byas pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma yin te/ sgron gsal las/ dpal ldan tshogs gnyis kyi rgyud rgyal po gsang 'dus/ rnal 'byor phreng sogs bshad rgyud bzhi/ ma rtogs pa dang the tshom dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyis shin tu gsal bar rnam log rtog med pa yang shin tu ni/ phye ma nor ba gsal ba ni sgra zur ma chag par bshad/ rnam phye ni tshig don re re nas so/ legs tshig re re nas bshad pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lugs de gnyis kas kyang rnal 'byor gyi sgra don mi 'dor te/ de'i don/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min/

/thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes 'byung la/ rnal 'byor gyi skad dod la yo ga zhes bya/ sgra'i bstan bcos las/ yo rtsir sbyor ba la'o/ /zhes bshad pas gnyis mnyam par sbyar ba zhig yin la/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs par/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang stong pa nyid ro gcig tu sbyar ba dang / lha ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par sbyar bar bshad pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid dang / lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu zung du sbyor bas na rnal 'byor zhes bshad de/ zab cing rgya che zhes bshad pa/ /rnam par mi rtog zab pa ste/ /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /sgyu ma lta bu zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ sgyu ma lta bu de ci zhe na/ chos kun rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhes/ /sangs rgyas pa kun smras mod kyi/ /bdag byin rlabs las phyir phyogs pas/ /rmi lam sgyu 'drar rtogs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud 'di pas de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa la bzhed pa yin te/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyi rnam gzhag rim par/ rdo rje slob mas gsol pa/ de kho na nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa gnyis ka'i rgyud las ni/ lha thams cad zhal gcig pa lta bur gsungs na/ 'dir ci'i phyir zhal gsum pa lta bur bsgrags zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bu ston rin po ches/ sa skya pa la sogs pa bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan phal cher spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang sogs mdzad pa la zhen nas/ 'dir yang de bzhin ngos bzung ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ dngos grub kun gyi 'bras 'dod pa'i/ /sngags shes pas ni sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i 'grel par/ sbyin sreg gi mchod sbyin dbul ba ste/ gnyis ka'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba ni lhag ma'o/ /zhes spyod rgyud la kha 'phangs pas rnam snang mngon byang gi rtsa ba'i rgyud dang /

rgyud phyi mar las thams cad pa dang las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gsungs pas/ sbyin bsreg 'phrin las char phebs su rnam snang mngon byang nas bshad pa'i sbyin sreg gyong se ba gcig mdzad yod de/ 'phags bskor ba rang gi grub mtha'i rkang 'chugs pa yin no/ /dge ldan pa chen po'i lugs la yang / 'dir bshad pa'i gnyis ka'i rgyud sbyong rgyud la 'chad de/ rnam gzhag rim pa'i ṭi kar kho na nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa dang / gnyis ka'i rgyud rnam snang mngon byang las zhes sogs kyi 'bru bsnon byas/ dogs spong yang / de nyid 'dus par gtso bo zhal bzhi par bshad kyang 'khor gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams shin tu mi 'thad de/ 'di'i gnyis ka'i rgyud rnam snang mngon byang du 'dod na der lha thams cad zhal gcig par ma gsungs te/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang / zhal gsum phyag drug pa la sogs pa zhal mang phyag mang bshad pas/ lha thams cad kyi tshig gsungs pa don med par thal ba'i skyon yod do/ /de nyid 'dus pa las gtso bo zhal bzhi par bshad kyang / zhes sogs kyi dogs spong mi dgos te/ rgyud sde'i dngos bstan gtso bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can gcig las ma bshad pas/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyi rjes su 'brangs pa rnams kyis grub chen kun snying la 'di skad ces/ khyed kyis rdor dbyings kyi gtso bo zhal bzhi par byas pa mi 'thad de/ de nyid 'dus par zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes rgol ba la/ kun snying na re/ bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang rtsa ba'i rgyud ngan song sbyong rgyud las zhal bzhi pa las zhes/ rnam gzhag ṭīkkar yo ga dang spyod rgyud gnyis ka la ma sbyangs pa'i sngo lo 'phyar tshar nas/ phyis rting ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi ṭīkkar rgyud khong rang gsal grags pas 'di gnyis ka'i rgyud de nyid 'dus pa la byed pa tsam zhig ngos zin 'dug

gzhan ṭīkka de na kha chal ha che bshad do/ /zhes bsgrubs pas de'i lugs yin gyi/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan rang zhal gcig pa yin pas klu byang gis de'i dbang du mdzad do/ /spyir gnyis ka'i rgyud phyi lus ngag gi spyod pa dang / nang ting nge 'dzin gnyis ka cha mnyam par spyod pas spyod rgyud la grags pa yod kyang / slob dpon yab sras 'di rnams kyis gsang 'dus sogs deng sang bla med du grags pa rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa yo gar grags pa rnams la gnyis ka'i rgyud kyi tha snyad mdzad pas 'dir de bzhin du go bar bya'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud ni rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa ding sang spyod rgyud du grags pa rnams nyid yin la/ bya ba'i rgyud ni dpung bzang dang legs grub la sogs pa rnams so/ /rtog pa'i rgyud ni spyir bya ba'i rgyud nyid yin pa la/ sngags dang sbyin sreg dang / phye ma la sogs pa phyi'i bya ba gtso bor gyur pas las tshogs bsgrub pa ston pa la bya ste/ ngo bo bya ba'i rgyud du 'du'o/ /zhes rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos gsungs te legs so/ /rgyud sde de dag gi ming ni ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa las/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha/ 'di dag gi ming gi yi ge mtha' ma rnams so zhes gsungs pas/ mtha' can zhes pa ni mtshon pa ste/ thog ma can dang / dbus can yang thob pa yin no/ /de yang dper brjod na/ sarba buddha sām bhyog zhes pa sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba ga'i mtha' can/ badzra sa mā ya zhes pa rdo rje phreng ba la'i mtha' can lta bu'o/ /rgyud der gsal byed so gsum las ma gsungs kyang / sgron gsal du/ dang po'i ka dang mtha' ma'i ṣa sbyar bas kṣa zhes pa bstan te/ de'i mtha' can pañtsa rakṣa bsrung ba lnga'i rgyud lta bu'o/ /rtsa rgyud 'di ni 'gos rdog pa rnams kyis mtha' ma'i sa dang /

dbus nas ma dang / dang po'i dza ste/ sa mā dza zhes pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa 'dus pa zhes bya ba/ gsal byed so bzhi'i mtha' can gyi rgyud 'di ni stong phrag bzhi'i rtsa ba'am/ rgyal po lta bu yin no/ /snyan grags bzang pos rgyud phyi mar 'di'i mtshan/ de yi rtsa ba yi ge gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ yin/ de gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yin la/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud yin pas gsang ba 'dus pa zhes gsungs pa yang de bzhin du bshad du rung tsam yin mod/ 'dir yi ge gsum rje 'gos kyis sa mā dzaḥnyid la bshad pa gzung ngo / /rgyud de dag so so'i nges pa rnam par gzhag pa ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ don dam pa'i bden pa las rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pas langs te/ 'dod chags las byung ba'i byang chub kyi gnas bstan pa'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus na 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyi bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis btsun mo'i bha ga la yang dag par zhugs te/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang 'gal ba rmad du byung ba'i rdo rje'i tshig gi mtha' drug gis rab tu dpyad de bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni rgyud sde gang du rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa zhes pa 'od gsal thams cad stong pa langs te zhes pa lus bzlog gi rlung sems la zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa 'dod chags las byung ba'i byang chub kyi gnas/ 'dod yon bsten cing bsgyur ba lam du byas pa las byung ba mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi gnas thob par byed pa zhes pa'o/ /lhan cig spyod ma dang rjes su 'brangs ma'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus na rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa sogs 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyi zhes pa btsun mo dang zhal sbyor gyi rnam par bzhugs pa'i lha chos 'byung gi dbus su chud pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can gyi rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor lha sum cu rtsa gnyis bsgom pa bskyed pa'i rim pa dang /

bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa bde stong gi ye shes bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang / btsun mo'i bha ga la yang dag par zhugs pa ni 'dod chags las byung ba'i rig ma brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i cho ga gsungs pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang 'gal ba ni/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pas 'bras bu skye gnas bzhir skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'chi ba dang / bar do rnams grub pa'i rgyu'i rtog pa tha mal gyi rtog pa gzung 'dzin bya byed kyi rtog pa/ dngos po ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa gsum spong ba dang / bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa dang / bgrod min la bgrod pa sogs mdor na 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i rnam gzhag hrul por zhig pa'o/ /rmad du byung ba ni snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i sbyang gzhi rang bzhin gyi chos rnams rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs rim dang bcas par gzhi bsgyur te gnas gyur gyi sku lus 'di nyid la 'grub pa'o/ /de rnams ston pa'i rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud rnams kyi tshig gis bshad pa dang / dgongs pas bshad pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pas bshad pa dang / drang ba'i don dang / nges pa'i don/ sgra ji bzhin pa dang / sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa ste/ mtha' drug gis rab tu dpyad de rgyud don ma lus pa gdams ngag tu sgrub pa ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi don la gnas so/ /mdor na rnal 'byor pa gang zhig dbang po rno ba de kho na nyid bsgom par gcig tu 'dun pa/ sngon goms pa'i stobs kyis bya ba dang dngos po thams cad la tha dad pa'i 'du shes mi 'jug pa/ theg pa chen po la sems rnam par sbyangs pa/ shes rab dang gnyis su med pa'i spyod pa la mngon par dad pa'i bdag nyid chen po la ni de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor mdzad de gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis 'jug cing / spros pa dang bcas pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / shin tu spros pa med pa'i spyod pa ston pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa bstan pa yin no/

/rig pa dang lha mo rnams lhan cig dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor dgod pa/ de las byung ba'i las byed pa'i bsgrub pa la sogs pa de kho na nyid rnam pa bcus rab tu spyad de sgrub par byed pa/ gnyis ka'i rgyud la zhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rig ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha la dgod pa ni kun rig lta bu la dngos su yod pa dang / rdor dbyings las/ mu stegs rgol ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs su sbas pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan bkod pa yod pa dang / lha mo bkod pa ni/ sgeg sogs brgyad mchod pa'i phyir du dkyil 'khor la bkod pa yod pa phal cher la bzhugs shing / la la la ma bkod pa sogs sna tshogs pa yang snang ngo / /de las byung ba'i las byed pa'i bsgrub pa zhes pa ni/ thog mar rig pa dang lha mos mtshon te dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs nas de'i spyan sngar dngos grub kyi ye shes la slob pa dang phyag rgya'i ye shes la slob pa sogs kyis zhi sogs kyi las bsgrub pa la gsungs so/ /de kho na nyid rnam pa bcu ni/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / rab gnas kyi rgyud dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud rnams dgongs pa mthun par/ phyi'i de nyid bcu/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /stangs stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang / /sbyin sreg mchod pa las sbyar dang / /slar bsdud pa yi rnam pa ni/ /phyi yi de nyid bcu yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas de nyid bcu tshang ba dang / gzhi lnga tsam phal cher tshang ba yang gnyis ka'i rgyud yin no/ /de la dkyil 'khor ni phyi'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang / ras bris la sogs pa dang / nang gi dkyil 'khor zhes gnyis su 'thad do/ /ting nge 'dzin ni gsum ste/ dang po sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog go /phyag rgya ni las dang / chos dang / dam tshig dang / rgyas bsdus gang rung yod pa ste phyag rgya bzhi'i

rgyas gdab dgos zhes bshad pa'o/ /kha cig tu bzhi ka la lus kyi phyag rgya/ ngag gi phyag rgya/ sems kyi phyag rgya bzhi gsum bcu gnyis po thams cad tshang bar yod pa dang / kha cig tu 'bring tsam dang / kha cig tu bzhi ka sngags kyis byed pa dang / kha cig tu bzhi ka lag pa'i phyag rgyas byed pa sogs mdor na rgyas bsdus gang yod kyang tshang ngo / /stangs stabs ni sa chog la sogs pa'i dus su byed pa'i g.yas brkyang la sogs pa'i stengs ka'o/ /'dug stangs ni rnal 'byor bsgom pa la sogs pa'i dus dang / sa chog sogs su rdo rje dang sems dpa'i skyil krung la sogs pa'o/ /bzlas brjod ni ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas dang zhes 'di pas tha snyad mdzad pas ngag bzlas ni oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ zhes pa lta bu ngag tu sgra lhang gis brjod pa'o/ /yid bzlas ni sna rtser phra mo'i rnal 'byor la sems gtad de sngags zlos pa lta bu yin no/ /sbyin sreg ni las bzhi dang / las thams cad pa sogs so/ /mchod pa ni dpal mchog dang po lta bu'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod pa dang / de nyid 'dus par sgeg sogs brgyad dang / kun rig tu mchod pa nyer lnga pas mchod pa lta bu yin no/ /las la sbyar ba ni/ oṃ badzra dha tu/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis sems can rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems bskyed du gsol zhes pa lta bu ste/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab dang phyogs gcig byas kyang rung ngo / /slar bsdud pa'i rnam pa ni/ mjug gi cho ga rdul tshon chu bor dor ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs pa'o/ /rab tu dpyad de zhes pa ni de nyid bcus rgyud sde'i khog phub ste/ mchog dang thun mong sgrub par byed ces pa'o/ /mdor na gang zhig de kho na nyid la mngon par dga' ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ rnal 'byor la lhag par mos pa/ phyi'i bya ba la mi dga' bar ting nge 'dzin rgyud rnam par gzhag par 'dod pa rnams la ni bya ba'i yan lag nyi shu/

rnal 'byor gyi yan lag gtso cher ston pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa la/ 'dir gnyis ka'i rgyud ces gsungs pa yin no/ /las kyi bya ba sna tshogs rgya chen po bya ba'i rgyud dang / phyag rgya dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu dpyad pas sgrub par byed pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bsrung ba'i sngags rgya dang / rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgya sogs dang / sbyin sreg dang / rdzas sbyor la sogs pa'i las kyi bya ba sna tshogs rgya chen po bya ba'i rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar yang spyod cing bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas thabs shes rab kyi spyod pa'i phyag rgya ste/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lha skur bsgom pa'i phyag rgya la sems dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid de nga rgyal byed pa'o/ /rab tu spyad pa ni bdag bskyed dang ldan pa'i mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rgya chen po bsgrub pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud yin te/ mdor na bya ba'i khyad par la yang mos shing / thabs dang shes rab kyi spyod pa rgya chen po la sbyor ba ni nang gi bdag nyid can gyi tshul yang mi dor bar spro ba de dag la ni gsang sngags dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa shes rab dang / thabs gtso bor gyur pa rgya cher ston pa dang / spyod pa'i rgyud rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa la sogs pa gsungs pa yin no/ /'jigs par dmigs shing shin tu gtsang sbra byed pa dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba med pa dang / bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i spyod tshul skyon gyi rgyu'i rtog pas rab tu spyad pas sgrub par byed pa ni bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bshad pa'i rmad du byung ba'i spyod tshul snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du bsgyur ba dang /

nyon mongs ye shes su bsgyur ba dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa sogs gsang chen rnams blo khog tu mi tshud par dngangs skrag skye zhing / de rnams la skyon gyi rgyu'i rtog pa skye ba dang / der ma zad gnyis ka'i rgyud las byung ba'i ye shes pa bcug pa'i bde ba med pa ste/ de la bde ba ci 'dra ba zhig yod na/ grub chen kun snying la sogs pa na re/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs 'di rnams spyod rgyud man ngag las khyad par du 'phags te/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug byas pa las byung ba'i bde ba yod pa'i phyir/ dper na 'jig rten pa pho mo'i dbang po nyi tshe ba sprad pa la yang bde ba 'byung na/ nged ye shes pa'i dbang po dang dam tshig pa'i dbang po so sor 'dres pa la ci'i phyir bde ba mi 'byung / so sor 'dres pa'i go rgyu ni ye shes pa'i mig gi dbang po dang dam tshig pa'i mig gi dbang po gnyis dbyer med du 'dres gzhan rnams de bzhin no/ /des na 'jig rten pa 'dzag bde las khyad par du 'phags pa na bde ba dam pa'o/ /der ma zad spyod pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa ste/ bdag lhar bskyed pa dang / bdag der nga rgyal byed pa med pa'o/ /'dir bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa zhes dmigs kyi bsal bas spyod rgyud yan la bdag bskyed yod par grub bo/ /'o na bya ba'i rgyud nas nyams len ci 'dra ba zhig ston snyam na/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la 'jigs par dmigs pa'i nges 'byung dang / rang don la 'jigs par dmigs pa'i sems bskyed dang / bdag 'dzin la 'jigs par dmigs pa'i lta ba rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas gzugs kyi sku rjes su dran pa'i sgrub thabs mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor mdun du ras bris sogs lhar bskyed/ de'i spyan sngar khrus gsum byed pa dang / gos gsum brje ba la sogs pa'i gtsang sbra shin tu chen po dang bcas pa'i bsnyung gnas drag po dang ldan pas mchod pa dang bzlas pa sogs byed pa dang /

chos kyi sku'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgrub thabs mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom ste/ rnal 'byor de gnyis kyis rab tu dpyad pas sgrub par byed pa ni tshe 'di nyid la bden pa mthong ba yan chad kyi rtogs pa bskyed nus pa'i cho ga rgyud kyi dngos bstan la yod pa'o/ /mdor na 'gro ba gang skye ba gzhan du goms pa'i bag chags kyi stobs kyis nags tshal dben pa la mngon par dga' zhing / khrus dang / dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / mchod pa dang / sbyin sreg dang / dka' thub dang / bzlas brjod la sogs pa'i bya ba med par yid mnyam par 'jog mi nus pa de kho na nyid bsgom pa'i nus pa chung ba dang / mtshan ma can gyi spyod pa la dga' ba dag yod pa/ de'i phyir na phyi'i spyod pa de dag shas cher ston pa'i bya ba'i rgyud/ legs par grub pa'i rgyud chen po la sogs pa gsungs pa yin no/ /sngags dang / sman dang / sbyin sreg dang / phye ma dang / mig sman dang / rkang mgyogs la sogs pa'i dngos grub chen po brgyad rab tu spyad pas grub par byed pa ni rtog pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /zhes pa'i don sngar ltar rjes dran gnyis bsgoms nas/ sngags la sogs pas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub nor bsgrub la sogs pa dngos su ston pa'i rtog pa ste/ nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa dang / gar mkhan mchog gi rtog pa dang / gnod gnas kyi rtog pa dang / tshogs bdag gi rtog pa dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la sogs pa rnams yin no/ /mdor na las tshogs kyi bya ba gtso bor ston pa tsam la dgongs nas rtog pa'i rgyud du phye ba ste/ ngo bo bya ba'i rgyud du 'du'o/ /slob dpon yab sras kyi bzhed pas rgyud sde'i dbye ba 'di bzhin byas pa la/ kha cig 'di snyam du ma rgyud kyai rdo rje nas/ rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyi/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba ji ltar spong snyam na bshad par bya ste/

'dir slob dpon gyis gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi'i mtha' can gyi rgyud sde stong phrag so bzhi'i rnam dbye shes par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyud sde lngar gsungs mod kyi/ don la bzhir bsdu bar dgongs pa yin te/ rim lnga las sgyu lus byin gyis brlab pa'i dbang bskur gyi skabs su slob ma'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa las dbang bskur ba thob cing / rgyud rnam pa bzhi'i dgongs pa shes zhes bshad/ de la 'gos rdog pa'i mchan du bshad rgyud bzhi'i don la mkhas pa la bshad pa yang yin mod/ chag los bya ba'i rgyud la sogs pa bzhi la bshad pa legs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa rgyud sde stong phrag so bzhi'i dpon po'am rtsa ba yin par khas blangs tsam nas 'khor ram g.yog tu gyur pa de shes dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na bshad rgyud las/ rtog pa'i rgyud la stong phrag bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rtogs pa'i phyir lngar bshad pa yin gyi/ rtog pa'i rgyud bya ba'i rgyud kyi nang tshan yin no/ /gzhan yang klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu par/ bya rgyud cho ga ma gtogs par/ /spyod dang gnyis ka rnal 'byor gyi/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas ni/ /kun lugs las byung yang dag bsngags/ /zhes bya ba'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la gnyis ka'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rje sa bcad nas/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang bzhi gsungs kyi/ rtog pa'i rgyud ma byung bas ma rgyud pa'i rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa dang khog mthun no/ /de la bya ba'i rgyud ni/ rgyud sde gang du gsang sngags kyi cho ga bshad cing bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ma bshad pa de ni/ dpung pa bzang po dang / gsang ba spyi rgyud dang / legs par grub pa dang / bsam gtan phyi ma ste spyi rgyud bzhi dang / so so'i rgyud phyed dang nyis brgya lhag tsam zhig yod do/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi bdag bskyed yod med kyi tshul la sngon gyi rgya gar gyi slob dpon phal che ba dang /

bod kyi rje btsun sa skya pa rnams dang / 'gos kyi rjes 'brangs rnams dang / mar pa dpon slob rnams te/ mdor na bu ston rin po che ma byon gyi bar du/ bya rgyud rang rkang gi nyams len la bdag bskyed med pa'i tshul nyid byung ba yin la/ phyis bu ston pas rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag tu/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las bdag bskyed med par gsungs shing / bod kyi bla ma rnams kyang de ltar bzhed mod/ rgya gar gyi 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs zur pa mang po dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / rgya mtsho dang / phyed dang nyis brgya pa rnams las bdag bskyed bshad pa rnams bya rgyud rang rkang gis thob pa yin nam/ rgyud sde gong ma rnams kyi rgyas bkab pa yin brtag go /zhes the tshom tsam mdzad cing / phyis don zhags kyi bshad pa zhib mor/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed yod de/ don la'ang thob cing sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa'i phyir/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i lung de dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal mi byed pa la dgongs zhes gsungs so/ /de mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pas gtan tshigs su grub na/ dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal mi byed pa 'gal te/ des mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms kyi 'grel par/ bzod par gsol/ bsngo ba byas nas/ oṃ badzra atma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdag nyid las kyi rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /dge ldan pa chen pos bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod dgos te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa'i phyir dang / 'di 'dod chags rigs bzhi'i bltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyi rgyud sde yin la/ bltas pa'i bde ba rang rgyud la bskyed pa la rang blta ba po lha de dang der bsgom dgos kyi/ mdun du sangs rgyas spyan ras gzigs dang / gos dkar mo lta bu zur mig can bris shing bskyed pa la bltas pas/
