rang rgyud la bltas pa'i 'dod chags las byung ba'i bde ba bskyed mi nus pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di bya rgyud la bdag bskyed rigs pas bsgrub pa'i drag shos yin/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i lung gi don bya rgyud phal che ba dang / gdul bya'i khyad par 'ga' zhig la dgongs kyi/ bya rgyud thams cad kyi dbang du byas pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ lung rigs dang dogs spong rnams rim pa bzhin mi 'thad de/ sngags rim dang / spyi rnam du rgyud sde gsum dang drug tu 'dod pa la dgag pa byas nas/ rang lugs la rgyud sde bzhir khas blangs pa yin la/ 'di'i skabs su sangs rgyas gsang ba bya spyod rgyud sde gcig tu 'dod pa'i lugs kyi rnam snang mngon byang dang / phyag rdor dbang bskur las gsungs pas bdag bskyed yod pa'i sgrub byed dgod pa la nang 'gal 'byung ngo / /khyed rang gi sgrub byed go sla bar dril na/ bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod de/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang dang / phyag rdor dbang bskur las bshad pa'i phyir du song / de byas tsa na bya spyod gnyis rgyud sde'i sde tshan gcig tu khas blangs shing / gzhan yang bya spyod gnyis ngo bo'i sgo nas khyad par med cing khas blangs pas sngags rim du rgyud sde bzhi'i grangs bshad pa mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ bya spyod gnyis ngo bo gcig cing de gnyis la zab khyad mi 'dug pa'i phyir dang / rnam snang mngon byang dang phyag rdor dbang bskur bya rgyud yin na/ spyod rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi ga la yod/ des na sgrub byed ltar snang tsam du song ba yin no/ /'dod chags lam du byed pas bdag bskyed bsgrub pa'i rigs pa de yang mi 'thad de/ 'o na mi 'dod chags can zhig gis bud med la bltas pa'i bde ba rang rgyud la bskyed par 'dod na/ rang bud med du bsgom dgos par 'gyur ro/ /de 'dod na ha cang thal zhing mngon sum gyis gnod do/

/nged kyis dge ldan du phyin dus de skad zhus pas/ khong pa na re/ nged kyi rigs pa de rnam byang gi yin la/ khyed kyi de kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs yin pas lan du mi rung ngo / /zhes lce ma chad tsam gsungs so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na rnal 'byor chen pos mdun skyed bsgrub dus mdun du lha yab yum zhal sbyor bsgom pa des/ gnyis ka 'khyud pa'i bde ba lam du byed dgos tsa na/ rang mdun bskyed kyi lha der nges par bsgom dgos par 'gyur te/ bltas pa'i bde ba lam du byed pa la rang lhar bskyed dgos pa'i phyir/ bde ba lam du mi byed na rnal 'byor chen po'i sgrub pa pos mdun bskyed bsgom pa don med par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mdun bskyed la yang mtshungs so/ /'di lta bu'i grub mtha' khyed kyis bcas tsa na/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po'i sgrub thabs kyi mdun bskyed la skur pa btab/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed bzos te sgro btags pas lung rigs kyi gnod pa mang du khyed la 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /yang khong pa na re/ thang sku la lha bris pa de rang nyid 'di ltar bsgom dgos pa yin zhes mtshon par bya ba'i phyir yin gyi/ mdun du de ltar bsgom pa ma yin no zhes gsungs pa la/ 'o na 'dul ba lung las/ ston pa'i skyes rabs 'bri bar gsungs pa ston pa'i sngon gyi mdzad pa mang bas gzhan dad par bya ba'i phyir yin la/ khyed ltar na rang rgyal po thams cad sgrol la sogs par bsgom dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa bri bar gsungs pa rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang / khyad par du ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa mthong nas gzhan chos la 'jug pa'i phyir yin la/ khyed ltar na rang yi dwags dang dmyal ba pa sogs su bsgom dgos par 'gyur ro/ /rang rgyud la ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa 'byung ba la rang ngan 'gror bsgom mi dgos na/

rang rgyud la bltas pa'i bde ba bskyed pa la rang lhar bsgom dgos pa'i dam bca' nyams/ zhes smra na lha phan tshun zur mig sogs blta ba la dmigs pas rang rgyud la bde ba 'dren cing nyon mongs pa lam du 'gyur ro/ /rgyud sde gong mar bdag bskyed med par gsungs pa'i lung don bya rgyud phal cher la dgongs kyi mtha' dag la ma yin na/ bya rgyud bdag bskyed yod pa gcig tshol shog dang med do/ /bdag bskyed med pa gdul bya'i khyad par 'ga' zhig la dgongs zhes pa yang mi 'thad de/ gdul bya la bstan pa'i lam de rgyud sde'i don la mi gnas par 'gyur ba sogs skyon mtha' yas so/ /de bas na grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi 'grel pa dang / slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyi gur gyi 'grel pa dang / int+ra bhu ti'i bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang / slob dpon tha ga na rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa rnams las bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med pa gsal bar bshad cing / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa sogs rgyud kyi don yang de ltar du snang la/ bya rgyud kho rang nas bdag lhar bskyed pa yi ge na tsam zhig kyang ma bshad pa dang / bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma rje btsun sa skya pa dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba 'gos dpon slob rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par rgya gar gyi bya rgyud shing rta'i srol 'byed paṇḍi ta byung ba mchog gis kyang bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med pa gsal bar gsungs so/ /des na bya rgyud kyi nyams len tshe dpag med dang / gtsug tor rnam rgyal lta bu la cho ga'i yan lag bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang bzhis kha bskangs te bya rgyud rang lugs su nyams su len pa dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya mtsho lta bu dang / dge slong ma dpal mo'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs lta bu rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi rgyas bkab ste nyams su len pa dang /

slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs kyis rnam 'joms lta bu bya spyod gnyis bsres te spyod rgyud ltar nyams su len pa sogs rgya bod kyi nyams len pa chen po rnams la rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi gdams ngag ston tshul mi 'dra ba du ma zhig snang bas gang bka' lung yod pa de dang de khungs la gtugs nyams su blang bar bya yi/ thams cad bsres nas pho tshod rang bzo'i grub mtha' bca' bar mi bya'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud ni rgyud sde gang du bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa bshad cing ye shes pa dgug gzhug ma bshad pa de'i chos kyi rnam grangs bod na bzhugs pa la/ rnam snang mngon byang dang / phyag rdor dbang bskur la sogs pa dgu yod do/ /dge ldan pa chen pos spyod rgyud la ye shes pa dgug gzhug yod de/ phyag rdor dbang bskur las 'gro yang rung / 'greng yang rung bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bshad pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa mi 'thad de/ spyod rgyud la ye shes pa dgug gzhug yod par spyir rgya gar gyi mkhas grub thams cad dang / bod kyi bu ston yan chad thams cad mi bzhed la/ 'on kyang 'di khong pa rang gi gsung rab la dbang chen po bco brgyad kyi nang nas che shos gcig yin no/ /khyad par grub chen sangs rgyas gsang bas spyod rgyud kyi bstan bcos che la mang ba 'di tsam gcig las ma bshad pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas gsang ba tshad mar byed na des khyab la/ mi byed na sngar bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod de/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa'i phyir zhes pa'i grub mtha' la gnod pa chen po 'byung ngo / /spyir gyi yo ga dang rnal 'byor pha rgyud pa 'ga' zhig gi lugs la cho ga zin pa dang / ye shes pa gshegs gsol byed pa yin la/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud pa rnams gshegs gsol mi byed par rang la stim par byed pas dus thams cad du rang ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa tha mi dad pa'i nga rgyal 'byung /

khong pa'i thugs la ma rgyud pas de ltar du 'chad/ phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi lung 'di yang 'gro 'dug 'gul bskyod gang byed kyang lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par 'dug par dgongs nas ye shes pa dgug gzhug bzhed pa 'dra/ de min na lung de dang ye shes pa dgug pa la 'brel med par 'gyur ro/ /ma rgyud las bshad pas byed na spyod rgyud la rdzogs rim bsgom dgos par thal ba'i skyon yod de/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'di pa ltar na gnyis ka'i rgyud ni/ rgyud sde gang du bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'i steng du ye shes pa dgug gzhug yod pa'o/ /de'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ de kho na nyid 'dus pa/ dpal mchog rtse mo/ ngan song sbyong rgyud la sogs pa nyi shu tsam yod do/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang rjes pa sbyar nas/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ni/ rgyud sde gang du sbyang gzhi rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa dang / 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa/ snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i tha mal gyi rnam rtog snang ba sna tshogs pa lha dang bde chen du bsgyur ba'i thabs rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor yod pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud man la ni lha'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba la bskyed rim ni rnal 'byor chen po pa kho na'i khyad chos yin no/ /'dir bshad pa'i rnam gzhag 'di rnams ni slob dpon smad zhabs kyis rgyas par gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i 'phags skor ba ltar na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la dbye na ma rgyud dang pha rgyud gnyis te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ /ces so/ /ma rgyud la rigs drug ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs ni/ ji bzhin pa brnyes pa nam mkha' mnyam pa/ he ru ka'am mi bskyod pa'i rigs/ kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog dus 'khor/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ ma hā ma ya rnams yin no/

/rnam snang gi rigs rdo rje gdan bzhi/ mi g.yo ba bla med/ 'od dpag med kyi rigs la/ ku ru kulle'i rtog pa/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa/ padma dra ba'i rgyud ces pa la deng sang dbang bka' yang yod do/ /rin 'byung gi rigs rdo rje bdud rtsi/ don grub kyi rigs mgon po mngon 'byung / phur pa rtsa dum/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor chen por bshad pa rnams yin no/ /pha rgyud la bu ston rin po ches rigs lnga ru 'byed de/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs la yang rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor/ rigs kyi bdag po ni drag po gsum 'dul la sogs pa 'khor lo chen po sogs ston pa'i phyag rdor gyi skor/ rigs kyi khro bo ni gshin rje gshed kyi skor zhes bya rgyud pa'i brda chad yar khyer nas mdzad kyang de mi 'thad de/ spyir rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yan chad du rigs kyi gtso bo bdag po khro bo gsum gyis 'byed tshul mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang / bya rgyud pa ni rigs kyi bdag po dang / khro bo byang sems pa thob pa rang dga' ba dang / khro bo rang rgyud pa la 'dod la/ 'di'i phyag rdor dang / gshin rje gshed dmar nag sogs yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /bye brag tu phyag rdor gyi rgyud phal cher rje btsun rin po ches/ 'di la log par rtog pas sa steng khengs/ /zhes rgyud brdzus ma mang po yod par gsungs shing / dmar chos kyi rgyal po sogs 'khor chen pa rnams kyis phyag rdor ma rgyud du bshad la/ khyed rang gi rgyud sde'i dkar chag tu yang phyag rdor gyi skor rnams lhad can du bshad zin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam snang gi rigs kyang rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhes bzhed pa yang / rgyud 'di kun dga' snying po/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ paṇḍi ta smṛti dzñā na kirti rnams yo gar bkral cing / dngos bstan la de ltar bkral na phar 'then tshur 'then mi dgos pas legs po rang zhig yong bas 'di rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde yin par mtha' gcig tu ma nges mod/

'on kyang de tsam yin du chug go /padma'i rigs ral gcig ma'i rtog pa bya ba khro phu ba la bzhugs pa de la bya gsungs te/ 'di yang khro phu ba tshad mar byed na khro phu bas ma rgyud du bzhed pas/ pha rgyud kyi don med/ mi byed na rgyud 'di'i kha 'dzin khro phu ba ma gtogs gzhan byed mkhan med pas rgyud gang nas byung cha med par 'gyur ro/ /rgyud khong rang gi ngo bo ni rnying ma'i rgyud cig yin nam/ bod kyi bzos pa zhig yin nam/ mkhas pa la grags chung zhing / bu ston pa rang gis kyang 'di nas lung drangs pa gcig kyang med do/ /rin 'byung gi rigs nam mkha'i snying po'i rgyud ces bya ba yod de bod du ma 'gyur/ las kyi rigs kyang bod na med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /pha rgyud rigs lngar 'byed de/ 'byed rgyu bod na med pa'i gsung de yi byung dogs med do/ /'o na 'dir ji ltar dbye ba byed snyam na/ ma rgyud rgyas par logs su shes par 'gyur la/ pha rgyud la brag ltag pa rdog nyi ma seṅges/ rtsa ba'i rgyad/ gsang 'dus le'u bcu bdun pa/ rgyud phyi ma/ le'u phyi ma bco brgyad pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ rdor phreng sogs bzhi/ 'phros pa'i rgyud gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor rnams la gsungs/ de zhes dbye ba mdzad pa yang snang mod/ rgya gar ba du ma dang / bod snga rabs pa zhang shes rab bla ma sogs rgyud sde gsum du 'byed de/ de skad du yang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags mi spong zhing 'dod chags can byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor/ zhe sdang gis zhe sdang mi spong zhing zhe sdang can byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba gshin rje'i gshed kyi skor/ gti mug gis gti mug mi spong zhing gti mug can byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skor/

dang po la gsang ba 'dus pa ni 'og tu 'chad la/ phyag rdor gyi skor la rgyud ci yin 'di yin med pa bzhi bcu zhe gcig yod/ de nyid kyi phyir rje btsun rin po ches/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ /'di la log par rtog pas sa steng khengs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum 'dul gyi gzungs kyi rgyud bya ba/ gzungs dang rgyud gnyis ka'i mtshan 'byar ba/ sngags bho bho bhan yod pa de nyid rgyud dag po yin 'di nas 'khor chen ston/ 'di la dmar gyi ṭikka dang / sgrub dkyil dang yig cha tshang ma yod cing / dbang bka' dang lung bka' yang ding sang gi bar du bzhugs/ de dag gi dkyil 'khor lha bcu gsum ma yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam par yod pas cis kyang pha rgyud du byed na/ 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i zla la bzhag go /zla gsang thig le la da lta lung bka' ma gtogs dbang bka' dang 'grel pa ni med la/ bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dkar chag tu/ zla gsang thig le'i 'grel pa ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa zhes pa bris pas sngon ni byung bar gsal lo/ /'di kha cig gis ma rgyud du bzhag pa yod kyang / 'di nyid las/ dpa' bo zla gsang thig le zhes bshad pas pha rgyud du bzhag pa rigs so/ /zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i rgyud gshin rje gshed kyi skor rnams ni/ dmar nag gnyis su 'dus la/ dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa'i le'u dang po nas lha lnga ston/ brgyad pa nas bcu gsum ma ston cing / rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa'i lha lnga ma 'di yang 'di dang cha mthun cing / brten pa'i ngo bo ni rgyud rgyas pa 'bum pa yin la/ dpal 'dzin gyi bcu gsum ma yang 'di nyid la brten no/ /de dag bod du dpyal lo tsā ba chos bzang / chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ paṇa chen dha na shī las g.yag sde lo tsā ba la gsungs pa'i lugs dang gsum du 'dus/ de'i gong rje 'gos dang / sa skya pa gong ma rnams la ni med do/

/deng sang lha lnga ma/ bcu gsum ma gnyis ka'i dbang dang / rgya gzhung dang / rgyud kyi lung ni bod na bzhugs la/ rgyud 'di la rgya 'grel ni med/ dgra nag la mkhas pa zhig shes na 'chad sla ba ni 'dug go /glo bo lo tsā ba'i lugs kyi bcu gsum ma'i dbang bka' yang chag lo'i slob ma yin pas chag lugs su 'du'o/ /phyis bzang ldan 'debs mkhan kun spangs chos grags dpal la rgya dpe gcig byung ba bu ston pa la bskur nas bsgyur pa/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa yin lung bka' ni med/ 'di blo bzang snying po'i lha lnga ma'i sgrub thabs dang shin tu mthun pas de 'di la brten nas mdzad pa 'dra'o/ /nag po'i rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dgra nag le'u bco brgyad pa/ de'i 'khrul 'khor gsal bar ston pa gdong drug drag las bye brag tu ston pa rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /dgra nag la grub chen dpal 'dzin/ shanti pa/ gzhon nu zla ba/ nag po pa rnams kyi 'grel pa yod cing dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i lha bcu gsum ston/ gsang 'dus lha bcu gsum ma sangs rgyas kyis rgyal po int+ra bhu ti la dbang bskur mdzad pa de dang 'di gnyis zhi ba dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yin la/ 'on kyang de'i lha rnams kyi rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis yum la 'khyud pa dang 'di rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ma gtogs phyag lhag ma rnams 'dra zhing phyag mtshan yang 'dra'o/ /'di la grub chen dpal 'dzin dang / la li ta badzra la sogs pa'i gzhung phran yang yod cing / bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo la cog gru shes rab bla mas bsgyur/ khyad par 'bring mtshams kyi zhang pa yab sras rnams <!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>zhang shes rab bla ma ni cog gru klu'i rgyal mtshan nas mya ngan med pa'i dpal yan chad du lo tsā ba mang du byon pa'i rgyud rgya gar du byon te de wa a ka ra tsant+ra bha dra dang / de'i slob ma a mo gha badzra las nag po skor gsum gsan nyams su bzhes pa de'i sku gsung thugs kyi sras zhang sam gha bha tra yab sras gnyis ka'i thugs sras zhang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/

de'i slob ma sam bha'i sras gcen gtsang 'od/ gcung rdo rje rtse mo/ gcung gi sras mched gnyis ka'i slob ma rdo rje yang rtse/ de'i slob ma dngos grub rgyal mtshan sogs so/ /'di'i 'chad nyan dang bsgrub pa byed de/ de yang khong rnams rgyud 'di la bshad gsar byed/ de'i sngon du bsnyen pa lo skya sngo bcu gnyis song bya ba dang / drug tsam re byed pa'i srol bzang po yod pas dgra nag zhang la thug zer/ snyos kha rag pa zhes dang po zer zhing 'dam gyi kha thod na khong tsho'i dgon pa chen po yod/ ding sang skyo lugs su a mo gha badzra bod du byon/ zhang shes rab bla ma la chos bshad dbus su byon skyo nag 'grel ston dang mjal dbang bskur nas rgyud bshad de 'di bzung du btags/ des skyo ye shes 'byung gnas/ des skyo bsod nams bla ma/ des skyo rdo rje 'bar/ lho brag pa ro mnyam rdo rje sogs las brgyud do/ /grags pa skyo pa rnams kyang 'di'i bshad pa dang nyams len mdzad do/ /zhang pa lta bu'i rgyas po ni med/ 'on kyang bshad pa hrug ge ba re dang dbang bka' yod do/ /rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras gong ma rnams kyang 'di la thugs dam mdzad cing thugs rtsis shin tu che bas da lta yang bstan pa yod do/ /'khrul 'khor gsal bar ston pa gdong drug la rgya gar ba'i 'grel pa ni med/ gzhung phran slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / de wa a ka ra tsaṇḍas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gcig yod de/ slob dpon phyi ma 'di gdong drug gi bdag po yin par byed do/ /bod du rwa rdo rje grags kyis 'grel pa bsdus pa gcig mdzad/ gzhung phran gyi chos sna bzhi bcu zhe brgyad mdzad de/ man ngag bzang zhing gsal ba yod do/ /rgyud sde'i lung dang dbang bka' yang ding sang bzhugs/ drag po'i las bye brag tu ston pa rdo rje 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa la slob dpon gzhon nu zla ba dang /

mi bskyod rdo rje'i 'grel pa yod cing / gzhan kha cig tu grub pa'i rdo rjes mdzad zer/ la lar mdzad byang med pa yang 'byung / kha cig tu bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas mdzad zer/ la lar swa na shrīs mdzad zer ba ming mi 'dra yang / 'grel pa de bzhi'i tshig zhus dag thub pa lta bu byas pas rgya 'grel gcig kyang yod do/ /gzhung phran la slob dpon la li ta badzras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa/ bcu bzhi la nye ba gcig yod/ 'di la rje btsun sa skya pa rnams dang / ra pa rnams dang / skyo pa la sogs pa bod na yang shin tu thugs rtsis che zhing bar chad bzlog pa la ches bsngags pas rgya gar na yang rab tu dar ba yin no/ /kho rang la bltar phyin na gsang zhing sbas pa zhig 'ong thang pa zhig 'dug kyang / rgya bod gnyis kar grags che'o/ /des na da lta bod na gshin rje gshed nag po skor gsum gyi bstan pa yang tshang bar bzhugs pa lags/ gzhung gzhan gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa bya ba dang / gshin rje gshed dgra dmar gyi rtog pa bya ba dang / rtog pa gcig pa zhes bya ba rnams ni bod kyi sngags pa mi mkhas po 'gas brtsams pa yin zhing / rtog gsum bya ba 'di skyo pa'i bla ma gong ma mkhas po zhig gis byas/ de nas 'khrul 'khor shin tu che ba ston no/ /skyo pa'i bla ma grub chen a mo gha badzra chung ba yin la/ khong gi 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs 'khrul 'khor ston pa zhi ba las bdun/ drag po las bdun/ drag las phyogs gcig bya ba rnams dang shin tu mthun/ mdor na rtog gsum sangs rgyas kyis gsung pa'i rgyud dang / rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i gzhung ni ma yin no/ /skyo pa rang la shin tu dgos/ gzhan su dang yang mi mthun no/ /a mo gha'i gzhung zhib las bdun sogs kyang rwa pa dang mi mthun no/ /rwa pa rnam la myur ba'i las bdun bya ba/ rgyud rgya gzhung nas dngos su ma bshad kyang man ngag shin tu myur ba/ snying po dang / rtsa sngags spel/

rtsa sngags dang nye snying spel/ nye snying dang snying po spel/ gsum ka spel bya ba sogs byas pa zab mo zhig byung pa ding sang 'di phyogs na ni de'i bka' lung med/ mdo khams na dong dom pa dang / yon tan 'bum bya ba de tsho la mkhas pa byon 'dug pas de'i rgyun e yod yin/ bla ma rgya dang / mgar dang / ldong gsum yang rwa lo'i dngos brgyud kyi slob ma yin pas rwa pa'i khongs su 'du'o/ /rtog gsum la skyo ba rang gi ṭīkka bzang po yod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba la/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang gsum las/ dang po la slob dpon kun dga' snying po dang / rab zhi bshes gnyen/ smrirti rnams kyis yo gar bkral ba'i 'grel pa byas/ dus 'khor gyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi dbang bskur bcu gcig bya ba'i nang du 'di'i dbang byung na yang da lta ni med/ phyis lo bcu tsam gyi gong na bla ma kha cig rnam snang sgyu dra'i dbang byed kyis drag ste/ sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i dbang ni ma yin no/ /slob dpon a bha yas phreng bar/ rnal 'byor bla med du bshad pas 'dir pha rgyud du bzhag go /'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba khri drug stong pa'i dum bu mtshan yang dag par brjod pa yo ga dang bla med du bkral pa sogs bshad srol rgya che bar bzhugs/ rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ rtsa ba'i rgyud gsang ba'i snying po sogs/ kha cig gis rma rin chen mchog gi brtsams so zhes gsungs kyang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gsang ba'i snying po/ sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu pa/ sgyu 'phrul bla ma/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul/ thabs kyi zhags pa rnams rgyud rnam par dag pa 'dra/ lhag ma legs par rtogs la gyis gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /spyir rnying ma ba rnams kyis rgyud brtsams pa nan tar mang na yang bstan pa snga dar la/ sku'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/

gsung gi rgyud zla gsang thig le/ thugs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi rgyud rdo rje bdud rtsi/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud karmā ma la/ kha skong gi rgyud rnam snang sgyu dra zhes pa drug gsar rnying kun la rtsod pa med par grags pa'i rgyud yin no/ /'dod chags can 'dul ba dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la/ rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud gnyis/ rtsa rgyud du 'jog byed rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis gang gi thog mar byung zhing bshad bzhir gyur pas rtsa rgyud/ phyis byung zhing 'chad byed du 'dug pas bshad rgyud ces pa ltar yin no/ /'di'i rtsa rgyud chen mo 'bum phrag gsum pa gsungs nas snyigs dus kyi sems can tshe thung ba rnams la mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs zhes slob dpon shanti pa'i gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog tu bshad do/ /u rgyan sogs na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i phyag na bzhugs pas grub pa thob pa rnams la ni thos bsam byed pa'i skal ba yod do/ /snyigs dus kyi sems can tshe thung ba rnams la rtsa rgyud bsdus pa le'u bco brgyad pa 'di ston pas bzlas te gsungs la/ de yang slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras le'u bcu bdun pa yan la rtsa rgyud du mdzad de/ sgron gsal las kyang de ka'i 'grel pa mdzad cing / mdo bsres las kyang le'u bcu bdun pa las btus te bstan ces 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /le'u bco brgyad pa rgyud phyi mar mdzad de sgron gsal du lung drangs pa mang du yod cing / 'chad pa po rnams kyis lung tsam re rdog arya de bas don bcu gsum du bcad pa'i sa bcad yod do/ mdzad do/ /slob dpon ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams kyis bskyed bsnyen sgrub bzhi/ rdzogs sbyor ba yan lag drug kyi gnad rnams rgyud phyi ma las ston pas bshad rgyud kyi mthil rang du mdzad la/ le'u bco brgyad pa la slob dpon sman zhabs kyis 'grel pa zur du mdzad pa yang yod do/

/rgyud 'di bod du thog mar lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/ le'u bco brgyad pa'i mjug tu 'gyur byang smos pa bcu bdun yan la rtog pa'i rgyal po rdzogs so bya ba las 'gyur byang mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /'phags lugs pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud la rje 'gos dpon slob nas kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yan bshad rgyud bzhir khong pa'i khrid yig na'ang bzhi las med/ 'dod de/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ rdo rje phreng ba'o/ /bu ston pas de'i steng du rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa/ gnyis med rnam rgyal dang brgyad du bzhed do/ /sgron gsal du de rnams nas lung mang po drangs pas gsungs te/ de ltar na bzang spyod kyi lung yang drangs pas de yang bshad rgyud du 'gyur ro/ /rgyud phyi ma las/ 'phags lugs pas lung yar drangs pa yod/ 'bru snon phar byas pa ni med de/ 'di pa la 'grel pa sgron gsal gcig po las ni med/ de las ni 'grel pa le'u bcu bdun pa yan las ma mdzad do/ /bla med rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa 'di nas ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i lha'i grangs dang / bzlas pa dang / sna rtse gsum gyi rdzogs rim gsal bar byed cing / gzhan 'dus pa spyi la phan pa'i lung mang du bzhugs mod/ rgya bod kyi 'phags skor ba rnams la ma byung ngo / /rgyud 'di la rgya 'grel ni med/ bod kyi ṭīkka yang ma mthong zhing / rgyud rang gi ngo bo khyad par 'phags pa zhig snang la/ rgyud 'bum na lung bzhugs pa yin no/ /sgron gsal gyi gleng gzhi 'chad pa'i lha'i dbang pos zhus pa las zhes lung drangs mod/ de bod yin pa yang srid/ rgyud yin pa yang po ti bod du ma 'gyur/ gnyis med rnam rgyal la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i po ti chen po yod pa de la bar skabs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams na re/

rgyud 'di chu shul pho ba lung du rgya pho ba lung pas brtsams pa yin te/ ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul yang khong la gsang 'dus mar lugs man ngag mang po yod pas de rnams ston byed kyi rgyud brtsams pa yin no/ /'di nas gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi nang du dkyil 'khor chen po so gnyis byas pa/ dbus kyi mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha so gnyis rdzogs pa/ de bzhin du shar lho mi g.yo ba'i gnas su mi g.yo bas gtso byas khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sar gtso bo mi bskyod pa bskyal ba sogs dkyil 'khor 'jigs su rung ba ches che ba gcig cig yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma yin no gsungs/ sa skya pa blo chen na re/ rgyud 'di la khong rang tsho rgya pho ba lung pa las/ stong grod pa lung pas byas zer na'ang gyis/ nga rang 'di'i dbang bskur byed zer nas mtshan can byed ces grags so/ /phyis mkhan chen thar pa lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe'i khrod nas bu ston pas gnyis med rnam rgyal bya ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu shog bu bzhi lnga tsam zhig gi rgya dpe brnyed nas/ de bsgyur pa'i mjug na 'di rgyud kyi dum bu las mi snang mod/ sngar gyi gnyis med rnam rgyal zhes grags pa chen po de brdzun mar rtogs par bya ba'i phyir 'di bsgyur to zhes bris/ phyis bla ma kun spangs chos grags pa la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud bya ba'i rgya dpe zhig 'bul mkhan byung / de bu ston la gser dang bcas te sgyur cig ces gnang nas bsgyur pas/ brtag gnyis tsam byas pa'i rgyud tshang ma zhig byung / de'i gsham na sngar mkhan chen thar pa lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe'i khrod nas rgyud 'di'i dum bu brnyed pa bsgyur mod kyang / da ni rgyud kyi rgya dpe tshangs ma brnyed nas bsgyur te/ sngar gnyis med rnam rgyal du grags pa de brdzun ma yang dag par rtogs par bya ba'i rin chen grub kyis bsgyur ces pa'o/

/zhes bris te kho pa rang gis bsgyur pa'i gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud de bshad rgyud du khas blangs so/ /spyir dang po'i gnyis med rnam rgyal chen po 'di rgyud rnam dag yin na gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud du bzhag na rung mod/ 'on kyang 'di la 'phags pa rin po ches rgyud kyi lung mang po drangs yod pas bka' min zhes kyang mi rung la kho rang gi ngo bo bod cig gis bsgrigs pa yin zhes kyang mi rung zhes brtag pa'i gnas su mdzad pa nyid legs so/ /bu ston pas gnyis med rnam rgyal 'di slob dpon yo ga ba zhig gis yo gar bkral nas kyang 'grel thub pa zhig snang la/ bla med yin na yang rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig bshad pas gti mug can 'dul ba'i khongs su rigs kyi/ gsang 'dus kyi don med do/ /sngar gyi gnyis med rnam rgyal chen po de'i ming yang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa rnam par rgyal ba thun mong min pa'i gsang ba zhes grags/ 'di tshad mar 'dod pa dag gis thun gsang las zhes pa'i lung yang drangs/ bu ston pas bsgyur pa 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba zhes bya ba'i mtshan med pas gsang 'dus kyi rgyud du 'gro bar ming de yang 'byar dgos tshod du 'dug ste/ klu byang dang zla grags sogs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba zhes pa las zhes 'byung zhing / 'phags skor ba'i gzhung rnams las thun mong min pa'i gsang ba las lung drangs pa rnams kyang 'di na mi snang ngo / /klu byang zla grags sogs kyis lung drangs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba de bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /spyir bka' dri ma med pa'i rgyud 'di lta bu bsgyur pa bu ston sku drin che la/ 'gyur yang legs mod lung med/ 'grel pa dang gzhung phran sogs med pas rgyud sde gang gi khongs su gtogs gzhag par dka' ba zhig 'dug go /des na 'phags lugs la bshad rgyud bzhi yin zhing /

de la yang thun mong ma yin pa dang / thun mong ba gnyis/ dang po la yang gnyis las/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi sogs kyi rgyan bdun gyi sgo nas rtsa rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig rnams 'di ltar 'chad gsal bar ston pa 'di lta bu'i bshad rgyud cig med na/ rtsa rgyud kyi tshig gis bshad pa bying can 'di mi thon/ 'di la slob dpon shardha ka ra warma'i rgyan bdun gyi brjed byang bya ba'i don 'grel gcig ma gtogs 'grel pa gzhan med do/ /dgongs pa lung ston gyis rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa yan gyi don gyi cha gsal bar ston te/ 'dis rtsa rgyud du sgyu ma dang 'od gsal zung 'jug gleng gzhi mthar thug tu bshad pa rnams gsal bar ston/ 'di lta bu'i bshad rgyud slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan nas byung ba yin gyi/ ye shes zhabs dang / shanti pa sogs la thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud 'di lta bu med pas 'phags skor ba'i bshad pa bying can 'di 'dra ma thon pa yin no/ /'di la 'grel pa tshang ma ni med/ rdor bzlas ston pa'i gzhung khol bu cung zad la slob dpon shardha ka ras 'grel pa mdzad do/ /bod rdog tshul khrims bzang pos byas pa'i ṭīkka yod/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus ni 'di'i ngag dben gyi skabs su shin tu phan/ gzhan kyai rdo rje dang / sambu ṭi sogs rlung gi bshad pa ston tshad kyi bshad rgyud yin no/ /'di la slob dpon ye shes snying po dang / smṛrti'i 'grel pa yod cing / snga ma ni bzang zhing / 'gyur yang shin tu legs so/ /rdo rje phreng ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud 'di'i gleng gzhi sbas don du gsal bar bshad pas bshad 'dus pa'i bskyed rim yang gsal bar ston/ rgyud 'di nas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi bde mchog ltar du ston cing / bde mchog gi rgyud du lus dkyil gyi dbang chog gsal bar ma bstan pa 'di'i nang du sbas te/

dper na mi zhig la nor chen po yod pa rang gi nang du mi 'jog par gzhan gyi khyim du sbed pa bzhin no/ /slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gnang ba byin nas rgyud 'di la rtsom gdan byas nas lus dkyil gyi cho ga brtsams pa yin te/ mdor na bde mchog dang thun mong gi bshad rgyud yin no/ /'phags lugs la sgron gsal las gzhan pa'i rab tu sgron gsal 'di la lo tsā ba byang rtses 'grel pa brgyad stong pa zhes gsungs te/ dpe brgyad la don gyis stong pas so zhes gsungs/ sogs 'grel pa bzhi tsam yod de/ sgron gsal gyi cha lag yin no/ /gzhan yang le'u bco brgyad po thams cad la slob dpon rdo rje bzhad pa'i 'grel pa/ bi ma la mi tra'i 'grel pa/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa de dag gzhung phran dang bcas pa bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su 'gyur te/ ding sang ni glegs bam tsam las bka' lung med do/ /ye shes zhabs lugs la bskyed rdzogs lta ba 'bras bu dang bcas pa gsal bar ston pa 'jam dpal zhal lung / bskyed rim sgrub thabs kun bzang / bdag bsgrub pa/ rdzogs rim 'grel thig dbang chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa sogs gzhung phran bzang la mang ba dang / shanti pa'i snyim pa'i me tog sogs 'grel pa bcu gnyis tsam dang / bod kyi yang lo chen dang / sa skya pa rnams shin tu thugs rtsis che la/ snyos kyi gye re lhas pa yab sras rnams kyi yig cha bzang la mang ba yod do/ /yang paṇḍi ta smrirti nas brgyud pa'i srol yang bod du byung mod kyang deng sang mi bzhugs/ spyir rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag byed na thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal/ thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma 'dres par byas nas/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gang 'chad kyang rang rang dang mthun par ston dgos pa las gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad rang lugs ltar brda chad bzhag pa yin no/ /'dir gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi'i mtha' can gyi rgyud sde stong phrag sum cu so bzhi'i nang nas rtsa ba dang mchog tu gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'chad par byed/

de la thog mar bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang / rgyud kyi byung tshul bshad par bya ba la spyir ston pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gsungs pa'i tshul/ de dag rgya gar du ji ltar byung pa'i tshul/ de nyid bod du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gsum las/ dang po slob dpon kun snying gi bzhed pas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas su gsungs par yo ga'i 'grel pa rnams dang / khyad par gsang 'dus yo gar bkral pa'i 'grel pa las bshad/ slob dpon kun snying la kha 'phangs nas zom rong chos bzang gis byas pa'i 'grel pa chen po ste drug tsam byas pa yang yod/ yang rdo rje phreng ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon a lam ka ka la zhes pa rgyan gyi rol pas mdzad par gsang sngags mtha' dag dga' ldan du gsungs par bshad pa yod na'ang / 'di rje btsun sa skya pa rnams spyir gsang sngags la ston pa 'dis bzlas te ma gsungs pa dang / gsungs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'dis bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu sangs rgyas nas theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ kyai rdor gyi rtsa rgyud 'bum lnga dang / 'di'i rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa sogs rtsa rgyud chen po rnams gsungs nas/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir ston pa 'dis sems can tshe thung zhing longs spyod dman pas rtsa rgyud chen po rnams la thos bsam byed pas dus 'das te bsgom pa'i ro mi myong bar 'gyur bar gzigs nas/ rtsa rgyud chen po de nyid mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs pas na/ de dag bzlas te ma gsungs pa yin no/ /de dag dang don 'dra zhing tshig nyung ba'i bsdus rgyud 'di lta bu rnams ni ston pas bzlas te gsungs pa yin no/ /de la dang po rgyud sde 'di rnams rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs u rgyan na bzhugs pa'i rgyal po int+ra bo dhi zhes bya bas nam mkha' la ston pa'i nyan thos rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba mthong nas/

ci yin dris pas/ ston pa'i nyan thos yin zer bas/ ston pa la dad pa skyes te gnyan yod na bzhugs pa mngon sum du mthong nas/ sang gi nyin par bdag gi 'dir gdugs tshod la gshegs su gsol zhes zhus pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ der chos zhus pas rab tu byung zhig gsungs/ mi nus pas 'dod yon la spyod bzhin du sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs lam zhu byas pas/ ston pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur ba de nyid kyi tshe grub pa brnyes so/ /'di ni dbang kho nas grol ba yin zhing / de'i 'khor bya rog yan chad kyis kyang gtor zan zos pas grub pa brnyes so/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje chos la rgyud sde rnams gtad de rdo rje chos ni gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin yin pas rgyud sde 'dzin pa la ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir ro/ /don phyag na rdo rje nyid yin no/ /der rgyal pos rgyud sde rnams gser la bai ḍūryas bris te de dag bzhugs pa'i khang bu yang byas so/ /de ltar rgyal po 'khor bcas thams cad lus de nyid kyis sangs rgyas nas yul khams de rim gyis stong nas mtshor gyur te/ mtsho de la klu mang po gnas shing rim gyis mtsho 'gram du grong yang chags/ de nas mtsho skams pas sngar gyi rgyal po'i dpe khang byung ba la he ru ka rang byung gi gandho la zhes ming btags so/ /de'i dpe rnams phyag na rdo rjes klu la gtad de/ dbang bskur lam bstan pas klu las gyur pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma mang bar byung ste/ he ru ka rang byung gi gandho la deng sang yang bar snang la bzhugs shing skal ldan 'ga' res mthong ba yin no/ /spyir u rgyan ni sa cha ser po de 'dra gcig yod la/ de ni o ḍi ya na zhes pa'i gnas de yin la/ sgra drang por bsgyur na 'phur 'gro zhes bya'o/ /de yang yul de'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams nam mkha' la 'phur nas 'gro ba'i phyir ro/

/zur chag pa las u rgyan zhes bya la/ de ni rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs drang po na yod cing / rdo rje gdan ni sa skya'i lho drang thad na yod ces kyang grags kyang skyid grong gi lho'i drang thad na yod do/ /'o na rgyud 'di 'phags pa'i yul du dus nam gyi tshe sus gdan drangs snyam na/ u rgyan na klu las gyur pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma mang du yod pa de'i tshe na/ 'phags pa'i yul la rgyal po bi su kalpa legs pa'i rtog ces pa theg chen gyi sde snod la mkhas pa zhig yod de/ des bsam pa/ theg chen gyi sde snod 'di dag las nyon mongs pa spong dgos zhes phal cher gsungs na yang / byang chub sems dpa' 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spyod kyang zhes bya ba dang / 'od srung gis zhus pa las/ ji ltar grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud/ /de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams bskyed la phan/ /zhes nyon mongs pa lam du byed par gsungs shing / sems can ni byang chub ste de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang bshad pas 'di'i don ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' yod nges te/ bdag gis brnyed na snyam du bsam pas/ rmi lam du u rgyan du song zhig dang brnyed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan ces 'dus pa ba chen po rnams gsungs shing / sa skya pa'i gsung las/ rgyal po bi su kalpa zhes bya ba nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa zhig gi rmi lam du khyod u rgyan du song zhig dang / skye ba 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bos te/ zhes 'byung ba dang / gang ltar yang mnal sad nas the tshom med par phyin pas/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma gcig dang 'phrad de bsnyen bkur byas pas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur lam bstan rgyud byin to/ /spyir u rgyan du la las dbang dang gdams ngag lon kyang rgyud ma lon pa dang /

la las rgyud lon kyang dbang lam ma thob pa yod kyang / rgyal po 'dis thams cad dus gcig la lon pa yin no/ /de ltar na rgyal pos lam bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes nas rgyud khyer te 'phags yul du byon nas rgya gar lho phyogs su dar bar mdzad de/ de'i tshe na 'phags yul na bram ze zhig la bu zhig yod pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sras sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i drung du rab tu byung nas/ bsnyen par rdzogs te mtshan yang sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po zhes grags so/ /des bhri kā ma la shi la'i mkhan po mdzad cing /bzhugs tsa na/ rgyal po bi su kalpa la u rgyan nas lon pa'i chos yod zer ba thos nas zhus pas/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa mang po gnang ngo / /bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes nas mda' 'phen pa'i spyod pa mdzad pas grub chen sa ra ha zhes grags so/ /slob dpon sha wa ri dbang phyug la sa ra ha chung ba zhes brda chad byed pa yang grub chen 'jigs su rung ba yin yang / 'di la ltos te dus phyi ba dang / 'di pa'i slob rgyun yin pas de bzhin byas kyang mi rung ba med do/ /sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po grub pa brnyes pa'i sa ra ha chen po des sngags kyi bstan bcos do ha mdzod kyi glu mdzad do/ /spyir do ha la rgyal po do ha btsun mo do ha/ dmangs do ha zhes grags pa du ma yod kyang / 'dir slob dpon gyis mdzad nges shes pa ni dmangs do har grags pa/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te zhes pa yod pa de yin la/ gzhan gnyis ni bal po'i paṇḍi ta 'dras byas pa yin no/ /des slob dpon klu sgrub la gdams te/ de la klu sgrub ni lho phyogs bhe ta'i yul du bram ze phun sum tshogs pa zhig la bu med par lha la gsol ba btab pas bu byung / bram ze mtshan mkhan la bstan pas gzugs byad kyi mtshan da bzang ste/ zhag bdun nas 'chi zer/ cis phan byas pas/ bram ze brgya dang / dge slong brgya la chos ston drangs na rim pa bzhin zla ba bdun dang /

lo bdun 'tsho zer/ de ltar byas pas lo bdun la nye bar bslebs/ pha ma bu'i ro mthong bar mi 'dod nas g.yog dang bcas te yul gzhan du spyugs/ des rim gyis nā lend+ra na sa ra ha bzhugs pa'i sgo drung du bslebs/ der tshigs su bcad pa bton pas/ nang du bos rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ rab tu byung nus na thabs yod gsungs/ gzod rab tu byung ba khas blangs/ der sbyong rgyud kyi 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i sgor zhugs te/ lam bstan nas bsgrub tu bcug pas tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes/ dgung lo brgyad pa la de nyid kyi drung du rab tu byung / de nas rim gyis bsnyen par rdzogs te mtshan dge slong dpal ldan du grags/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu bcug lam bsgoms pas dngos grub brnyes/ de nas dge 'dun gyi zhal lta ba la bskos te/ mu ge lo bcu gnyis su byung ba la/ slob dpon gyis bha ling ta'i drung du gser 'gyur gyi rtsi bslabs dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog byas mu ge sangs pa dang / dge 'dun rnams na re/ mu ge byung pa yin par 'dug la/ khyed kyis 'tsho ba ji ltar btsal zhes dris rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas dge 'dun log 'tsho la sbyar 'dug pas/ de'i bshags pa la mchod rten bye ba dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs shig ces gnas nas dbyung / dge 'dun log 'tsho la sbyar ba ma yin kyang / de ltar phyung na mchod rten dang bstan bcos rtsom pa'i phyir yin nam snyam/ de nas chos gsung gin bzhugs tsa na byis pa dri zhim pa gnyis chos nyan du byung pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'jog po'i bu yin zer/ slob dpon la klu'i yul du 'byon dgos zer ba la/ 'bum bskur ba dang / mchod rten gyi 'dam ster na 'gro gsungs nas byon/ chos gsungs pas klu rnams dad de/ 'bum gyi mjug dum pa gcig ma gtogs pa rnams dang 'dam bskur/ 'bum gyi 'gyur re skan las de man chad kyi gzhung da lta rdzogs so'i bar yod pa nyi khri nas kha bskangs pa yin no/

/de nas mi yul du phebs te mchod rten bzhengs/ seng ldeng gi nags su byon pas ma he 'tsho ba'i byis pa gcig na re/ bud med gcig gis slob dpon klu sgrub bya ba sgo na yod/ nang du shog gsung ngo zer phyin pas sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ 'di slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyi lugs kyi sgrol ma lha lnga ma me tog phreng 'dzin du grags pa de yin no/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis lha lnga'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ slob dpon 'dis gtso mo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ de nas byang sgra mi snyan du byon pa'i lam khar byis pa mang po'i lag yig gzigs/ gcig rgyal por 'gyur bar lung bstan/ tshur phebs dus des rgyal po thob 'dug go /des slob dpon gyi sbyin bdag byas nas yun ring du bzhugs/ de nas lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la byon/ /rgyal po de la bu gcig byung / bu de la ras gcig yod pa ma la 'di nya ra gyis/ rgyal po thob dus dgos zer/ ma na re/ khyod kyis rgyal po mi thob ste/ khyod kyi pha slob dpon klu sgrub dang srog gcig pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub yod pas so zer bas/ bu ngu ba la/ ma na re/ thabs yod khyod rang slob dpon gyi dbu slong du song / byang chub sems dpa' yin pas ster zer der phyin pas gnang / de nas dbu de gzhan zhig tu bskyur to/ /byams pa'i bstan pa la de gnyis 'grig yong zer ro/ /kha cig na re/ da lta yang dbu dang lus je nyer 'gro yi 'dug zer grags so/ /dbu dang sku lus ni rdo dkar po'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs so/ /de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po des dbu ma chos dbyings bstod pa la sogs pa bstod pa'i tshogs dang / rtsa ba'i shes rab la sogs pa rig pa'i tshogs dang / rin chen phreng ba la sogs pa gtam gyi tshogs dang / mdo kun las btus pa rnams mdzad/ bslab pa kun las btus pa chen po zhes bya ba slob dpon gyis mdzad par grags pa 'di gzhung khyad 'phags gcig ni snang /

bka' gdams pa 'ga' zhig gis ra sgreng gi mdo sde nas btus pa yin nam brtag go /sngags phyogs la byang chub sems 'grel zhes pa'i tshigs bcad ma 'di slob dpon gyis mdzad pa yin la/ lhug pa gcig yod pa 'di ti shri grang 'od la sogs pas bstan 'gyur du bstan bcos zur pa zhig tu byas mod/ sgron gsal gyi byang chub sems kyi le'u'i 'grel pa de zur du phyung ba yin no/ /sgrub thabs mdor byas/ mdo bsres/ rim pa lnga pa rnams mdzad/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba'i cho ga nyi shu pa 'di 'gos rdog pa rnams kyis slob dpon gyis mdzad par bzhed cing / de nas 'byung ba'i dbang bka' yang yod pa la/ sa skya pa rnams dbang bka' rnying pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ bu ston pa ma byon gong du 'di the tshom can yin su yang mi zer/ khong pas cho ga nyi shu pa slob dpon gyis mdzad pa ma yin te/ sgrub thabs mdor byas dang mi 'dra ba'i phyir dang / klu'i byang chub dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zhes zer ro/ /sgrub thabs mdor byas dang mi 'dra ba chen po rang med cing / klu'i byang chub dang mi 'dra ba'i phyir zhes bu yis byas pa la/ bla ma red mda' pa na re/ skyag 'byung med pa'i bu ston/ klu'i byang chub kyi dkyil chog ma dag ste/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang mi mthun pa'i phyir ma zer bar/ slob dpon gyi de min te slob ma dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zer ba mi 'thad ces smras mod/ bu ston gyi klu'i byang chub kyi cho ga nyi shu dang mi mthun pa'i phyir na/ slob dpon gyis mdzad nges shes pa min zer ba'i tshig 'di nus pa chen po yin te/ slob dpon gyis dkyil chog mdzad nges shes na/ klu byang gis de dang mi mthun pa'i dkyil chog ga la rtsom/ gzhan yang slob dpon klu byang la ka ma'i phye rkyal ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dngos slob bstan pa'i gtad rabs dgu pa yin zhing /

des mdzad pa'i dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal bar/ dbab pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis dbab pa'i snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma la dbab par bya ste/ grub pa'i dbang phyug klu'i blo'i cho ga las so zhes bshad cing / gzhan yang a bhya la sogs pa'i rgya gar ba mang pos klu byang gi dkyil chog nas lung shin tu mang ba drangs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas 'gos dpon slob dang / rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad par bzhed cing / de la brten pa'i dbang bka' yod pas slob dpon gyis ma mdzad ces smra ba ni shin tu dka'/ slob dpon gyi rtsom rnams gtsang hril pa gcig yong ba la 'gyur nyes pa e yin/ 'di nyog ge ba gcig kyang 'dug bu ston pa'i rig pa de dang gzhung kho rang gi tshig 'gros la brtags na min nam yang snyam ste brtag go /sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyi ras ris la brten pa'i dkyil chog dang / klu byang gi dkyil chog gnyis mtshams sbyor tsam ma gtogs tshig tshun chad kyang shin tu mthun/ de gnyis la brten pa'i dbang chog bla ma kha che paṇa chen gyis sa paṇa la gnang / 'di la sa lugs pa rnams dbang bka' gsar pa zhes gsungs/ deng sang bu ston pa'i lugs su yang grags shing / dkyil chog gi rtsom yang phal cher 'di la brten pa yin yang dbang bka' gcig gi brgyud pa gsar rnying thams cad la 'dod pa zha lu pa'i phyag srol yin no/ /de ltar bstan bcos rgya cher mdzad pa'i slob dpon klu sgrub de/ mdo lang kar gshegs pa dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma rnams nas rgyal ba nyid kyis lung bstan pa yin no/ /de la slob ma'i mchog ji ltar byung snyam na/ slob dpon arya de wa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub rnams ni dngos kyi slob ma yin pa la rtsod pa med la/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa kha cig dngos slob yin par 'dod/

kha cig min par 'dod de 'og tu dpyad do/ /slob dpon arya de wa ni sngon ston pa bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bya rog cig gis ston pa'i dbu la bya thal btang ste ston pas ma 'ongs pa na mu stegs su 'gyur te/ bstan pa la gnod pa byed par lung bstan/ der btsun chung zhig gis de ngas 'dul bar 'gyur pa'i smon lam btab bo/ /de nas dus ring zhig na rgyal po zhig gi ldum ra na padma mang po yod pa nyin kha bye zhing / mtshan kha zum par gyur pa las padma chen po zhig nyin mo yang kha zum ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan rgyal po la bsnyad pas/ de srungs shig sras skye'o zhes gsungs/ de nas zhag 'ga' nas kha bye bas/ slob dpon klu sgrub gang na yod zer ba'i khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig byung ngo / /de rgyal pos bur khas blangs/ de nas bu des ring zhag na slob dpon can byon rab tu byung bsnyen par rdzogs/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i dbang dang gdams pa zhus nas slob dpon gyi drung na lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs so/ /de'i dus na mu stegs shig la bu gcig skyes pa ma yis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gzhug byas kyang / phas ma nyan te mu stegs la bcug go /des dbang phyug bsgrubs pas grub ste dngos grub byin no/ /de nas khos rgya gar shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs na yod pa'i sangs rgyas pa kun pham par byas so/ /der ma na re/ rgya gar shar dang lho na sangs rgyas pa rta'i rna ba tsam yin/ yul dbus na lent+ra na sangs rgyas pa'i paṇḍi ta rta'i lus ltar ches che ba dag yod kyi/ der song nas khyod rgyal na nga rgyal byed pa yin mod byas pa dang / khong yul dbus su song / na ga lend+ra gang na yod byas pas/ bud med gcig na re/ blun po na lend+ra zer ba yin zer/ rten 'brel ma legs snyam so/ /der de na yod pa'i paṇḍi ta rnams la rang re rtsod/ nga rgyal na khyed kun nga'i bstan pa la 'jug dgos/

khyed rgyal na nga chu bo gaṅgā la lceb zer/ der khong dang rtsod nus pa'i paṇḍi ta ma byung nas gros byas pas/ dpal gyi ri la slob dpon yab sras bzhugs/ rang re rnams chos skyong mgon po la gsol ba 'debs la/ der zhu ba gtong ba drag zer nas gsol ba btab gtor ma byas/ de'i steng du 'phrin yig bzhag pa bya rog gcig gis khyer te dpal gyi ri la song / bod rnams chos skyong bya rog ma bya ba yin zer ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'phrin gzigs te/ nga rtsod pa byed pa la yul dbus su 'gro gsungs pa la/ 'phags pa lha na re/ slob dpon byon mi 'tshal nga yis 'gro yi zhus te/ khyod kyis mi thub gsungs/ thub zhus pas blta yi gsungs nas/ slob dpon gyis mu stegs kyi grub mtha' bzung / 'phags pa lha yis nang pa'i grub mtha' bzung rtsod pa byas pas/ lha lan gsum gyi bar du rgyal/ mu stegs ngan pa de khyer zhes lh+wam slob dpon la brgyab pas/ phyis 'gyod pa la/ slob dpon na re/ 'gyod mi dgos/ de dus nga mu stegs yin pa'i 'du shes yod pas so gsungs/ de ltar lha yul dbus su byon/ lam khar spyan slong ba la ya gcig byin no/ /der chu len pa'i tshul du byas nang du byon/ khos snga gong nas phyi nas rtsod pa yong bar go nas sgo la nyal/ nang du dge 'dun re re nas mgo la dbyug pa brgyab ste bgrangs/ der slob dpon lha nang du tshud gral gsham du bsdad pas/ mgo zlum gang nas 'ongs zer/ ske nas 'ongs byas/ de nas bzung ste rtsod pas mu stegs pham par byas te bstan pa la btsud pa ni slob dpon rta dbyangs yin no/ /sngon gyi lung bstan pa'i bya rog dang btsun chung ni de gnyis so/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon 'phags pa lhas dbu ma bzhi brgya pa dang / spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron me dang / sems kyi sgrib sbyong dang / bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa dang / mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa la sogs pa mdzad de/

arya de was mdzad zer ba'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa ni/ rdog arya de wa yin no/ /de ltar 'grel pa'i don la ma dpyad par arya de wa'i ming la 'khrul par zad do/ /slob dpon de 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma nas lung bstan to/ /slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen ni rim pa lnga pa'i rim pa gnyis pa mdzad mkhan gyi spyir bod na sgron gsal gyi ṭīkka nyi ma seṅge'i sgron chung / nyi ma lcam sgron 'bring / arya de wa sgron chen zhes grags so/ /slob dpon chen po de yin/ kha cig legs smra'i rim lnga'i 'grel par/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen slob dpon klu sgrub kyi sras kyi thu bo yin pas dgyes dgyes mdzad nas rim pa gnyis pa la shākya bshes gnyen gyi mdzad byang bcug pa yin zer/ kha cig na re/ shākya bshes gnyen slob dpon klu sgrub kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin zer/ 'dir rje 'gos kyi gsung las/ srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol 'gyur/ /zhes pa yan slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad nas/ shes rab ngo bo 'di nyid ni man slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis 'phros kha bskangs pa yin zhing / rim lnga'i mjug tu khong pa'i mtshan btab pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /gang ltar yang rim lnga la rgya gar gyis 'grel pa byas pa thams cad kyis khong gi 'di la yang byas pas klu sgrub kyi dngos slob chen po zhig yin par nges so/ /spyir yo ga ba chen po shākya bshes gnyen zer ba zhig byung ste/ des slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyi lung mang po drangs bshad pa byas pas 'di dang mi gcig yang spyod bsdus 'grel byed shākya bshes gnyen bya ba byung / de yang 'di ma yin/ 'grel pa de gtsang hrig pa dga' mo gcig 'dug 'on kyang spyod bsdus kyi 'grel pa 'gos rdog pa rnams kyi bzang ngo / /gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs pa la shākya bshes gnyen gcig byung ste/

de dang yang dus mi mtshungs/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub ni slob dpon klu sgrub i kha ra shing 'phel du gser 'gyur mdzad pa'i dus/ bram ze rgan rgon gnyis yod/ de la sbyin pa byin pas mgu ste/ rgad pos slob dpon gyi nye gnas byas/ de nas shi 'phos te ma he 'tsho ba'i bu gcig tu skyes/ ma he 'tsho ba'i tshe bag chags sad de/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dpal gyi ri la sgrub pa mdzad pa'i/ sgo drung du byon/ grub pa nga skyo sgom ston cig zer/ ma he sgoms kho rang gi ba lang gi khyu'i nang nas ma he dkar po zhig gsungs bsgoms pas shin tu gsal/ yang ji zhig na slob dpon zho rdza gang khyer nas/ slob dpon gyi rtswa'i spyil po'i sgo'i ma tshad na grub pa zhes 'bod par shog byas pas rwa co mi shong zer/ can byung / da nga yi rwa 'di ma bde dmigs pa spos zer/ mdun du mi dkar po thal mo padma khyer gzer/ sbyar ba gcig sgoms gsungs/ bsgoms pas mi dkar po gcig dngos su byung ste/ dngos grub ci 'dod zer ba la/ khyod de ru sdod ngas grub pa la dri yi byas/ dris pas slob dpon gyis mi de thugs rje chen po bya ba yin gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyis la rang gi snying khar thim par sgoms shig gsungs/ khyod rang nga'i snying la zhugs gyis gsungs/ de skad byas pas zhugs pa'i snang ba byung ngo / de ltar jo bos byin gyis brlabs pas rmongs pa'i mun pa bsal to/ /de nas slob dpon gyi drung du rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan klu'i byang chub ces kyang bya/ klu'i blo zhes kyang bya/ klu'i bshes gnyen zhes kyang zer ro/ /der slob dpon gyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug lam bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes so/ /slob dpon des 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bskyed rim ston pa rnam gzhag rim pa/

rdzogs rim ston pa las mtha' rnam 'byed dang / rim pa khong bsdu gnyis 'gos rdog pa la med/ snga ma chag dang / phyi ma pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ gzhan rim lnga'i 'grel pa nor bu'i phreng ba/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel chen 'grel pa don gsal bya ba gsum tsam las klu byang gis mdzad zer ba 'byung ste/ 'di rnams paṇḍi ta phra la ring grong 'jug byas pas zam rong chos bzang du skyes/ khong gis mang po brtsams te gzhan la kha 'phang byas pas khong gi yin nam/ de'i rjes su rong du de lta bu'i kha 'phang byed mkhan mang po byung 'dug pa de rnams kyis byas par nges kyi slob dpon klu byang gis mdzad pa ma yin no/ /mdzad nges shes pa'i sbyin sreg cig yod par 'dug ste bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon legs ldan 'byed dang sangs rgyas bskyang yang dngos slob chen po yin mod/ gsang 'dus 'gos lugs pa la cher ma grags so/ /slob dpon zla ba grags pa ni/ khong bshad nyan mdzad pa'i tshe/ rgya gar na lent+ra na mu stegs dang rtsod pa byed nus pa kun phyi ru chos 'chad/ mi nus pa kun nang du chos 'chad pa las/ slob dpon phyi ru chos 'chad pa'i tshe/ rgya gar lho phyogs nas slob dpon tsaṇḍa go mi byon/ slob dpon gyi chos grwar 'dud pa ma byas par bsdad pas/ chos ci shes dris pas/ sgra dang / sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ mtshan brjod shes byas pas paṇḍi ta chen po yin par go nas phyir bkyed de bsu ba byas/ shing rta gnyis la 'jam dbyangs gcig dang khong gnyis re re bkod/ tsaṇḍa go mis 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa byas pas/ 'jam dbyangs slob dpon la zhal phyir gzigs pas mjing pa yon por song ba la da lta rgya gar na 'jam dbyangs mjing yon du grags so/ /der slob dpon gnyis brtsad pas zla grags lan thogs med du 'debs nus shing / tsaṇḍas thogs bcas nus pa chen po byung / nangs shig khong la spyan ras gzigs kyis dngos su chos ston pa zla bas rgyab nas gzigs/

mdun du byon pas spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku gcig yod pa de la thim song / zla grags kyis nga la zhal ston na ston mdzod/ mi ston na nga 'chi byas pas/ rmi lam du khyod 'jam dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas nga yis zhal ston mi dgos/ tsaṇḍa go mi la ngas ma bstan na gzhan med gsungs/ der zla grags kyis 'phags pa nye ring ma mdzad par zhal ston mdzod zhus pas gzigs gsungs/ gzhan yang ri mo'i ba las 'o ma 'jo ba sogs dang / rdo'i ka ba la phyag bsnun pas thogs pa med par song ba la sogs pa'i yon tan mnga'/ 'dis mtshan nyid kyi phyogs la mngon pa mdzod dang grub mtha' rkang gcig pa'i phung po lnga brtag pa'i rab byed bya ba dang / dbu ma 'jug pa'i rtsa 'grel/ tshig gsal/ bzhi brgya pa rnams kyi 'grel pa dang / rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mdzad do/ /sngags la 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba mdzad cing / zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs bya ba zhig byung pa la/ 'ga' zhig bod ma yin zer te/ gro kha la bris pa'i rgya dpe mthong bas bod kyis byas pa ma yin zhing / zla grags chen po 'dis mdzad pa yang ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan mdor byas kyi bshad pa'i skabs su 'chad/ 'on kyang zla grags bya ba'i paṇḍi ta khyug pa zhig gis byas 'dug go /gsang 'dus kyi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa zhig yod pa rdog pa'i bla ma zhig gis byas nas kha 'phangs pa yin no/ /kha ma 'phangs na bstan bcos dga' mo gcig 'dug go /slob dpon 'di 'gos rdog pa rnams dang / pa tshab dang / chag lo dang / bka' gdam pa dang / bu ston rin po che klu sgrub kyi dngos slob yin zhes theng kyis 'then/ bka' gdams pa dngos slob yin te/ jo bo rjes/ klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyis sa skya paṇḍi ta la zhus pas/

dgongs pa skong ba'i slob ma yin gsungs pas sa paṇa gyi rjes 'brangs rnams dngos slob ma yin par bzhed do/ /bu ston gyis dngos slob yin te/ skye med mdzod las/ slob ma'i tha ma zla grags la/ /chos kyi tha ma skye med bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skye med mdzod klu sgrub kyis ma mdzad/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta zhig gis byas pa yin zhes khong rang gi chos 'byung chen mor bris tshar nas/ yang de'i lung khur nas mi la ngar ngar byas pas ga la 'ong / ri bo dge ldan pas dngos slob yin te/ tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i phyir zer te/ tshe'i rig 'dzin skyes nas brnyes kyi/ ma skyes gong du brnyes dogs med 'jung chung pa la/ 'on kyang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis phyis zhal bstan pa ni srid/ dus kyi dbang du byas na'ang dngos slob tu 'ong sa med/ des na sa skya pa'i dbang bka' gsar pa'i brgyud pa la/ klu sgrub/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu'i byang chub/ zla grags zhes 'byung / byang sems kyi sdom brgyud la/ klu sgrub/ arya de wa/ klu'i bshes gnyen/ zla grags bya ba yod pas/ klu sgrub dang zla grags kyi bar na slob dpon gnyis tsam yod dgos na yang / klu byang tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pas gcig gis chog go /dngos slob yin na tshig gsal las/ bde ba can du rgyal ba'i sras po klu sgrub gshegs par gyur pa des mdzad pa'i/ /gzhung mang dang ni slob ma'i tshogs de dag kyang dus mang zhig na nyams par gyur/ /de nyid nyi ma nub pas ding sang gzhung lugs gsal po de ni da lta gang na'ang med/ /ces pa'i nyen skad de tsam ga la 'ong / gcig nas gcig tu brgyud las 'ongs dang bdag gi rnam phye las brnyed gang / /legs ldan 'byed kyi legs bshad las ni rtsa she'i don brnyed/ ces kyang 'byung ba rnams kyi don la bsams pas dngos slob min par ston no/ /kha cig na re/ dngos slob yin te/ sgron gsal las/

klu sgrub las brnyed ces gzhung 'don te/ sgron gsal las ni klu sgrub man ngag las rim par brnyed ces pa yod do/ /des na lung brdzun byas pa la dgos pa ci yod/ mdor na ston pa gshegs nas lo bzhi brgya nas klu sgrub byon/ dgu brgya nas thogs med byon/ de'i gcung dbyig gnyen/ de'i slob ma phyogs glang / de'i rjes su zla grags byon te/ zla grags kyis gnas brtan chos skyong dang / dbyig gnyen dang / phyogs glang / phyogs snga ma la bzhi pa'i 'grel par bkod pa sogs dus kyi dbang du byas na ma zin pa sa paṇa yang gsungs pa mdzad cing / rje 'gos dang / pa tshab dang / chag lo tsā ba rnams kyi dngos slob tu bshad pa yang / rgyus khong tsho ka che zhing / mar pa'i gsang 'dus mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta'i bshad pa'i rgyud pa la yang dngos slob tu mdzad pas mtha' gcig tu dngos slob ma yin zhes smra ba yang rig pa'i khu byug gi slob ma na su ma ti na re/ zla grags kyis slob dpon klu sgrub lo brgya phyed bsten gsungs zhes pa pa tshab kyi bu slob rnams kyis bris pa yang 'dug go dka' mo rang gda'/ de lta bu'i slob dpon des slob pa'i rdo rje la gnang / des nag po pa la gnang / nag po pa 'di bu ston bde mchog nag po pa yin gsungs te dus mi mtshungs so/ /des dri med blo gros dang / sa 'dres pa la gnang / snga mas ye shes snying po/ des mar pa la gnang / sa 'dres pa la slob ma lnga ste/ mngon shes can/ btsun mo can/ shanti pa/ dpal sbas/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ mngon shes can gyi mtshan la bha ga la'i paṇḍi ta bidya bha dra ste/ rig pa bzang po zer/ btsun mo can gyi mtshan la za hor gyi mkhas pa chen po de wa a rdog nyi ma seṅges ngos kyi bla ma la bidya na dra mngon shes can dang / de wa a ka ra zhes smos pa'i rjes la za hor gyi mkhas pa btsun mo can dang zhes da wa a ka ra dang btsun mo can mi gcig par bshad pa yang yod do/

ka ra shanti ste lha'i 'byung gnas zhi ba zer/ snga mas gsang ba 'dus pa'i gtor chog mdzad/ shanti pas rgyud kyi 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog mdzad de/ ye shes zhabs lugs gtso che/ dpal sbas kyis 'dus pa'i skor mdzad pa ma thos/ 'di'i mar me mdzad de ye shes zhabs lugs pa de yang min/ jo bo rje yin par bu ston bzhed par 'dra ste/ bhri ka ma la shī la'i dhi paṃ ka ra zhes gsan yig tu 'byung yang / 'dir mar me mdzad bzang po zhes pa yod pas mi gcig go /mngon shes can gyi slob ma rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa/ mtshan dngos shrī bha dra bzang po dpal bya ba/ gsang mtshan dam tshig rdo rje zer bas 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs su/ shrī bha dras zhes pa smos/ stong thun chen mor/ rgyal ba'i chos la mnga' brnyes bdag gi bla ma bzang po dpal/ zhes 'byung / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel par nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad ces gsungs/ kha cig tu kṛṣṇa sa mā ya badzra zhes brjod pa'i paṇḍi ta des gsang 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog ma rgyud kyi cho ga gzhir bzhag pa'i 'dus pa'i dkyil chog mdor byas dang / rim lnga'i 'grel pa/ mdo bsre'i 'grel pa mdzad de/ mdo bsre la rgya 'grel 'di las med/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi'i gcig 'di'i lugs yin te/ dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i rtsa rgyud 'grel pa gzhung phran man ngag dang bcas pa bod du dus nam gyi tshe/ gang zag ji lta bus bsgyur cing dar bar byas she na/ sngon chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi ring la gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos mang po 'gyur te/ rtsa ba'i rgyud drug dang / glang chen rab 'bog la sogs pa yan lag gi rgyud bcu gnyis te tant+ra sde bco brgyad ces tha snyad byed kyang / sngar smos pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud drug ni dri ma med pa'i rgyud sde yin la/ gzhan rnams bod kyis rang dgar brtsams pa shas che'o/

/de la thugs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa la slob dpon rdo rje bzhad pa'i 'grel pa shog bu mda' tshad bco brgyad tsam byas pa gcig snang ba des rgyud 'chad mi thub kyang / don bsdus kyi 'grel pa lta bu bzang po zhig 'dug za hor gyi slob dpon bi shwa mu khas byas pa'i 'grel pa le'u bcu bdun pa la tshan pa gnyis su byas/ le'u bco brgyad pa la yang mdzad pa gcig 'dug pa rgya gar gyi yin ni yin/ mchan dkyus shor lta bu lhad cung zad kyang yod do/ /slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa yang yod/ de rnams bstan pa snga dar la byung ste/ rnying ma ba de rnams brgyud pa'i rgyud kyi lung dang dbang sogs ni ding sang med do/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud drug gi gzhan rnams go sla/ karma mā la ding sang bod na de'i dpe ni med/ rgyud rnam par dag pa yin par snang ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus 'grel du/ ji skad du las kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las zhes lung drangs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud de sngon bod du 'gyur ba yin tshod 'dug de ltar rgyud de rnams dar ba'i tshe rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsnubs te sngags pa rnams kyis rgyud kyi tshig tsam sgra ji bzhin du bzung nas sbyor sgrol chos su smra ba sogs chos log cher byung ngo / /de nas chos rgyal chen po lha bla ma ye shes bod kyis skyes bu dam pa rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs/ mdo rgyud mkhas par bslabs nas paṇḍi ta shrardha karma warma la sogs pa mang du gdan drangs/ rgyud 'grel mang po bsgyur pa'i tshe gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud 'grel chen sgron gsal dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ rim lnga/ spyod bsdus rnams bsgyur/ khyad par lo tsā ba'i thugs dam gyi mthil rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin pas gtso cher ye shes zhabs lugs la thugs dam mdzad/ de'i bstan pa shin tu dar bar byung ste lo chen nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' ding sang gi bar du yang yod do/

/gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi ni rgyud gzhung rnams bsgyur pa tsam las gtso bor 'chad nyan ma mdzad/ de'i sku tshe'i sked tsam la 'brog mi lo tsā ba byon ma rgyud kyi 'grel mang po bsgyur cing bstan pa yang ches gsal bar byas/ de'i drung du rje 'gos kyis sgra dang / gzhung phran tshogs mang du bslabs/ khyed la ma rgyud kyi gdams ngag zab la mang bar gda' bas bdag la gnang bar zhu byas pas/ gser khyer la shog gsungs/ yul du phyin zhing rnams btsongs pas gser mang po byung gser 'bul dgos pa mnyam po la rgya gar la phyin na dga' zhes sa skya pa rnams zer ro/ /'brog mi'i drung nas 'gro khar bla ma'i bid par ta'i dpe brkus te byon/ phyis 'gos la mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying pos chos gsan du byon pa'i tshe/ 'brog mis 'gos ngan pa nga'i bid par ta brku ba la chos nyan pa/ khyod la dam tshig med zer ba'i 'phrin gnang ste/ mnga' ris pas bshags pa phul zer/ 'chad lugs gcig la khong 'khrungs yul rta nag pa gdung rus blon po 'gos kyi brgyud pa yin pas 'gos/ lcam sring gnyis 'dus pa'i bu yin pas khug pa/ de nas rta nag phu yi lhas ra zhig tu btsar phyin pas lhas btsas/ cher skyes nas 'ug pa lung du zur pa la rnying ma slob tu btang pas rnying ma ba rnams khong la sdang bar byung pas ngas rgya gar du phyin la chos shig bslabs la khyed la cig bya yi zer/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer dang 'grogs te rgya gar du byon/ de dus mkhas pa sgo drug ni grongs tshar nas mi 'dug pas/ gsang 'dus slob dgongs/ su mkhas dris pas sa 'dres pa'i slob ma rnams drag zer/ shanti pa dang dpal sbas ni mi bzhugs/ gzhan mngon shes can dang btsun mo can rnams la gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams zhus bod du byon/ de tsam na mdo khams nas khams pa mar ston seng rgyal bya ba nor chen po yod pa gcig gtsang du byon/ 'jad kyi lung pa stong pa yod pa der bsdad tsa na 'gos dang mjal chos zhus/

nor mang po phul nas rgya gar du brdzangs/ de'i res la mngon shes can gyi grwa pa nag po dam tshig rdo rje la 'dus pa'i bshad pa rgya chen po dang / phyag len phra mo tshun chad la mkhas par bslabs/ de ltar rgyud gsungs dus bla ma de gsum gyi gsung bgros spyi dang bye brag so sor ma 'dres par bris pa rgyud kyi mchan chen po khyad par du 'phags pa dang rim lnga'i khrid so so la zhus pa la yang shog ril so sor byas pas shog ril gsum mdzad/ gzhan paṇḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can la yang chos mang du gsan te/ 'di paṇa chen ga ya dha ra dang yang gcig ste/ 'gos 'gyur kha cig tu paṇḍi ta sprin gyi rgya gar shar phyogs kyi ko sa la'i rgyal bu/ shugs can ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas zhes bshad/ lo chen rin bzang gis dbang sngon ma rang zhus pa kha che khri brtan gyi paṇḍi ta tsaṇḍa ha ri la yang chos zhus/ 'di bya spyod la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin par 'dug cing / khong gi grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam gzhag ston pa rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa las mngon rtogs ljon shing du lung drangs yong / gzhan yang bal yul rdzong gi na ga ko ṭa'i zhes kyang zer/ zhi ba bzang po bya ba dang / bal po mthil gyi rtsa ha ngu rgyal po'i khab kyi mkhas pa chen po dza hu shri ka ma la shī la'i thams cad mkhyen par grags pa dī paṃ ka ra/ sa ra ha la sogs pa'i paṇḍi ta bdun cu/ mkha' 'gro ma gnyis ste mkhas pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis la mdo rgyud man ngag mang du nos shing / rgya gar shar nub thams cad bskor bas paṇḍi ta skad sna mang ba rnams kyis kyang skad sna bdun brgyad las mi shes pa la/ rje 'gos kyis rgya gar shar nub kyi skad sna mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis mkhyen/ lo chen rin bzang gi 'gyur yod pa rnams la 'gyur bcos ma mdzad sgron gsal la dbyar khral cung zad bgyis zer ba'i sgron gsal dbyar khral ma bya ba la ding sang rtsis che bar byed do/

/bod du byon te rtsa bshad lnga'i nyams len mngon par rtogs pa stong thun chen mo zhes bya ba dang / rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel sgron gsal gzhir bzhag pa la/ bla ma mngon shes can/ btsun mo can/ rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa gsum po'i bshad srol thun mong ba dang / nang gses mi 'dra ba so sor ma 'dres par rtsa rgyud kyi steng du mchan du bkod pa/ 'dus pa'i mchan chen zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos khyad par can mdzad/ gzhan yang khong pa bla ma bsam pa bzang po zhig yin par 'dug pas/ man ngag thams cad yi ger bkod bshad nyan la rtsal bton pas rgyud kyi ka ba tshugs pa bzhi/ man ngag gi gdung chen theg pa bzhi/ las tshogs dang 'phrin las la mkhas pa slob ma zhig gis lha ma yin thag bzang ris kyi bu mo rig ma la bkug pa'i lo rgyus yod do gsungs/ lcam dang bral ma gshibs pa lta bu shin tu mang bar byung ngo / /ka chen bzhi ni/ brlan grags dbang / mang ra ba seṅge rgyal mtshan/ sum ston ye 'bar/ mi nyag dharma tsant+ra'o/ /gdung bzhi ni/ rngog dge ser ba/ dbus pa dga' 'bum/ lho rdo rje snying po/ snyal gyi bro gnye ba mgar chung chos kyi shes rab dang bzhi'o/ /ka chen bzhi'i nang nas bgres shos brlan grags dbang yin te/ chos ni mahā ya ma las gzhan tsam mi shes pa yin gsungs/ de la mang ra ba la sogs pa bu tsha/ gzhon pa rnams kyis rgan pa rnams la lha phyag kyang gsum gsum 'bul skad/ dge bshes mang ra ba ni bu tsho rnams kyi nang nas bla ma la zhabs tog che zhing shes rab kyang shin tu che bas 'phags pa yab sras kyi chos dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma kho na'i gdams ngag la mkhas/ sgron gsal gyi ka chen la sogs pa yig sna du ma mdzad/ khong rdog gi tsha bo yin te/ yum rdog gi dge tshe ma/ yab mang ra ban chen bya ba yin khong gis bla ma la gser g.yu la sogs pa'i nor mang po phul cing / khyad par gnag khyu chen po yod pa thams cad zho dong dang sbra khyi tshun chad cam me phul/

yab kyis 'o skol lha g.yag 'di ma 'bul byas pas/ khong na re/ bla ma la 'bul ba la lha g.yag bya ba gang na yod/ bla ma nyid lha yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar rje'i thugs zin nas 'phags skor gyi gdams ngag thams cad lhag ma lus pa mkhyen no/ /de la shes rab rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ brang ti rgya pe la sogs pa'i bu slob mang po bzhugs kyang / rngog chen po ye shes seṅge zhes bya bas khams nas 'jad du byon/ khong mang ra'i zhang po yin pas nga'i zhang po yin gsungs shing thugs rtsis chen mo mdzad de/ rgyud gdam ngag ma lus pa tshar bar yin skad/ rngog shes rab che bas bla mas gsungs pa'i chos la mi zin mi srid/ zin pa thams cad la ngas yi ger ma byas pa med gsungs skad/ khyad par rje 'gos kyi stong thun las/ mngon shes can gyi lugs zur du byung ba stong thun 'bring rim lnga'i sgron me/ po mdzad/ de'i sku gsung thugs kyi sras rdog nyi ma seṅges dzambha la 'grub pas longs spyod shin tu che zhing / ma rgyud mahā ma ya gcig mkhyen/ pha rgyud la shin tu mkhas pas slob ma mang du 'dus/ sku btsun par byed cing na bza' yang lus la snal 'phri ma myong par gso dar 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pas rdog shākya mu ne zhes grags/ des de dus yan la 'gyur ba'i 'phags lugs kyi gzhung rnams la sa bcad dang ṭīkka mdzad/ khyad par rgyud kyi stong thun shog bu mda' tshad ma bcu tsam byas pa'i stong thun chung ba bya ba dang / sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad mdzad pa la sgron ye shes seṅge'i yig cha rnams sa skya sgo bsrung na dpe 'dug dar rgyu med nyi ma seṅge'i tshe shin tu dar zhing legs pa yang yod/ chung ming bdud rtsi tshim byed/ du grags/ zur du sras gcig byung pa sku btsun pa'i grags pa ches pas mis ma tshor bar byas mdo smad du bskyal to/ /mdor na brag stag gi rdog nyi ma seṅge la mu ner grags pa des bres chu bar gyi brlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam can du byon zer/

der phyin pas 'dus pa rdzogs par gnang / bla ma 'dis sngar gyi bla ma gong ma'i 'grel pa dkyus su bcug sngon dus rdog pa yab sras kyi gsung bgros la slob ma rnams kyis zin bris su byas pa stod 'bum smad 'bum bya ba'i stod smad la po ti re re ste po ti gnyis yod pa zhig nas gsung bgros rgyas par bsnan pa'i 'grel bshad de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i ṭikka gcig bo dong se bsgom gyis kyang mdzad/ sgron chen zhes bya ba mdzad/ gsang 'dus la mkhas pa'i grags pa chen thob ste/ rdog arya de wa zhes ya ra la wa tshul bzhir bshad pa zhes pa yang mdzad/ grags/ des sa skyar chos rje sa paṇa gyi sku drung du byon te sa skya pa'i chos lugs kyang mang po gsan/ khong pas kyang sa skyar 'dus pa la sogs pa'i 'chad nyan mdzad/ sa skyar 'byon pa la sa thag ring pas lam stegs la bya ru gzhung sa paṇa gyis gnang / des na sa paṇa gyi slob ma zhang bya ru ba zhes grags/ sa paṇa gyi gsung la zin bris mdzad pa yang gzhal yas khang gi tshad la sogs pa du ma yod do/ /de gong du 'gos rdog pa rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog re ma gtogs dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod rgyas par byed pa'i srol med pa la khong gis sa skya pa lag len bde ba mig shugs khyer nas 'dus pa'i bsgrub mchod btsugs/ dkyil chog mchod phreng sogs bstan bcos mang po mdzad do/ /'gos rdog gi bla ma gong ma rnams sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa rgyun du mdzad pas bskyed rim bsgom tshul de'i zhar la 'ong / rim lnga'i khrid rgyun du bsgom zhing / dbang bskur ba'i tshe dkyil chog gi rgya gzhung dang stong thun la brten pa ma gtogs bod kyi mngon dkyil brtsams pa yang med cing mang po tshogs nas bsgrub mchod kyang mdzad do/ /de la skyin khar mjug gro kha dben tshe'i brtag pa rin chen grags dang / rong lha steng gi gtsang smra seng dang /

cha dkar mon mo brag gi mi nyag rdo rje grags gsum gyis gsan/ yang rdog nyi ma seṅge dang / brlan btsad tsha yab sras gnyis ka la snye mo zhu'i phug ka ba phug ston shes rab 'bum skyabs zer/ grags kyis gsan/ de la yang mi nyag rdo rje grags dang / gtsang smra seng gnyis kyis zhus/ de gnyis ka la nyang stod srib chung gi lce ston mdo sde seṅges zhus/ yang brlan rtsad tsha la rgyang mkhar thang dpe ba'i mkhan po 'phags pa skyabs kyis zhus/ de la gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od kyis gsan/ brtag pa rin chen grags kyis rdog arya de wa'i zhar chos pa yang mdzad cing / de dang lce ston mdo sde seṅge dang / gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od gsum ka la kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis gsan/ de la kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtshos gsan/ de la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub kyis gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes pas 'dus pa'i bdag por gyur cing / gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos 'byung / sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad/ sgrub dkyil la sogs pa'i yig cha mang du mdzad do/ /de'i sras kyi thu bo dam pa mkhas grub khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa zhig gi drung du/ bdag gi bla ma chos kyi rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos nye bar bsten te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel chen 'grel bshad 'dus pa la sogs pa mtha' dag bum pa gang byor bzhugs pa/ mtha' drug rab gsal/ dbang bka' brgyud pa mang po'i bka' babs phyogs gcig tu dril ba dang / sgrub thabs dang rgya gzhung mang po'i bshad pa rim lnga'i bsgom khrid dang bcas pa rgya cher gsan cing / de'i zhabs drung du nged kyis rgyud 'grel tshar gsum nyan cing / dbang bka' dang sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa sogs mang du zhus pa yin no/ /rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid kyi brgyud pa brlan btsad tsha yan sngar bzhin la/ mkhan po 'phags pa skyabs/

gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston rin po che/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī pa'i drung du nged kyis zhus/ dbang bka' 'gos nas rdog pa yab sras la brgyud pa'i tshul rgyud kyi bshad pa ji lta brlan tsad tsha dang 'phags pa skyabs kyi bar du arya de wa zhugs/ ba bzhin yin la/ sa lugs kyi dbang bka' rnying pa zhes grags pa rje 'gos kyi gdung bzhi'i dbus pa rngog dges bshes ser po/ gnam kha'ub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ bsod rtse mi 'byung bar kha'ub pa'i rdo rje bdud 'joms bya ba yang 'byung / chos rje khu dbon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de la nged kyis thob pa la re ba brtson 'grus byas te/ bla ma gshegs pas ring nas ma thob/ grub chen buddha shrī pa la zhus/ sa lugs kyi dbang bka' gsar pa'i brgyud pa zla grags nas sa rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par bzod pa'i lha/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa skya paṇa chen man rnying pa ltar ram/ yang na sa paṇa/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'ub pa dar she se mo ra sa rin chen dpal/ bla ma ra gnyis pa rin rgyal/ spru lung kun smon/ bla ma grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od man chad bshad bka' dang 'dra ba las/ chos kyi rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du thob/ dbang bka' rnying pa'i dkyil chog rdog arya de wa dang / rog tshe dbang grags kyis byas pa yod/ gsar pa la 'phags pa rin po che dang / bu ston pa'i dkyil chog yod do/ /dbang bka' rnying pa'i dbang bka' zhig thob pas/ brgyud pa sa lugs dang / rdog lugs gnyis ka la ded pas chog ste dbang chog gcig gis byas pa'i phyir ro/ /man ngag shog dril gsum nged kyis chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa la buddha shrī la yang zhus/

zhus/ des de gnyis kas/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa la zhus/ des bo dong pa nam mkha' dpal bya ba'i gsang 'dus pa gcig la zhus/ de stong thun chen mo buddha shrī la gsan gsungs/ rgya gzhung phran du ma bkras rin pa la yang gsan/ yan chad ma chod/ de dag gis ni gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs 'gos las byung tshul mdor bsdus te bshad zin pa yin/ gzhan yang gsang 'dus mar lugs su grags pa'i bka' srol chen po byung ste/ rje mar pa lo tsā bas dbus kyi lho brag nas rim gyi mu gu lung du bla chen 'brog mi'i drung du sgra mkhas shing skad byang bar bslabs/ sngags kyang cung zad zhus/ zhabs drung du lo gcig bzhugs pa la rgyud dang gdams ngag ye ma gnang nas lho bal du lo tsā ba gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs byung pa bla mas dgongs te/ 'brog bla chen gyis zhal nas/ lo tsā ni mkhas par khyod rang gis shes/ da rgyud dang gdams ngag zhu ba la khyod kyi sngar gyi zhabs tog gis cung mi yong bas yang na yul du song la rgyags thub pa longs la shog yang na khyod rang gis phul ba'i rta 'di yang phar phyin gyis gser du tshongs la bal po tsam du chos zhu ba la dka' las ci 'dug tshod blta ba la song dang / de nas gdod nga la yang gus pa drin du gzo ba zhig yong ste mchi gsungs/ der bla ma mar pas sngar khong rang phul ba'i rta nag po seṅge kha gdangs zhes bya ba de slar zhus nas/ bzab chen bubs gcig seng ldeng gi rta sga gcig dang gsum stag ris su 'tshong du phyin pa las gser srang nyi shu khugs nas/ dge bshes klog kya chen pos grogs mdzad de rim gyis rgya gar du byon snga ma res la lo bcu gnyis bzhugs pa yin/ mar pa'i gsung las/ kho bo mar pa lo tsā 'di/ /skye sa lho brag gting du skyes/ /bag chags mang mkhar gyi phyogs su sad/ /dpal mu gu lung gi dgon pa ru/ /sgra bsgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la/ /sgra thang klog skad kyi yig tshang bslabs/

/khong sku drin mi chung che bar 'khums/ /zhes gsungs/ phyir rgya gar du lan gsum/ bal por lan bzhi ste bdun/ shar nub/ lho byang / kha che/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta dang / ku sa lar grags tshad bla ma brgya rtsa/ brgyud pa 'dzin nges lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum bzhugs te/ gsung mgur las/ chos smon lam gyi 'brel pa bcu gsum bzhugs/ /khyad par grub thob zhal lnga bal po spyi ther ba/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba bzang po/ gha gha/ mai tri ba/ nā ro paṇa chen dang lnga'o/ bzhugs/ /rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis bzhugs/ /gtso bo dpal chen nā ro pa/ /de 'og rgyal sras mai tri pa/ /zhes pa dang / yang / zhabs pad spyi bor reg mdzad cing / /gsung don bdud rtsi'i rjes gnang pa/ /chos 'brel tsam gyi bla ma mang / /dpal siṅga gling pas sna drangs pa/ /snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i bla ma bdun gyi nang nas/ 'dus pa'i dbang dang rim lnga dmar khrid/ rgyud kyi bshad pa hril tsam dpal nā ro pa la nos shing / khyad par nub gu la kṣe tra'i gtsug lag khang du gnas pa dpal ye shes snying po las 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud gdam ngag 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bka' babs te/ nub gu la kṣe tra'i grong khyer du/ dpal ye shes snying po'i zhabs la btud/ /pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa nyan/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi gdam ngag thob/ /lam rim pa lnga yi don la bslabs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rim lnga'i dmar khrid yod pa la a cang che ste/ ma gtogs pa'i/ /rdzogs rim brgya dang brgya rtsa shes/ /che na ngo mtshar de che mod/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rim lnga'i khrid dang / rgyud rkyang mar lugs grub thob nyams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / int+ra bhu ti/ ḍa ki bde ba'i zhabs/ ḍombhi he ru ka rdo rje dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ kam bha la pa/ nag po spyod pa ba/ ti lo pa/

nā ro pa/ des mar pa la gdams/ yang klu sgrub kyis ma taṃ ki pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ dbang bka'i brgyud pa/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub nas mar pa ma taṃ ti lo nā ro/ yan 'dra ba las gsan cing / mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i brgyud pa rtsa rgyud bshad pa'i rgyud bzhi/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa ni/ brgyud lugs gnyis te/ klu sgrub kyi sras bzhi/ nye ba'i sras gsum ste bdun ni/ sgrol ma zhal gzigs na ga bho ti/ sa brgyad non pa arya de wa/ spyan ras gzigs zhal mthong ba ma taṃ ki pa/ 'jam dpal zhal gzigs pa shākya bshes gnyen/ nye ba'i sras gsum ni/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ dpa' bo dang gsum mo/ /de la ma taṃ ki pas rig pa'i khu byug a wa dhu ti pa/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ nag po zhabs/ dri med blo gros/ dpal ye shes snying po/ des mar pa la gdams/ brgyud lugs gnyis pa rtsa rgyud 'grel pa sgron gsal dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag rdor/ int+ra bhu ti/ klu'i rnal 'byor ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ zla grags/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ nag po pa/ dri med blo gros/ dpal ye shes snying pos mar pa la gdams te/ mar pa la 'phags skor gyi rgyud dang 'grel pa/ rgyud rkyang bshad rgyud bzhi phran dang bcas pa dang / ye shes zhabs lugs kyi yang dza ya na/ tha ga na/ snyim pa'i me tog gsum yod gsungs/ de lta bu'i rje mar pa lo tsā ba/ rngog gzhung pa chen po la sogs pa'i bu chen rnams las/ 'dus pa'i dbang lung / bshad pa dang / khrid bka'/ sngon gyi dus su gang zag so so las brgyud pa byung snang mod/ phyis bu ston rin po ches gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po de la dbang dang rgyud 'grel/ gdams pa'i bka' babs shing ding sang yan du bzhugs pa las/ dol gyi tshur ston dbang gi rdo rje la rgyud rkyang pa dang / dbang gdams par bcas pa'i bka' babs pas/
