des 'khon gad pa kirti/ des mi nyag thur la ba/ dbus pa mgar dga'/ grub thob zhang zhung pa/ de thugs sras gsum las/ zhang zhung pa chos kyi dbang phyug des rgya pho ba lung pa zhes pa yod do/ /de gsum ka la gang bar gser kha'i rin chen gling pa tshul khrims mdzes kyis zhus/ des rgya rnal 'byor pho ba lung pa la gdams te/ 'dis rim lnga bsdus gsal/ 'grel pa sogs mar lugs kyi yig cha mang du mdzad/ des dge slong chos grags bzang po/ bla ma shāka gzhon/ bla ma blo ldan/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ de la bu ston rin po ches mar pas mdzad pa'i spyi don khog phub/ nā ro pas mdzad pa'i rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa rnams gsan/ yang sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / byang sems blo gros rin chen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub snying po/ mtshan gsang ba ma taṃ ki pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ tshur ston dbang / mkhon gad pa kirti/ mkhan po byang khang pa bsod rin/ mkhan po thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ mkhan po thang dpe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ grub thob gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od/ bla ma 'di la mar 'gos gnyis ka'i gdams pa thams cad kyi bka' babs pas zhal pho yang che ste/ deng sang gsang 'dus mar lugs/ 'gos lugs gnyis kyi gdam ngag 'dod pa tsho nga can shog zer/ de'i nang nas mar lugs la thugs rtsis shin tu che ste/ spyir mar pas rim lnga'i don bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa'i man ngag bla ma'i zhal las rtogs par bya ba zhes pa yi ger bkod/ de'i mtshan bsdus na/ rim lnga bsdus gsal zhes zer zhing / rgya pho ba lung pa dpon slob rnams rim lnga rdo rje'i tshig sbram zhes gsungs so/ /de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yig cha bzang po yin zhing / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim pa lnga pa zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇḍi ta nā ro pas mdzad nas/ mar pas pu la ha rir bsgyur ces pa 'byung ba'i dpe rim lnga bsdus gsal gsum 'dab tsam zhig 'byung ba 'di yang /

rim lnga gdan rdzogs bya ba khyad par du 'phags pa yin/ rang re'i 'di na man ngag dge sdings su kun mkhyen 'phags pas phyag ris mdzad pa'i dpe cha dngos su yod/ de rnams la deng sang gser sding pa mkhas tshod du 'dug khong gi lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi po ti chen po 'byung ba/ de'i sgom pa'i skabs su rim lnga mar lugs bris/ gzhan yang nā ro chos drug dang rim lnga bsres pa'i rim lnga nag khrid du grags pa'i yig cha chang chung mang po gcig tu bsdoms nas lam 'bras glegs bam tsam 'byung / kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyi gsan yig tu/ nā ro chos drug dang rim lnga bsres pa nag khrid du grags pa'i lung thob/ ces 'byung ngo / /rnam pa gcig tu na nā ro chos drug tu yang / sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gsang 'dus nas phar 'byon par gda' bas bsres pa rang min nam/ bsres na yang cher mi 'gal lam snyam/ gang ltar yang nag khrid du grags pa la bskyed rdzogs gnyis gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa lam rtags dang 'brel pa'i gdam ngag don lnga ma dang / don bzhi ma/ rim lnga gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i man ngag 'khor lo can dang / 'khor lo med pa dang / srog rtsol la brten nas gtum mo bsgom pa lam rim lnga dang sbyar ba/ rim lnga sems dpa' gsum brtseg gi gdam ngag 'khor ba 'jug ldog la brten nas ma rig pa rtsad nas bcad pa'i gdam ngag skye 'chi gnyis la brten nas grong 'pho 'jug gis le lo can 'chi khar sangs rgya ba'i gdam ngag mnyam gzhag sgyu ma/ rmi lam sgyu ma/ bar do sgyu ma gsum gyi man ngag sku gsum gyi 'pho ba/ btsan thabs su 'pho ba/ chags can 'og sgo la brten nas bde ba lam du blang ba bsre ba drug pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gseng lam/ sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag mgrin par rmi lam la brten nas sgyu ma btsan thabs su bzung ba'i man ngag snying khar mi shigs pa'i thig le la brten nas ma rig pa rtsad nas bcad pa'i gdam ngag

rim lnga gcig car bar/ gsang ba thugs kyi rim lnga/ dkyil 'khor nyid nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul gtan la dbab pa/ pha rgyud yang snying / ma rgyud yang snying zhes bya ba la sogs pa yod cing / gzhan yang gser sding pas 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs sogs yig cha mang du mdzad cing / bshad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ de'i spyan sngar kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis zhus/ des kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho la gdams te/ dam pa de nyid thog ma nyid nas bod na bzhugs tshad kyi bka' lung gsan thub pa zhig gi 'phen pa btang nas yi ge dang / lha ris shin tu mkhas pa cig bslabs te/ des bla ma rnams kyi zhabs tog dang / rang gi 'tsho ba mdzad nas de'i dus kyi bla ma bzang dgu thams cad las bka' lung man ngag bgrang ba las 'das pa gsan la/ khyad par gsang 'dus la dbang rang yang brgyud lugs mi gcig pa mang du gsan cing / rgyud 'grel gzhung phran dang bcas pa la mar 'gos sogs kyi bshad srol mi 'dra ba mang po dang / rim lnga'i khrid kyang / 'gos lugs dang / mar lugs kyi bsdus gsal dang / gdan rdzogs sogs dang / nag khrid du grags pa rnams dang / yi ge med pa'i rim lnga dmar khrid kyi gdams pa rnams gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes pas nyams rtogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ dmar khrid la bla ma don ri grags chen gyi zhal nas/ nga na so rgas pas tshig don zin dka' bas yi ger 'khod gsungs pa'i bka' ma chogs par khrid yig gson tsam gcig mdzad/ jo 'tsho ba byang chub rdo rjes zhus pa'i ngor yu mo khugs zhes bya ba dmar khrid kyi ngo sprod cig kyang mdzad do/ /dam pa de zha lur bu ston rin po ches spyan drangs te/ bla mas gang zag so so la lugs so so'i dbang bka' so sor gsan pa'i phyag len phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i dbang bka' rgyas pa zhig mdzad de/ snying nas 'dus pa slob na sngon la rim lnga dgos gsungs khrid phog

de'i rjes su rgyud 'grel gzhung 'grel/ gdams pa sna tshogs dang bcas te bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ste/ rje des kyang thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis gtan la phab ste/ phyag len dang bshad pa'i rtsom rab tu mang po dang / dmar khrid kyi yi ge kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyis mdzad pa khongs su bcug pa'i khrid yig chen mo mdzad de/ bstan pa spyi dang khyad par gsang 'dus dar rgyas su mdzad do/ /de nas bzung ste gsang 'dus kyi dbang bka' rgyas pa gcig la brgyud pa so sor 'dod pa 'di byung / 'gos rdog gi lugs dang / sa skya pa'i dbang bka' rnying pa la gcig gis chog sa lugs gsar pa dang / chag lugs dang / mar lugs sogs la phyag len mi 'dra ba chen po 'dug pas sa skya pa'i kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi ltar so sor byung na gtsang shas che ba gda' ste/ da zha lu pas gcig tu bsres 'dug pas dgag bsgrub drags na dbang bka' gcig kyang med pa byung dogs 'dug tsa na rang re'i thob yig tu yang zha lu pa'i lugs ltar/ dbang gcig la brgyud pa so sor 'dod pa ka byas yod de/ bar skabs nas gsang 'dus kyi dbang bskur ma thob pa la rim lnga 'bogs pa'i srol gcig byung ste/ dbang med pa'i khrid de yang 'ol le ba yin no/ /mar lugs kyi dbang bka' rkyang pa'i brgyud pa khon gad pa kirti nas/ yar lung / zur dgon pa mgar ston sher rgyal/ gnyan rtse ang phug pa sprul sku rin chen seṅge / go lung pa ye shes rgyal/ rong ston mkhan po/ byang chub zung / gshong blo brtan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ de la bu ston pas zhus/ yang ang phug pa rin seng ges/ rong pa sher seng / ston mo lung pa ye shes 'bar/ chos sku/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ des bu ston rin po che/ rgyud kyi bshad pa dang / dbang brgyud khyung lhas pa la brgyud de chos rje shar pa las thos pa dang / bsdus gsal dang / gdan rdzogs dang /

nag khrid kyi lung dang / dmar khrid kyang dpal ldan pa la brgyud de/ rje buddha shrī la zhus la/ der ma zad mkhan chen dharmā shrī dang / lo tsā ba byang rtse'i zin bris kyang buddha ba la thos te/ mdor na mar lugs rnams kyang ding sang tshang bar bzhugs pa yin no/ /jo bo rje'i lugs kyi dbang dang rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa/ rdo rje 'chang / int+ra bhu ti/ nā ga jo gi bram ze sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ zla grags/ ku su lu che chung / jo bo rje/ rong pa mgar dge ba/ lha rje la bstod pa tshul khrims shes rab/ de'i sras che ba shes rab rgyal po/ chung ba gtsang bsgom shes rab gtsug tor/ che ba'i sras lha rje chos 'khor/ thang stod chos kyi 'od/ klokya grags pa dpal/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan grags pa dpal/ dger phu ba bsgom ye/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od pas grags pa dpal la dbang dang gzhung phran tsam nos shing / bsgom ye las rgyud 'grel phran bcas rdzogs par gsan nas bu ston la gdams/ de man chad khyung chen pa nas sngar ltar ro/ /jo bo'i lugs kyi rim lnga gcig sngon yang byung / bar skabs su yang dar mod/ ding sang chad nas med do/ /chag lugs kyi rgyud 'grel dbang dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub nas sras kyi gtso bo shākya bshes gnyen/ arya de wa/ klu'i byang chub/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa bzhi la gnang / arya de bas 'phags pa rta dbyangs/ de nas rol pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza landha ri pa/ dpe med dpal/ gaṃ bhi ra ma ti/ niska laṃ ka de wa/ rai want+rai bha dra/ chag sgra bsgyur pa chos rje dpal/ yang klu'i byang chub kyis ḍombhi pa/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ghaṃ bhi ra ma ti man 'dra/ yang dpal ldan zla ba grags pas rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par grags pa'i lha/ bzod pa'i lha dang gcig la/

snyog med lha/ rai want+rai bha dra/ chag lo tsā ba/ 'u yug pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ don ri grags chen/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od man chad sngar ltar ro/ /bla ma chag lo 'dis dbang chog chag los mdzad pa'i dkyil chog las dbang bka' gcig la klu sgrub kyi dkyil mchog ltar na 'di ltar 'dod/ klu byang gi ltar na 'di ltar byed ces 'byung / 'gos rdog gi lugs bzhin mdzad/ brgyud pa bal po'i bla ma la 'dod par mdzad de/ bal po re went+ra dang / 'gos kyi dbang chog cig de ye rang mi gcig gam/ khong de ltar du mdzad/ chag lo'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyis sa skyar 'dus pa'i bshad nyan yun ring du byas pas rang re bla brang shar pa'i dpe tshan rnams kyi khrod la chag los mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi sa bcad dang ṭīkka sogs shin tu mang / ding sang yang chag lo nas brgyud pa'i gsang 'dus kyi dbang dang bshad pa bla ma thang po che pa rnams la yod/ rang re'i chos rje g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal ba dang / chos rje rong chen pa dpon slob gnyis kyis kyang gsang 'dus thang po che ba la zhus pa yin no/ /mdor na brgyud lugs mang po nas kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la bka' lung byung snang ba/ bu rin po che nas rang re'i bar du yod pas rgyud dang 'grel pa ngo bo'i lung bshad tsam gang gi lugs ltar byas kyang 'ong mod de/ de dag gi nang nas rgyud kyi bshad pa bying che la 'grel pa dang mthun pa/ mngon shes can/btsun mo can/ nag po pa gsum gyi man ngag rab tu mang pos brgyan pa 'gos lugs ston par byed/ ston tshul yang bu ston pa'i ṭīka chen 'di gsal zhing sa bcad legs la/ gleng gzhi sbas don gyi sgra sgrub dgos pa rnams khong pa sgra mkhas pas nan tar legs par thon yod pas 'di gzhir bzhag 'dir 'gos lugs kyi gdam ngag ma tshang ba dang / mi gsal ba dang / cung zad mi mthun pa yod pa rnams rje 'gos nyid kyi mchan chen mo la nged kyis 'phral du gtugs te ston pa yin no/

/brgyud pa'i rim pa bar ma chad pa 'di shin tu gal che ste/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar/ phan tshun brgyud pa'i rim pa yi/ /bla ma bzang pos zhal las shes/ /zhes gsungs shing thogs med kyi gzhi bsdu bar/ slob dpon dang slob ma gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de 'ong pas lung zhes bya zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na rang bzo dang rtog btags spangs te/ rgyud rim dang bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun la rtsis che bar byed pa yang gnad kyi don yin no/ /spyir du bla med kyi rgyud 'grel go ba la bskyed rdzogs kyi brda chad legs por chags dgos pas/ ding sang chos thun gcig la bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dang / rim lnga'i khrid 'chad par byed de yang 'dus pa gzhung phyis phran nas slob bya ba yin gsungs/ phran gyi 'chad bya ba yin pas/ bskyed rim gyi sgrub thabs ston pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mdor byas/ de rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ba man bsre/ bskyed rim gyi dka' ba'i gnas 'grol ba klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim pa/ mdor byas kyi yan lag tu nag po pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog mngon shes can gyi gtor chog rnams 'chad cing / rdzogs rim la 'phags pa'i rim lnga nyid dang / de'i sems dben gyi skabs su 'phags pa lha'i sems kyi sgrib sbyong / klu byang gi las mtha' rnam 'byed/ sgyu lus kyi skabs su 'phags pa lha'i bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/ 'od gsal gyi skabs su 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi byang chub sems 'grel/ 'phags pa lha'i mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa/ rim lnga spyi la phan pa la rim lnga khongs su bsdu ba klu byang gis mdzad pa/ sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi lam rim rnams kyang ci nus su 'chad la/ khyad par lam mtha' dag gi gzhung shing dang / rdzogs rim gyi spyi khog spyod pa gsum dang bcas pa rgyas la gsal bar ston pa slob dpon 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus sgron me rnams rim gyis ston pa lags/

de dag gis ni rgyud 'grel 'chad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba spyi'i rnam gzhag dang byung tshul bstan zin pa yin/ dngos gzhi'i rgyud 'grel nyid sang dgong nas mdzad par zhu ste zla ba gsum tsam dgos so zhes gsungs so/ /phyag na rdo rje klu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /bi su kalpa grub chen sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub yab sras shākya bshes gnyen dang arya de wa/ klu byang zla ba grags/ /slob pa'i rdo rje nag po sa 'dres pa/ /paṇa chen mngon shes can dang btsun mo can/ /dam tshig rdo rjes 'phags yul snang bar mdzad/ /bod 'dir sgra bsgyur 'gos kyis gsal byas te/ /mang ra seng rgyal rdog chen ye shes seng / /nyi ro'i phrag seng nyi brlan btsad tsha/ ma seng dang <!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>ston arya de wa/ /rin grags gtsang / smra seng mi nyag rdor grags lho ston mdo sde/ mdo sde seng / phug ston3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>/'bum skyabs rgya mkhar thang dpe ba <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>'phags pa skyabs dang rgyang rong gser sding ba/ gzhon nu 'od/ /kun bar skabs kyi brgyud pa gyes pa/ 'dus chos sku <!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>man ngag la/ 'od zer 'phags pa 'od/ /bu zha lu/ ston sras mchog 'khyung bar pa/ gzhon nu bsod nams las/ /dpal ldan sa skya shar pa/ bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal/ /de las kun mkhyen kun dga'/ bzang pos lan gsum gsan/ /thos bsam bsgom pas myong mdzad rgyud 'grel che/ /zhing 'dir gdul bya'i tshogs la gsungs pa'i tshe/ /rgyud 'grel byung zhing 'chad tshul rnam gzhag 'di/ /rang nyid blo yi dran pa gso phyir dang / /skal mnyam gzhan la'ang phan par bya ba'i phyir/ /dad can kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/

/sgro skur spangs te bla ma'i gsung bzhin bris/ /'on kyang bdag blo skar 'od lta bu yis/ /rgyud 'grel gling bzhi gsal bar ma byas pas/ /byung tshul gangs can mngon du ma gyur na/ /bdag blo'i nyes par zad kyi bla ma'i min/ /'di bris dge ba gang thob dge ba des/ /ma gyur 'gro rnams thams cad mkhyen 'gro zhing / /thub bstan ches rgyas bstan 'dzin bla ma yi/ /sku tshe mgon po tshe dpag med bzhin shog /ces pa'i smon lam tshigs su bcad pa de nyid kyi rjes su tshig lhug pa'i zin bris kyi sbyar byang dang bcas byung ba yin la// ༈ //yang bshad ma thag pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi byung tshul spyi rnam de nyid dang sgo 'brel ba'i rje rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang pos gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor gsungs tshul rnams rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nyid kyi rnam thar gyi tshul du bshad pa'i chos kyi rje srad pa kun dga' blo gros kyi zin bris las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpal gyi chos grwa chen po e waṃ chos ldan du rje thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po pa dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa/ bdag rang lo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa chu mo bya'i lo gsar shar ba nas/ dgun dpyid zla ba bzhi'i bar du rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor gsungs pa la/ sngon du zla gcig tsam gyi spyi'i byung tshul rgyas pa zhig gnang ste bdag gis gang zin tsam gcig bris yod/ de nas snga chos la bskyed rdzogs gzhung phran dang bcas pa gnang zhing / dgong chos la rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa rgyas par gsungs/ tsha rting ma'i gsol ja'i thog tu bskyed rim gyi bshad pa gsung dus/ bu ston rin po che'i mdor byas kyi ṭīkka la snga gzigs re mdzad nas ja grol ma thag snga chos gsung du 'byon pas/ tshogs su chos rim la rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya nyer gcig re/

gsang 'dus nyid kyi gtor chog ltar 'jig rten pa'i gtor bsngo mdzad nas/ chos gsungs te bskyed rim gyi bshad pa 'gos rdog gi bzhed pa gtso cher rang lugs su bzhag nas/ bu ston gyi bzhed pa res 'thad pa dang / skabs su sun 'byin dgos pa yang snang zhing / phyis kyi 'dus pa la sbyangs shing mkhas par rlom pa dag gi rtog brtags la dgag bsgrub cher mdzad/ rang lugs kyi sgrub byed du sngon 'gro dang / lhag mos lta bu'i don tshan re song rim gyi rang lugs 'phags pa'i bzhed pa dang mthun par bstan pa'i phyir/ mdor byas/ de yang rgyud kyi lung gis bsgrub pa dang / mdor byas su cung zad kha skong dgos pa yang yod pas mdo bsre/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor/ sbyang gzhi snod bcud kyi srid pa'i rim pa ltar sbyong byed ston pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa rnams kyi 'bru snon/ rgyas bshad/ dka' gnas rnams lung rigs man ngag gi sgo nas zhib par ston cing / zla grags kyis mdzad zer ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyang bshad pa dang bcas par gnang / rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslabs nas bden gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi bar du/ spyod bsdus las 'byung ba'i bslab tshig ring mo rgyas par gsungs/ de dus snga gzigs la rje 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo/ shog dril gsum/ 'gos kyi gsung bgros yig sna dang bcas pa mdzad nas rim lnga 'gos lugs/ de las kyang paṇḍi ta btsun mo can gyi shog dril la thugs rtsis su mdzad de/ gzhan mar lugs la dmigs pa'i byed lugs 'di ltar yod do zhes dmigs rkang tshang bar gnang ste/ bu ston gyi khrid yig dben pa gsum 'gos lugs gtso la/ dben pa gnyis mar lugs rang du yod cing / zung 'jug gnyis ka ltar yod ces gsungs pa las dgag bsgrub cher mi mdzad/ ding sang gi 'dus pa bar grags pa rnams kyi gsung la yi ger bris pa la nor pa 'di 'dra yod cing /

nged kyis gsung gleng gi sgo nas rtsad bcad pa la 'di 'dra yod do zhes sogs phyogs snga rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa long pa'i dgag bsgrub cher mdzad/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga dang / 'phags pa'i spyod bsdus la bshad pa mdzad/ gzhan gzhung rnams la lung bshad pa tho re ba gnang / de'i tshe bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa zhib rgyas che la 'gag don 'dril ba/ sun 'byin sgrub byed nus pa che la tshig ris gtsang ba/ nyams len sems thog khyer bde ba gnang bas/ bdag gi slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po don yod dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ snga chos de gsan rjes byams chos gsung ba'i chos grwar nyin re bzhin chos rje rin po che'i de ring gi chos thun de gcig pos mkhas pa'i khyad par/ dgag bsgrub kyi rnam gzhag nyams len la sbyor tshul/ ye rang tsho'i yon tan phyogs gcig tu dril ba la med gsungs/ chos thun yang 'tshams par byung bas dgyes dgyes mdzad/ gung ja'i bar la rje 'gos kyi mchan chen po la snga gzigs mdzad cing / res 'ga' rdog pa'i 'grel bshad kyang gzigs nas dgong chos la sgron gsal gyi mchod brjod rgyan bdun gyi stong thun rnams la/ sngon la gzhung thog tu mi gzigs par skam bshad rgyas pa re mdzad/ de nas bu ston rin po che'i mtha' drug rab gsal gyi steng nas bshad pa dang 'bru non lung tshun chad yi ge gcig kyang ma lus par mdzad rjes/ mang ra'i dka' mchan dang / rdog dang brlan gyi ṭīkkar/ de 'dra'i nyang nyog mang po mi byed par go rgyu che la tshig nyung ba'i hril pa 'di 'dra re byed pa yin gsungs nas snga rabs pa'i lugs kyi bshad pa rno thag chod pa re mdzad de/ dper mtshon na/ sgron gsal gyi mchod brjod bshad par dam bca' la/ bu ṭīka na 'bru snon dang / bshad yam rgyas la/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la spyi sbas mthar thug sogs skyor gyin mang po bris pa gsungs rjes su/ snga rabs pa rnams 'di 'dra'i go rgyu chung la zer rgyu mang ba mi byed/

rgyud tshig la gzhi bshad dgos pa du ma 'byung yang / bstan bcos kyi 'bru snon la bzhi bshad byed pa ci 'dra yin ma shes/ 'di la mang ra seng rgyal 'di ltar gsungs te/ bshad ces sbyar/ gang bshad na dpal ldan rgyud rgyal zhes dang / rgyal ba'i 'dus gang yin pa bshad/ gang gi bshad na zla ba grags pas bshad/ sngon du bya ba ci byas nas bshad na/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la btud de bshad/ tshul ji ltar bshad na rnal 'byor rgyud kyi shin tu gsal bar rnam phye legs spyad pa/ mtha' drug ni 'ching pas bcings te bshad/ snod gang la bshad na rgyal sras yul gyur te dbang rnon skal ldan la bshad/ slob dpon su'i man ngag la brten nas bshad na/ de ni klu sgrub las brnyed pa ste lta bu'i man ngag la ma brten na bshad par mi nus te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyis gnas kyi rgyas btab ces sbyar/ tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pas dpal ldan no/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po ni gsang 'dus so/ /gang 'dus na rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pas rgyal ba'i 'dus gang yin pa'o/ /khyab pa ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so/ /bdag ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i bdag nyid du gyur pas so/ /dpal ldan zung 'jug rdo rje don dam/ sems dpa' kun rdzob/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi ni bshad rgyud bzhis so/ /shin tu mi shes pa dang bral te ma nor ba'o/ /gsal ba ni the tshom dang bral te sgra zur ma chag pa'o/ /rnam phye ni log rtog dang bral te rgyud kyi don tshig re re nas so/ /legs par bshad ni tshig rang yang bsdebs legs pa'o/ /'chad lugs kyi chings sgra ji bzhin pa dang / ma yin pa dang / dgongs pa/ dgongs min/ drang don/ nges don te/ tshig dang / don dang / tshig don gnyis ka'i mtha' drug gi chings kyis bcings nas so/ /de lta bu'i bshad tshul dka' zhing zab pa ni rgyal sras te/

rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gi yul du gyur pas de la bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyis gnas ni/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa thugs kyi nying khu bskyed rdzogs gnyis so/ /rgyas btab ni mtshan pa'i rgya'o/ /zhes pa'i don dka' mchan las 'byung bas mdor na dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag btsal nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba 'dus pa zla grags bdag gis bshad pa'i rgyud bzhis mtha' drug gi chings dang ldan par/ klu sgrub kyi gdam ngag la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs don rim gnyis kyi rgya dang ldan pa de/ slob ma dang brgyud 'dzin rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyi don du bshad ces pa'o gsungs te/ de lta bus mtshan no/ /gleng gzhi'i bshad pa'i skabs su rim lnga'i bshad pa rgyas par gnang te yun ring po song / de man chad la sngon la rgyud kyi steng du 'bru snon dang bshad pa go sla ba re de nas 'grel pa'i 'bru snon rgya che ba re/ de nas bu ṭīka ltar 'bru dang bshad pa sbyar ba re/ de nas ṭīka 'dir de bzhin bshad kyang / mchan chen dang / rdog dang / brlan gyis go bde la don bzang pa re 'di ltar mdzad gsungs pa dang / skabs mang por ni mchan chen gyi yin tshod du 'dug ste/ mngon shes can gzhung 'di dang 'di la 'di ltar 'chad/ btsun mo can 'di 'dra 'chad/ nag po pas 'di skad gsungs te/ khong kun gyi bshad lugs ya mtshan che ba/ rje 'gos kyang gsung bgros 'di tsam yang so sor ma 'dres par bkod pa thugs bsam dge ba bstan pa la bsam pa a tshi a tshi ba/ 'di lta bu sngon gyi sa skya pa rnying ma tsho la kyai rdor birwa pa'i lugs dang gzhan mi bsre man ngag lugs dang 'grel pa lugs mi bsre/ man ngag lugs kyi yang thun mong du gsungs pa dang / lam 'bras kyi lung sbyor mi bsre ba yod/ ding sang yin na rgyal khams kyi lung 'khyams kun yod bsres tshar/ bslad tshar/ rje 'gos 'di bzhin mdzad pa bka' drin che gsungs/

dus phyis kyi gsang 'dus kyang gsar pa rnams ni sgron gsal gyi mchan dang mtha' dpyod zer ba'i rigs lam nas drangs zer/ spyir bla med kyi grub mtha' dang mi mthun/ dgos su mar 'gos sogs la ye med pa'i/ sol ba brdar ba'i dkar po mi 'byung ba ltar rang lus 'dis sangs rgyas mi 'grub/ rnam smin gyi lus dor te rang bzhin gnyug ma'i yid lus gcig gis zung 'jug bsgrub bya ba sogs gsung rab la dbang chen po mang po byas yod de/ bla med kyi rgyud kyi gzhung gi go ba rnal ma re chags na yig cha de kun bklags pa tsam gyis rang skyon rjen cher te rig rgyu zhig yong bya ba sogs dgag bsgrub kyang mang du mdzad pas chos thun shin tu che/ rjes na mar la mkhas mchog don yod dpal ba'i drung nas/ chos grol nas rang gi gnas su phebs nas 'di skad gsungs te/ gsang sngags pa'i chos kyi 'chad lugs bu ṭīka yig tshogs can de phyag tu bsnams/ de'i yi ge gcig kyang ma lus pa la 'bru bsnan/ der rting go chod mod/ yang de bkag nas snga rabs pa'i bzhed pa re/ yang na snga rabs pa la thugs rtsis mdzad rting bu ṭīka gis gang mdzad/ bshad lugs de rno la bzang ba/ nyung ba de ka gnang bas chog mod/ phyogs snga la yang kha cig na re zhes mi chen gyi tshig sbram po mdzad pas chog pa la/ chos rje dge ldan pa chen pos 'di ru 'di skad bris/ 'di'i dus 'di skad gsungs/ de 'dras ga na 'ongs la a pha pha zhes gsungs pa sogs de 'dra gsungs ga la dgos/ bla ma chen po 'di tsam du song nas mi chos gru bzhi lam pa byas pas chog pa yin gsungs te/ drung nas rang spyir dga' ba gdong la 'byon dgos pas rgyud myur bar grol na dgongs pa dang / khyad par mtshan nyid kyi chos mang po 'chad dgos pas chos thun chung tsam la chos 'gro che ba byung na dgongs par 'dug go /bdag gi bsam mno la ni/ sngon la rgyud rkyang la 'bru bsnan te ting nge 'dzin 'dis nyams len 'di ston gsungs pa des brda chad lam pa ra chags/

de nas sgron gsal 'bru bsnan te tshul bzhi sogs bshad tshul 'grel pa rang sked gsal seng ste 'ong / bu ṭīka phyag tu bsnams nas 'chad cing tshig re re bzhin 'bru bsnan te gsungs pa ni chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pa de bu ston la shin tu mos pas/ bu ston bka' 'bum bzhengs/ cung zad ma grub pa la chos rje nyid kyis bsobs te bsabs kyang yod/ rjes kyang bu ṭīka steng nas tshar gsum gsan pas de'i 'brel dang zhen par gda'/ rjes su yig cha rnying ma rnams kyi lung de man ngag thon che ba dang go sla ba sogs dgos pa mang po gzigs pa yin te de tsho'i gsung bskyor tsa na/ khong kun gsang 'dus la mi tshe phyi zhing dril ba rnams zhes gsungs pa sogs che brjod mdzad pa/ yig cha bzang po de rnams kyi bshad bsgrub dar la re bar 'dug bu ston gzigs rgya che yang rdog dang / brlan gyi yig cha rnams las/ 'gos kyi stong thun dang / mchan chen/ shog dril gsum dang ma mjal tshod du 'dug ste/ khong pa nan ltar bshad yam mang pa la/ rdog pas 'di ltar gsungs zhes pa las/ 'gos kyi yig cha na 'di yod ces ma bkod do/ /'dus pa ba phyi ma rnams la dgag bsgrub mdzad pa'i tshe yang rje'i zhal la blta snying 'dod cing da dung sun 'byin dang tshig nyams 'dra byung na bsam dga' ru chor ba dang / chos thun 'di da rung ma grol na snyam pa dang / 'di lta bu'i rgyud sde khyad par can rje 'gos lta bu'i lo tsā ba rang bzo mi mdzad pa la man ngag che ba'i gsung la gtug tu yod pas/ bdag rang yang bsod nams che ba snyam pa dang / zhang lung pa'i drin las kyang gsang 'dus kyi bshad srol bzang po da lta'i bar du byung bar 'dug snyam pa dang / dge ldan pas kyang gsang 'dus la go la ma go'i yig cha mdzad/ ding sang dar bas rjes kyang dge ldan du sku mdun du yang khong tsho'i lugs dpyis phyin par zhus/ yig cha rnams kyang bzhengs/

bshad pa mdzad pas khong tshos ring lam nas 'dren zhes pa de'i gnyen por/ rjes snga rab pa'i lung man ngag thabs mkhas kyi khyad par mang po'i mdzod rdol te/ lhug par gnang ba 'di khong tshos 'ben bzang po btsugs pa'i drin yang yin par go bas/ kho bo la ni dge ldan pa la dgra'i 'du shes rnam pa thams cad du med do/ /de ltar zla ba gsum gyi bar du snga chos dgong chos gnyis ka 'dus pa la dril te/ rgyud 'grel/ bshad srol gsar rnying phyogs snga'i tshul gyi dge ldan pa'i grub mtha'i gnad dang / spyi bshad kyi dus 'chad do gsung pa'i gzhung phran rnams dang / grub chen klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu pa dang bcas pa thams cad gnang zhing / rgyun ma chad pa nyan pa lags so/ /bdag gis de gong dang de'i rjes nas kyang bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa dang khrid thos pa'i tshe/ 'gos lugs gtso che ba la/ mar pa'i bsdus gsal dang / gdan rdzogs/ nag khrid/ dmar khrid sogs na dmigs pa'i rkang 'di lta bu yod do zhes khrid kyi don rnams legs par thob cing / lung rnams ni da thob la re yod do/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis mkhas pa kun blo'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ bstan 'dzin mchog gi bstan pa spel ba la/ /don gnyer slob mas don du gnyer ba'i tshul/ /mdzad pa ngo mtshar mdzad bzang 'di som la/ /kun kyang dam chos kun la don gnyer gces/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don lnga pa kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seṅge'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po'i nyi 'od kyi don 'grel lam bzang gsal ba'i snang ba zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen gcig tu bsdus pa gong na med pa'i rgyud chen po rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa 'di la thog mar sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabs bskyed pa'i rim pa ting nge 'dzin gsum dang /

rdzogs pa'i rim pa rim pa lngas bcings pa'i srol chen po phye ste slob tshogs dang bcas pas gzhung phran gyi sgo nas 'dzam bu'i gling du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor las dbang bskur ba nos te/ zhal gyi lung thob nas lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i lam srol phye ba'i nang nas bskyed pa'i rim pa ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ /'di la gsum ste/ bla ma chen po ji ltar byon pa'i lo rgyus smos pa/ des bkral ba'i lam spyi'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa/ de las bskyed pa'i rim sa bcad 'di'i don rgyas par shes par 'dod na kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi rnam bshad lam bzang gsal ba'i snang bar blta bar gyis shig kho bos byas pa'i bstan bcos 'dir ni rnam bshad de nyid kyi dbu na bzhugs pa'i lugs 'di'i dam pa'i chos 'byung tshul nyid bsdus pa'o/ /pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bla ma 'di rgya gar shar lho'i yul sindhu ra zhes bya bar/ rgyal po gha pa ro pra bha wa zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs so/ de byis pa nyid nas gzugs dang / shes rab dang / kun tu spyod pa rnam par dag par gyur nas/ sgra dang / sdeb sbyor dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos la sogs pa la rab tu mkhas par sbyangs so/ /cher skyes pa dang rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor nas/ na lent+ra'i phyogs gcig tu grong khyer rdo 'jog ces bya bar rgyal po shrī dharmā pā las brtsigs pa trika zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du/ mkhan po rnam par snang mdzad bzang po'i slob ma/ thugs rje dang byang chub kyi sems la goms pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab du ma'i mdzod 'dzin cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don gsal bar 'chad pa slob dpon seṅge bzang po'i drung du pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs sbyangs nas/

shrī na lend+rar rigs ldan yon tan bshes gnyen gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rtsom pa dang / bshad pa sogs byas nas der gnas pa rnams brod pa bskyed do/ /de nas byang phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du byon te/ yul de'i phyogs gcig na slob dpon nor bu'i gling du skyes pas nor bu gling pa zhes kyang bya/ gzugs sna tshogs su ston pas sna tshogs gzugs zhes kyang bya/ 'jol sgeg rdo rje zhes bya ba de'i drung du/ bya ba dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mang du gsan/ de nas de'i phyogs gcig na gu ni ru zhes bya bar grags pa'i bla ma de'i drung du bsnyen te lung mang du gsan/ yang yul de'i phyogs gcig na lakṣa mo se na chen mo'i drung du zla ba brgyad kyi bar du bzhugs nas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsan te/ der 'phags pa gnod gnas kyi grub pa thob bo/ /de nas dza len dha rar/ sa mo pā ta ste/ slob dpon byis pa chung ngu'i zhabs zhes bya ba shes rab kyi rgyud la bsam pa chu klung lta bur gyur pa'i drung du shes rab kyi rgyud mang du gsan to/ /de nas lho phyogs nam mkha'i shing ldan kong ka nar ba liṃ bā ta ste/ slob dpon bsrung ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba/ thabs kyi rgyud la bsam pa chu klung lta bur gyur pa'i drung du lo dgu bzhugs te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud chen 'grel bcas bco brgyad bar du nyan ces gsungs te/ bla ma'i dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud chen ni rnal 'byor rnams so/ /'grel bcas ni rnal 'byor legs par bslab pas sme sha can gyi bu mo/ nyi la mu tra ta de dang bcas pas zla ba bco brgyad kyi bar du nyan par gsungs so/ /de'i tshe bla ma'i zhal nas bdag gis don 'di ma rtogs zhes gsungs/ de la thugs cung zad chad de/ 'di ma rtogs na gzhan don med snyam nas phyag rgya 'dus pa'i glegs bam du byas nas mgul par btags te/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ku ba tsa zhes bya bar stag dang /

dred la sogs pa mang po gnas pa'i tshal du byon te zla ba drug bsgoms pas de kho na nyid rtogs so/ /de nas ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i tshe 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'jol sgeg rol pa dang bcas pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / sprul pa'i dge slong ma gnyis dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi khang pa chung ngu zhig tu snang bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas rim pa gnyis pa'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba 'jam dpal gyi lung gsungs/ zhes pa 'di tsam zhig zhal lung las 'byung la/ gtam rgyud gzhan las ni bla ma ba liṃ pa ta'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi the tshom gyi mdud pa de dag rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar 'jam pa'i rdo rje bzhugs pa'i drung du zhus shig des grol bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan nas byon pa'i lam khar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su khang bu zhig gi drung na bud med gcig dang / khyi mo zhig gnas pa dang / de dang nye ba na btsun pa zhig chos gos kyis thod byas nas zhing rmod cing 'dug pa gzigs pas/ kye ma rab tu byung ba bud med dang bcas zhing rmod pa 'di 'dra ba byung pas bstan pa nyams so snyam du dgongs nas thugs skyo bar gyur to/ /de ltar na yang nyi ma'i dus la babs pas der byon nas bsod snyoms mdzad par dgongs pa dang / btsun pa des bud med la/ rab tu byung pa 'di la dro drongs shig bsgos pas/ bud med des nya rgya khyer nas chu phran zhig la nya bshor te/ de btsos nas khyi mo'i mdun du shing lo la bzhag nas chos ston drongs zhes bsgos pas/ khyi mo bskyugs pa dang / der sngar gyi nya dang bcas pa drangs pas/ slob dpon gyis ched du dmigs pa'i sha dang / mi gtsang bar dgongs nas ma gsol lo/ /de nas btsun pa na re/ kyai 'dzam bu'i gling pa la phal pa'i zas byin ces bsgos pas/ 'bras chan zho dang bcas pa drangs pa dang /

slob dpon gyis gsol nas yang gshegs par dgongs pa dang / btsun pa de na re/ da 'di na phar song yang do nub sdod sa mi rnyed kyi sang song zer bas der bzhugs so/ /der slob dpon gyis gsang ba 'dus pa zhal 'don du bton pa dang / gang du slob dpon gyis ma shes pa'i sar/ bud med des mi mgu ba dang / ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur re byas pa dang / slob dpon gyis 'dis the tshom chod par 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs te/ phyag btsal nas gsol ba btab pa dang / bud med de na re/ ngas mi shes da ci'i btsun pa de shin tu mkhas pa yin pas de la zhus shig zer ro/ /de gar song dris pas chang nyor song zer/ bsgugs pas phyi ma red chang gis bzi nas 'khyor bzhin pa 'ongs pa gzigs pas/ ma dad kyang nga rgyal bcag nas phyag btsal te/ bdag la gsang ba 'dus pa bshad par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur longs shig ces gsungs/ bdag gis dbang bskur thob ces brjod pas/ nga nyid kyis dbang bskur dgos zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyis yo byad btsal nas dbang zhus so/ /der ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad kyi mtshan mo spyil po gzhal med khang du sprul/ de'i dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa mngon sum du bstan nas dbang zhus zhes pa snang ngo / /lo rgyus gzhan las ni sngar gyi btsun pa de yang dkyil 'khor gyi drung du 'dug nas/ nga la dbang len nam/ dkyil 'khor la dbang len zhes gsungs pa la/ dkyil 'khor la dbang len zhus pas/ dkyil 'khor mi snang bar gyur nas/ der dkyil 'khor btsun pas sprul pa yin par dgongs nas phyag 'tshal te/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod nas gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor sprul pa la tho rangs dbang blangs zer ba yang ma dag pa 'dra ste/ zhal lung las/ mgo dang lag gnyis yol dang tshes brgyad rgyal la babs/ /ston zla 'bring po'i tho rangs skya rengs shar dus su/

/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul pa la/ /bdag gis don ni blang phyir gsol ba rab tu btab/ /khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin/ /zhes gsungs pa tsam las mi snang yang / de'i 'grel par de nas dge slong gis gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i mchog la gnas par shes nas/ de las spyan ras gzigs kyi btsal ba'i phyir/ 'jam dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul lo/ /tshes gang zhe na/ mgo dang lag gnyis yol nas tshes brgyad rgyal la babs/ /zhes so/ /nam zla gang zhe na ston zla ra ba zhes so/ /der sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang bla ma la mos pa dris pa dang / sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la mos par bka' gsal ba dang / dge slong bla ma dang bcas pa de nyid du khang pa chung ngu zhig gi nang du bzhugs so/ /de nas bla ma chen pos 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor la de bzhin nyid blang bar bya ba'i phyir gsol ba 'di skad du btab bo/ /khyod ni zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na 'grel pa 'dir dkyil 'khor sprul pa yang tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs sprul par gsungs shing / mjug tu zhal gyi lung gnang zin nas skya rengs shar ba'i tshe sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dge slong bla ma gnyis dang bcas pa mi snang bar gsungs pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul ma thag tu gsol ba btab nas gdams pa gnang bar gsal lo/ /gtam rgyud de ltar 'chad pa ni sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / bla ma la mos pa dris pa dang / sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la mos par shes nas dge slong bla ma dang bcas pa de nyid du khang pa chung ngu zhig gi nang du bzhugs zhes pas 'khrul gzhi byas par snang yang / de'i don sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la mos par shes pa'i tshe dge slong bla ma dang bcas pa sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i sar bzhugs nas dkyil 'khor dang tha dad du snang la/ bla ma la mos par shes na sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid dge slong bla ma dang bcas pa der byon nas tha mi dad du snang zhes pa'i don no/

/gtam rgyud snga ma ba liṃ pā tas lung bstan nas ri bo rtse lngar 'gro ba'i lam khar de ltar byung bar bshad pa yang cung zad ma dag pa 'dra ste/ zhal lung las/ rdo rje gdan rgyab ku pa tsa na zhes bya ba yi tshal/ /stag dang dred sogs mang zhig 'jigs pa'i sar/ /zla ba drug tu gnas nas chos rnams de nyid rtogs/ /sprul pa'i dge slong bla ma gnyis dang bcas par 'phrad/ /mgo dang lag gnyis yol dang zhes sogs sngar drangs pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang zla ba drug song ba'i mthar sngar bshad pa ltar gyi sprul pa gsum po dang 'phrad nas/ zas dang spyod pa la cung zad ma dad pas/ btsun pas dkyil 'khor sprul te/ btsun pa de dang / khyi mo dkar mo dang / bud med ngan ma bu chung ngu dang bcas pa gsum po yang dkyil 'khor gyi drung du gnas pa la gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur nas lung thob par gsal te/ zhal lung las/ sprul pa gsum po de ltar du gnas pa yang gsungs shing / mjug tu/ khyod kyis zas kyi bya ba dang / /nga la cung zad 'khrul rtog pas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /gtam rgyud kha cig las tshigs bcad 'di dag btsun pas bshad par gsungs pa yang ngo bo gcig pa la 'gal ba med kyang / rnam pa'i cha nas de ltar ma yin te/ zhal lung gi 'phro nyid du/ khyod kyang zas kyi bya ba dang / /nga la cung zad 'khrul rtog pas/ /khyod kyis tshe 'di nyid la ni/ /gzugs bcas phung po rang lus ni/ /gnas ni yang dag mi 'gyur te/ /rnam par shes pa mi bshig pa/ /phyag rgya chen po rab tu 'grub/ /de bas khyod kyis yang dag blos/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /gsang chen gsang la rab gsang ba/ /gong na med pa'i lung chen po/ /'di yi rim pa dang po yi/ /bsgrub pa'i thabs dang sbyin sreg dang / /gtor ma sna tshogs 'khor lo dang / /bsdus pa la ni rnam bshad dang / /dkyil 'khor cho ga la sogs pa/ /mi shes mun sgrib sems can gyi/

/thur ma lta bu rtsom par gyis/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /de la sgrub pa'i thabs ni kun tu bzang mo gsum mo/ /sbyin sreg ni gnyis kyi cho ga'o/ /gtor ma ni mi nub pa'i sgron me'o/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo ni tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga'o/ /bsdus pa ni rin po che 'bar ba'o/ /rnam bshad ni ma mdzad do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni nyis brgya lnga bcu pa zhig mdzad de/ bla mas rgya dpe kha cher khyer nas yul dbus kyi slob ma rnams kyis ma mthong bar grag go /sogs kyi sgras bsdus pa rtsa ba'i ye shes chen po/ tshigs su bcad pa mdzod 'grel ba'i thig le bdag nyid grub pa 'byung ba/ byang chub sems kyi thig le/ dpal bkra shis kyi rnam bshad chen mo/ bzhi pa la 'jug pa'i thabs dang bcas pa/ nor sbyin dbang po'i sgrub thabs te lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu gnyis mdzad do/ /de dag gi slob ma'i tshogs la phan gdags pa'i nang nas rgyal tshab kyi sar 'os pa'i gang zag bco brgyad dang / de'i nang nas mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i gang zag mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje bde ba chen po ste bzhi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni bla ma chen po'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin yin pas mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa'i bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i rjes su 'brangs par sman pa'i zhabs kyis bshad do/ /bla ma chen pos rnam bshad ma mdzad pas/ /rtsa rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa la 'grel pa mdzad pa'i slob ma bcu gsum byung bar grags shing / rjes 'jug la yang sman pa'i zhabs dang / dpal 'bras rdo rje dang / tsi lu pa dang / tha ga na la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang du byung ste/ srol bla na med pa'o/ /'di man chad gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos 'byung tshul rang du mi snang yang lam spyi'i rnam gzhag rtogs pa la shin tu phan pa zhig 'dug pas bris pa lags/ gnyis pa des bkral ba'i lam spyi'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa la bzhi ste/

lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba bsgom par bya ba'i lam dngos/ rtog pa'i rim pas gzhag pa'i gdam ngag lam gyi sgrub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ dkyil 'khor/ slob dpon/ dbang / dam tshig dang sdom pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ ri mo'i dkyil 'khor/ lus dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dang po la mar me mdzad kyi bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang / sman pa'i zhabs kyi dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter gnyis las/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nyid la gsungs shing ngag dbang grags pa'i dbang gi rab byed las/ rdul tshon dang / ras ris dang / yid kyi dkyil 'khor dang gsum du gsungs so/ /rdul tshon la yang gang zag gi sgo nas 'bri tshul gsum ste/ las dang po pas 'bri tshul dang / ye shes la cung zad dbang ba dang / ye shes la dbang bas 'bri tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dkyil chog nyid las bshad pa'i thig tshon gyi cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du 'bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni khye'u dang / bu mo lo bcu gnyis lon pa grong pa'i chos kyis ma phog pa la pra phab nas rang gis thig tshon byin rlabs byas pa gtad de 'brir bcug pa'o/ /'di la yang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'bri na khye'u la mi bskyod pa dang / bu mo la ma mā ki phab/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor la 'od dpag med dang gos dkar mo/ sku'i dkyil 'khor la rnam snang dang / sangs rgyas spyan phab par gsungs shing / dgos pa ni 'jig rten pa dag gis nus pa med do/ /zhes brnyas pa spong ba'i phyir yin par gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni sa chog nas brtsams te mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sprul te gsum char la yang cho ga lhag ma rnams ni 'dra bar bshad do/ /'di la sman pa'i zhabs kyis/ bsam gtan dkyil 'khor bsam gtan gyi/ /mchod dang dbang bskur de bzhin du/ /byas nas gzhan la 'ga' yi don/ /bsgrub phyir lugs 'di bsgo ba 'o/

/zhes bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sogs kyi tha snyad gsungs so/ /bla mas de ltar sprul nus kyang / /slob ma dkyil 'khor de bltar nus pa dang / mi nus pa gnyis las/ dang po dkyil 'khor der dbang bskur/ phyi ma la ye shes la cung zad dbang ba'i lugs ltar pra phab nas dbang bskur ba'i lugs gnyis gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ma gsum ni/ sambu ṭi dang / 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma gnyis las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha gar gsungs pa nyid/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems nyid de/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ni yongs su brtag /ces gsungs pa'i don/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa'i bzhed pas/ gsang ba chos kyi dkyil 'khor gsum la 'chad pa'i lugs yod kyang / 'di'i lugs kyi rgyu'i slob dpon gyis lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / rgyu dang rkyen gyi slob dpon gnyis kyis byang chub kyi sems dang / lhan cig byed pa'i slob dpon gyis bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la 'chad do/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi don yang 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang / ma rgyud ltar gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor ma yin gyi/ slob dpon gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang skur ba'i tshe gtso bo'i thugs kha nas bye ste dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon so sor snang ba'i cha nas slob dpon gyis lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ sman pa'i zhabs kyis ri mo dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis las bum dbang len par gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i don snga rabs pa kha cig ri mo'i dkyil 'khor las gzhan mi mthong ba'i skal med rnams la ri mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i skal ldan rnams la lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhes dang / gzhan dag ri mo'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor du slob dpon gyi dbang thob zer ba gnyis ka don la mi gnas te/

snga ma bde mchog dril bu pa sogs la yod kyang lugs 'di la med pa'i phyir dang / phyi ma la ni de lta bu'i khyad par dbyer med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa slob dpon la gsum ste/ rgyu'i slob dpon/ rkyen gyi slob dpon/ lhan cig byed pa'i slob dpon no/ /dang po ni bum dbang bskur ba/ gnyis pa ni gsang ba bskur ba'i bla ma'i phyag rgya/ gsum pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i slob ma'i phyag rgya ste/ 'di nyid sngon byung gi rnam 'phrul dang sbyar nas dge slong byi ba'i sham thabs can chos gos la thod byas pa ni rgyu'i slob dpon/ khyi mo dkar mo ni rkyen gyi slob dpon/ bud med ngan ma bu chung ngu dang bcas pa ni lhan cig byed pa'i slob dpon yin par zhal lung gi 'grel par bshad do/ /gsum pa dbang la gsum ste/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /gsum po re re la yang / slob dpon dang / yon dang / sdom pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang / cho ga dang / ngo bo dang / dag bya dang / skal ba gang dang mnyam pa dang / gdam ngag dang / rtogs pa dang / nges tshig ste bcu gcig bcu gcig gi sgo nas sman pa'i zhabs kyis sbyor ba bdun pa las gsungs te/ slob dpon gyi skabs su rgyu'i slob dpon las bum dbang / rkyen gyi slob dpon las gsang dbang / de gnyis dang lhan cig byed pa'i slob dpon gsum las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang len pa dang / sdom pa'i skabs su bum dbang las thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa/ gsang dbang las srog gcod sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa/ shes rab ye shes las dkyil 'khor bri ba sogs 'gog pa'i mchog gi sdom pa thob pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su ri mo dang lus dkyil gyi dkyil 'khor las bum dbang / byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor las gsang dbang / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang len par gsungs so/

/'o na de dag thams cad dbang bzhi pa la ci'i phyir ma bshad snyam na/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang / dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter gnyis las/ dbang bzhi pa bskur ba'i tshul gtan ma gsungs shing / dbang gi rab byed las ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ye shes la yan lag bdun ldan gyi ngo sprod byed pa'i sgo nas bskur ba'i tshul gsungs so/ /sbyor ba bdun pa las ni/ da ni yang dag bshad par bya/ /bzhi pa mngon par byang chub pa/ /bla ma'i zhal nas nges thob pa/ /sbyor ba bdun gyi de nyid bshad/ /rang bzhin gnas phyir slob dpon med/ /rin thang med phyir yon med de/ /sdom pa bas na sdom pa med/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor med/ /stobs kyis thob phyir dbang med de/ /spyi bas rang gi ngo bo med/ /chos kun gnyen po gnyen po med/ /rdo rje 'dzin gnas sa med de/ /rang bzhin med phyir cho ga dang / /lta ba nges tshig med pa ru/ /bla ma yis ni yang dag bshad/ /ces bshad do/ /'o na dbang bzhi pa la slob dpon sogs gtan med pa yin nam snyam na/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang las logs su gyur pa'i de dag med ces pa'i don yin gyi/ dbang bzhi pa mtshan nyid pa dang de tshig gis bskur ba'i tshul mi bzhed pa ni ma yin te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang / /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'di la gsum ste/ dbang bzhi pa mtshan nyid pa/ mtshon byed dpe'i dbang bzhi pa/ de tshig gi sgo nas ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sku gsum yan lag bdun dang ldan pa ste/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med/ /yan lag bdun po nyid dang ldan pa'i bsgrub bya 'dir/ /bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs bsgos blo can rnams kyang bsngags/

/zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa ston par byed pa ste/ phyag rgya chen po kho na dbang bskur ba bzhi pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi ye shes gcig nyid la sngar gyi slob dpon la sogs pa'i don tshan bcu gcig rang bzhin lhun grub kyi tshul du tshang ste/ sbyor ba bdun pa las sngar gyi dbang bzhi pa ston pa'i tshig gi mjug tu/ shes rab las skyes ye shes ni/ /bzhi pa yin par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang / /zhes de ltar dang / yang dang / de bzhin zhes pa'i tshig gsum gyis dbang gsum pa'i ye shes la yan lag bdun ldan tshang bar ngo sprod pa ste/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i gzhung las/ de ltar sgra dang ldan nyid phyir/ /yang gi sgra don skyes nyid phyir/ /de bzhin sgra don ldan nyid phyir/ /bzhi pa de bzhin nyid bdag 'dod/ ces gsungs pas so/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi man ngag las/ dbang bzhi po re re la yang sbyang gzhi dang slob dpon sogs don tshan bcu drug so sor bzhed pa ni grub chen gyi 'grel tshul gzhan yin no/ /gsum pa dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnyis te/ thun mong ba'i sdom pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sta gon dang 'jug pa'i skabs su thob pa'i so thar dang / byang sems kyi sdom pa dang / rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs su thob pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa ste/ slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka'i thun mong ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spang ba'i dam tshig dang sdom pa dang / bza' ba dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / rnal 'byor snying po'i sdom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bum pa'i dbang gi skabs su thob pa ste/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang / yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad bsrung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni gsang dbang gi skabs su thob pa ste/ sha lnga dang /

bdud rtsi lnga bza' ba dang / bsrung ba srog gcod sogs bzhi'o/ /'di ni kyai rdo rje las dgongs te gsungs par byas nas bzhi pa'i dam tshig tu gsungs kyang / 'dir ni sems can gyi don du 'gyur na srog gcod pa sogs byang chub sems dpa' dang thun mong ba dang / rnam rtog gi srog gcod pa sogs dgongs te gsungs pa rnams gsang dbang gi dam tshig tu gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ shes rab ye shes kyi skabs su thob pa ste/ phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba la sogs pa bkag nas phyag rgya spyan ma la sogs pa dang / sgrub pa po rigs lngar shes par byas nas dag mi dag gi 'du shes 'gog pa'o/ /yang dam tshig 'di dag bsdus na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdom pa gsum du yang gsungs te/ lus kyi sdom pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi lus rdo rje sems dpa' las byung bar shes par byas nas gzhan gyi lus la mi smod pa dang / rang gi lus kyi spyod pa la blang dor dgag pa dang / rang gzhan gyi ngag rdo rje sems dpa' las byung bar shes par byas nas gzhan gyi ngag la mi smod pa dang / rang gi ngag bzang ngan la blang dor dgag pa dang / rang gzhan gyi sems rdo rje sems dpa' las byung bar shes par byas nas gzhan gyi sems la mi dmod pa dang / rang gi sems phyi mas snga ma sun mi dbyung ba gsum du bsdus nas gsungs te/ snga ma rnams ni las dang po pa'i dam tshig dang / phyi ma rnams ni brtan pa thob pa'i dam tshig tu mngon no/ /gnyis pa bsgom par bya ba'i lam gyi ngo bo ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ 'di la dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo / grangs nges pa/ bsgom pa'i go rim dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i thabs khyad par can du gyur pa'i sngags kyi spyod pa ste/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ dbang po dang ni yul rnams kyi/ /rkyen las gang dang gang byung ba'i/ /yid de man zhes bya bar bshad/ /tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don/

/'jig rten spyod las rnam grol bar/ /gang bshad dam tshig sdom pa ni/ /rdo rje kun gyi bsrung ba ni/ /sngags kyi spyod pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di la gang skyob par bya ba'i yid/ gang las skyob pa'i spang bya/ gang gis skyob pa'i thabs dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mant+ra zhes pa'i ma na la o byin pas ma no ni yid de/ dbang po drug dang / yul drug gi rkyen las byung ba'i rnam par shes pa tshogs drug go /de ni tshig rkang dang po gsum gyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhung la dngos su med kyang / don gyis thob pa mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun par gang bshad pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa'i spyod pa mtshan rtog las grol ba'i thabs khyad par can rdo rje gsum gyi bsrung ba bla na med par 'dus te/ 'di la bskyed rim gyi rdo rje gsum gyi bsrung ba ni lus ngag yid gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum du shes par byas nas nyams su len pa yin la/ rdzogs rim la ni ye shes gcig nyid la bsrung ba gsum cha tshang ba'o/ /de ni tshig rkang phyi ma lngas ston no/ /gnyis pa dbye ngo ni/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi mar/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis der bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim gnyis so/ /dang po ni 'og tu rgyas par 'chad do/ /gnyis pa la snying khar mi shigs pa'i thig le bsgom pa dga' ba'i rang bzhin/ gsang gnas su gsang ba'i thig le bsgom pa dga' ba bar ma'i rang bzhin/ lus kyi gnas gzhir sprul pa'i thig le bsgom pas dga' bral gyi rang bzhin/ dga' ba gsum cha ro gcig pa mi shig pa'i thig le/ de nyid bsgoms pas lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin te gtso bor thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi gsungs la/

de yang / sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis las rgya la brten nas sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dpe'i tshul gyis mngon sum du rtogs nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa zla ba drug gam bco brgyad du spyad pas tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang bsgrub pa ste/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /phyag rgya las skyes chos thams cad/ /sgyu ma la sogs 'drar bsgrub pa/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis ni/ zhal lung las/ sgyu ma dang ni smig sgyu dang / /brag cha 'gal me 'khor lo dang / /sprul pa dri za'i grong khyer dang / /chu bur dang ni mig 'khrul dang / /gzugs brnyan chu zla la sogs par/ /zhes dang / sogs kyi sgras bsdus pa rmi lam dang / dbang po'i gzhu gnyis yin par gsungs so/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs gnyis po yang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zab gsal gnyis med yin pa ltar/ zab gsal gnyis med kyi tshul gyis bsgom dgos pa las/ bskyed rim gyi zab gsal gnyis med ni ye shes kyi tshogs kyi zab mo stong pa nyid bsgoms nas de las langs te sems gsal ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par brtags pa na/ zab mo stong pa nyid dang / gsal ba dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dbyer med pa ste/ sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun ni ma gtogs pa/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan ci'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / zab cing rgya che ba yi bdag nyid can/ /der ni kun rtog gang yin snang mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rdzogs rim gyi zab gsal gnyis med ni phyag rgya la brten nas dpe'i tshul gyis rtogs pa ste/ zhal lung las/ de bzhin phyin log rnam par shes/ /log pas zab gsal gnyis med kyi/

/don 'dra zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ zab gsal gnyis med kyi don 'dra zhes pa ni/ ji bzhin ma yin pa'i phyir 'dra ba ste brtag pa'i sgo zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa grangs nges pa la bzhi ste/ spang bya gnyis yin pas dang / bsgrub bya gnyis yin pas dang / bskyed bya gnyis yin pas dang / rang gi ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pas rim pa gnyis su grangs nges pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spang bya tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa dang / lhar zhen pa'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis spong bas rim pas gnyis su grangs nges pa ste/ spang bya dang po'i lung ni sngar drangs zin la/ gnyis pa ni/ zhal lung gi 'grel par/ de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pas gzhi rnam par bkod nas/ da ni rdzogs pa'i rim pas de sbyong ba'i thabs gsungs pa zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsgrub par bya ba thun mong gi dngos grub dang / mchog gi dngos grub gnyis su nges pas rim pa gnyis su nges te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ tha mal pa ni rdo rje bzhi/ /ye shes rdo rje mchog rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ bskyed par bya ba sngags kyi sku dang / ye shes kyi sku gnyis su nges pas rim pa gnyis su nges te/ zhal lung gi 'grel pa las/ dang po'i rim pas zhes pa ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa rtogs pas rang gi rgyud kyi las kyi sgrib pa'i dri ma rnam par dag par bya ste/ ye shes sgyu ma zhes pa ni ye shes cung zad dag pa'i sku ste zhes gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa ni rdzogs pa'i rim pas zab gsal gnyis med dpe'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa la bskyed rim nges par rten du dgos pas rim pa gnyis su grangs nges te/ zhal lung las/ de las lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /sdom pa mchog la gnas byas nas/ /nga 'o snyam pa'i gzi bskyed la/ /rim pa gnyis pa de nyid bsgrub/ /ces gsungs pa'i mjug tu bskyed rim bsgom tshul tshigs su bcad pa lnga gsungs nas/

de mnyes de la goms bslabs pas/ /phyi rol lus ni log byed de/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul mchog /mtha' yi de nyid bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / 'grel par/ dang por rim pa gnyis pa'i gzhi rnams dgod pa'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa gsungs pa/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa bsgom pa'i go rim ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi gdang bu lta bur gsungs/ /zhes dang / spyod bsdus sgron mer yang bskyed rim la lob nas rdzogs rim la bslab par gsungs pas bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim bsgom par bzhed cing / ḍombhi he ru ka yang de dang mthun par bzhed do/ /lugs 'di la ni bskyed rim rten tsam du byas nas/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gtso bor bsgom pa dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid kyis yang dag pa'i ye shes la dbang ba'i bar bgrod par byed pa'i lugs gnyis kyai rdor man ngag lugs dang / mtsho skyes lugs ltar bzhed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sngar rten dang brten pa'i skabs su bshad zin la/ phyi ma ni de ma thag tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rtogs pa'i rim pas bzhag pa'i gang zag la bzhi ste/ las dang po pa/ ye shes cung zad babs pa/ ye shes la dbang ba/ yang dag pa'i ye shes la dbang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang bskur ba dang bskyed pa'i rim gyi gdam ngag tshul bzhin du thob nas rags pa dang / phra ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor thams cad rim pa bzhin du bsgom dgos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rags pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor yud tsam gyis bsgom nus shing / phra ba'i sa'i snying po la sogs pa rim pa bzhin du bsgom nus pa ste/ 'di la rags pa'i lha'i bskyed chog phri nas phra ba'i lha snga ma bzhin du bsgom dgos so/ /gsum pa ni/ rags pa dang phra ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor gnyis ka yud tsam gyis bsgom nus pa ste/

'di la phra ba'i lha'i bskyed chog rnams kyang phri nas phra rags kyi lha'i rnal 'byor thams cad se gol gtogs pa tsam la cig car du rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bsgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdul phran gcig gi nang du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dogs pa med par bsgom nus pa ste/ 'di ni drod chen po mthong ba'i lam thob pa na stong gsum yungs 'brur bsdud pa la che chung med par rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis gsungs pa dang mthun par mngon no/ /des na sman pa'i zhabs kyis gang zag dang po gsum du bsdus par gsungs pa dang / so so skye bo'i gnas skabs su rtogs pa'i rim pas bzhag pa'i gang zag gsum du nges pa la dgongs te/ slob dpon 'di dang / mar me mdzad gnyis char gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon la/ gang zag dang po gsum gyi rnam gzhag kho na gsungs pa thams cad dgongs pa gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag bzhi'i rnam par gzhag pa 'di ni/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa las/ nangs par langs nas snga ma bzhin/ /legs zlos dang po'i las can yin/ /ye shes cung zad babs gyur pas/ /sngags kyi tshul khrims brtul zhugs brtan/ /mig dang sku sogs byin gyis brlabs/ /thun mtshams su ni rab bsgrims bzlas/ /ye shes cung zad dbang thob pas/ /rnam pa kun tu rab rdzogs par/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i byed pa po/ /nyin mtshan rnal 'byor yang dag bsten/ /yang dag ye shes dbang thob bsgom/ /khams kyi rdul na'ang 'khor lo mchog /gzugs can bdag nyid gzugs kyi ni/ /'gro ba'i don gyi bya ba bya/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /bzhi pa lam gyi sgrub pa'i 'bras bu la gnyis te/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bo/ /dang po la brgyad de/ rig 'dzin dang / mngon shes dang / mi snang ba dang / rgya mtsho bcag pa dang / mngags gzhug dang / sngags kyi khyad par dang /

mig sman dang / las bzhi'i rab tu dbye'o/ /gnyis pa ni yang dag pa'i ye shes la dbang thob pa/ sa dang po mthong ba'i lam nas brtsams/ gsang gsum gcig tu 'dus pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa'i bar te/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter las/ cig shos rdo rje'i gsum yin te/ /de dang de ru rab bstan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid grub dngos grub ni/ /yang dag ye shes dbang thob bo/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'bras bu mthar thug ni zab gsal gnyis med de/ grol ba'i thig le las/ zab mo kho na rtogs pas min/ /gsal ba dag kyang de bzhin no/ /de phyir thal byung zab mo yis/ /grol 'dod de la nga ma dad/ /de bas gnyis med rang bzhin du/ /rtogs pas tshe 'dir 'bras thob nges/ /rnam par rtog pa kun bral bas/ /bsam brjod yul las shin tu 'das/ /mkha' bzhin dri med kun 'byung ba/ /rtags bral zab mo nyid ces bya/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /sgyu ma 'ja' tshon lta bu ru/ /rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud sbyong ba/ /yang dag gsal ba zhes bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras/ kun mkhyen smra ba'i dbang po smra ba'i phul/ /phul byung mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs mkhyen pa'i gter/ /gter chen chos kyi mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje/ /rje btsun de ni nges don de bzhin gshegs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /spyi don drug pa paṇa chen nyi zla seṅges gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ shar mdo khams kyi paṇḍi ta/ kun mkhyen pa'i dbang po go ram bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seṅge'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin/ mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇa chen nyi zla seṅges zin bris su mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa legs bshad snying po zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud don gyi lam rim nyams su len tshul mdo tsam zhig bshad pa la don gsum ste/

bshad bya rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag 'chad byed lam srol gyi byung tshul/ bshad bya'i brjod don gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya la gzigs nas/ phar phyin theg pa dang / rdo rje theg pa gnyis gsungs pa las/ dang po la yang gdul bya'i dbang gi grub mtha' bzhi ste/ sde snod gsum theg pa gsum du gnas shing / gnyis pa la yang / rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /zhes sogs gang zag gi rim pas gsang sngags thams cad rgyud sde bzhi ru bsdus nas gsungs/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus nas rtog pa dang / bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / gnyis ka dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces lnga ru gsungs pa la sogs pa mang du yod kyang / rgya gar gyi paṇa grub phal che ba ni gsang sngags thams cad rgyud sde bzhi ru bsdud pa la mi mthun pa med pa nyid yin te/ gong gi lngar gsungs pa de yang / rtog pa'i rgyud ni las tshogs gtsor ston pa la dgongs nas zur du bgrangs pa yin gyi/ ngo bo bya rgyud dang gcig yin no zhes rje btsun rtse mo gsungs/ gnyis ka'i rgyud ni rgyud sde gzhan 'ga' zhig tu spyod rgyud la gsungs pa yod kyang / 'dir yo gar gsungs shing / rnal 'byor ni rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud do/ /don 'di lta bu la dgongs nas 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / rim lnga'i sgyu lus kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i skabs su/ rgyu sde bzhi la mkhas pa zhes gsungs so/ /spyi rnam du rje btsun rtse mos gnyis ka 'phags lugs la yod par gsungs pa'o/ /de dag gi nang nas 'di ni rnal 'byor chen por 'du ste/ de la yang gsum/ thabs gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud/ shes rab gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ thabs shes gnyis ka ston pa gnyis med kyi rgyud do/ /dang po la yang gdul bya 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba 'dod chags kyi rnam 'phrul gtso bor ston pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor/

gti mug can gtso bor 'dul ba gti mug gi rnam 'phrul gtso bor ston pa rnam snang sgyu dra'i chos skor/ zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba zhe sdang gi rnam 'phrul gtso bor ston pa gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor gsum las 'di ni dang po ste/ de la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud ji tsam gcig bzhugs snyam na/ kha cig na re/ 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bcur bzhed de/ de'ang rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ bshad rgyud ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ rdo rje phreng ba/ rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa/ gnyis med rnam rgyal/ rnam snang sgyu dra'o/ /zhes zer ro/ /der ni ma nges te/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa ni sgron gsal du lung drangs pa tsam las bod du yang ma 'gyur bas/ mdo rgyud gang yin yang mi gsal mod/ e waṃ ma ya'i bshad pa byung bas rgyud yin du chug kyang / lung drangs pa tsam gyis de'i bshad rgyud du mi 'grub ste/ sgron gsal du e waṃ ma ya la phan pa tsam zhig rgyud gzhan du yang mtshungs pa sogs skyon du ma yod do/ /gnyis med rnam rgyal ni che chung gnyis yod pa las/ che ba ni po ti long pa tsam zhig yod de rgya pho ba lung pas byas pa yin la/ chung ba rgyud yin kyang rnam snang sgyu dra dang mthun pa tsam las/ 'phags lugs la bshad rgyud du phan pa'i shes byed ci yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam snang sgyu dra ni sngar smos pa ltar pha rgyud rang rkang thub pa gcig yin gyi/ 'di'i bshad rgyud ma yin te/ grub chen kun snying gis 'di gnyis rtsa bshad du sbyar nas sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs pa yo gar bkral pa tsam ma gtogs/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub sus kyang le'u bcu bdun pa'i bshad rgyud du sgyu dra sbyar nas/ spyir bla med khyad par 'phags lugs su bkral pa med pa'i phyir ro/

/rang lugs ni 'phags lugs la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang po lnga dang / ye shes zhabs lugs la bshad rgyud phyi ma gnyis sbyor bar bzhed mod/ 'phags lugs la yang rgyud phyi ma le'u bco brgyad pa 'di zhal gyis bzhes dgos pa 'dra ste/ 'phags pa yab sras kyis rgyud phyi ma 'di gsang 'dus kyi rgyud yin par bshad pa gang zhig de'i rtsa rgyud ma yin pa'i phyir dang / rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa'i dka' gnad thams cad dri ba lnga bcu rtsa bzhir bsdus nas dris pa'i lan thams cad le'u bco brgyad pa 'dis gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ gsang ba 'dus pa thams cad kyis kyang 'di bshad rgyud du zhal gyis bzhes dgos pa 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /yang 'phags pa yab sras kyis bshad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi chings dang / rgyud phyi mar gsungs pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi chings gnyis mi mthun pas/ 'phags lugs kyi bshad rgyud du sbyor ba mi rigs so snyam na/ skyon med de/ yab sras kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi chings tshul der/ le'u bco brgyad par bshad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi chings tshul de 'dus pa yin te/ de'ang bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bcings par yan lag bzhi'i bcings par 'dus pa dang / rdzogs rim rim pa lngas bcings par 'dus pa dang / sbyor ba yan lag drug gi bcings par 'dus tshul zhib tu sgron gsal le'u bcu gnyis par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin gsum dang rim pa lngas 'chings pa ni/ rtsa rgyud la rdo rje phreng ba sbyar ba'i dgongs pa ste man ngag go /de ltar 'phags lugs la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud lnga'am drug tu bzhed pa'i rtsa bshad sbyor tshul ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las rgyan bdun gyi bshad thabs sogs bstan/ dgongs pa lung ston gyi rtsa rgyud kyi stod kyi tshig re re la yang mtha' drug tshul bzhir bshad/ lha mo bzhis zhus kyis rdzogs rim gtso bor ston/

rdo rje phreng bas dbang chog phal che ba dang / bskyed rim ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi 'chings tshul dang / rdzogs rim gyi 'chings rim pa lnga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs sum cu rtsa gnyis su byed pa sogs bstan/ rgyud phyi mas gong du smos pa ltar dris lan lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa rnams bstan te sbyor tshul rnams shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa 'chad byed lam srol byung tshul la gnyis/ rgya gar du byung tshul/ bod du byung tshul/ dang po la srol chen po bdun tsam snang ba las/ dang po srol rnams kyi rgyal po ltar gyur pa 'phags lugs byung tshul bstan pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po 'phags pa yab sras kyis gzhung ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub rang gis rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa las btus nas/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor byas pa'i lha so gnyis kyi sgrub thabs ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bcings pa'i gzhung mdor byas zhes bya ba dang / de nyid rgyud kyi lung dang sbyor zhing lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdus pa sogs ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig kha skong ba'i tshul gyis sgrub thabs mdo dang bsre ba zhes bya ba ste bskyed rim kyi gzhung gnyis/ rdzogs rim lnga dang / byang chub sems 'grel gnyis te bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung bzhi mdzad cing / yang des mdzad do zhes snga rabs pa rnams gsungs pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ de la phyis kyi mkhas pa dag 'di ni klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ma yin te/ klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang mi mthun pa mang po 'dug pa'i phyir ro gsungs pa la/ gzhan dag na re/ de ltar dpon slob kyi gzhung 'gal byung na/ slob ma'i gzhung the tshom can du shes par rigs kyi/ slob dpon gyi gzhung the tshom can du byed pa mi rigs so/ /zhes zer ba ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ dkyil chog gnyis po de'i nang nas klu byang gi dkyil chog ni rgya gar ba'i paṇa grub mang pos tshad ldan du zhal gyis bzhes pa'i phyir te/

zung 'jug gsal ba'i ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su/ grub chen klu byang gis spel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa las shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / a bha ya dang / kha che paṇa chen la sogs pas tshad ldan du mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dkyil chog dang po de klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa yin na/ klu byang dang sgra gcan 'dzin gyis de'i rjes su de dang mi mthun pa'i dkyil chog re mdzad pa'i don med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dang po the tshom can du grub bo/ /de'i sras kyi thu bo arya de was/ sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa nas 'bras bu'i bar gyi/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam rim rdzogs par ston cing / khyad par rdzogs rim gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhung le'u bcu gcig gi bdag nyid spyod bsdus sgron ma zhes bya ba dang / de'i sems dben la 'phros nas sems kyi sgrib sbyong / sgyu lus la 'phros nas bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa dang / 'od gsal la 'phros nas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa ste gzhung bzhi mdzad do/ /grub chen klu'i byang chub kyis rdul tshon la brten pa'i bum dbang yan chad kyi dkyil chog nyi shu par grags pa dang / mdor byas sbyang gzhi dang sbyor ba rnam gzhag rim pa zhes pa dang / rdzogs rim rim lnga khongs bsdus zhes bya ba ste gsum mdzad de/ phyi ma la kha cig 'di the tshom can yin te/ rim pa re'i nang du yang rim pa lnga lnga byas pa'i phyir ro gsung par grags te de ni theg pa chen po'i lugs la chos re re'i nang du yang chos thams cad 'dus par bzhed pa ste ches khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /gal te de lta bu la skyon du byas nas mi 'thad na/ phyin drug re re'i nang du phar phyin drug drug gsungs pa'ang mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ yang grub chen sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil chog dbang bzhi char tshang ba zung 'jug gsal ba zhes bya ba mdzad de/

klu byang gis dbang chog la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i tshe yang dbang gong ma gsum 'di nas kha skong ba yin no/ /slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis ni sngar gyi rim lnga'i mjug rkyang pa tsam las gzhan ma mdzad de/ de'ang rim lnga'i/ srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol 'gyur/ /zhes pa yan chad slob dpon gyis mdzad cing / de man chad slob mas mdzad nas shākya bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'o zhes byung ste/ 'di la 'khrul nas kha cig shākya bshes gnyen klu sgrub kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs su 'dod pa ni ma brtags par smra ba'o/ /de ltar yab sras lnga'i gzhung gi rgyab rten du/ dgongs pa skong ba'i slob ma zla ba grags pas rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba zhes bya ba mdzad do/ /gnyis pa de dag lam gyi rim par sgrig tshul la/ spyir gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam rim ni/ dang por sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs pas/ theg pa gsar pa la bslab ces bya ba smin byed kyi dbang bskur te/ dran pa gcig pa zhes bya ba bskyed rim bsgoms pa'i mthar lus dben sku rdo rje/ ngag dben gsung rdo rje/ sems dben thugs rdo rje/ sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pa/ 'od gsal don dam bden pa zung 'jug dang bcas pa la rim gyis slob pa yin la/ de dag rdzogs pa ni spyod bsdus sgron mes kyang ston mod/ gzhung so so'i dbang du byas na/ klu byang gi nyi shu ba dang / zung 'jug gsal bas smin byed kyi dbang bstan/ mdor byas mdo bsres rnam gzhag rim pa dang gsum gyis bskyed rim bstan/ de nas lus dben gyi mtshams sbyar te rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni rim pa lnga pas bstan cing / gzhung phran gzhan rnams ni de dag gi 'phros gzhung yin pa dang / sgron gsal ni thams cad kyi rgyab rten yin tshul gong du smos pa bzhin no/ /lam srol gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs yin no/

/slob dpon des le'u bcu bdun pa la rgyud phyi ma dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan sbyar nas/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum po de la brten nas 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso bor byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs dang / rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le la sogs pa'i gzhung bcu bzhi mdzad de 'og tu rtogs par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon de yang / dang po slob dpon seṅge bzang po la pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs bslabs te/ yon tan bshes gnyen la sogs pa'i rigs ldan rnams la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis sgo nas dar bar mdzad de/ phyis nub phyogs u rgyan du byon nas slob dpon 'jol sgeg rdo rje la gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing / yang yul de nyid du lcam legs smin dang / gu ni ni zhes bya ba'i bla ma zhig la yang gsang 'dus mang du gsan to/ /yang yul dza lendha ra na mthar slob dpon ba yo la rtsang pa ta zhes bya ba la yang chos skor de legs par gsan nas/ lho phyogs kyi yul du slob dpon bha liṃ ta a tsarya zhes bya ba mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i bla ma lo dgu'i bar zas gos kyis mnyes par byas nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bco brgyad gsan pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod kyis don ma rtogs zhes gsungs pas/ don ma rtogs pa la rtogs pa mi skye zhes dgongs nas rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su u pa tha zhes pa stag dang / dom la sogs pa gcan gzan ma rung pa gnas pa'i yul du zla ba drug rtsa rgyud kyi glegs bam mgul du btags nas bsgrub pa mdzad pas/ ston zla bar pa'i skar ma rgyal gyi nub skya rengs shar ba tsam na/ sprul pa'i dge slong bla ma gnyis 'jol sgeg rdo rje 'jam rdor dang bcas pa'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs te/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal nas 'jam dpal zhal lung du grags pa'i rdzogs rim lung bstan dang bcas pa 'di gnang ngo /

/lung bstan pa ni gzhung de'i mjug tu/ khyod kyang zas kyi bya ba dang / /nga la cung zad 'khrul rtog pas/ /tshe 'di nyid la mi 'grub ste/ /zag bcas phung por rang gzugs ni/ /yang dag gnas ni mi 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis lus 'di spangs ma thag /rnam par shes pa mi bshigs pa/ /phyag rgya chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ /des na khyod kyi yang dag blos/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /gsang ba gsang chen ches gsang ba/ /gong na med pa'i lung chen po/ /de yi rim pa dang po yi/ /sgrub thabs bzang dang sbyin sreg gnyis/ /gtor ma sna tshogs 'khor lo dang / /bsdus pa dang ni rnam bshad dang / /dkyil 'khor cho ga la sogs pa/ /mi shes mun pas kheb 'dra ba'i/ /thur ma lta bu brtsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhung de dag gi grangs la mi mthun pa du ma snang yang / de'i 'grel pa sman zhabs kyis mdzad pa las/ rim pa dang po ni sgrub pa'i thabs 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /sgrub thabs bzang ni kun tu bzang mo gsum mo/ /sbyin sreg ni sbyin sreg gi cho ga gnyis so/ /gtor ma ni mi nub pa'i sgron me'o/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo ni tshogs 'khor chen mo'o/ /bsdus pa ni rin po che 'bar ba'o/ /rnam bshad ni ma mdzad do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni nyis brgya lnga bcu pa gcig mdzad kyang bla mas dpe kha cher bsnams nas bdag gis ni ma mthong ngo / /sogs kyi sgras bsdus pa ni/ rtsa ba'i ye shes chen mo dang / tshigs su bcad pa mdzod dang / grol ba'i thig le dang / bdag grub par bsgrub pa dang / byang chub sems kyi thig le dang / bkra shis kyi rnam bshad chen mo dang / bzhi pa la 'jug pa thabs dang bcas pa dang / chu sbyin dbang po'i sgrub thabs gsum ste/ de ltar na lung dang mthun pa'i gzhung bcu bzhi mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /'o na ding sang 'di'i dbang chog gang la byed snyam na sman zhabs kyi 'khor bcas su/

rang gi grwa pa'i tshogs nas rgyal tshab kyi sar 'os pa'i slob ma bco brgyad kyi nang nas bden pa mthong ba ni/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje bde ba chen po dang bzhi yod pa las/ kho bo ni dang po'i rjes su 'brang ste bla ma chen po'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i steng nas byed do/ /srol gsum pa ni slob dpon shanti pas rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog ces bya ba mdzad pa yin te/ slob dpon 'dis slob dpon sman zhabs dang / rgyal sras sa 'dres pa gnyis la zhus pa yin kyang / de gnyis dang mi mthun pa mi bskyod pa gtso bor byas pa'i lha nyer lngar byed pa dang / lta ba sems tsam du bkral pa sogs grub mtha' du ma yod do/ /srol bzhi pa ni paṇḍi ta smrirtis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rang 'gyur du mdzad pa zhig yod pa de yin te/ de'ang bla ma bzang po'i zhabs zhes pa la zhus pa yin no/ /lam srol lnga pa ni shanti pa'i sku tshe'i smad la shambha la nas dus 'khor byung ba'i dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan gyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba de yin te/ de'ang dus 'khor gsang 'dus ltar bkral pa ni ma yin gyi/ gsang 'dus dus 'khor ltar bkral pa yin te/ dus 'khor ba'i bzhed pas gsang sngags thams cad dus 'khor ltar 'grel bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /srol drug pa ni slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa gling gzhi ma rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba gcig yod do/ /lam srol bdun pa ni grub chen kun snying gis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa la byed de/ de'ang slob dpon 'dis ni rgyud 'di dang /

rnam snang sgyu dra dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rnams yo gar bkral pa'i lugs yin no/ /gnyis pa bod du lam srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su paṇḍi ta shrardha ka ra warma la/ lo chen rin bzang gis spyir gsang sngags khyad par 'dus pa rnam gnyis zhus shing / de'i nang nas kyang gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang / ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis ka'i dbang bka' sogs zhus kyang / 'phags lugs ni da lta chad nas med do/ /de'i sku tshe'i mjug tu jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i dus mgar dge ba rab gsal la 'dus pa'i dbang khrid bshad bka' gnang ba ni ding sang med la/ 'jam rdor gyi rigs pas spyan ras gzigs gtso bor byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bka' sogs gnang ba ni ding sang yang bzhugs so/ /lha bcu dgu po de yang rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan la rigs lnga yum bzhi khro bo bzhi ste bcu gsum las med kyang / gleng gzhi nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje ma drug bsnan pa la 'dod cing / gtso bor 'jam rdor dang spyan ras gzigs kyang 'khor gyi sems dpa' der bcug pa ni ma yin gyi/ rang rkang ba re logs nas spyan drangs pa yin par bzhed la/ de'i tshe rigs lnga ma tshang ba'i nyes pa'ang med de/ 'jam rdor gyi tshe mi bskyod pa rigs bdag tu bteg cing / spyan ras gzigs kyi tshe 'od dpag med rigs bdag tu bzhugs te/ de'i shul du mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa yin no/ /yang bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas rgya gar du ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma la ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang bka' gsan pa yang deng sang sa skya pa la bzhugs so/ /yang jo bo rje phebs pa'i rjes su bla chen 'brog mi rgya gar du byon te rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas par mdzad nas phebs te gsang ba 'dus pa rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can la gsan pa yin yang deng sang chad nas med do/ /de'i sku tshe'i mjug tsam la rje 'gos lo tsā ba khug pa lhas btsas kyis rgya gar la lan gsum byon te/

de'i bar la mi'i bla ma bdun cu mkha' 'gro ma'i bla ma gnyis te bdun cu rtsa gnyis la gtugs skad/ de dag gi nang nas gsang ba 'dus pa ni/ bla ma mngon shes can/ btsun mo can/ rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa/ rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can te bzhi la zhus so/ /de nas bod du bla ma dang po gsum gyi dgongs pa bkod pa'i stong thun chen mo dang / rim lnga'i dka' gnad logs su bkod pa bla ma gsum gyi shog ril gsum dang / bla ma bzhi ka'i dgongs pa sgron gsal gyi steng du mchan la bkod pa/ sgron gsal mchan chen du grags pa rnams mdzad cing bshad do/ /de'i slob ma rdog ye shes seṅges kyang gong gi de las bsdus pa'i stong thun dang / sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa yang mdzad cing / gzhan yang slob brgyud rnams kyis stong thun sogs kyi yig cha du ma mdzad pa yod do/ /de lta bu'i lo tsā ba de la rgyud kyi ka chen tshugs pa'i slob ma bzhi/ man ngag gi gdung chen theg pa brgyad/ las tshogs dang lag len la mkhas pa lcam dang dral ma bshibs pa ltar byung ste/ 'dus pa'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad do/ /de nas sa skya pa la brgyud tshul la/ rje 'gos kyi 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la/ des pū ra a skyabs la/ des sa skya pa chen po la gnang ba gcig dang / 'gos la dbus pa dge ser gyis/ de la gnam kha'ub pas/ de la rje sa chen gyis gsan te gnyis byung ngo / /de nas 'phags pa rin po che'i bar du byung ste/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dang / de'i slob ma dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal sogs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyang yod do/ /de nas rje rdo rje 'chang gi bar du byon pa'i rdog lugs kyi dbang bka' ni da lta chad pa 'dra'o/ /da lta ni klu byang gi nyi shu pa dang / sgra gcan 'dzin gyi zung 'jug gsal ba'i lugs paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud de/ chos rje sa paṇa la babs pa'i dbang rgyud 'di yin no/
