/yang 'gos dang dus mnyam du rje btsun mar pa lo tsā bas rgya gar du byon te/ rje btsun na ro ta pa la 'dus pa'i chos skor sogs gsan nas bod du byon te/ khong gi lugs kyi gsang 'dus la mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i lugs dang / ku sa li'i lugs gnyis su byas nas/ dang po sgron gsal dang / spyod bsdus kyi steng nas rim gyis pa'i lam rim du bzhed/ gnyis pa rim lnga gdan rdzogs sam nag khrid ces bya ba mdzad de/ sangs rgyas lag bcang ma'i man ngag gang zag gcig car ba'i lam yin zhes bzhed cing / 'di khong gi slob ma rgya pho ba lung pa dang / gser sding pa nas brgyud de deng sang yang yod do/ /kha cig gi 'di dang klu sgrub kyi rim lnga gnyis bsres nas khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa byas pa ni/ bka' srol dang lam rim gyi khyad par tsam yang ma phye ba'o/ /gzhan yang chag lo dang lcang lo sogs nas brgyud pa byung mod/ deng sang ni chad nas mi snang ngo / /de ltar bod du gsang ba 'dus pa'i srol 'dzin pa du ma byung yang / srol 'dzin rnams kyi rgyal po ni 'gos yab sras rnams su shes par bya'o/ 'di man chad gsang 'dus kyi chos 'byung tshul rang du mi snang yang rgyud man ngag gi brjod bya sngags rim gtan la 'bebs pa la shin tu legs pa zhig 'dug pas bris pa lags/ gsum pa de ltar ngos bzung ba'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud de dag lam srol de dag gis bshad pa'i brjod bya'i don gtan la dbab pa la/ 'dir gtso bor 'phags pa yab sras kyi bzhed pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud don thams cad don bzhir bsdus nas 'chad de/ de yang rgyud 'di la dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'jug tu rung ba'i rten gyi gang zag des blang dor gyi dngos po yongs su shes pa'i spyod yul/ des nyams su blang bar bya ba gnyen po lam gyi rim pa/ sa bcad 'di'i don rgyas par shes par 'dod na nyi zla bla ma seṅge'i mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad legs bshad snying po zhes bya bar blta bar gyis shig kho bos byas pa'i bstan bcos 'dir ni rnam bshad de nyid kyi dbu na bzhugs pa'i lugs 'di'i chos byung tshul nyid bsdus pa'o/

/des blang pa las byung ba 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag go /dang po ni gsung rab spyi nas bshad pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag thun mong ba rnams kyang 'dir 'jug mod/ 'di rang nas bshad pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag ni lngar mdzad de/ utpal lta bu'i gang zag padma dkar po lta bu'i gang zag padma dmar po lta bu'i gang zag tsanda lta bu'i gang zag rin po che lta bu'i gang zag go /de la gang zag dang po'i mtshan nyid ni gsum ste/ thos pa che ba/ don zin pa/ de ma thag tu tshig don gnyis ka brjed pa'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid kyang gsum ste/ dang po gnyis gong ltar la tshig don gzhan la ston mi nus pa'o/ /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid ni dad pa che ba/ snying rje che ba/ thos pa che ba/ thos don de ma thag brjed par 'gyur ba ste bzhi yin no/ /gang zag bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid ni lnga ste/ thos pa chung ba/ nga rgyal che ba/ don gyi rtsa ba med pa/ tshig gi spros pa mang ba/ don gang zag gzhan gyis zin par mi nus pa'o/ /lnga pa ni rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid la bdun te/ tshul khrims dag pa/ mkhas la bsgrin pa ste khong grung ba/ shes rab che ba/ rgyud gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/ thos pa che ba/ don gzhan la ston nus pa'o/ /'o na de lta bu'i gang zag lnga char gyis rgyud 'di la nyan bshad sgrub gsum byar rung ngam snyam na/ nges pa med de/ de la gang zag dang po dang gsum pa gnyis kyis ni bag chags tsam gzhag pa'i phyir du nyan du rung gi bshad sgrub byar mi rung ste tshig brjed nas med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dang bzhi pas ni nyan pa dang sgrub par rung gi bshad par mi rung ste dang pos tshig don ston mi nus shing / gnyis pas don bstan kyang 'dzin mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag lnga pas ni thams cad du rung bar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa blang dor gyi dngos po yongs su shes par bya ba'i spyod yul ni bden pa gnyis yin te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/

sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang / /dam pa'i don gyi bden pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ spyir theg pa chen po'i lugs la shes bya'i gtso bo thams cad bden pa gnyis su 'dus shing / khyad par rgyud 'dir dang por bden pa gnyis so sor bstan nas/ mthar thug zung 'jug tu grub pa 'bras bur gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i bden pa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag cung zad brjod na/ re zhig bden gnyis so sor bstan pa dang / mthar thug bden gnyis dbyer med du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis kyi/ dang po kun rdzob bden pa'i ngo bo ni 'dir rlung sems tsam ste/ de yang byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po rlung gi bzhon pa can de thog ma med pa'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i dbang gis phyi rol gyi snang ba sna tshogs su snang zhing zhen pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phar phyin theg par phyi rol gyi snang ba la kun rdzob bden par bzhag kyang / 'dir de'i 'khrul gzhi rlung tsam la 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / rlung sems tsam de mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sgyu lus su grub pa'i tshe snang ba thams cad de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das so zhes shes par bya ba la sogs pa'i dgos pa yin no/ /gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dgongs pa yin par ma rtogs pa kha cig gis dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' thun mong ma yin pa sbyar nas/ phyi rol gyi snang ba lta zhog gi sgrub pa po rang gi lus kyang bzhag nas/ de las logs su rlung sems tsam las mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku 'grub par 'dod pa ni ches 'khrul ba'o/ /gnyis pa don dam par bden pa'i ngo bo ni/ thog ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba gang du yang mi dmigs shing nam mkha'i dbyings ltar gnas pa de yin te/ rtsa rgyud le'u bco lnga pa las/

byang chub sems dpas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos ni gang la gnas/ gang las byung / bka' stsal pa/ lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rje las byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems gang la gnas/ nam mkha' la gnas so/ /nam mkha' gang la gnas/ gang la yang mi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs shing / byang chub sems kyi le'ur/ rigs lnga'i byang chub kyi sems so sor gsungs pas kyang 'di ston pa yin no/ /de yang rang gi ngo bo 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyis so so rang rig pas gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis nyams su myong ba tsam yin yang / gdul bya dman pa rnams kyis rtogs pa'i don du tha snyad tsam du gcig du bral la sogs pa'i sgo nas dbu ma pa'i gzhung lugs ltar gtan la 'bebs par byed do/ /'di rdzogs rim du nyams su len pa'i tshe na sgyu lus kyi 'og gi 'od gsal gyi ngo bo nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa bden gnyis dbyer med du bsgrub pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral yang / rang gi ngo bo mi dor bar zung 'jug tu gnas pa yin kyang / glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas ma shes pa de sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gyis so sor shes par byas nas ngo bo zung 'jug tu byed pa yin no/ /de yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam gnyis/ /so so'i char ni shes gyur nas/ /gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pas/ /zung du 'jug pa des bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /gsum pa de nyams su blang bya gnyen po lam rim la/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces gsungs pas/ smin byed kyi lam dang / grol byed kyi lam gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis/ smin byed la 'jug pa'i yan lag dang / smin byed kyi lam dngos so/ /dang po la bzhi/ rgyu rkyen khyad par can/

bdag po'i rkyen khyad par can/ lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen khyad par can/ dmigs pa'i rkyen khyad par can no/ /dang po ni/ gang la dbang bskur ba'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ de yang sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslabs pas rgyud sbyangs pas te/ 'dis dbang bskur zhing dam tshig 'bog par 'os pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang gis dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ de'ang slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni rgyud tha dad nas mang du gsungs kyang / 'dir rnam snang sgyu dra las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing / /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /de ni slob dpon yin zhes bya/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sngags/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin te/ de yang rang bzhin rgyud kyi khyad par dang / 'dus byas yon tan gyi khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis bstan cing / gnyis pa ni de'i 'og ma gsum gyis bstan la/ rkang pa rjes ma gsum ni go sla'o/ /gsum pa ni slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga mtshan nyid dang ldan pa byas pa ste/ de la bzhi/ sngon du 'gro ba'i bsnyen pa/ sa'i cho ga sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba'o/ /dang po gsum ni go sla la/ bzhi pa dam tshig pa bri ba'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa/ de la mchod pa bya ba/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa ste bzhir gnas so/ /bzhi pa ni slob dpon gyi mchog mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ de slob ma la bstan par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la dbye na dbang bka' rnying ma ba rnams kyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor/

ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gsum du 'dod/ /klu byang gis/ slob ma'i don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo rnam brgyad bri bar bya/ /rin chen de bzhin sa bon dang / /me tog tshon dang de bzhin du/ /bye ma g.yo dang phye ma dang / /de bzhin yid kyi dkyil 'khor bden/ /zhes brgyad du gsungs te/ de yang rin chen ni rin po che'i tshon gyis bris pa/ sa bon ni 'bras la sogs pa'i phye mas bris pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /me tog ni go sla/ tshon ni rtsi tshon gyis ras la bris pa/ bye ma g.yo ba ni rang bzhin zhib pa'i bye ma dkar po tshon gyis kha bsgyur pas bris pa/ phye ma ni cong zi la sogs pa zhib par btags nas kha bsgyur pas bris pa/ yid kyi dkyil 'khor ni ting nge 'dzin gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar sprul pa/ bden pa'i dkyil 'khor ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor te/ de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor drug ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gcig lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang brgyad yin no/ /gnyis pa smin byed dngos la/ bka' rnying pas bzhir mdzad de/ de yang dam tshig dang sdom pa phog pa/ slob ma gzhug cing dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ dbang bskur ba sngags dang phyag rgya bstan pa'o/ /snga rabs pa de dag phal che bas/ rdo rje phreng ba nas bde mchog gi dbang dang / 'di'i dbang gi chings bstan pa gnyis so sor ma phye bar/ 'dir yang mi bskyod pa chu dbang du byas pa ni/ yab sras kyi gzhung dang 'gal te/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i chu dbang gi skabs su/ de nas brtag par bsam la zhes rnam snang du bsgom pa dngos su bshad cing / nyi shu pa'i chu'i skabs su mi gsal kyang ming dbang gi skabs su/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin bsgoms nas/ /zhes mi bskyod par bshad pas rnam snang chu dbang du 'grub la/ sgron gsal le'u bcu drug par yang rnam snang chu dbang sogs su rgyu mtshan dang bcas te bshad pa'i phyir ro/

/bka' gsar pa 'di pa'i lugs ni/ klu byang gis bum dbang yan chad la zung 'jug gsal ba'i dbang gong ma gsum dang / sgron gsal gyi skabs 'ga' zhig gis kha bskangs nas smin byed kyi lam 'don pa yin te/ de'ang dkyil chog nyi shu pa'i sdom gyi rim pa bzhin mdzad pa las/ sdom ni/ dang por sa ni sbyangs pa dang / /de nas sa yongs 'dzin pa dang / /phyi nas bgegs ni nyer zhi dang / /thod lo skor gyi thig gdab dang / /de nas sa lha sogs lhag par/ /gnas dang de nas gsol btab dang / /phyi nas slob ma lhag gnas dang / /nam mkhar thig gi gdab pa dang / /tshon sna lnga yi cho ga dang / /tshon rtsi rnams ni dge ba dang / /lha rnams spyan drangs nyid dang ni/ /de nas slob ma gzhug pa dang / /khrus kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga dang / /de nas sangs rgyas dbang bskur dang / /de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskur dang / /lha dang bla ma yon gnyis dang / /rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa dang / /de nas gshegs gsol cho ga dang / /dkyil 'khor las byed phur bu dang / /skud pa bsdu ba nyid kyang ste/ /rab mchog cho ga nyi shu yi/ /ji ltar ji ltar rgyas shes pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa pa yin te/ de'i cho ga dang po bcu gcig ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba yin la/ de nas bdun ni slob ma la bya ba yin zhing / rjes ma gnyis mjug gi bya ba yin par shes par bya ste/ de dag gis lha rnams spyan drangs zhes pa'i skabs su sgron gsal le'u brgyad pa'i bdag mdun tha mi thad du bsgrub tshul sbyar/ sangs rgyas dbang bskur gyi skabs su sgron gsal le'u bcu drug par bshad pa'i lus dkyil dang nang dbang byed tshul rnams sbyar/ rjes gnang gi skabs su zung 'jug gsal ba'i dbang gong ma bskur tshul sbyar bas 'phags lugs kyi dbang chog yongs su rdzogs pa zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa grol byed kyi lam ni/

bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis su 'dus te/ rgyud phyi ma las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis der bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la thun mong ba'i bsnyen pa dang / mchog gi bsnyen pa zhes pa'i tha dad kyang bya ste/ de nyid las/ thun mong mchog gi bye brag gi /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /tha mal pa ni rdo rje bzhi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i rdo rje bzhi ni/ dang po stong pa'i byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru bkod/ /ces pas bstan pa'i bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi yin la/ ye shes bdud rtsi ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni rjes dran dang / /zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug go /de'i bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi po de rgyas par bstan pa'ang / de nyid las/ bsnyen pa'i dam tshig sbyor ba yi/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /nye bar bsgrub pa bsgrub chen po/ /rdo rje'i skye mched thams cad nyid/ /sngags kyi bdag po bsgom pa na/ /bsgrub pa'i tshe na bskul bar gsungs/ /bsgrub pa chen po byed pa'i tshe/ /dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag bsam/ /rdo rje rnam snang 'di dag gi /tha mal bsgrub pa'i bsnyen pa bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ yan lag bzhi pa 'di kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs dang / gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs pas ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa sogs bzhi la sbyor la/ 'dir ni dang po'i mgon po bskyed pa sogs bzhi la sbyor ro/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs la thun mong dang mchog gi bsnyen pa zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis bskyed rim gyis thun mong bsgrub pa dang / rdzogs rim gyis mchog bsgrub pa zhes gsungs pa yang thun mong ba'i dngos grub bsgrub pa la bskyed rim dgos pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyis/

bskyed rim gyis thun mong tsam las mchog mi 'grub pa ni ma yin te/ bskyed rim ni gzugs sku'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i rim pa gnyis po de la yang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas te/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi gdang bu lta bur gsungs/ /zhes sogs bskyed rim sngon du song ba'i dbang du mdzad nas ngag dben nas brtsams te rim pa lngar mdzad/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas sgron gsal du/ bskyed rim la rim pa gcig tu byas nas lus dben dang ngag dben sems dben du bsdus te rim pa lngar mdzad/ 'phags pa lhas spyod bsdus su rim pa dgur mdzad de/ de yang sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa la bslab pa/ theg pa gsar pa la dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rigs kyi dbye bas lus rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ a l̥ ka l̥'i bdag nyid ngag rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ sems rnam par dag pa sems rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyi nye bar mtshon pa'i kun rdzob sgyu lus la bslab pa/ ril por 'dzin pa dang rjes su bshig pa'i rnam pas don dam 'od gsal la bslab pa/ mthar bden gnyis zung 'jug la bslab pa'o/ /de las de dag gi dang po ni/ byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud sbyangs nas dbang gi snod du rung bar byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni dbang bskur te dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rim la dran pa rtse gcig pas bslab pa'o/ /gsum pa ni phra thig gi rnal 'byor la bslab pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni sbyang gzhi thams cad rigs brgyar phye nas de sbyong byed kyi lha so gnyis kyang rigs brgyar phye ste bsgom/ de la goms pa na rigs lngar bsgom/ de'ang goms pa na gsang chen rigs gcig tu bsdus nas thugs rdo rje lta bu bsgom pa'o/

/de lta bu'i lus dben 'di 'phags pa klu sgrub dang slob dpon gyis rim pa gang gi khongs su bsdus kyi gsal kha mi gsungs kyang / 'phags pa lhas skabs 'dir bsgom par gsungs la snga rabs pa rnams kyi bskyed rdzogs ri dang 'tshams pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad mod/ 'di rang gi ngo bo ni bskyed rim gyi phyogs su gtogs te/ sbyang gzhi lha zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgom pa tsam la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /bsdu ba'i tshe na rdzogs rim gyi phyogs su bsdu dgos te/ rdzogs rim sgom pa'i tshe 'di la lha'i rnal 'byor nges par dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa ni rlung 'jug gnas ldang gsum po rdo rje gsum gyi bzlas par nam shar gyi bar du bsgom pa'o/ /drug pa ni snang mched thob gsum gyi rim pas gnyis snang gi rtog pa rnam dag gi bar du bsgom pa'o/ /bdun pa ni gong gi dben pa gsum gyis bsgrub pa'i rdo rje gsum po de mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgrub pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni sku de la yang bden 'dzin gyi dri ma cung zad yod pa rnams 'od gsal stong pa nyid du sbyong ba'o/ /dgu pa ni de ltar 'od gsal stong pa nyid las langs pa'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i ngo bo can du byed pa'o/ /de ltar rim pa lnga dang dgu la sogs par phye yang / nyams su blang bya'i gtso bo ni rim pa gnyis su 'du la/ zhes pa de rnams kyis nyi zla seṅges gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ kun khyab khyab bdag gangs can bstan pa'i gtso/ /ma lus lus can kun skyabs sa skya pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin 'dzin mar byon dkon mang byon pa'i/ /ngo mtshar mtshar ba'i gtam 'di e ma ho/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don bdun pa rjes 'jug mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/

bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srol lhad med spyi dang / bye brag thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i skyes chen dam pa rgyal ba'i lung bstan bsnyes pa'i rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin no/ /mgon po de'i slob bu bzod pa'i phar phyin las byung ba'i skal bzang mchog gi lus rten la rnam dpyod kyi bzhin ras shin tu dwangs pas mdzes shing / don gnyer yid tu 'ong ba'i mig gis rnam par spras pa'i skyes bu gang gis zin bris su byas pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul bshad pa'i gsung zin bris 'di la sbyar byang mi snang yang / mjug byang du gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos 'byung 'di ni mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa bdag chen chu mig pa chen po blo gros dbang phyug pas mdzad par gda'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ de bzhin du rjes su dpag pa'i blos rig par bya'o/ /rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen gyir gsal byed sum cu so bzhi'i mtha' can gyis rgyud sde stong phrag sum cu so bzhi gsungs par gyur pa de rnams kyi nang nas/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba'i phyir/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po de nyid 'dus don cung zad gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la/ spyi don dang / skabs kyi don gnyis/ spyi'i don la rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod pa dang / rgyud sde gsum du 'dod pa dang / bzhir 'dod pa dang / lngar 'dod pa dang / drug tu 'dod pa dang / bdun du 'dod pa dang / dgur 'dod pa'o/ /dang po ni a bha ya ka ra'i lugs te/ phyi dang nang du dbye bas rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod pa dang / gnyis pa ni slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i lugs te/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de rgyud sde gsum du 'dod pa dang /

rang lugs la yang yo ga rnal 'byor gyi chos skor 'chad pa'i gnas skabs su rgyud sde gsum du zhal gyis bzhes/ gsum pa ni rje btsun birwa pa yab sras kyi bzhed pas kyai rdo rje'i chos skor rgyud gsum dang bcas pa 'chad pa'i skabs su/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud te rgyud sde bzhir 'dod/ bzhi pa ni 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi bzhed pas/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud ltar/ rgyud sde lngar 'dod de/ bya ba'i rgyud/ rtog pa'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ gnyis ka'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang lngar 'dod do/ /lnga pa ni rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba'i lugs la drug tu 'dod de/ de yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i/ rnal 'byor gyi/ rnal 'byor bla med la/ pha bla na med pa'i/ ma bla na med pa'i/ ma yi yang ma bla na med pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po ste rgyud sde drug go /rang lugs la yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud dang / sgrub thabs la sogs pa 'chad pa'i skabs su zhal gyis bzhes/ drug pa ni jo bo rje'i lam sgron gyi 'grel par rgyud sde bdun du 'dod pa dang / rgyud sde dgur 'dod pa ni rnying ma ba rnams kyi lugs yin te/ rang lugs la bdun du 'dod pa dang / dgur 'dod pa zhal gyis mi bzhes/ de rnams kyi nang nas rgyud sde lngar 'dod pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lugs nyid yin te/ de la bya ba'i rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ dpung bzang la sogs pa rnams yin te/ rtog pa'i rgyud ni/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi bye brag tu gyur pa'i 'phrin las dang / thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs rnams ston pa yin/ rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud ni/ spyod pa'i rgyud do/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud ni de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud yin la/

rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i pha rgyud rnams yin la/ de nyid 'dus pa la gnyis ka'i rgyud ces bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ phyi'i bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra dang nye reg la sogs pa ston pas bya rgyud dang mthun/ lha bskyed pa dang / ye shes pa gzhug pa dang / dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du mar la mar bzhag pa dang / chu la chu bzhag pa ltar rnal 'byor bla na med pa dang mthun pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na sangs rgyas gsang bas spyod rgyud la gnyis ka'i rgyud du bzhed pa ni/ phyi lus ngag gi spyod pa bya ba'i rgyud dang mthun pa dang / nang ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bya ba rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun pa'i phyir/ /'o na 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyis rgyud sde bzhir zhal gyis mi bzhes pa yin nam snyam na/ bsdus nas rgyud sde bzhir yang 'dod pa yin te/ rtog pa'i rgyud bya ba'i rgyud kyi khongs su sdud pa dang / 'dod chags sogs rigs bzhi'i gnyen por rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa dang / gsang 'dus rim lnga'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i gnas skabs su/ rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi la mkhas par byas nas gsungs pa dang / 'di la bu rin po ches/ bshad rgyud rnam pa bzhi yin gsungs kyang / rang lugs la bya rgyud sogs rgyud sde bzhi po yin no/ /'o na rnal 'byor rgyud de nyid pha rgyud yin byas nas/ ma rgyud zhal gyis mi bzhes pa ni ma yin te/ pha rgyud gtso che zhing ma rgyud zhar byung gi tshul du 'dod pa yin te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud de la dbye ba la/ gzhan lugs dgag pa dang / rang lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la bu rin po che pas/ ma rgyud la sgo bdun yod pa bzhin du/ pha rgyud la yang sgo bdun gyi dbye ba mdzad de/

mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi rgyud/ rnam snang gi rigs kyi/ rin 'byung gi rigs kyi/ 'od dpag med kyi rigs kyi/ don grub kyi rigs kyi/ rigs drug gi gtso bo bsdus pa'i rigs kyi rgyud/ rigs drug cha mnyam gyi rgyud do/ /bye brag tu mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi rgyud la/ mi bskyod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud/ mi bskyod pa'i khro bo'i rigs kyi rgyud/ mi bskyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rigs kyi rgyud do/ /de rnams kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud brgyad dang bcas pa ni/ mi bskyod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud do/ /gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag 'jigs byed rnams ni/ mi bskyod pa'i khro bo'i rigs kyi rgyud/ 'khor lo chen po'i rgyud che chung bzhi bcu zhe gnyis tsam bzhugs pa rnams ni/ mi bskyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rigs kyi rgyud/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnam snang gi rigs kyi rgyud/ rin 'byung gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ nam mkha'i snying po'i rgyud yin te/ 'di bod du ma 'gyur gsungs/ /'od dpag med kyi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ bde chen ral gcig gi rgyud yin/ don grub kyi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ kun tu bzang po'i rgyud yin te/ 'di yang bod du ma 'gyur gsungs/ rigs thams cad gtso bo bsdus pa'i rgyud/ rigs drug cha mnyam pa'i rgyud ni/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud yin gsungs/ 'di yang kha cig gis ma rgyud du 'dod pa yod kyang mi 'thad de/ dpa' bo zla gsang thig le las/ /zhes dpa' bo'i sgras bstan pas pha rgyud yin gsungs/ de ltar khyed kyis ma rgyud la sgo bdun gyi dbye ba byas pa ltar du/ pha rgyud la yang sgo bdun gyi dbye ba byed pa mi 'thad de/ snga rabs pa rnams dang / 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung rnams su bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang rin 'byung gi rigs kyi rgyud dang /

don grub kyi rigs kyi rgyud dang / rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi rgyud gsum po bod du ma 'gyur gsungs pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'di lta bu bsgyur du med pa'i phyir/ bye brag tu mi bskyod pa'i rigs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ khro bo'i rigs/ byang chub sems dpa'i rigs dang gsum du dbye ba ni/ bya rgyud kyi shan bkab pa yin gyi/ bya rgyud la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ padma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ nor bu'i rigs la sogs pa'i dbye ba yod kyang / rnal 'byor bla med la 'di lta bu'i dbye ba gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir na mi 'thad do/ /gnyis pa rang gi lugs la snga rabs pa rnams kyis pha rgyud sde gsum du gzhag pa ltar/ zla gsang thig le las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor/ zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor/ gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud/ 'di'i mtshan gzhi 'dzin lugs la/ snyos lo tsā bas dang po gnyis 'dra ba la/ gti mug can rjes su gzung ba la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud yin gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ mtshan gzhi ngos ma zin par 'dug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa skabs kyi don la sbyar ba la/ bye brag tu dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi dbye ba bshad pa/ de ma rgyud las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul/ de la bshad srol ji ltar byung tshul lo/ /dang po la rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud gnyis so/ /rtsa rgyud ni le'u bcu bdun pa yan chad yin/ bshad rgyud la bzhir 'dod pa dang / drug tu 'dod pa dang / drug tu 'dod pa gnyis pa'i lugs dang / brgyad du 'dod pa dang bzhi'o/ /dang po bzhir 'dod pa ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud/ dgongs pa lung ston/

bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus dang bzhi'o/ /'di rang lugs la yang zhal gyis bzhes so/ /gnyis pa bu rin po che'i lugs la bshad rgyud drug gam brgyad du 'dod pa las/ drug tu 'dod pa ni gong gi bzhi po'i steng du/ gnyis med rnam rgyal/ pha rgyud rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud do/ /gsum pa drug tu 'dod pa gnyis pa'i lugs ni/ gong gi bzhi po'i steng du/ bla ma rin chen pas lha'i dbang pos zhus pa'i rgyud/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud phyi ma dang drug tu 'dod la/ snga ma ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud yin te/ sgron gsal du e waṃ ma ya'i 'chad pa'i skabs su lung du drangs shing tshad mar byas pa'i phyir/ rgyud phyi ma yang bshad rgyud yin te/ de nyid du lung du yang dang yang du drangs don yang dag par bshad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa brgyad du 'dod pa ni gong gi drug po'i steng du/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa dang / gsang 'dus kyi rgyud phyi ma dang brgyad do/ /de la gnyis med rnam rgyal gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud du 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ de nyid rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i chos skor ston byed yin la/ gsang 'dus kyi chos skor mi ston par 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis med rnam rgyal gsar pa bu ston pas 'gyur mdzad pa de/ rgya pho ba lung pas gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal brdzus ma gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbye bas dkyil 'khor sum cu so gnyis bzos nas po ti bam gcig yod pa de bsub pa'i phyir du mdzad pa yin gsungs/ gzhan yang lha'i dbang pos zhus pa'i rgyud 'di nyid/ brtag gnyis kyi'ang bshad rgyud du 'gyur te/ de nyid du lung drangs shing tshad mar byas pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang 'di nyid 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi mgor gleng gzhir e waṃ ma ya 'chad pa'i skabs su lung du drangs shing tshad mar byas so snyam na/ 'o na mdo rin chen phung po dang / brgyad stong pa dang /

sangs rgyas phal po che rnams kyang gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud du 'gyur te/ de nyid du lung drangs shing tshad mar byas pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyang dus 'khor bshad rgyud du 'gyur te/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud du/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bar de nyid lung du drangs shing de nyid kyi don yang dag par bshad pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud phyi ma dang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud gnyis gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs pas bshad rgyud du 'dod kyang / 'phags lugs pas bshad rgyud du 'dod mi dgos te/ dper na bde mchog sdom 'byung dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gnyis/ spyir bde mchog pa'i bshad rgyud yin kyang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha' bas bshad rgyud du khas mi len pa bzhin no/ /rang lugs la thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud gnyis/ thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud ni/ lha mo bzhis zhus dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba gnyis/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud ni/ tshig gi cha ston par byed pa dgongs pa lung ston pa/ don gyi cha ston par byed pa ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa yin no/ /rdo rje phreng ba las bde mchog dril bu pa'i lus dkyil dang / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa ston par byed pas bde mchog dang thun mong ba yin/ lha mo bzhis zhus ni/ rtsa dang khams la sogs pa ston pas ma rgyud tsam dang thun mong yin no/ /gnyis pa ma rgyud las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ khyed ma rgyud pa las dbang dus su mtshon par byed pa'i ye shes kyi rgyun lam dus su skyong bar byed pa'i lam zab mo rgya chung ba gcig yod pa yin la/ de ni nged pha rgyud pa la yang yod de/ de'i steng du zab pa dang rgya che ba'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ sgyu lus dang / 'od gsal dang /

zung 'jug gi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang khyed ma rgyud pa ni rang rang gi rgyud kyi sgo nas bstod pa dang bcas pa yin la/ nged pha rgyud pa ni rgyud gzhan gyi sgo nas bstod pa dang bcas pa yin te/ dgra nag dang gshed dmar las/ 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje'i gshed/ /brtul zhugs mthar thug sangs rgyas thod/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang mar pa lo tsās rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gtum mo rlung gi rnal 'byor te/ /bde chen byang chub sems kyis so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang / khyod ma rgyud pa la gtum mo'i lam yod pa'i dod du/ nged pha rgyud pa'i rlung gi rnal 'byor yin/ yang khyed ma rgyud pa la dbang gsum pa'i lam yod pa'i dod du/ nged pha rgyud pa la yang sems dben yod la/ de'i steng du yang sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug gsum gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bshad srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi bshad srol/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i bshad srol/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i bshad srol/ shanti pa'i bshad srol/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i bshad srol/ paṇḍi ta smrirti'i bshad srol lo/ /dang po ni/ gong gi bshad rgyud bzhi rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang rtsa bshad du sbyar ba la brten nas gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor ston pa yin/ gnyis pa ye shes zhabs lugs pa ni/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud gnyis bshad rgyud du byas pa dang / rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang rtsa bshad du sbyar ba la brten nas gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu ston par byed/ gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang / rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba rtsa bshad du sbyar ba la brten nas gsang 'dus yo ga ltar bkral ba'i gsang 'dus lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor ston pa yin la/

bzhi pa shanti pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog ces bya ba/ de yang lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor ston par byed/ kha cig gis 'di nyid ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i rjes 'brangs yin zer yang / de ni ma yin te/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos gsang 'dus yo ga ltar bkral pa yin la/ 'dis ni gsang 'dus bla med ltar bkral 'dug pa'i phyir/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i 'grel pa dang / smṛrti'i 'grel pa gnyis su yang lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor re re ston par byed pa yin/ de rnams kyi nang nas 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi bshad srol de nyid gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la/ dgongs 'grel mkhan po rnams kyis bstan bcos ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ lam la slob pa'i rim pa/ dngos kyi bstan byar gyur pa'i nyams len mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rtsa bshad le'u bcu bdun yan chad la btus pa'i sgrub thabs mdor byas zhes kyang bya/ bsdus rim zhes kyang bya ba'i mtshan gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgrub thabs/ de nyid rgya gar du paṇḍi ta 'ga' zhig gis rgyud kyi dgongs par ma song zer ba la/ rgyud kyi dgongs par song ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di dang 'di yin zer ba bstan pa'i phyir du/ sgrub thabs mdo dang bsre ba dang / rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i thun mong ba byang chub sems 'grel dang bstan bcos rnam par dag pa bzhi mdzad do/ /'phags pa'i dngos slob arya de was/ spyod bsdus sgron me/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong / mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa dang bzhi mdzad do/ /yang dngos kyi slob ma klu byang gis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed ston par byed pa rnam gzhag rim pa/ rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa/ rdzogs rim rim pa khongs su bsdu ba'i man ngag

las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa/ yang dngos kyi slob mar gyur pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung dngos su med la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim pa lnga pa de'i nang gi rim pa gnyis pa de mdzad pa yin gsungs na yang / paṇḍi ta legs smin ka ras 'dir rim pa gnyis pa 'di shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa ma yin/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir du mdzad byang bcug pa yin zer ba dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis shākya bshes gnyen slob dpon klu sgrub kyi mtshan yin zer ba rnams don la gnas pa ma yin te/ rang lugs la 'gos kyi stong thun du gsungs pa ltar/ rim pa dang po dang / rim pa gnyis pa'i/ srid pa'i gzeb las grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa yan klu sgrub kyis mdzad nas/ de man gyi rim pa gnyis pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa yin no/ /sgra gcan 'dzin bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zung 'jug gsal ba/ nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog mngon shes can gyis mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon rab 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga de rnams kyi rten sa'am/ rgyab rten du gyur pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i 'grel chen sgron gsal/ rang lugs kyis tshad mar 'dzin pa'i bstan bcos rnam par dag pa bco brgyad po 'di rnams yin no/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di nyid bu rin po ches the tshom can du 'dug ste/ klu byang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zer ro/ /de la red mda' pa na re/ khyed kyi de slob dpon gyis byas pa rnam dag ma yin te/ slob mas byas pa dang mi mthun pa 'dug pa'i phyir du 'dug pa'i de ltar na klu byang gis mdzad pa de rnam dag ma yin/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa de rnam dag yin te/

bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang mthun pa 'dug pa'i phyir zer yang / klu byang gis byas pa de nyid rnam dag yin te/ 'di tshad mar mi byed mkhan med pa dang / zung 'jug gsal ba las kyang / gang dag dbab par mi nus pa de dag ni mi dbab la/ dbab par nus pa de dag gis ni klu'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhin dbab par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ slob dpon de nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gtad pa'i gtad rabs bcu bzhi pa yin gsungs/ gzhan yang zla grags kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba 'di nyid la red mda' bas mdor byas tshig lhug par btang ba tsam yin 'dug pas 'di rgya 'grel ma yin/ bod 'ga' zhig gis byas pa yin 'dug zer ba yin yang / rang lugs la rgya 'grel yin te/ rgya dpe yang gnyis tsam 'dug pa dang / ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta dang / la li ta badzra gyis mdzad pa'i rgya 'grel yang gnyis tsam 'dug pa'i phyir/ sa paṇa gyi dngos kyi slob ma lho pa kun mkhyen gyi chos rje pa'i rnam thar du/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs de shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ de nyid chos rje'i gsung rgyun yin pa dang mdzad pa yin pa srid gsungs/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa yin na tshad ma'i 'grel pa mdzad mkhan gyi rgyan mkhan po yin gsungs/ dge ldan pa na re/ dbu ma pa chen por gyur pa zla ba grags pa de nyid yin la/ de nyid 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dngos kyi slob ma yang yin te/ klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin/ /de yi man ngag brgyud pa ni/ /zhes 'byung ba'i phyir zer yang / rang lugs la dngos kyi slob ma ni ma yin te/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i sgron gsal dang nang 'gal ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa skong pa'i slob ma'am/ rmi lam gyi skabs su chos gsan pa'i slob ma dang /

rje btsun birwa pas rje sa chen la chos gnang ba ltar gyi slob ma ni yin pa srid gsungs/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang / rgyud phyi ma gnyis kyi 'grel pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba dang / spyod bsdus sgron me'i 'grel pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad zer ba dang / rdzogs rim gyi gzhung don gsal dang / nor bu'i phreng ba gnyis klu byang gis mdzad zer ba dang / gsang 'dus kyi ro bsreg gi cho ga ya ra la wa tshul bzhi'i bshad pa arya de was mdzad zer ba dang / mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel zla grags kyis mdzad zer ba 'di rnams ni bstan bcos rnam par dag pa ma yin no/ /klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba dang / shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad zer ba dang / klu byang gis mdzad zer ba rnams ni/ zom rong chos bzang gis byas par shes par bya'o/ /gzhan gnyis kyang paṇḍi ta de dang des mdzad pa ma yin no/ /de bod kha ba can du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul la/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos paṇḍi ta pra ta la zhus nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi bshad bka'/ dbang bka'/ rim lnga'i khrid bka' rnams gsan/ bod du dar bar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa yod kyang / thugs dam de gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang / bde mchog la mdzad/ 'chad nyan gyi mthil de kri yog bde gsum la mdzad pas bod du dar bar ma byung / yang 'brog mi lo tsā bas paṇḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can la zhus nas/ paṇḍi ta de nyid rje ga ya dha ra yin gsungs/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bka' bshad bka' la sogs pa gsan kyang / de yang da lta chad nas med gsungs/ yang jo bo rjes rong pa mgar dge la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bka' bshad bka' la sogs gnang nas de'i sgrub thabs tsam byas pa yod kyang / dbang bka' la sogs pa chad nas med gsungs/ yang chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis bal po'i paṇḍi ta ra went+ra pa la zhus nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad bka' dang / dbang bka' rnams de'i slob ma chag grags pa grub/

de'i slob ma jo btsun me 'bar rnams la brgyud nas da lta dbang bka' ma chad yod gsungs/ 'brog mi'i slob ma 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis rgya gar du byon nas/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i sku gzhogs su zhag pa mdzad nas/ paṇḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can/ mngon shes can/ btsun mo can/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje ste bla ma bzhi la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bka'/ bshad bka'/ rim lnga'i khrid bka' rnams zhus nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor la shin tu mkhas pa zhig byung / de nyid kyis bstan bcos mdzad pa la/ rtsa rgyud kyi mchan mdzad nas deb brgyad tsam yod pa gcig sgron gsal la yang mchan mdzad pa dang / 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo zhes bstan bcos rnam par dag pa gcig dang / btsun mo can la sogs pa rnams la rdzogs rim zhus pa'i 'gos kyi shog dril gsum dang bstan bcos rnam par dag pa bzhi mdzad/ 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo 'di dang / rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ljon shing dang / dus 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnams kyis byas pa'i 'od zer brgya ba 'di gsum las bod na bstan bcos bzang ba med gsungs/ 'gos kyi slob ma rdog ye shes seṅges mdzad pa la gzhung phran rnams la sa bcad re tsam mdzad pa yod/ des rdog nyi ma seṅge la gnang / 'di nyid kyis bstan bcos mdzad pa la/ 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung phran rnams la sa bcad re dang 'grel pa re mdzad/ stong thun bar pa zhes bya ba dang / sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa dang / sgron chung rnams mdzad/ de nyid kyis brlan btsad tsha nyi ma lcam la gnang / de nyid kyis bstan bcos mdzad pa rnams la yang gzhung phran rnams la zin bris re tsam mdzad pa dang / sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa sgron bar rnams mdzad/ de nyid kyis rdog nyi ma seṅges sras po rdog arya de wa la gnang / 'di nyid kyis bstan bcos mdzad pa la gzhung phran rnams la yang zin bris cung zad tsam mdzad pa dang /

stong thun chung ba dang / sgron gsal gyi 'grel pa sgron chen rnams mdzad/ sa skya pa las brgyud pa ni 'gos kyis 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la gnang / rje sa chen gyis yab la ma gsan pa dang / yab kyi dngos slob skyu ra a skyabs la gsan/ brgyud pa gzhan yang 'gos kyis dbus pa dge ser la gnang / des gnam kha'u pa'i gcung po chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ des sa skya pa chen po la gnang / des rje btsun sku mched la brgyud do/ /de rjes bar skabs su brgyud pa chad pa lta bur song 'dug na yang / phyis sa skya paṇḍi tas paṇa chen shākya shrī la dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang / zung 'jug gsal ba gnyis kyi steng nas dbang bka' gsan/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i 'gyur yang mdzad/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgos kyi 'chad nyan pa la 'od zer shākya bskos nas 'chad nyan dar bar mdzad/ da lta nye rang gi gsang 'dus kyi bla ma brgyud pa la bu ston yong ba de yang / sa lugs nas brgyud pa yin te/ sa skya pa'i dges bshes don ri grags chen gyis kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la gnang / des bu ston la gnang / des mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams la gnang / des shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan la gnang / des kun dga'i mtshan can la gnang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa lam la slob pa'i tshul ni/ lam 'bras pa la/ lam rim can pa dang gcig car ba gnyis byung pa bzhin du/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang lam rim can dang / gcig car ba gnyis su gsungs pa yin te/ mkhas pa paṇḍi ta la lam rim can pas dkri ba ni/ arya de wa yin gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa ku su lu la lam gcig car bas dkri ba ni/ grub chen ma tang gi ba yin gsungs/ 'di nyid kyis lam gyi dkri ba'i tshul la yang / rgyud rkyang man ngag gi bshad pa dang / rim lnga gdan rdzogs gcig pa dang / dbang bskur tshul yang / dbang bzhi la dkyil 'khor bzhi dang / me tog dor tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi/ ye shes dbab pa'i tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi byas pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas lag bcangs su gtod pa'i gdam ngag yin gsungs/

'di nyid kyis ti li pa la gnang / des na ro pa la/ des mar pa la/ des rim lnga bsdus gsal mdzad/ de'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa la rgya pho ba lung pa dang / gtsang ron gyi me ston tshon po gnyis byung / pho ba lung pas rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi 'grel pa gcig kyang mdzad/ 'di lhad ma zhugs pa'i 'grel pa rnam dag cig yod gsungs/ gtsang ron gyi me ston tshon pos mdzad pa'i rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi 'grel pa de la/ na ro chos drug dang bsra se bsre se byas pa'i lhad zhugs pa'i 'grel pa rnam dag min pa 'dug gsungs/ 'di nyid kyi dbang bka' la sogs pa ni da lta chad nas med gsungs/ lam rim can du dkri ba 'di nyid gtan la 'bebs par byed pa 'di la/ 'gos kyi bslab tshan ring mor grags pa ltar du/ spyod bsdus sgron me las/ dang po nyid nas sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob pa na/ theg pa gsar pa dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob pa na rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob pa na/ bsgrub pa las dang po'i ting nge 'dzin la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob nas lus dben sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob nas ngag dben gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob pa na sems dben thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob pa na kun rdzob sgyu lus kyi rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob pa na don dam 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob pa na zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/ /de la lob pa na gang la yang bslab par mi bya ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngar yang dag par bslabs zin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar du dang po nyid nas sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di nyid kyis pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs pa lta bu yin la/

dngos su byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa bstan pa yin la/ theg pa gsar pa zhes pa ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di nyid/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang ma gsungs/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang mi gsung / da ltar gyi shākya thub pa 'di nyid kyis gsungs pas na/ theg pa gsar pa zhes pa dang / dran pa gcig pa zhes pa ni/ kye rdor ba ltar gyi lha dran pa gcig pa ste lha dpa' bo gcig pa lta bu gcig ngos 'dzin pa ni ma yin la/ 'dir ni gsang ba 'dus pa lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa gcig la ngos 'dzin pa yin la/ dran pa gcig pa la yang / sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa yin la/ 'di rdog lugs pa'i btsun pa 'ga' zhig gis dbang bskur med par rim lnga'i khrid ston pa yang 'ga' re byung 'dug pas/ sdom gsum rab dbyer/ dbang bskur med par gsang sngags ston pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi phyogs snga yang 'di yin gsungs/ dran pa gcig pa dngos ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor dran pas te sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas sgom par byed pa yin la/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la slob pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi sna rtse nas/ mar gyi gsang gnas kyi sna rtse gnyis su thig le yungs 'bru tsam gyi nang du gsang ba 'dus pa lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sgom par byed pa yin no/ /bsgrub las dang po pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bslab pa ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub 'dod pa dag gis ni rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa zla ba drug spyad nas/ de nas thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa yin la/ thun mong gi dngos grub mi 'dod pa phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa rnams kyis ni/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa ma spyad par/ lus dben sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'o/

/de ni nang gi sha khrag dang / rtsa rgyus dang / rus pa dang / khams dang / phyi rol gyi gzugs sgra la sogs pa rnams dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa yin la/ ngag dben gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa ni/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi ngo bor bsgom pa yin la/ de la lob pa'i tshad kyang rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi ngo bor rtogs nus pa la byas so/ /sems dben thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa ni/ las kyi phyag rgya ye shes kyi rig ma la brten nas bslab pa yin te/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo rig tsam du rtogs pa ni chos can rig pa yin/ de nyid skye med stong pa nyid du rtogs pa ni chos nyid rig pa yin la/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo rig tsam gyi ngang las sems gsum lha sku dang bcas pa rdo rje 'chang gi bskur bsgyur nus pa ni sgyu lus kyi rnal 'byor yin/ de yang rang bzhin skye ba med pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ni don dam 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor yin la/ de'i ngang nas rdo rje 'chang gi skur ldang nus pa ni zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor yin no/ /'o na zung 'jug dang sgyu lus kyi rnal 'byor gnyis la rdo rje 'chang du bsgyur nus pa la khyad par mi 'dug go snyam na/ khyad par yod de/ sgyu lus la sgyu ma tsam du zhen pa'i sgyu zhen yod la/ zung 'jug la sgyu zhen tsam yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /'di man chad gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos byung tshul rang du mi snang yang nyams len mngon shes rim pa'i gnad che rags shes pa la phan pa zhig 'dug pas bris pa yin no/ gsum pa nyams len mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la/ lha dgu'i mngon par rtogs pa/ lha bcu gsum ma'i/ lha bcu dgu'i/ lha nyer lnga'i/ lha so gnyis kyi/ lha so bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa dang drug yod do/ /lha dgu ma dang /

lha so bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa gnyis ni/ dus 'khor du bya ba'i rgyud rigs gsum/ rnal 'byor pha rgyud rigs drug gsungs pa'i nang gi dus 'khor ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bstan pa yin no/ /lha bcu gsum ma ni gsang 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud las dngos bstan du thon par gyur pa'i int+ra bo ti'i lugs yin/ lha bcu dgu ma ni mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor ston pa yin yang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ gang la rgyab bzhag dbus mar bzhag /ces gsungs pa ltar du/ 'jam dbyangs kyi rigs bdag mi bskyod pa yin pa de rigs bdag gi tshul du dbus su bzhag nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'jam dbyangs kyis byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang / gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor yang / 'od dpag med kyi rigs bdag gi dkyil 'khor yin te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs bdag kyang 'od dpag med yin pas/ de nyid rigs bdag gi tshul du dbus su bzhag nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor gtso bor byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis 'byung ba yin/ phyi ma 'di nyid lha bla ma 'od kyis jo bo rje la zhus nas/ nged spyan ras gzigs la mos pa yod pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang bskur gcig zhu byas pas/ de cis kyang rung gsungs nas spyan ras gzigs lha bcu dgu'i dbang bskur gnang ba yin/ nyi shu rtsa lngar byas pa kun snying gi yo gar bkral ba yin no/ /sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / smṛrtis bla med du bkral ba yang yod do/ /de rnams kyi nang nas lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor 'di rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan bcu gsum/ dgongs pa lung ston/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa sogs bshad rgyud nas kha bskangs nas ston par byed pa 'di klu sgrub lugs yin pas 'di gtan la 'bebs par byed pa 'di la/

gang gis bsgom par byed pa'i gang zag gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ ji ltar bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang ldan zhing / gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gcig dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni dben zhing nyams dga' ba rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bsgom/ gsum pa ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi don thams cad rim pa gnyis su 'dus pa yin te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis/ rdo rje can gyis chos bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /gcig ni bskyed pa'i rim pa ste/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'o/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las kyang / bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang / /rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa nyid/ /rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje can gyi chos thams cad rim pa gnyis su 'dus pas/ rim pa gnyis po 'di la yang bla ma gong ma rnams kyis rten dang brten par 'dod pa dang / dus 'khor ba rnams kyis bskyed rim rjes dpag gi lam dang / rdzogs rim mngon sum du 'dod pa dang / slob dpon arya de was/ gang zhig skye ba kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /'chi ba'i ming yang don dam bden pa yin/ /bden gnyis 'di dag bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /brnyed pa gang de ma 'ong sangs rgyas yin/ /gsungs kyang / rim pa gnyis nyams su blangs pa la brten nas ma 'ong pa na myur du sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i rim pa gnyis po de yang / bskyed rim gyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la ye shes brgyud nas 'dren par byed pa dang / rdzogs rim gyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la ye shes dngos su skyed par byed pa yin no/ /'o na de lta bu'i rim pa gnyis po de spang bya ji ltar spong ba dang / gnyen po ji ltar bskyed snyam na/

bskyed rim gyis skye ba gtso bor gyur pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum sbyong ba dang / rdzogs rim gyis 'chi ba gtso bor gyur pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum sbyong / gnyen po ji ltar bskyed snyam na/ gong du bstan pa ltar du rim pa gnyis kyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la rgyud nas ye shes bskyed pa dang / dngos su skyed par byed pa yin no/ /zhes pa la/ de rnams kyis rjes 'jug mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod ma lus pa bstan zin to// //'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams/ /dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla mas spel mdzad nas/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i bstan pa dar tshul 'di/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas phyir bshad/ /sngon tshe sngon nas 'brel ba'i 'dren pa mchog /yang dang yang du bskyangs pa'i bka' drin can/ /kun mkhyen kun gyi spro bsdu'i byed po gang / /yongs 'dzin yongs skyobs rje btsun mus par 'dud/ /khyed kyi mkhyen pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs/ /khyed kyi brtse bas ma khyab lus can su/ /khyed kyi nus pas nyon mongs ye shes bsgyur/ /khyed 'dra'i 'dren pa 'jig rten gsum na dkon/ /mkhas min mkhas par rlom pa'i blun po 'ga'/ /mkhas mchog khyed nyid mkhas par mi 'dzin na/ /skal ngan bskal brgyar dmyal ba 'dod pa'am/ /bdud kyis byin brlabs bdud tshig smra bar zad/ /de phyir dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas gang / /gang zhig bslu med bla ma skyabs kyi mchog /mchog gsum ma lus gcig tu 'dus pa'i rje/ /rje btsun gang de kho bos skal bas brnyed/ /sngon byon gong ma'i legs bshad rgya mtsho rnams/ /sngon tshe thos dang bsam pas ljongs 'di khyab/ /sngon gyi mdzad bzang rjes su slob 'dod nas/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rnams phyogs gcig bsdebs/

/'di ni ngo mtshar rin chen bang mdzod de/ /'di don rang dang gzhan gyis rtogs phyir dang / /'di la brten nas bstan pa dar ba'i phyir/ /'di nyid ri mor bris la legs bshad spel/ /deng sang blo chung rang blo'i rtsal zhan pas/ /dpyod ldan gsung rab dpyod la smod byed pa/ /dus ngan dus kyi snang tshul 'di 'dra la/ /legs bsam legs bshad don gnyer bya bar rigs/ /'on kyang bdag blo skyes dang sbyangs pa'i yid/ /yid 'phrog blo yi gsung rab don kun rtogs/ /rtogs pa de nyid gzhan la phan phyir bshad/ /bshad pa 'di yis ljongs 'di khyab gyur cig /gsang 'dus chos 'byung rin chen bang mdzod 'di/ /gsang 'dus chos bdag zhing skyong dbang por gyur pa gdong bzhi pa la gtad/ /gsang 'dus bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel ba'i phyir/ /gsang 'dus chos 'byung 'di nyid dar bar mdzod/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni/ grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba padma'i rnam 'phrul 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i mtshan can las lugs 'di'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog sogs yig cha du ma'i lung gi bka' drin nos shing / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam par sprul pa rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las/ lam gyi rtsa ba smin byed kyi dbang gi bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myangs la/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po byang chub kyi sems rdo rje buddha dhwa dza zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na g.yo ba'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid las/

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i grol byed zab mo'i khrid kyi rim pa smin rgyas su nos te/ de dang 'brel ba'i yig cha mdo byas/ mdo bsres/ rnam gzhag rim pa/ spyod bsdus sgron me sogs rgya gzhung mang po dang / de dag gi dgongs 'grel bod kyi gsung rab tshad ldan du ma'i bshad lung sogs mtha' chod par bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'i skal ba bzang po can/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ sngon dus rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul rnams la dwang 'dod kyi dad pa bcos min skyes pa dang / da dung kho bo cag rjes 'jug dang bcas pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas su bya nus pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam dag pa'i kun nas bslangs te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas te/ rgya gar lugs la raktā kṣī zhes pa mig dmar zhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la shing pho byi ba'i lo/ uttā ra phalgu ṇi zhes pa'i zla ba'i dmar cha bzang po gnyis pa'i tshes la/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ su kha shtsa hi tā stu/ phan bder gyur cig swasti dza yantu/ bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig ka lya na wardhantu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig swasti sra dza bhyaḥ skye dgu rnams bde legs su gyur cig cig zhus// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
